items.title: Grammar 1–3 · My Dream

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Explain or clarify something already stated using 可以說是.
grammarPages.explanation: 用來進一步說明前面的說話內容。「可以說是」和「可說是」的意思一樣。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 可以說是 / 可說是 + Noun / Predicate

patternRows.english: You could say I am your fan.
You could say he is an adult now.
You could call this my second home.

items.question: Can 可以說是 mean physical ability to speak?
items.answer: No. 可以說是 means 'practically / you could say'; use 可以說 without 是 for ability or permission to speak.
items.wrongTraditional: 我可以說是一句中文。
items.wrongSimplified: 我可以说是一句中文。

right.traditional: 我可以說一句中文。
right.simplified: 我可以说一句中文。
right.pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ shuō yí jù zhōngwén.
right.english: I can speak a sentence of Chinese.

items.question: Does 可以說是 replace normal 是 in direct facts?
items.answer: Use 可以說是 to soften a description or summarize; use ordinary 是 for direct factual identities.
items.wrongTraditional: 他可以說是我哥哥。
items.wrongSimplified: 他可以说是我的哥哥。

right.traditional: 他真的是我哥哥。
right.simplified: 他真的是我哥哥。
right.pinyin: Tā zhēnde shì wǒ gēge.
right.english: He really is my older brother.

text.traditional: 你演的戲，我都看了，我可以說是你的戲迷喔，快幫我簽個名吧！
text.simplified: 你演的戏，我都看了，我可以说是你的戏迷喔，快帮我签个名吧！
text.pinyin: Nǐ yǎn de xì, wǒ dōu kàn le, wǒ kěyǐ shuō shì nǐ de xìmí o, kuài bāng wǒ qiān ge míng ba!
text.english: I've watched all your dramas; you could say I'm your fan—please sign an autograph for me!

text.traditional: 他下個月就滿十八歲了，可以說是一個大人了。
text.simplified: 他下个月就满十八岁了，可以说是一个大人了。
text.pinyin: Tā xià gè yuè jiù mǎn shí bā suì le, kěyǐ shuō shì yí ge dàrén le.
text.english: He turns eighteen next month; you could say he's an adult.

text.traditional: 我在高雄住了十年了，這裡可說是我第二個家。
text.simplified: 我在高雄住了十年了，这里可说是我第二个家。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zài Gāoxióng zhù le shí nián le, zhè lǐ kě shuō shì wǒ dì èr ge jiā.
text.english: I've lived in Kaohsiung for ten years; you could call it my second home.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 可以說是 in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

segments.hint: Use the phrase meaning "you could say that".

questions.correctFeedback: 可以說是 explains and summarizes the situation before the noun phrase 個中國通了。
questions.repairFeedback: Use 可以說是 before the noun predicate; 可以說 without 是 indicates ability to speak.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This phrase is used to further explain or clarify something already stated. 可以說是 and 可說是 have the same meaning.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express feelings that exceed expectations using 多麼…啊.
grammarPages.explanation: 表示感嘆的意思，說明事情比本來想的程度高。表達時帶有誇張的語氣，「麼」可以省略，結尾以「啊」結束。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 多（麼）+ Adjective + 啊

patternRows.english: What a pity not to become an actor!
How cute that dog is!
How comfortable I am!

items.question: Can 多麼 ask for quantity or cost?
items.answer: No. 多麼 is exclusively an exclamation of degree ('how...!'); use 多少 to ask for prices or quantities.
items.wrongTraditional: 這本書多麼錢？
items.wrongSimplified: 这本书多么钱？

right.traditional: 這本書多少錢？
right.simplified: 这本书多少钱？
right.pinyin: Zhè běn shū duōshǎo qián?
right.english: How much is this book?

items.question: Does 多麼 modify a noun directly?
items.answer: 多麼 modifies adjectives/stative verbs, not bare nouns; say 多麼好 instead of 多麼人.
items.wrongTraditional: 他是多麼人啊！
items.wrongSimplified: 他是多么人啊！

right.traditional: 他是多麼好的人啊！
right.simplified: 他是多么好的人啊！
right.pinyin: Tā shì duóme hǎo de rén a!
right.english: What a wonderful person he is!

text.traditional: 你長得這麼好看，身高也夠高……不當演員多麼可惜啊！
text.simplified: 你长得这么好看，身高也够高……不当演员多么可惜啊！
text.pinyin: Nǐ zhǎngde zhème hǎokàn, shēngāo yě gòu gāo…… bù dāng yǎnyuán duóme kěxí a!
text.english: You are so good-looking and tall enough…what a pity it would be not to become an actor!

text.traditional: 那隻狗的眼睛大大的，耳朵長長的，多可愛啊！
text.simplified: 那只狗的眼睛大大的，耳朵长长的，多可爱啊！
text.pinyin: Nà zhī gǒu de yǎnjīng dà dà de, ěrduo cháng cháng de, duō kě'ài a!
text.english: That dog's eyes are big and its ears are long; how cute!

text.traditional: 外面熱死了，我在家邊看電視邊吃芒果冰，多舒服啊！
text.simplified: 外面热死了，我在家边看电视边吃芒果冰，多舒服啊！
text.pinyin: Wài miàn rè sǐ le, wǒ zài jiā biān kàn diànshì biān chī mángguǒbīng, duō shūfu a!
text.english: It's terribly hot outside; how comfortable it is to watch TV and eat mango ice at home!

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 多麼…啊 in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

questions.correctFeedback: Use 多麼 in the exclamatory pattern 多麼 + Adjective + 啊！
questions.repairFeedback: In an exclamation ending in 啊, use 多麼 rather than plain 很.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This construction indicates a feeling when one encounters something exceeding one's expectations. Expressed in an exaggerated tone of voice, the 麼 can be dropped, and an 啊 added to the end of the sentence, usually following an adjective.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Add an additional reason or explanation using 再說.
grammarPages.explanation: 「再說」當連詞。「再說」後面的句子是對前面句子所說的內容，補充、說明或提供進一步的解釋。
grammarPages.pattern: Clause 1 + 再說 + Clause 2

patternRows.english: You look good; besides, audiences approve of your performance.
I must submit two reports; besides, finals are soon.
You make many friends; besides, you understand yourself better.

items.question: Can 再說 alone mean 'say it again'?
items.answer: As a conjunction adding reasons, 再說 introduces a clause; to ask someone to repeat, say 請再說一次.
items.wrongTraditional: 請再說，我沒聽懂。
items.wrongSimplified: 请再说，我没听懂。

right.traditional: 請再說一次，我沒聽懂。
right.simplified: 请再说一次，我没听懂。
right.pinyin: Qǐng zài shuō yí cì, wǒ méi tīngdǒng.
right.english: Please say it once again, I didn't understand.

items.question: Where does conjunction 再說 sit in the sentence?
items.answer: 再說 sits at the beginning of the reinforcing clause, never at the very end.
items.wrongTraditional: 我不想去，沒有錢再說。
items.wrongSimplified: 我不想去，没有钱再说。

right.traditional: 我不想去，再說我也沒有錢。
right.simplified: 我不想去，再说我也没有钱。
right.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng qù, zàishuō wǒ yě méiyǒu qián.
right.english: I don't want to go; besides, I have no money.

text.traditional: 你長得這麼好看……不當演員多麼可惜啊！再說，觀眾也都很肯定你的表現。
text.simplified: 你长得这么好看……不当演员多么可惜啊！再说，观众也都很肯定你的表现。
text.pinyin: Nǐ zhǎngde zhème hǎokàn…… bù dāng yǎnyuán duóme kěxí a! Zàishuō, guānzhòng yě dōu hěn kěndìng nǐ de biǎoxiàn.
text.english: You are so good-looking…what a pity not to become an actor! Besides, the audience really approves of your performance.

text.traditional: 最近得交兩個報告，再說，快期末考了，下星期的旅遊我不去了。
text.simplified: 最近得交两个报告，再说，快期末考了，下星期的旅游我不去了。
text.pinyin: Zuìjìn děi jiāo liǎng ge bàogào, zàishuō, kuài qímòkǎo le, xià xīng qī de lǚyóu wǒ bú qù le.
text.english: I have two reports due, and finals are coming up; I'm not going on next week's trip.

text.traditional: 參加社團活動能交到不少朋友，再說，還能讓我們更了解自己，你為什麼不參加呢？
text.simplified: 参加社团活动能交到不少朋友，再说，还能让我们更了解自己，你为什么不参加呢？
text.pinyin: Cānjiā shètuán huódòng néng jiāo dào bùshǎo péngyǒu, zàishuō, hái néng ràng wǒmen gèng liǎojiě zìjǐ, nǐ wèishénme bù cānjiā ne?
text.english: Club activities help us make quite a few friends and, besides, understand ourselves better; why don't you join?

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 再說 in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

segments.traditional: 我也剛換好衣服，別出門了吧。
segments.simplified: 我也刚换好衣服，别出门了吧。

questions.correctFeedback: 再說 introduces an additional reinforcing reason.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 再說 to add another reason for not going out.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 再說 is used as a conjunction. The sentence following 再說 reinforces the content of the preceding sentence, or explains that content in greater detail.

dialogue.title: 對話 · Dialogue
dialogue.setting: 在咖啡店 · At the coffee shop

text.traditional: 東賢，沒想到才兩年沒見，你已經是個大明星了。你演的戲，我都看了，我可以說是你的戲迷喔，快幫我簽個名吧！
text.simplified: 东贤，没想到才两年没见，你已经是个大明星了。你演的戏，我都看了，我可以说是你的戏迷喔，快帮我签个名吧！
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: Dongxian, I never thought that after only two years, you are already a big star! I've watched all the dramas you acted in; you could say I am a fan of yours! Quickly sign an autograph for me!

text.traditional: 別這麼說，我還要繼續努力。
text.simplified: 别这么说，我还要继续努力。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: Don't say that; I still need to keep working hard.

text.traditional: 我覺得你已經很努力了。而且，你的中文進步得這麼快，是怎麼做到的？
text.simplified: 我觉得你已经很努力了。而且，你的中文进步得这么快，是怎么做到的？
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: I think you are already very hardworking. And your Chinese improved so fast, how did you manage that?

text.traditional: 我把劇本裡要說的部分，都請老師錄了音，一有空就不斷地聽，不斷地練習。這樣子才學得好、學得快。
text.simplified: 我把剧本里要说的部分，都请老师录了音，一有空就不断地听，不断地练习。这样子才学得好、学得快。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: I had the teacher record all the lines I needed to speak in the script, and whenever I had free time I listened and practiced continuously. That way I could learn well and fast.

text.traditional: 這真是個好辦法，難怪你進步得這麼快。對了，你對未來有什麼計畫？
text.simplified: 这真是个好办法，难怪你进步得这么快。对了，你对未来有什么计划？
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: That's really a great method, no wonder you improved so quickly. By the way, what plans do you have for the future?

text.traditional: 我從小就想當導演，腦子裡每天都想著這件事。有時連做夢都夢到自己拍電影的樣子，所以我打算明年開始學拍電影。
text.simplified: 我从小就想当导演，脑子里每天都想着这件事。有时连做梦都梦到自己拍电影的样子，所以我打算明年开始学拍电影。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: Ever since I was little I wanted to be a director, and I think about this every day. Sometimes I even dream of myself filming movies, so I plan to start learning film directing next year.

text.traditional: 導演？你長得這麼好看，身高也夠高，而且什麼角色都演得很好，不當演員多麼可惜啊！再說，觀眾也都很肯定你的表現。
text.simplified: 导演？你长得这么好看，身高也够高，而且什么角色都演得很好，不当演员多么可惜啊！再说，观众也都很肯定你的表现。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: Director? You grew up looking so handsome, you are tall enough, and you act well in every role; what a pity not to be an actor! Besides, audiences really appreciate your performance.

text.traditional: 導演還是可以演戲的。其實，要當好導演，不但得懂怎麼拍電影，也要教演員演戲，挑戰更大。
text.simplified: 导演还是可以演戏的。其实，要当好导演，不但得懂怎么拍电影，也要教演员演戏，挑战更大。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: A director can still act. Actually, to be a good director, not only must one know how to make films, but one also has to guide actors; the challenge is even greater.

text.traditional: 我聽說不少導演為了把電影拍好，連家都很少回去，有的還因為這樣離婚了。不過，我想只要你有實力，就不怕挑戰了。
text.simplified: 我听说不少导演为了把电影拍好，连家都很少回去，有的还因为这样离婚了。不过，我想只要你有实力，就不怕挑战了。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: I heard quite a few directors rarely go home just to make good movies, and some even got divorced because of this. But I think as long as you have real capability, you won't fear challenges.

text.traditional: 謝謝。今天能跟妳見面聊聊真好。
text.simplified: 谢谢。今天能跟你见面聊聊真好。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: Thank you. It is really wonderful to meet and chat with you today.

text.traditional: 那你以後別再跟我說，因為要演總統、石油公司大老闆什麼的，沒時間跟朋友聚一聚。不管多忙，你也要留點兒時間給朋友啊！
text.simplified: 那你以后别再跟我说，因为要演总统、石油公司大老板什么的，没时间跟朋友聚一聚。不管多忙，你也要留点儿时间给朋友啊！
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: Then don't tell me later that you have no time to gather with friends because you need to play a president or oil tycoon. No matter how busy, leave some time for friends!

text.traditional: 嗯！對了，也聊聊妳自己吧。妳學的是法律，以後要當律師吧？
text.simplified: 嗯！对了，也聊聊你自己吧。你学的是法律，以后要当律师吧？
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: Sure! By the way, let's talk about you. You study law, so you will become a lawyer in the future, right?

text.traditional: 其實，我學法律是因為爸爸的要求。他希望我先當律師，將來有機會當上市長就更好了。
text.simplified: 其实，我学法律是因为爸爸的要求。他希望我先当律师，将来有机会当上市长就更好了。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: Actually, I studied law because of my father's request. He hopes I first become a lawyer, and it would be even better if I have a chance to become mayor in the future.

text.traditional: 所以當市長是妳的夢想嗎？
text.simplified: 所以当市长是你的梦想吗？
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: So becoming mayor is your dream?

text.traditional: 唉，誰想當市長啊？不過，從小我爸媽什麼事都替我安排好了，雖然不喜歡，我也只能忍耐。
text.simplified: 唉，谁想当市长啊？不过，从小我爸妈什么事都替我安排好了，虽然不喜欢，我也只能忍耐。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: Sigh, who wants to be mayor? But since childhood my parents arranged everything for me; even though I don't like it, I can only endure it.

text.traditional: 其實，我們都不是小孩子了，自己的未來應該自己決定吧。
text.simplified: 其实，我们都不是小孩子了，自己的未来应该自己决定吧。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: Actually, we are no longer children; our future should be decided by ourselves.

text.traditional: 就是說嘛！但是我爸媽的想法太保守了，一時很難改變他們。
text.simplified: 就是说嘛！但是我爸妈的想法太保守了，一时很难改变他们。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: Exactly! But my parents' mindset is too conservative; it's very difficult to change them all at once.

text.traditional: 希望有一天，妳也能為了自己的夢想努力。
text.simplified: 希望有一天，你也能为了自己的梦想努力。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: I hope that one day you can also strive for your own dream.

text.traditional: 嗯，我們一起加油吧！
text.simplified: 嗯，我们一起加油吧！
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: Yeah, let's cheer each other on together!

items.completionDescription: Great progress! You completed the first part of this lesson.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Connect two clauses showing causal result or contrast using 而.
grammarPages.explanation: 「而」當連詞，「因為」的後面是事情的原因，「而」的後面是事情的結果。常用在書面或正式場合。「因為……（，）而……」有「因為……所以……」的意思。
grammarPages.pattern: Clause 1 + 而 + Clause 2

patternRows.english: Some directors became very famous because they made good films.
He moved to the countryside because he could not adjust to city life.
He lost his job because he drove after drinking.

items.question: Can 而 connect two nouns like 和?
items.answer: No. 而 connects two clauses or verb phrases; use 和 or 跟 to connect nouns.
items.wrongTraditional: 我想買蘋果而香蕉。
items.wrongSimplified: 我想买苹果而香蕉。

right.traditional: 我想買蘋果和香蕉。
right.simplified: 我想买苹果和香蕉。
right.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi píngguǒ hé xiāngjiāo.
right.english: I want to buy apples and bananas.

items.question: Where is 而 placed between two clauses?
items.answer: 而 stands before the second verb or predicate clause, not before the subject.
items.wrongTraditional: 他很聰明，而大家都喜歡他。
items.wrongSimplified: 他很聪明，而大家都喜欢他。

right.traditional: 他聰明而且善良。
right.simplified: 他聪明而且善良。
right.pinyin: Tā cōngmíng érqiě shànliáng.
right.english: He is smart and also kind.

text.traditional: ……還有一些導演因為拍出了好電影而變得很有名。
text.simplified: ……还有一些导演因为拍出了好电影而变得很有名。
text.pinyin: ……hái yǒu yìxiē dǎoyǎn yīnwèi pāi chū le hǎo diànyǐng ér biàn de hěn yǒumíng.
text.english: …Some directors have also become famous because they made good films.

text.traditional: 他因為不適應都市緊張的生活，而搬到了鄉下，過著自由、簡單的日子。
text.simplified: 他因为不适应都市紧张的生活，而搬到了乡下，过着自由、简单的日子。
text.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi bú shìyìng dūshì jǐnzhāng de shēnghuó, ér bān dào le xiāngxià, guò zhe zìyóu, jiǎndān de rìzi.
text.english: Because he could not adapt to the stressful city life, he moved to the countryside and lives a free, simple life.

text.traditional: 大家約他吃飯喝酒，慶祝他找到工作，沒想到他因為喝酒開車而丟了工作。
text.simplified: 大家约他吃饭喝酒，庆祝他找到工作，没想到他因为喝酒开车而丢了工作。
text.pinyin: Dàjiā yuē tā chīfàn hē jiǔ, qìngzhù tā zhǎodào gōngzuò, méi xiǎngdào tā yīnwèi hē jiǔ kāi chē ér diū le gōngzuò.
text.english: Everyone invited him out to celebrate his new job, but unexpectedly he lost it because he drove after drinking.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 而 in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

segments.traditional: 他因為不適應都市的生活，
segments.simplified: 他因为不适应都市的生活，

questions.correctFeedback: 因為…而… connects the cause directly to the subsequent action in one sentence.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 而 to link the cause with the verb phrase 搬到了鄉下.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 而 is a conjunction, 因為 is followed by the cause, and 而 is followed by the result of the matter. Commonly used in written or formal occasions. 因為……（，）而……means 因為……所以…….

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express producing a new creation or result through an action using V出.
grammarPages.explanation: 動詞後面加「出」可表示動作從裡到外的方向，例如：我從書包裡拿出鉛筆。本課動詞後面加「出」，表示動作完成後，產生新事物。常用的動詞有：想、做、說、穿、拍、寫、找、算、研究等等。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + Verb + 出 + Object

patternRows.english: Some directors made good films.
He wrote a novel.
I cannot make a satisfactory cake.

items.question: Does V出 mean physical movement out of a place?
items.answer: V出 here emphasizes creating or bringing an idea into reality (想出, 寫出); physical emergence uses 走出來.
items.wrongTraditional: 他從房間寫出來了。
items.wrongSimplified: 他从房间写出来了。

right.traditional: 他從房間走出來了。
right.simplified: 他从房间走出来了。
right.pinyin: Tā cóng fángjiān zǒu chūlái le.
right.english: He walked out from the room.

items.question: Can any verb take 出 to mean production?
items.answer: Only verbs of creation or cognition take productive 出 (想出, 做出, 畫出, 寫出).
items.wrongTraditional: 他吃出了一張畫。
items.wrongSimplified: 他吃出了一张画。

right.traditional: 他畫出了一張畫。
right.simplified: 他画出了一张画。
right.pinyin: Tā huà chū le yì zhāng huà.
right.english: He painted a picture.

text.traditional: ……還有一些導演因為拍出了好電影而變得很有名。
text.simplified: ……还有一些导演因为拍出了好电影而变得很有名。
text.pinyin: ……hái yǒu yìxiē dǎoyǎn yīnwèi pāi chū le hǎo diànyǐng ér biàn de hěn yǒumíng.
text.english: …Some directors have also become famous because they made good films.

text.traditional: 他花了三年的時間，最後寫出了一本大家都非常喜愛的小說。
text.simplified: 他花了三年的时间，最后写出了一本大家都非常喜爱的小说。
text.pinyin: Tā huā le sān nián de shíjiān, zuìhòu xiě chū le yì běn dàjiā dōu fēicháng xǐài de xiǎoshuō.
text.english: He spent three years and finally wrote a novel that everyone loves.

text.traditional: 我學做蛋糕學了很久，還是做不出讓自己滿意的蛋糕。
text.simplified: 我学做蛋糕学了很久，还是做不出让自己满意的蛋糕。
text.pinyin: Wǒ xué zuò dàngāo xué le hěn jiǔ, háishì zuò bu chū ràng zìjǐ mǎnyì de dàngāo.
text.english: I've studied cake-making for a long time but still cannot make a cake that satisfies me.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using V出 in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

segments.traditional: 他花了一年的時間，終於寫
segments.simplified: 他花了一年的时间，终于写

segments.hint: Result complement for creating a new work.

questions.correctFeedback: 寫出 indicates bringing a new creative work into existence.
questions.repairFeedback: Use the result complement 出 for creating and producing a new work.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Add 出 after the verb to indicate that the direction of the action is from the inside to the outside. For example, 我從書包裡拿出鉛筆. In this lesson, adding 出 after the verb means that new things will be generated after the action is completed. Commonly used verbs are: 想, 做, 說, 穿, 拍, 寫, 找, 算, 研究, etc.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: State that an outcome or decision remains unchanged regardless of a hypothetical condition.
grammarPages.explanation: 「就算」當連詞，後面是一個假設，表示不會因為這個假設的情況，而改變原來的事實或決定。例如：A：今天下雨，我不去學校了。B：不行，就算下雪，也得去學校。
grammarPages.pattern: 就算 + Condition (，) + 也 + Result / Action

patternRows.english: Even if extremely tired, Dongxian still feels very happy.
Even working twelve hours is still no problem.

columns.pinyin: èrshí nián bù chī bù hē
columns.meaning: no food or drink for twenty years

patternRows.english: Even without eating or drinking for twenty years, I still could not afford it.

grammar.pinyin: èrshí nián bù chī bù hē
grammar.meaning: no food or drink for twenty years

examples.speaker: 旁白
examples.traditional: 這種為了夢想的生活，就算累得不得了，東賢也覺得很開心。
examples.simplified: 这种为了梦想的生活，就算累得不得了，东贤也觉得很开心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng wèile mèngxiǎng de shēnghuó, jiùsuàn lèi de bùdéliǎo, Dōngxián yě juéde hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: For this kind of life for his dream, even if he was exceedingly tired, Dongxian still felt very happy.

text.traditional: 這種為了夢想……，就算累得不得了，東賢也覺得很開心、很滿足。
text.simplified: 这种为了梦想……，就算累得不得了，东贤也觉得很开心、很满足。
text.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng wèile mèngxiǎng……, jiùsuàn lèi de bùdéliǎo, Dōngxián yě juéde hěn kāixīn, hěn mǎnzú.
text.english: This kind of life for a dream…even when he is extremely tired, Dongxian still feels happy and satisfied.

examples.speaker: 方小姐
examples.traditional: 方小姐想多存一點兒錢，就算一天工作十二個小時也沒問題。
examples.simplified: 方小姐想多存一点儿钱，就算一天工作十二个小时也没问题。
examples.pinyin: Fāng xiǎojiě xiǎng duō cún yìdiǎnr qián, jiùsuàn yì tiān gōngzuò shí'èr ge xiǎoshí yě méi wèntí.
examples.english: Miss Fang wants to save more money; even if she works twelve hours a day, it is no problem.

text.traditional: 方小姐想多存一點兒錢，就算一天工作十二個小時也沒問題。
text.simplified: 方小姐想多存一点儿钱，就算一天工作十二个小时也没问题。
text.pinyin: Fāng xiǎojiě xiǎng duō cún yìdiǎnr qián, jiùsuàn yì tiān gōngzuò shí'èr ge xiǎoshí yě méi wèntí.
text.english: Miss Fang wants to save a little more money; even working twelve hours a day is no problem.

examples.speaker: 旁白
examples.traditional: 我覺得那個地區房子的價格太高了，就算二十年不吃不喝也買不起。
examples.simplified: 我觉得那个地区房子的价格太高了，就算二十年不吃不喝也买不起。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde nàge dìqū fángzi de jiàgé tài gāo le, jiùsuàn èrshí nián bù chī bù hē yě mǎi bù qǐ.
examples.english: I feel house prices in that area are too high; even if one does not eat or drink for twenty years, one still cannot afford it.

text.traditional: 我覺得那個地區房子的價格都太高了，就算二十年不吃不喝也買不起。
text.simplified: 我觉得那个地区房子的价格都太高了，就算二十年不吃不喝也买不起。
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde nàge dìqū fángzi de jiàgé dōu tài gāo le, jiùsuàn èrshí nián bù chī bù hē yě mǎi bu qǐ.
text.english: I think the homes in that area are all too expensive; even without eating or drinking for twenty years, I couldn't afford one.

items.question: Can 就算 and 雖然 be used interchangeably?
items.answer: No. 雖然 introduces an established fact, while 就算 introduces a hypothetical condition (even if).
items.wrongTraditional: 雖然明天考試很難，我也要去唱歌。
items.wrongSimplified: 虽然明天考试很难，我也要去唱歌。

right.traditional: 就算明天考試很難，我也要去唱歌。
right.simplified: 就算明天考试很难，我也要去唱歌。
right.pinyin: Jiùsuàn míngtiān kǎoshì hěn nán, wǒ yě yào qù chànggē.
right.english: Even if tomorrow's test is very difficult, I still want to go singing.

items.question: Can 就算 be paired with 但是 instead of 也?
items.answer: No. 就算 must pair with 也 (or 還) in the main clause, not 但是.
items.wrongTraditional: 就算下大雨，但是我一定要去跑步。
items.wrongSimplified: 就算下大雨，但是我一定要去跑步。

right.traditional: 就算下大雨，我也要去跑步。
right.simplified: 就算下大雨，我也要去跑步。
right.pinyin: Jiùsuàn xià dàyǔ, wǒ yě yào qù pǎobù.
right.english: Even if it pours with rain, I still want to go running.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 就算……也…… in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

questions.correctFeedback: 就算 introduces a hypothetical concession: even if it snows, I will still run.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 就算 to emphasize that the hypothetical situation will not change the decision.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 就算 is a conjunction, followed by a hypothesis, which means that the original situation will not be changed because of the content of this hypothesis. For example, A：今天下雨，我不去學校了。B：不行，就算下雪，也得去學校。

dialogue.title: 短文 · 追求夢想的東賢 · Dongxian Pursuing His Dream

text.traditional: 電影是許多人生活中的休閒娛樂，但是要把一部電影拍好，可不是一件容易的事。
text.simplified: 电影是许多人生活中的休闲娱乐，但是要把一部电影拍好，可不是一件容易的事。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: Movies are leisure entertainment in many people's lives, but making a good movie is by no means an easy task.

text.traditional: 東賢從小就對電影很有興趣，常常夢想自己能成為一位著名的導演。
text.simplified: 东贤从小就对电影很有兴趣，常常梦想自己能成为一位著名的导演。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: Ever since childhood, Dongxian has been very interested in movies, often dreaming of becoming a famous director.

text.traditional: 為了追求這個夢想，東賢高中畢業後就決定到臺灣學習中文和電影製作。
text.simplified: 为了追求这个梦想，东贤高中毕业后就决定到台湾学习中文和电影制作。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: In pursuit of this dream, after graduating from high school Dongxian decided to go to Taiwan to learn Chinese and filmmaking.

text.traditional: 起初，東賢的父母因為擔心他的未來而反對這個決定，希望他能留在韓國念商學。
text.simplified: 起初，东贤的父母因为担心他的未来而反对这个决定，希望他能留在韩国念商学。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: Initially, Dongxian's parents opposed this decision because they worried about his future, hoping he would stay in Korea to study business.

text.traditional: 但東賢拿出自己的計畫書，向父母保證自己一定會認真學習、照顧好自己。
text.simplified: 但东贤拿出自己的计划书，向父母保证自己一定会认真学习、照顾好自己。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: However, Dongxian presented his plan and guaranteed to his parents that he would study earnestly and take good care of himself.

text.traditional: 到了臺灣後，東賢一邊在大學念書，一邊在電影劇組實習，生活雖然忙碌但非常充實。
text.simplified: 到了台湾后，东贤一边在大学念书，一边在电影剧组实习，生活虽然忙碌但非常充实。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: After arriving in Taiwan, Dongxian studied at university while interning on film sets; life was busy yet very fulfilling.

text.traditional: 東賢說：「追求夢想就像畫一張美麗的圖畫，只要不斷努力，就一定能畫出精彩的人生。」
text.simplified: 东贤说：「追求梦想就像画一张美丽的图画，只要不断努力，就一定能画出精彩的人生。」
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: Dongxian said: 'Pursuing a dream is like drawing a beautiful picture; as long as you work continuously, you will definitely paint a splendid life.'

items.title: Grammar 1–4 · Convenience Stores Are So Convenient

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express that something was already done or known long before using 早就……了.
grammarPages.explanation: 使用「早就……了」表示說話的人感覺「很久以前已經……了」。比如：「我早就知道他不能來了。」、「蛋糕早就被吃光了。」
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 早就 + Verb Phrase + 了

items.question: How does 早就 differ from 已經?
items.answer: 早就 emphasizes the subjective feeling of 'long before / way ahead of time', whereas 已經 simply states factual completion.
items.wrongTraditional: 我剛才早就知道了。
items.wrongSimplified: 我刚才早就知道了。

right.traditional: 這件事我早就知道了。
right.simplified: 这件事我早就知道了。
right.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ zǎo jiù zhīdào le.
right.english: I knew about this a long time ago.

items.question: Can 早就 be used for things that just happened?
items.answer: No. 早就 implies a significant amount of elapsed time; for recent events use 剛才 or 剛剛.
items.wrongTraditional: 他早就剛剛出門了。
items.wrongSimplified: 他早就刚刚出门了。

right.traditional: 他早就出門了。
right.simplified: 他早就出门了。
right.pinyin: Tā zǎo jiù chūmén le.
right.english: He went out a long time ago.

text.traditional:
朋子：臺灣的便利商店有送洗衣服的服務，我怎麼不知道？
尚恩：早就有了，挺方便的。
text.simplified:
朋子：台湾的便利商店有送洗衣服的服务，我怎么不知道？
尚恩：早就有了，挺方便的。
text.pinyin:
Péngzi: Táiwān de biànlì shāngdiàn yǒu sòngxǐ yīfu de fúwù, wǒ zěnme bù zhīdào?
 Shàng’ēn: zǎo jiù yǒu le, tǐng fāngbiàn de.
text.english: Tomoko: Taiwan’s convenience stores have a laundry service? How did I not know? Sean: They have had it for a long time; it is quite convenient.

text.traditional:
A：我剛才聽說小張為了照顧生病的奶奶，下個月就要離開公司了。
B：這件事大家早就知道了，你怎麼現在才知道？
text.simplified:
A：我刚才听说小张为了照顾生病的奶奶，下个月就要离开公司了。
B：这件事大家早就知道了，你怎么现在才知道？
text.pinyin:
A:wǒ gāngcái tīngshuō Xiǎo Zhāng wèile zhàogù shēngbìng de nǎinai, xià gè yuè jiù yào líkāi gōngsī le.
B: zhè jiàn shì dàjiā zǎo jiù zhīdào le, nǐ zěnme xiànzài cái zhīdào?
text.english: A: I just heard that Xiao Zhang is leaving the company next month to look after his sick grandmother. B: Everyone knew that long ago; why have you only just heard?

text.traditional: 你不是早就計畫好要出國了嗎？怎麼出國前兩天才跟老闆請假呢？
text.simplified: 你不是早就计划好要出国了吗？怎么出国前两天才跟老板请假呢？
text.pinyin: nǐ bú shì zǎo jiù jìhuà hǎo yào chū guó le ma? zěnme chū guó qián liǎng tiān cái gēn lǎobǎn qǐngjià ne?
text.english: Hadn’t you planned your trip abroad long ago? Why did you only ask your boss for leave two days before leaving?

questions.correctFeedback: 早就 pairs with 過/了 to emphasize that something was told long ago.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 早就 to emphasize that the announcement occurred well in advance.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Using 早就……了 means that the speaker feels "It's been... It's already been a long time". For example, 我早就知道他不能來了。Or 蛋糕早就被吃光了。

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express doing a secondary action on the way using 順便.
grammarPages.explanation: 表示趁著做某件事情時，同時做第二件事，但不會增加太多麻煩或花太多時間。一般用在拜託某人做某件事，例如：朋友要去郵局寄信，我請他順便買個信封。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + Action 1 + 順便 + Action 2

items.question: Can 順便 be used for a special, deliberate trip?
items.answer: No. 順便 means 'in passing / on the way' without going out of your way; for a deliberate trip, say 特地 or 專門.
items.wrongTraditional: 我順便坐飛機去看你。
items.wrongSimplified: 我顺便坐飞机去看你。

right.traditional: 我特地坐飛機去看你。
right.simplified: 我特地坐飞机去看你。
right.pinyin: Wǒ tēdì zuò fēijī qù kàn nǐ.
right.english: I specially flew to visit you.

items.question: Where is 順便 placed in relation to the secondary action?
items.answer: 順便 sits immediately before the secondary verb phrase that you perform on the way.
items.wrongTraditional: 我去超商買牛奶順便。
items.wrongSimplified: 我去超商买牛奶顺便。

right.traditional: 我去超商順便買牛奶。
right.simplified: 我去超商顺便买牛奶。
right.pinyin: Wǒ qù chāoshāng shùnbiàn mǎi niúnǎi.
right.english: I went to the store and conveniently bought milk.

text.traditional: 如果餓了，就順便買個泡麵，還能免費使用熱水，真方便。
text.simplified: 如果饿了，就顺便买个泡面，还能免费使用热水，真方便。
text.pinyin: rúguǒ è le, jiù shùnbiàn mǎi ge pàomiàn, hái néng miǎnfèi shǐyòng rèshuǐ, zhēn fāngbiàn.
text.english: If you are hungry, buy instant noodles while you are there; you can even use the hot water for free. How convenient!

text.traditional: 紀先生下班經過朋友家時，順便把幫朋友買的筆電送去了。
text.simplified: 纪先生下班经过朋友家时，顺便把帮朋友买的笔电送去了。
text.pinyin: Jì xiānsheng xiàbān jīngguò péngyou jiā shí, shùnbiàn bǎ bāng péngyou mǎi de bǐdiàn sòng qù le.
text.english: When Mr. Ji passed his friend’s home after work, he also dropped off the laptop he had bought for his friend.

text.traditional: 小龍跟顧客介紹新產品的時候，都會順便說說他自己使用的經驗。
text.simplified: 小龙跟顾客介绍新产品的时候，都会顺便说说他自己使用的经验。
text.pinyin: Xiǎo Lóng gēn gùkè jièshào xīn chǎnpǐn de shíhòu, dōu huì shùnbiàn shuō shuo tā zìjǐ shǐyòng de jīngyàn.
text.english: When Xiaolong introduces new products to customers, he also talks about his own experience of using them.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Complete the book dialogues and answer the situations.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

questions.correctFeedback: 順便 introduces a secondary request done along with the primary trip.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 順便 for an action done on the way without extra trouble.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 順便 means that while doing something, do the second action at one's convenience, without taking too much trouble or spending too much time. Generally used to ask someone to do something. For example, 朋友要去郵局寄信，我請他順便買個信封。

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe two alternating actions or rapidly changing conditions using 一會兒…一會兒….
grammarPages.explanation: 「一會兒」作副詞，「一會兒……，一會兒……」表示兩種或多種情況先後或交替發生。說話的人覺得情況在很短的時間內改變，語氣有時有一點誇張。例如：「這幾天的天氣一會兒冷，一會兒熱，容易讓人感冒。」
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 一會兒 + Action 1 + 一會兒 + Action 2

items.question: Can 一會兒…一會兒… describe simultaneous actions?
items.answer: No. It describes alternating actions in quick succession; for simultaneous actions, use 一邊…一邊….
items.wrongTraditional: 他一會兒吃飯一會兒看電視。
items.wrongSimplified: 他一会儿吃饭一会儿看电视。

right.traditional: 他一邊吃飯一邊看電視。
right.simplified: 他一边吃饭一边看电视。
right.pinyin: Tā yìbiān chīfàn yìbiān kàn diànshì.
right.english: He is eating while watching television.

items.question: Can 一會兒 be used with a single verb?
items.answer: In this pattern, both parts must repeat (一會兒 A，一會兒 B) to show alternation.
items.wrongTraditional: 他今天一會兒哭。
items.wrongSimplified: 他今天一会儿哭。

right.traditional: 他今天一會兒哭一會兒笑。
right.simplified: 他今天一会儿哭一会儿笑。
right.pinyin: Tā jīntiān yíhuìr kū yíhuìr xiào.
right.english: Today he cries one moment and laughs the next.

text.traditional: 臺灣便利商店的店員一會兒煮咖啡，一會兒擦桌子，太辛苦了。
text.simplified: 台湾便利商店的店员一会儿煮咖啡，一会儿擦桌子，太辛苦了。
text.pinyin: Táiwān biànlì shāngdiàn de diànyuán yíhuǐr zhǔ kāfēi, yíhuǐr cā zhuōzi, tài xīnkǔ le.
text.english: Taiwan’s convenience store clerks make coffee one moment and wipe tables the next. It is exhausting.

text.traditional: 今天整天下雨，風一會兒大，一會兒小，這樣的天氣出門真麻煩！
text.simplified: 今天整天下雨，风一会儿大，一会儿小，这样的天气出门真麻烦！
text.pinyin: jīntiān zhěngtiān xià yǔ, fēng yíhuǐr dà, yíhuǐr xiǎo, zhèyàng de tiānqì chūmén zhēn máfán!
text.english: It has rained all day; the wind is strong one moment and weak the next. Going out in this weather is troublesome!

text.traditional: 最近來看房子的人多了起來，大家一會兒幫客人倒茶，一會兒帶客人參觀房子，所有的人都忙死了。
text.simplified: 最近来看房子的人多了起来，大家一会儿帮客人倒茶，一会儿带客人参观房子，所有的人都忙死了。
text.pinyin: zuìjìn lái kàn fángzi de rén duō le qǐlái, dàjiā yíhuǐr bāng kèrén dào chá, yíhuǐr dài kèrén cānguān fángzi, suǒyǒu de rén dōu máng sǐ le.
text.english: Recently more people have come to view houses; everyone is busy pouring tea for visitors one moment and showing them around the next.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Complete the book dialogues and answer the situations.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

questions.correctFeedback: 一會兒……一會兒…… links contrasting actions alternating rapidly.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 一會兒 to pair with the second 一會兒 for rapid alternation.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 一會兒 is an adverb, 一會兒……，一會兒……means that two or more situations occur one after the other or alternately. The person speaking feels that the situation has changed in a short period of time, and the tone has some exaggeration. For example, 這幾天的天氣一會兒冷，一會兒熱，容易讓人感冒。

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Give up a plan or accept a compromised situation using 算了.
grammarPages.explanation: 「算了」用於口語，表示說話的人對某個事物的情況不滿意，但是也不想再花時間、用太麻煩的辦法處理。「算了」可以單獨成句，也可以放在替代情況之後。例如，A：「對不起，我下個月很忙，不能跟你去旅行了。」B：「算了。」或「我找別人跟我去算了。」
grammarPages.pattern: Situation + 算了

items.question: Can 算了 mean 'calculated correctly'?
items.answer: As an idiom, 算了 means 'forget it / let it drop'; to calculate, use 算好了.
items.wrongTraditional: 這道數學題我算了。
items.wrongSimplified: 这道数学题我算了。

right.traditional: 這道數學題我算好了。
right.simplified: 这道数学题我算好了。
right.pinyin: Zhè dào shùxué tí wǒ suàn hǎo le.
right.english: I have calculated this math problem.

items.question: Can 算了 precede a noun directly?
items.answer: 算了 is a predicate exclamation or clause-final marker; it never acts as a noun modifier.
items.wrongTraditional: 這是一個算了事。
items.wrongSimplified: 这是一个算了事。

right.traditional: 這件事就算了吧。
right.simplified: 这件事就算了吧。
right.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì jiù suànle ba.
right.english: Let's just drop this matter.

text.traditional:
朋子：……你可以去那裡領。
尚恩：……我在便利商店領算了。
text.simplified:
朋子：……你可以去那里领。
尚恩：……我在便利商店领算了。
text.pinyin:
Péngzi:…… nǐ kěyǐ qù nàlǐ lǐng.
 Shàng’ēn:…… wǒ zài biànlì shāngdiàn lǐng suàn le.
text.english: Tomoko: …you can withdraw money there. Sean: …I will just withdraw it at the convenience store.

text.traditional: 這幾天工作忙死了，晚上不想煮飯，我想就去便利商店買算了。
text.simplified: 这几天工作忙死了，晚上不想煮饭，我想就去便利商店买算了。
text.pinyin: zhè jǐ tiān gōngzuò máng sǐ le, wǎnshàng bù xiǎng zhǔ fàn, wǒ xiǎng jiù qù biànlì shāngdiàn mǎi suàn le.
text.english: Work has been terribly busy these days, and I do not want to cook at night. I think I will just buy food at a convenience store.

text.traditional:
A：我的手機不小心掉到馬桶裡了，怎麼辦？不知道修理費貴不貴？
B：算了，我看別修理了，換支新的吧。
text.simplified:
A：我的手机不小心掉到马桶里了，怎么办？不知道修理费贵不贵？
B：算了，我看别修理了，换支新的吧。
text.pinyin:
A:wǒ de shǒujī bù xiǎoxīn diào dào mǎtǒng lǐ le, zěnmebàn? bù zhīdào xiūlǐ fèi guì bù guì?
B: suàn le, wǒ kàn bié xiūlǐ le, huàn zhī xīn de ba.
text.english: A: I accidentally dropped my phone in the toilet. What should I do? I wonder if repairs are expensive. B: Forget it; I think you should get a new one instead of repairing it.

grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

segments.traditional: 排隊要等二十分鐘，太久了，我們去別家吃
segments.simplified: 排队要等二十分钟，太久了，我们去别家吃

segments.hint: Colloquial phrase for accepting a compromise.

questions.correctFeedback: 算了 placed after an alternative action indicates a practical compromise.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 算了 to drop the long wait and choose another restaurant.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 算了 is used colloquially. The person speaking is dissatisfied with a situation, but does not want to spend time or to make too much effort to deal with or solve it. 算了 can be used alone or at the end of the alternative choice. For example, A：對不起，我下個月很忙，不能跟你去旅行了。B: 算了。Or 我找別人跟我去算了。

dialogue.title: 對話 · 便利商店真方便 · Convenience Stores Are So Convenient

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 你提著一大包東西，要去哪裡啊？
lines.simplified: 你提着一大包东西，要去哪里啊？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ tízhe yí dà bāo dōngxi, yào qù nǎlǐ a?
lines.english: You’re carrying a large bag of things; where are you off to?

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 我要去便利商店送洗衣服。
lines.simplified: 我要去便利商店送洗衣服。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yào qù biànlì shāngdiàn sòngxǐ yīfu.
lines.english: I’m going to the convenience store to send clothes for dry cleaning.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 臺灣的便利商店有送洗衣服的服務，我怎麼不知道？
lines.simplified: 台湾的便利商店有送洗衣服的服务，我怎么不知道？
lines.pinyin: Táiwān de biànlì shāngdiàn yǒu sòngxǐ yīfu de fúwù, wǒ zěnme bù zhīdào?
lines.english: Taiwan’s convenience stores have laundry services? How did I not know?

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 早就有了，挺方便的。我剛到臺灣時，跟朋友去便利商店，被嚇了一跳。
lines.simplified: 早就有了，挺方便的。我刚到台湾时，跟朋友去便利商店，被吓了一跳。
lines.pinyin: Zǎo jiù yǒu le, tǐng fāngbiàn de. Wǒ gāng dào Táiwān shí, gēn péngyou qù biànlì shāngdiàn, bèi xià le yí tiào.
lines.english: They’ve had it for a long time; it’s quite convenient. When I first arrived in Taiwan, I went to a convenience store with a friend and was shocked.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 怎麼了？被什麼事嚇了一跳？
lines.simplified: 怎么了？被什么事吓了一跳？
lines.pinyin: Zěnme le? Bèi shénme shì xià le yí tiào?
lines.english: What happened? What shocked you?

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 我沒想到臺灣的便利商店有這麼多服務。像領錢、買票，還有收電話費、水電費什麼的。
lines.simplified: 我没想到台湾的便利商店有这么多服务。像领钱、买票，还有收电话费、水电费什么的。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ méi xiǎngdào Táiwān de biànlì shāngdiàn yǒu zhème duō fúwù. Xiàng lǐngqián, mǎipiào, hái yǒu shōu diànhuàfèi, shuǐdiànfèi shénmede.
lines.english: I never expected Taiwan’s convenience stores to offer so many services. Like withdrawing money, buying tickets, plus collecting phone bills, utilities, and so on.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 對，真的很多。我覺得現在臺灣的便利商店比以前方便，比如說，提供休息空間，讓客人坐下來，好好地吃個東西、喝點飲料。
lines.simplified: 对，真的很多。我觉得现在台湾的便利商店比以前方便，比如说，提供休息空间，让客人坐下来，好好地吃个东西、喝点饮料。
lines.pinyin: Duì, zhēnde hěn duō. Wǒ juéde xiànzài Táiwān de biànlì shāngdiàn bǐ yǐqián fāngbiàn, bǐrú shuō, tígōng xiūxí kōngjiān, ràng kèrén zuò xiàlai, hǎohāode chī ge dōngxi, hē diǎn yǐnliào.
lines.english: Right, really a lot. I feel Taiwan’s convenience stores now are more convenient than before; for instance, providing seating areas so customers can sit down and comfortably have a bite to eat or drink a beverage.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 是啊。現在我早晚都去，有時候整個下午都在那裡看書、寫功課。如果餓了，就順便買個泡麵，還能免費使用熱水，真方便。
lines.simplified: 是啊。现在我早晚都去，有时候整个下午都在那里看书、写功课。如果饿了，就顺便买个泡面，还能免费使用热水，真方便。
lines.pinyin: Shì a. Xiànzài wǒ zǎowǎn dōu qù, yǒu shíhou zhěng ge xiàwǔ dōu zài nàlǐ kànshū, xiě gōngkè. Rúguǒ è le, jiù shùnbiàn mǎi ge pàomiàn, hái néng miǎnfèi shǐyòng rèshuǐ, zhēn fāngbiàn.
lines.english: Yeah. Now I go both morning and night; sometimes I spend the whole afternoon there reading and doing homework. If I get hungry, I casually buy instant noodles, and can even use hot water for free; it’s really convenient.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 我來不及做早餐的話，就去那裡買個饅頭、牛奶。有時候也去買最愛的熱狗跟汽水，雖然沒什麼營養，但是可以讓心情變得更好，哈哈哈！
lines.simplified: 我来不及做早餐的话，就去那里买个馒头、牛奶。有时候也去买最爱的热狗跟汽水，虽然没什么营养，但是可以让心情变得更好，哈哈哈！
lines.pinyin: Wǒ láibují zuò zǎocān dehuà, jiù qù nàlǐ mǎi ge mántou, niúnǎi. Yǒu shíhou yě qù mǎi zuì ài de règǒu gēn qìshuǐ, suīrán méi shénme yíngyǎng, dànshì kěyǐ ràng xīnqíng biàn de gèng hǎo, hāhāhā!
lines.english: If I don’t have time to make breakfast, I go there to buy a steamed bun and milk. Sometimes I also buy my favorite hot dog and soda; although not very nutritious, it puts me in a better mood, hahaha!

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 是啊。對了，我聽說日本的便利商店也很方便，商品也很多。
lines.simplified: 是啊。对了，我听说日本的便利商店也很方便，商品也很多。
lines.pinyin: Shì a. Duì le, wǒ tīngshuō Rìběn de biànlì shāngdiàn yě hěn fāngbiàn, shāngpǐn yě hěn duō.
lines.english: Yeah. By the way, I heard convenience stores in Japan are also very convenient, and have lots of merchandise.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 跟臺灣的差不多。從中餐、西餐，到白菜、香蕉等蔬菜水果都買得到，也有各式各樣的生活用品。
lines.simplified: 跟台湾的差不多。从中餐、西餐，到白菜、香蕉等蔬菜水果都买得到，也有各式各样的生活用品。
lines.pinyin: Gēn Táiwān de chàbùduō. Cóng zhōngcān, xīcān, dào báicài, xiāngjiāo děng shūcài shuǐguǒ dōu mǎi de dào, yě yǒu gèshì gèyàng de shēnghuó yòngpǐn.
lines.english: About the same as Taiwan’s. From Chinese food and Western meals to vegetables and fruits like cabbage and bananas, you can buy them all; there are also all kinds of daily necessities.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 我個人覺得便利商店在日本和臺灣能夠成功，除了是二十四小時的，也因為提供的服務非常多，能滿足大家的需求。
lines.simplified: 我个人觉得便利商店在日本和台湾能够成功，除了是二十四小时的，也因为提供的服务非常多，能满足大家的需求。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ gèrén juéde biànlì shāngdiàn zài Rìběn hàn Táiwān nénggòu chénggōng, chúle shì èrshísì xiǎoshí de, yě yīnwèi tígōng de fúwù fēicháng duō, néng mǎnzú dàjiā de xūqiú.
lines.english: Personally, I think convenience stores are successful in Japan and Taiwan not only because they are open 24 hours, but also because they provide so many services, meeting everyone’s needs.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 嗯，我同意。法國沒有這樣的商店嗎？
lines.simplified: 嗯，我同意。法国没有这样的商店吗？
lines.pinyin: Èn, wǒ tóngyì. Fǎguó méiyǒu zhèyàng de shāngdiàn ma?
lines.english: Mm, I agree. Doesn’t France have stores like this?

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 法國沒有二十四小時的，也沒有這麼多服務。我想主要是因為法國人的想法和工作習慣跟臺灣人不一樣吧。
lines.simplified: 法国没有二十四小时的，也没有这么多服务。我想主要是因为法国人的想法和工作习惯跟台湾人不一样吧。
lines.pinyin: Fǎguó méiyǒu èrshísì xiǎoshí de, yě méiyǒu zhème duō fúwù. Wǒ xiǎng zhǔyào shì yīnwèi Fǎguórén de xiǎngfǎ hàn gōngzuò xíguàn gēn Táiwānrén bù yíyàng ba.
lines.english: France doesn’t have 24-hour ones, nor so many services. I think it’s mainly because French people’s mindset and working habits are different from Taiwanese people’s.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 我的法國朋友也說，臺灣便利商店的店員一會兒煮咖啡，一會兒擦桌子，太辛苦了。
lines.simplified: 我的法国朋友也说，台湾便利商店的店员一会儿煮咖啡，一会儿擦桌子，太辛苦了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ de Fǎguó péngyou yě shuō, Táiwān biànlì shāngdiàn de diànyuán yìhuǐr zhǔ kāfēi, yìhuǐr cā zhuōzi, tài xīnkǔ le.
lines.english: My French friend also said that Taiwanese convenience store clerks make coffee one moment and wipe tables the next; it’s so hard!

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 是啊，他們真的太忙了。（看錶）不好意思，我等一下有個約會，現在得先去送洗衣服了，也順便領點錢。
lines.simplified: 是啊，他们真的太忙了。（看表）不好意思，我等一下有个约会，现在得先去送洗衣服了，也顺便领点钱。
lines.pinyin: Shì a, tāmen zhēnde tài máng le. (Kàn biǎo) Bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ děng yíxià yǒu ge yuēhuì, xiànzài děi xiān qù sòngxǐ yīfu le, yě shùnbiàn lǐng diǎn qián.
lines.english: Yeah, they really are too busy. (Looks at watch) Excuse me, I have an appointment shortly, so I need to go drop off the laundry now and also withdraw some cash on the way.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 附近有一家銀行的自動提款機不收手續費，你可以去那裡領。
lines.simplified: 附近有一家银行的自动提款机不收手续费，你可以去那里领。
lines.pinyin: Fùjìn yǒu yì jiā yínháng de zìdòng tíkuǎnjī bù shōu shǒuxùfèi, nǐ kěyǐ qù nàlǐ lǐng.
lines.english: There is an ATM from a nearby bank that doesn’t charge fees; you could withdraw there.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 沒關係，手續費不過幾塊錢，我在便利商店領算了。
lines.simplified: 没关系，手续费不过几块钱，我在便利商店领算了。
lines.pinyin: Méi guānxi, shǒuxùfèi búguò jǐ kuài qián, wǒ zài biànlì shāngdiàn lǐng suànle.
lines.english: That’s fine; the transaction fee is only a few dollars, I might as well just withdraw it at the convenience store.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 嗯，你說的對。
lines.simplified: 嗯，你说的对。
lines.pinyin: Èn, nǐ shuō de duì.
lines.english: Mm, you’re right.

items.completionDescription: Great progress! You completed the first part of this lesson.

items.title: Grammar 5–7 · Convenience Stores Are So Convenient

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express separating things or moving away from a spot using the complement 開.
grammarPages.explanation: 「開」當結果補語，有「本來在一起的東西分離」的意思，例如：打「開」、拉「開」。「開」也有「人或物離開本來的地方」的意思，例如：走「開」、離「開」、拿「開」等。也可以在結果補語「開」的前面加上可能補語「得」或「不」，例如：打「得」開、打「不」開、走「得」開、走「不」開等。
grammarPages.pattern: Verb + 開 / 得開 / 不開

items.question: How does complement 開 differ from 開始?
items.answer: Complement 開 indicates separation or leaving a spot (打不開, 走不開). 開始 indicates the onset of an action.
items.wrongTraditional: 我打開始了書本。
items.wrongSimplified: 我打开始了书本。

right.traditional: 我打開了課本。
right.simplified: 我打开了课本。
right.pinyin: Wǒ dǎ kāi le kèběn.
right.english: I opened the textbook.

items.question: What does 走不開 mean?
items.answer: 走不開 means being tied up and unable to leave one's post, not physical inability to walk.
items.wrongTraditional: 我腳痛，走不開路。
items.wrongSimplified: 我脚痛，走不开路。

right.traditional: 我在做飯，現在走不開。
right.simplified: 我在做饭，现在走不开。
right.pinyin: Wǒ zài zuòfàn, xiànzài zǒu bu kāi.
right.english: I am cooking and cannot step away right now.

text.traditional: 在臺灣，許多人的生活離不開超商，……
text.simplified: 在台湾，许多人的生活离不开超商，……
text.pinyin: zài Táiwān, xǔduō rén de shēnghuó lí bu kāi chāoshāng,……
text.english: In Taiwan, many people cannot do without convenience stores in their daily lives…

text.traditional:
A：這個門我開了半天就是打不開，你過來看看。
B：你拿錯鑰匙了，怎麼打得開呢？
text.simplified:
A：这个门我开了半天就是打不开，你过来看看。
B：你拿错钥匙了，怎么打得开呢？
text.pinyin:
A:zhège mén wǒ kāi le bàntiān jiùshì dǎ bu kāi, nǐ guòlái kàn kan.
B: nǐ ná cuò yàoshi le, zěnme dǎ de kāi ne?
text.english: A: I have tried opening this door for ages, but it will not open. Come and look. B: You have the wrong key; how could you open it?

text.traditional:
A：媽媽，舅舅打電話給妳。
B：我在煎魚呢，走不開，跟他說我十分鐘後打過去。
text.simplified:
A：妈妈，舅舅打电话给你。
B：我在煎鱼呢，走不开，跟他说我十分钟后打过去。
text.pinyin:
A:māma, jiùjiu dǎ diànhuà gěi nǐ.
B: wǒ zài jiān yú ne, zǒu bu kāi, gēn tā shuō wǒ shí fēnzhōng hòu dǎ guòqù.
text.english: A: Mum, Uncle is calling you. B: I am frying fish and cannot get away; tell him I will call back in ten minutes.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Complete the book dialogues and answer the situations.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

segments.traditional: 上課了，請大家把課本翻
segments.simplified: 上课了，请大家把课本翻

questions.correctFeedback: 翻開 expresses opening a book so pages are parted.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 開 as the result complement for opening apart.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: When 開 is used as a result complement, there is a meaning of "things that are originally together are now separated". For example, 打"開", 拉"開". 開 also means "a person or thing leaves the original condition". For example, 走"開", 離"開", 拿"開", etc. It is also possible to add possible complements 得 or 不 before the result complement 開. For example, 打"得"開, 打"不"開, 走"得"開, 走"不"開, etc.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express a result achieved through a process or time period using 經過.
grammarPages.explanation: 「經過」後面可接過去的一段時間，例如：他寫字寫得很慢，經過了兩個小時才把功課寫完。「經過」還可以接事情進行的過程，例如：我的電腦經過李老闆修理，好用多了。
grammarPages.pattern: 經過 + Process / Experience + Result

items.question: Can 經過 mean passing by a physical location?
items.answer: Yes, as a verb it means passing by; as a preposition here, it means 'through the process of'.
items.wrongTraditional: 經過超商我要買東西。
items.wrongSimplified: 经过超商我要买东西。

right.traditional: 經過超商時我想買東西。
right.simplified: 经过超商时我想买东西。
right.pinyin: Jīngguò chāoshāng shí wǒ xiǎng mǎi dōngxi.
right.english: When passing by the store, I wanted to buy something.

items.question: Can 經過 be followed immediately by an adjective without a process?
items.answer: 經過 introduces an experience or process, not an adjective attribute.
items.wrongTraditional: 經過高興他笑了。
items.wrongSimplified: 经过高兴他笑了。

right.traditional: 經過努力他成功了。
right.simplified: 经过努力他成功了。
right.pinyin: Jīngguò nǔlì tā chénggōng le.
right.english: Through hard work, he succeeded.

text.traditional: 有一些超商每經過一段時間，就會舉辦活動……
text.simplified: 有一些超商每经过一段时间，就会举办活动……
text.pinyin: yǒu yìxiē chāoshāng měi jīngguò yí duàn shíjiān, jiù huì jǔbàn huódòng……
text.english: Some convenience stores hold events every so often…

text.traditional: 他以前一句中文都不會說，才經過三個月，現在不但朋友多了，買東西還會講價呢！
text.simplified: 他以前一句中文都不会说，才经过三个月，现在不但朋友多了，买东西还会讲价呢！
text.pinyin: tā yǐqián yí jù Zhōngwén dōu bú huì shuō, cái jīngguò sān ge yuè, xiànzài búdàn péngyou duō le, mǎi dōng xi hái huì jiǎngjià ne!
text.english: He could not speak a single sentence of Chinese before; after just three months, he has more friends and can even bargain when shopping!

text.traditional: 我們社區的健身用品不夠，經過開會討論，決定下個月增加兩輛健身腳踏車。
text.simplified: 我们社区的健身用品不够，经过开会讨论，决定下个月增加两辆健身脚踏车。
text.pinyin: wǒmen shèqū de jiànshēn yòngpǐn bú gòu, jīngguò kāihuì tǎolùn, juédìng xià gè yuè zēngjiā liǎng liàng jiànshēn jiǎotàchē.
text.english: Our community does not have enough fitness equipment. After discussing it at a meeting, we decided to add two exercise bikes next month.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Complete the book dialogues and answer the situations.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

segments.traditional: 這件事，我覺得應該好好把握機會。
segments.simplified: 这件事，我觉得应该好好把握机会。

questions.correctFeedback: 經過 introduces the event or experience that led to the realization.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 經過 for having experienced a life event.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The 經過 of this lesson is followed by a period of time. For example, 他寫字寫得很慢，經過了兩個小時才把功課寫完。經過 can also show the results of a certain action, e.g. 我的電腦經過李老闆修理，好用多了。

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express the method or instrument used to achieve an objective using 用…來….
grammarPages.explanation: 「用」有使用的意思。「用 NP（來）V」表示使用某種方法或手段做某一件事。這裡的「來」可以省略，句子的意思不變。例如：「老師用很多例子來說明語法」和「老師用很多例子說明語法」意思是一樣的。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 用 + Tool / Method + 來 + Action

items.question: Can 來 be omitted in the 用…來… pattern?
items.answer: Yes. The book explicitly says that omitting 來 does not change the meaning. 用 introduces the means before the action.
items.wrongTraditional: 他用寫字來這支筆。
items.wrongSimplified: 他用写字来这支笔。

right.traditional: 他用這支筆來寫字。
right.simplified: 他用这支笔来写字。
right.pinyin: Tā yòng zhè zhī bǐ lái xiězì.
right.english: He uses this pen to write.

items.question: Can the purpose in 來 precede the tool in 用?
items.answer: No. The order is always Tool/Means first (用 X), then Purpose second (來 Y).
items.wrongTraditional: 他來寫字用筆。
items.wrongSimplified: 他来写字用笔。

right.traditional: 他用筆來寫字。
right.simplified: 他用笔来写字。
right.pinyin: Tā yòng bǐ lái xiězì.
right.english: He uses a pen to write.

text.traditional: 有一些超商……用送神祕小禮物的方式來吸引顧客。
text.simplified: 有一些超商……用送神秘小礼物的方式来吸引顾客。
text.pinyin: yǒu yìxiē chāoshāng…… yòng sòng shénmì xiǎo lǐwù de fāngshì lái xīyǐn gùkè.
text.english: Some convenience stores…use mysterious little gifts to attract customers.

text.traditional: 現在手機的功能很強，很多人都用手機來處理事情。
text.simplified: 现在手机的功能很强，很多人都用手机来处理事情。
text.pinyin: xiànzài shǒujī de gōngnéng hěn qiáng, hěn duō rén dōu yòng shǒujī lái chǔlǐ shìqing.
text.english: Phones have powerful functions nowadays, and many people use them to handle things.

text.traditional: 孔子常用講故事的方式來告訴學生做人做事的道理。
text.simplified: 孔子常用讲故事的方式来告诉学生做人做事的道理。
text.pinyin: Kǒngzǐ cháng yòng jiǎng gùshì de fāngshì lái gàosù xuésheng zuòrénzuòshì de dàolǐ.
text.english: Confucius often used stories to teach his students principles for how to live and act.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Complete the book dialogues and answer the situations.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

segments.traditional: 教授說這學期的成績主要是
segments.simplified: 教授说这学期的成绩主要是

questions.correctFeedback: 用 NP 來 V indicates the concrete method or basis used to decide.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 用 NP 来 V to state what the evaluation is based on.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 用 here means "to use". 用 NP（來）V means using a certain method or means to do something. The 來 here can be omitted, and the meaning of the sentence does not change. For example, 老師用很多例子來說明語法 and 老師用很多例子說明語法 have the same meaning.

dialogue.title: 短文 · 臺灣的超商 · Convenience Stores in Taiwan

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 在臺灣，許多人的生活離不開超商，所以街上到處都看得到超商，每走幾步路就有一家，有時候還能看到兩家超商連在一起。為什麼超商能吸引顧客不斷地上門呢？
lines.simplified: 在台湾，许多人的生活离不开超商，所以街上到处都看得到超商，每走几步路就有一家，有时候还能看到两家超商连在一起。为什么超商能吸引顾客不断地上门呢？
lines.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, xǔduō rén de shēnghuó lí bu kāi chāoshāng, suǒyǐ jiē shàng dàochù dōu kàn de dào chāoshāng, měi zǒu jǐ bù lù jiù yǒu yì jiā, yǒu shíhou hái néng kàndào liǎng jiā chāoshāng lián zài yìqǐ. Wèishénme chāoshāng néng xīyǐn gùkè búduàn de shàngmén ne?
lines.english: In Taiwan, many people cannot do without convenience stores in their daily lives, so convenience stores can be seen everywhere on the streets. There is one every few steps, and sometimes you can even see two stores right next to each other. Why are convenience stores able to attract a steady stream of customers?

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 一提到超商的優點，大家馬上想到的，就是可以買到各式各樣的東西。比如，忽然下雨了，沒帶傘的話，就能趕快進超商買把傘；天氣變冷了，就能買到厚的手套和帽子；要是想喝點兒下午茶，也能買到點心，順便再帶杯咖啡回家。而且在超商，還能付停車費、信用卡費、水電費，連送洗衣服都不是問題。
lines.simplified: 一提到超商的优点，大家马上想到的，就是可以买到各式各样的东西。比如，忽然下雨了，没带伞的话，就能赶快进超商买把伞；天气变冷了，就能买到厚的手套和帽子；要是想喝点儿下午茶，也能买到点心，顺便再带杯咖啡回家。而且在超商，还能付停车费、信用卡费、水电费，连送洗衣服都不是问题。
lines.pinyin: Yì tídào chāoshāng de yōudiǎn, dàjiā mǎshàng xiǎngdào de, jiù shì kěyǐ mǎi dào gèshì gèyàng de dōngxi. Bǐrú, hūrán xiàyǔ le, méi dài sǎn dehuà, jiù néng gǎnkuài jìn chāoshāng mǎi bǎ sǎn; tiānqì biàn lěng le, jiù néng mǎi dào hòu de shǒutào hàn màozi; yàoshi xiǎng hē diǎnr xiàwǔchá, yě néng mǎi dào diǎnxin, shùnbiàn zài dài bēi kāfēi huíjiā. Érqiě zài chāoshāng, hái néng fù tíngchēfèi, xìnyòngkǎfèi, shuǐdiànfèi, lián sòngxǐ yīfu dōu bú shì wèntí.
lines.english: When mentioning the merits of convenience stores, what immediately comes to mind is that you can purchase all kinds of goods. For instance, if it suddenly rains and you haven’t brought an umbrella, you can quickly step in to buy one; when the weather turns cold, you can purchase thick gloves and a hat; if you want afternoon tea, you can get a snack and pick up a coffee to take home on the way. What’s more, at convenience stores you can pay parking fees, credit card bills, and utilities; even sending clothes to be washed is no problem at all.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 逛超商也能夠增加不少生活的樂趣，因為超商經常進一些特別的商品來吸引顧客，像外國的零食、飲料和化妝品等；而且有一些超商每經過一段時間，就會舉辦活動，用送神祕小禮物的方式來吸引顧客。不少人為了這些小禮物，一天就去買好幾回。對臺灣人來說，超商就像一個親切的好鄰居，每次進去時，店員都帶著微笑對客人說聲歡迎，他們的服務態度真的很不錯。
lines.simplified: 逛超商也能够增加不少生活的乐趣，因为超商经常进一些特别的商品来吸引顾客，像外国的零食、饮料和化妆品等；而且有一些超商每经过一段时间，就会举办活动，用送神秘小礼物的方式来吸引顾客。不少人为了这些小礼物，一天就去买好几回。对台湾人来说，超商就像一个亲切的好邻居，每次进去时，店员都带着微笑对客人说声欢迎，他们的服务态度真的很不错。
lines.pinyin: Guàng chāoshāng yě nénggòu zēngjiā bù shǎo shēnghuó de lèqù, yīnwèi chāoshāng jīngcháng jìn yìxiē tèbié de shāngpǐn lái xīyǐn gùkè, xiàng wàiguó de língshí, yǐnliào hàn huàzhuāngpǐn děng; érqiě yǒu yìxiē chāoshāng měi jīngguò yí duàn shíjiān, jiù huì jǔbàn huódòng, yòng sòng shénmì xiǎo lǐwù de fāngshì lái xīyǐn gùkè. Bù shǎo rén wèile zhèxiē xiǎo lǐwù, yì tiān jiù qù mǎi hǎojǐ huí. Duì Táiwānrén lái shuō, chāoshāng jiù xiàng yí ge qīnqiè de hǎo línjū, měi cì jìnqu shí, diànyuán dōu dàizhe wēixiào duì kèrén shuō shēng huānyíng, tāmen de fúwù tàidù zhēnde hěn búcuò.
lines.english: Browsing convenience stores can also add much fun to daily life, because convenience stores regularly stock special items to attract customers, such as imported snacks, drinks, cosmetics, and more. Furthermore, every so often some convenience stores hold promotional events, using mystery gift giveaways to draw customers. For the sake of these small gifts, many people go make purchases several times a day. To Taiwanese people, the convenience store is like a friendly good neighbor; every time you walk in, the clerk smiles and greets guests with a warm welcome—their service attitude is truly great.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 不過，超商的工作是很辛苦的。在小小幾坪的空間裡，店員一會兒要收錢、找零錢，一會兒又要煮咖啡、幫客人把食物加熱，有時候還要教顧客使用機器買票。如果碰到態度差的顧客或看到滿桌的垃圾，也不能生氣。有顧客抱怨時，公司還會要求店員改善服務品質。想當好一個超商店員，真的不容易。
lines.simplified: 不过，超商的工作是很辛苦的。在小小几坪的空间里，店员一会儿要收钱、找零钱，一会儿又要煮咖啡、帮客人把食物加热，有时候还要教顾客使用机器买票。如果碰到态度差的顾客或看到满桌的垃圾，也不能生气。有顾客抱怨时，公司还会要求店员改善服务品质。想当好一个超商店员，真的不容易。
lines.pinyin: Bùguò, chāoshāng de gōngzuò shì hěn xīnkǔ de. Zài xiǎoxiǎo jǐ píng de kōngjiān lǐ, diànyuán yìhuǐr yào shōuqián, zhǎo língqián, yìhuǐr yòu yào zhǔ kāfēi, bāng kèrén bǎ shíwù jiārè, yǒu shíhou hái yào jiāo gùkè shǐyòng jīqì mǎipiào. Rúguǒ pèng dào tàidù chà de gùkè huò kàndào mǎnzhuō de lājī, yě bù néng shēngqì. Yǒu gùkè bàoyuàn shí, gōngsī hái huì yāoqiú diànyuán gǎishàn fúwù pǐnzhí. Xiǎng dāng hǎo yí ge chāoshāng diànyuán, zhēnde bù róngyì.
lines.english: However, convenience store work is very arduous. Within just a few ping of space, the clerk must collect cash and make change one moment, then brew coffee and heat food for customers the next; sometimes they also need to teach customers how to use the ticketing kiosks. Even if they encounter rude customers or see tables strewn with trash, they cannot lose their temper. When a customer complains, the company requires clerks to improve service quality. Being a great convenience store clerk is truly not easy.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 超商的功能多、服務速度快，但是也有缺點，比如有些商品比超級市場貴了點兒。不過，以臺灣人的習慣，不需要花太多時間就買得到想要的東西，就算多付一點兒錢也是可以接受的。
lines.simplified: 超商的功能多、服务速度快，但是也有缺点，比如有些商品比超级市场贵了点儿。不过，以台湾人的习惯，不需要花太多时间就买得到想要的东西，就算多付一点儿钱也是可以接受的。
lines.pinyin: Chāoshāng de gōngnéng duō, fúwù sùdù kuài, dànshì yě yǒu quēdiǎn, bǐrú yǒuxiē shāngpǐn bǐ chāojí shìchǎng guì le diǎnr. Bùguò, yǐ Táiwānrén de xíguàn, bù xūyào huā tài duō shíjiān jiù mǎi de dào xiǎng yào de dōngxi, jiùsuàn duō fù yìdiǎnr qián yě shì kěyǐ jiēshòu de.
lines.english: Convenience stores have many functions and fast service, but there are also disadvantages; for instance, some goods are slightly more expensive than at supermarkets. However, according to Taiwanese habits, being able to buy what you want without spending too much time makes paying a little extra acceptable.

items.title: Grammar 1–4 · It Won't Hurt to Shop Around

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Won't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express trying an action before deciding to buy or use something with 試+V.
grammarPages.explanation: 決定購買或使用某物品以前，先試試看是不是真的喜歡、真的合適。這個「V」常是單音節的動詞，例如：吃、穿、用、喝、開等。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 試 + Verb

items.question: When do you use 試穿 instead of 穿穿看?
items.answer: 試穿 specifically emphasizes testing an item for fit and suitability before deciding to purchase.
items.wrongTraditional: 你可以穿穿看這件洋裝，看合不合適。
items.wrongSimplified: 你可以穿穿看这件洋装，看合不合适。
items.wrongPinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ chuānchuān kàn zhè jiàn yángzhuāng, kàn hé bu héshì.
items.wrongEnglish: You can try wearing this dress to see if it fits.
items.explanation: While 穿穿看 expresses an attempt, 試穿 specifically highlights testing suitability prior to a purchase decision.

right.traditional: 你可以試穿這件洋裝，看合不合適。
right.simplified: 你可以试穿这件洋装，看合不合适。
right.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ shìchuān zhè jiàn yángzhuāng, kàn hé bu héshì.
right.english: You can try on this dress to see if it fits.

items.question: Can 試 be reduplicated before another verb (e.g. 試試躺)?
items.answer: No, use single 試 followed by a monosyllabic verb (試躺, 試吃, 試喝).
items.wrongTraditional: 買床的時候一定要試試躺。
items.wrongSimplified: 买床的时候一定要试试躺。
items.wrongPinyin: Mǎi chuáng de shíhou yídìng yào shìshi tǎng.
items.wrongEnglish: When buying a bed you must try lying down.
items.explanation: Do not reduplicate 試 before another verb; use single 試 + monosyllabic verb (試躺).

right.traditional: 買床的時候一定要試躺。
right.simplified: 买床的时候一定要试躺。
right.pinyin: Mǎi chuáng de shíhou yídìng yào shìtǎng.
right.english: When buying a bed you must try lying down on it.

text.traditional: 這套淺色的也很好看，妳都試穿一下吧！
text.simplified: 这套浅色的也很好看，你都试穿一下吧！
text.pinyin: Zhè tào qiǎnsè de yě hěn hǎokàn, nǐ dōu shìchuān yíxià ba!
text.english: This light-colored outfit is also very pretty; why don't you try them both on!

text.traditional: 買床的時候一定要試躺，覺得舒服再買。
text.simplified: 买床的时候一定要试躺，觉得舒服再买。
text.pinyin: Mǎi chuáng de shíhou yídìng yào shìtǎng, juéde shūfu zài mǎi.
text.english: When buying a bed you must try lying down on it, and only buy if it feels comfortable.

text.traditional: 那家超商提供新口味的飲料給客人免費試喝，喝過的人都說好喝。
text.simplified: 那家超商提供新口味的饮料给客人免费试喝，喝过的人都说好喝。
text.pinyin: Nà jiā chāoshāng tígōng xīn kǒuwèi de yǐnliào gěi kèrén miǎnfèi shìhē, hē guò de rén dōu shuō hǎohē.
text.english: That convenience store provides free samples of the new flavor drink for customers to try, and everyone who tasted it said it was delicious.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 試+V in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the correct phrase to complete the sentence.

segments.traditional: 這套沙發賣得相當好。您可以
segments.simplified: 这套沙发卖得相当好。您可以

questions.correctFeedback: 試坐 indicates testing the sofa by sitting on it prior to buying.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 試坐 before deciding to buy the sofa.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Before deciding to buy a product or to use it, first try to see if you really like it or if it is really suitable. There "V" are often monosyllable verbs, such as 吃, 穿, 用, 喝, 開, etc.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Won't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express disposal, consumption, disappearance, or undesirable removal with V掉.
grammarPages.explanation: 「掉」是補語，用在及物動詞的後面，有去除或出現不好的結果的意思，例如：吃掉、扔掉、賣掉、拿掉等。如果「掉」用在不及物動詞的後面，表示離開的意思，例如：走掉、飛掉、跑掉、壞掉等。
grammarPages.pattern: Verb + 掉

items.question: How does 掉 differ from 完 as a result complement?
items.answer: 完 indicates finishing a task; 掉 indicates disposal, consumption away, or undesirable consequence.
items.wrongTraditional: 沒穿幾次就破了，最後只好扔了它完。
items.wrongSimplified: 没穿几次就破了，最后只好扔了它完。
items.wrongPinyin: Méi chuān jǐ cì jiù pò le, zuìhòu zhǐhǎo rēng le tā wán.
items.wrongEnglish: After wearing a few times it tore, in the end had to throw it away.
items.explanation: 完 indicates finishing a process; 掉 denotes disposal, disappearance, or removal.

right.traditional: 沒穿幾次就破了，最後只好扔掉。
right.simplified: 没穿几次就破了，最后只好扔掉。
right.pinyin: Méi chuān jǐ cì jiù pò le, zuìhòu zhǐhǎo rēngdiào.
right.english: After wearing them a few times they tore, so in the end they had to throw them away.

items.question: Why is 跑掉 used instead of 跑完?
items.answer: After an intransitive verb of movement, 掉 expresses departing or escaping away.
items.wrongTraditional: 我擔心送他皮鞋，他會走完。
items.wrongSimplified: 我担心送他皮鞋，他会走完。
items.wrongPinyin: Wǒ dānxīn sòng tā píxié, tā huì zǒuwán.
items.wrongEnglish: I worry if I gift him leather shoes, he will walk away.
items.explanation: Use 跑掉 or 走掉 for running away or departing, not 完.

right.traditional: 我擔心送他皮鞋，他會跑掉。
right.simplified: 我担心送他皮鞋，他会跑掉。
right.pinyin: Wǒ dānxīn sòng tā píxié, tā huì pǎodiào.
right.english: I worry if I gift him leather shoes, he will run away.

text.traditional: ……沒穿幾次就破了，最後只好扔掉。
text.simplified: ……没穿几次就破了，最后只好扔掉。
text.pinyin: Méi chuān jǐ cì jiù pò le, zuìhòu zhǐhǎo rēngdiào.
text.english: After wearing them just a few times they tore, and in the end they had to throw them away.

text.traditional:
A：你那輛車不常開又舊得很，不如賣掉吧！
B：它還能開，賣掉太可惜了。
text.simplified:
A：你那辆车不常开又旧得很，不如卖掉吧！
B：它还能开，卖掉太可惜了。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ nà liàng chē bù cháng kāi yòu jiù de hěn, bùrú màidiào ba! B: Tā hái néng kāi, màidiào tài kěxí le.
text.english: A: You don't drive that car often and it's quite old; you might as well sell it off! B: It can still be driven; selling it would be such a pity.

text.traditional:
A：我擔心送皮鞋給男朋友，他會跑掉。
B：那就送他皮帶好了，這樣他就跑不掉了。
text.simplified:
A：我担心送皮鞋给男朋友，他会跑掉。
B：那就送他皮带好了，这样他就跑不掉了。
text.pinyin: A: Wǒ dānxīn sòng píxié gěi nánpéngyou, tā huì pǎodiào. B: Nà jiù sòng tā pídài hǎo le, zhèyàng tā jiù pǎo bu diào le.
text.english: A: I worry that if I gift leather shoes to my boyfriend, he will run away. B: Then give him a belt; that way he won't be able to run away.

words.pinyin: nà jiù sòng tā pídài hǎo le

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using V掉 in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the correct phrase to complete the sentence.

segments.traditional: 你那輛車不常開又舊得很，不如
segments.simplified: 你那辆车不常开又旧得很，不如

questions.correctFeedback: 賣掉 indicates disposing of an old car by selling it.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 賣掉 to express parting with an old car through sale.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The complement 掉 is used after the transitive verb, and it means to remove or produce bad results, such as 吃掉, 扔掉, 賣掉, 拿掉, etc. If the complement 掉 is used after the intransitive verb, it means to leave. For example, 走掉, 飛掉, 跑掉, 壞掉, etc.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Won't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express complete inclusion with one specific exception using 什麼(N)都……，就是…….
grammarPages.explanation: 「什麼（……）都……」表示「全部、任何」，例如：「他什麼忙都幫」表示他任何忙都會幫，「我什麼東西都吃」表示任何東西我都吃。而「就是」的後面是唯一的選擇或不同的情況。例如：他什麼茶都喝，就是不喝紅茶。
grammarPages.pattern: 什麼(N)都 + Predicate，就是 + Exception

columns.pinyin: lǎobǎn yào wǒ měi tiān jiābān

items.question: Why use 就是 instead of 只是 in 什麼都好……?
items.answer: In the structure 什麼(N)都...，就是..., 就是 specifically introduces the sole exception to universal inclusion.
items.wrongTraditional: 這個專櫃什麼都好，只是價格高了很多。
items.wrongSimplified: 这个专柜什么都好，只是价格高了很多。
items.wrongPinyin: Zhè ge zhuānguì shénme dōu hǎo, zhǐshì jiàgé gāo le hěn duō.
items.wrongEnglish: Everything at this counter is good, just the price is high.
items.explanation: When setting off a single exception against 什麼……都, 就是 emphasizes the sole exception.

right.traditional: 這個專櫃什麼都好，就是價格高了很多。
right.simplified: 这个专柜什么都好，就是价格高了很多。
right.pinyin: Zhè ge zhuānguì shénme dōu hǎo, jiùshì jiàgé gāo le hěn duō.
right.english: Everything at this counter is great, except the prices are much higher.

items.question: Why use 就是不能 instead of 只要不?
items.answer: To contrast total willingness with one single refusal, use 就是不能.
items.wrongTraditional: 我剛畢業，什麼工作都願意做，只要不加班。
items.wrongSimplified: 我刚毕业，什么工作都愿意做，只要不加班。
items.wrongPinyin: Wǒ gāng bìyè, shénme gōngzuò dōu yuànyì zuò, zhǐyào bù jiābān.
items.wrongEnglish: I just graduated, willing to do any job, as long as no overtime.
items.explanation: To single out an explicit non-negotiable exception to 什麼工作都, use 就是不能.

right.traditional: 我什麼工作都願意做，就是不能接受天天加班。
right.simplified: 我什么工作都愿意做，就是不能接受天天加班。
right.pinyin: Wǒ shénme gōngzuò dōu yuànyì zuò, jiùshì bù néng jiēshòu tiāntiān jiābān.
right.english: I am willing to do any job, except I cannot accept daily overtime.

text.traditional: 我覺得這個專櫃什麼都好，就是價格高了很多。
text.simplified: 我觉得这个专柜什么都好，就是价格高了很多。
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhè ge zhuānguì shénme dōu hǎo, jiùshì jiàgé gāo le hěn duō.
text.english: I feel everything at this counter is great, except the prices are much higher.

text.traditional: 我剛大學畢業，什麼工作都願意做，就是不能接受老闆要我每天加班。
text.simplified: 我刚大学毕业，什么工作都愿意做，就是不能接受老板要我每天加班。
text.pinyin: Wǒ gāng dàxué bìyè, shénme gōngzuò dōu yuànyì zuò, jiùshì bù néng jiēshòu lǎobǎn yào wǒ měi tiān jiābān.
text.english: I just graduated from university and am willing to do any job, except I cannot accept the boss asking me to work overtime every day.

text.traditional: 文小姐從設計學校畢業後，什麼服裝都設計過，就是沒設計過帽子。
text.simplified: 文小姐从设计学校毕业后，什么服装都设计过，就是没设计过帽子。
text.pinyin: Wén xiǎojiě cóng shèjì xuéxiào bìyè hòu, shénme fúzhuāng dōu shèjì guò, jiùshì méi shèjì guò màozi.
text.english: After graduating from design school, Ms. Wen has designed all kinds of apparel, except she has never designed hats.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 什麼(N)都……，就是…… in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the correct phrase to complete the sentence.

segments.traditional: 我覺得這個專櫃什麼都好，
segments.simplified: 我觉得这个专柜什么都好，

questions.correctFeedback: 就是 highlights the single drawback amidst general satisfaction.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 就是 to introduce the exception to 什麼都好.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 什麼（……）都…… means "all, anything", for example, 他什麼忙都幫 means "He will help with anything." And 我什麼東西都吃 means "I will eat anything." The statement after 就是 means the only option or different situation. For example, 他什麼茶都喝，就是不喝紅茶。

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Won't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Advise someone to stop doing an action with 別再……了, or state cessation with 不再……了.
grammarPages.explanation: 「別再……了」的意思是，說話的人建議或提醒對方不要再做某件事情了，例如：別再讓父母擔心了。如果說話的人要提醒自己或敘述別人不再做某件事情了，就使用「不再……了」，例如：我不再喝酒了。
grammarPages.pattern: 別再 + Action + 了 / 不再 + Action + 了

patternTable.title: Urging Cessation or Stating No Longer

items.question: When do you use 別再……了 vs 不再……了?
items.answer: 別再……了 is an imperative urging someone else to stop; 不再……了 states personal cessation or a factual report.
items.wrongTraditional: 媽媽，妳不再幫我洗衣服了！我自己會洗。
items.wrongSimplified: 妈妈，你不再帮我洗衣服了！我自己会洗。
items.wrongPinyin: Māma, nǐ búzài bāng wǒ xǐ yīfu le! Wǒ zìjǐ huì xǐ.
items.wrongEnglish: Mom, you no longer wash clothes for me! I will do it myself.
items.explanation: When urging someone else to stop an action, use 別再……了 instead of 不再.

right.traditional: 媽媽，妳別再幫我洗衣服了！我自己會洗。
right.simplified: 妈妈，你别再帮我洗衣服了！我自己会洗。
right.pinyin: Māma, nǐ bié zài bāng wǒ xǐ yīfu le! Wǒ zìjǐ huì xǐ.
right.english: Mom, don't wash clothes for me anymore! I can wash them myself.

items.question: How do you state your own resolution to stop an activity?
items.answer: Use 不再……了 for your own cessation, not the imperative 別再.
items.wrongTraditional: 如果這次比賽輸了，我就別再踢足球了。
items.wrongSimplified: 如果这次比赛输了，我就别再踢足球了。
items.wrongPinyin: Rúguǒ zhè cì bǐsài shū le, wǒ jiù bié zài tī zúqiú le.
items.wrongEnglish: If we lose this match, I shouldn't play soccer anymore.
items.explanation: When declaring your own determination to quit, use 不再……了, not the imperative 別再.

right.traditional: 如果這次比賽輸了，我就不再踢足球了。
right.simplified: 如果这次比赛输了，我就不再踢足球了。
right.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhè cì bǐsài shū le, wǒ jiù búzài tī zúqiú le.
right.english: If we lose this match, I will no longer play soccer.

text.traditional: ……別再買了，妳還要去看球鞋呢！
text.simplified: ……别再买了，你还要去看球鞋呢！
text.pinyin: … Bié zài mǎi le, nǐ hái yào qù kàn qiúxié ne!
text.english: … Don't buy any more; you still have to go look at sneakers!

text.traditional:
孩子：你別再幫我洗衣服了！我自己會洗。
媽媽：我怕你洗不乾淨，如果洗得乾淨，我就不再幫你洗了。
text.simplified:
孩子：你别再帮我洗衣服了！我自己会洗。
妈妈：我怕你洗不干净，如果洗得干净，我就不再帮你洗了。
text.pinyin: Háizi: Nǐ bié zài bāng wǒ xǐ yīfu le! Wǒ zìjǐ huì xǐ. Māma: Wǒ pà nǐ xǐ bu gānjìng, rúguǒ xǐ de gānjìng, wǒ jiù bú zài bāng nǐ xǐ le.
text.english: Child: Don't wash clothes for me anymore! I can wash them myself. Mother: I worry you won't wash them clean; if you do, I won't wash them for you anymore.

words.pinyin: wǒ pà nǐ xǐ bu gānjìng
words.meaning: I fear you cannot wash them clean

text.traditional:
太太：你的腳受傷了，別再踢足球了。
先生：要是這次比賽輸了，我就不再踢了。
text.simplified:
太太：你的脚受伤了，别再踢足球了。
先生：要是这次比赛输了，我就不再踢了。
text.pinyin: Tàitai: Nǐ de jiǎo shòushāng le, bié zài tī zúqiú le. Xiānsheng: Yàoshi zhè cì bǐsài shū le, wǒ jiù bú zài tī le.
text.english: Wife: Your foot is injured; don't play soccer anymore. Husband: If we lose this match, I won't play anymore.

words.pinyin: yàoshi zhè cì bǐsài shū le

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 別再……了 in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the correct phrase to complete the sentence.

questions.correctFeedback: 別再買了 urges a friend to stop buying additional items.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 別再買了 to advise someone to halt continuing an activity.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 別再……了 means that the person speaking suggests or reminds the other person not to do something anymore. For example, 別再讓父母擔心了。If the speaker reminds himself or mentions that others are not doing something anymore, use 不再……了. For example, 我不再喝酒了。

dialogue.title: 對話 · 貨比三家不吃虧 · It Won’t Hurt to Shop Around

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 瑪莉，這家專櫃的洋裝看起來真漂亮，而且現在週年慶打八折呢！
lines.simplified: 玛莉，这家专柜的洋装看起来真漂亮，而且现在周年庆打八折呢！
lines.english: Mary, this boutique's dress looks really beautiful, and there's a twenty percent discount for the anniversary sale!

lines.speaker: 瑪莉
lines.traditional: 是挺好看的，但買衣服一定要先試穿，試穿看看合不合身再決定。
lines.simplified: 是挺好看的，但买衣服一定要先试穿，试穿看看合不合身再决定。
lines.english: It's quite nice, but when buying clothes one must always try them on first to see if they fit well before deciding.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 妳說得對。那我先進去試穿這件淺藍色的。
lines.simplified: 你说得对。那我先进去试穿这件浅蓝色的。
lines.english: You're right. Then I'll go inside first to try on this light blue one.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 瑪莉，妳看這件怎麼樣？我覺得腰部有點緊，而且價格還是太高了。
lines.simplified: 玛莉，你看这件怎么样？我觉得腰部有点紧，而且价格还是太高了。
lines.english: Mary, what do you think of this piece? I feel the waist is a bit tight, and the price is still too high.

lines.speaker: 瑪莉
lines.traditional: 與其買一件不舒服的名牌洋裝，不如到樓上的平價專櫃看看，那裡款式也很多。
lines.simplified: 与其买一件不舒服的名牌洋装，不如到楼上的平价专柜看看，那里款式也很多。
lines.english: Rather than buying an uncomfortable designer dress, it would be better to check the affordable section upstairs; there are many styles there too.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 可是樓上的衣服材質怎麼樣？我什麼衣服都穿過，就是皮膚容易過敏，不能穿太粗糙的料子。
lines.simplified: 可是楼上的衣服材质怎么样？我什么衣服都穿过，就是皮肤容易过敏，不能穿太粗糙的料子。
lines.english: But how is the material of the clothes upstairs? I've worn all kinds of clothes, it's just that my skin is easily allergic, so I can't wear rough fabrics.

lines.speaker: 瑪莉
lines.traditional: 放心吧，樓上有幾個專櫃不僅質料柔軟，價格也很實在。
lines.simplified: 放心吧，楼上有几个专柜不仅质料柔软，价格也很实在。
lines.english: Don't worry, several boutiques upstairs not only have soft materials, but their prices are very fair.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 太好了！那我們別再這裡浪費時間了，趕快上樓去逛逛吧。
lines.simplified: 太好了！那我们别再这里浪费时间了，赶快上楼去逛逛吧。
lines.english: Awesome! Then let's not waste more time here, let's head upstairs quickly to look around.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Won't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Connect progressive reasons or features formally using 不僅……也/還/而且…….
grammarPages.explanation: 「不僅」當連接詞，有「不但」的意思，多用在書面，後面的分句句首用「還、也、而且」。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 不僅……，也/還/而且……

patternTable.title: Conjunction 不僅 (Not Only ..., But Also)

items.question: How does 不僅 differ from 只?
items.answer: 不僅 means "not only" and pairs with 也/還 for progressive addition, whereas 只 restricts to only one thing.
items.wrongTraditional: 購物時要多看幾家店，只比一比價格，也比品質。
items.wrongSimplified: 购物时要多看几家店，只比一比价格，也比品质。
items.wrongPinyin: Gòuwù shí yào duō kàn jǐ jiā diàn, zhǐ bǐ yì bǐ jiàgé, yě bǐ pǐnzhì.
items.wrongEnglish: When shopping check several shops, only compare price, also compare quality.
items.explanation: Use 不僅……還要/也要 to introduce two complementary considerations, not 只.

right.traditional: 購物時要多看幾家店，不僅要比價格，還要比品質。
right.simplified: 购物时要多看几家店，不仅要比价格，还要比品质。
right.pinyin: Gòuwù shí yào duō kàn jǐ jiā diàn, bùjǐn yào bǐ jiàgé, hái yào bǐ pǐnzhì.
right.english: When shopping check several stores: not only compare price, but also compare quality.

items.question: Can 不僅 be paired with 但是?
items.answer: No, 不僅 adds positive reinforcement and pairs with 也, 還, or 而且, not the contrastive 但是.
items.wrongTraditional: 謝先生不僅性格開朗，工作但是很認真。
items.wrongSimplified: 谢先生不仅性格开朗，工作但是很认真。
items.wrongPinyin: Xiè xiānsheng bùjǐn xìnggé kāilǎng, gōngzuò dànshì hěn rènzhēn.
items.wrongEnglish: Mr. Xie not only is cheerful, but work is serious.
items.explanation: 不僅 pairs with 也, 還, or 而且 for progressive addition, never with contrastive 但是.

right.traditional: 謝先生不僅性格開朗，工作也很認真。
right.simplified: 谢先生不仅性格开朗，工作也很认真。
right.pinyin: Xiè xiānsheng bùjǐn xìnggé kāilǎng, gōngzuò yě hěn rènzhēn.
right.english: Mr. Xie not only has a cheerful personality, but is also very conscientious in his work.

text.traditional: 購物時要多看幾家店，不僅要比一比價格，還要比一比品質。
text.simplified: 购物时要多看几家店，不仅要比一比价格，还要比一比品质。
text.pinyin: Gòuwù shí yào duō kàn jǐ jiā diàn, bùjǐn yào bǐ yì bǐ jiàgé, hái yào bǐ yì bǐ pǐnzhì.
text.english: When shopping you should check several shops, not only comparing prices but also comparing quality.

words.pinyin: yào duō kàn jǐ jiā diàn

text.traditional: 謝先生不僅性格開朗，工作也很認真、負責，所以同事都很喜歡他。
text.simplified: 谢先生不仅性格开朗，工作也很认真、负责，所以同事都很喜欢他。
text.pinyin: Xiè xiānsheng bùjǐn xìnggé kāilǎng, gōngzuò yě hěn rènzhēn, fùzé, suǒyǐ tóngshì dōu hěn xǐhuān tā.
text.english: Mr. Xie not only has a cheerful personality, but is also very serious and responsible at work, so his colleagues all like him very much.

text.traditional: 照華人的傳統，除夕當天不僅要打掃、貼春聯，而且家人要在一起吃年夜飯。
text.simplified: 照华人的传统，除夕当天不仅要打扫、贴春联，而且家人要在一起吃年夜饭。
text.pinyin: Zhào Huárén de chuántǒng, chúxì dāngtiān bùjǐn yào dǎsǎo, tiē chūnlián, érqiě jiārén yào zài yìqǐ chī niányèfàn.
text.english: According to Chinese tradition, on New Year's Eve one not only sweeps and puts up spring couplets, but family must also gather to eat New Year's Eve dinner.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 不僅……也/還…… in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the correct phrase to complete the sentence.

questions.correctFeedback: 不僅要 pairs with 還要 to emphasize considering both price and quality.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 不僅要 to introduce the first of two parallel requirements.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 不僅 is used as a conjunction connective, which means the same as 不但. It is mostly used in writing. The beginning of the following clauses starts with 還, 也, 而且.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Won't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express gradual incremental changes across sequential units with 一M比一M + Vs.
grammarPages.explanation: 說明事物或情況的程度逐漸變化。例如：天氣一天比一天熱了。
grammarPages.pattern: NP + 一 M 比 一 M + Vs (了)

items.question: How does 一M比一M differ from 一M一M?
items.answer: 一M比一M expresses an incremental increase in degree across sequential items; 一M一M expresses sequential order without comparison.
items.wrongTraditional: 那裡的商品常常是一樣一樣便宜。
items.wrongSimplified: 那里的商品常常是一样一样便宜。
items.wrongPinyin: Nàlǐ de shāngpǐn chángcháng shì yí yàng yí yàng piányi.
items.wrongEnglish: The goods there are often one by one cheap.
items.explanation: To express that each item is cheaper than the preceding one, use 一樣比一樣, not 一樣一樣.

right.traditional: 那裡的商品常常是一樣比一樣便宜。
right.simplified: 那里的商品常常是一样比一样便宜。
right.pinyin: Nàlǐ de shāngpǐn chángcháng shì yí yàng bǐ yí yàng piányi.
right.english: The merchandise there is often cheaper from one item to the next.

items.question: Where does 比 go in the 一M比一M structure?
items.answer: 比 must be placed between the two measure words: 一M + 比 + 一M + Vs.
items.wrongTraditional: 空氣一年一年比差了。
items.wrongSimplified: 空气一年一年比差了。
items.wrongPinyin: Kōngqì yì nián yì nián bǐ chà le.
items.wrongEnglish: The air year after year compared worse.
items.explanation: The structure is 一M + 比 + 一M + Vs (一年比一年差), placing 比 between the measure words.

right.traditional: 空氣一年比一年差了。
right.simplified: 空气一年比一年差了。
right.pinyin: Kōngqì yì nián bǐ yì nián chà le.
right.english: The air has been getting worse year by year.

text.traditional: 那裡的商品常常是一樣比一樣便宜。
text.simplified: 那里的商品常常是一样比一样便宜。
text.pinyin: Nàlǐ de shāngpǐn chángcháng shì yí yàng bǐ yí yàng piányi.
text.english: The goods there are often cheaper from one item to the next.

text.traditional: 這個學期王小明很用功，考試的成績也一次比一次進步了。
text.simplified: 这个学期王小明很用功，考试的成绩也一次比一次进步了。
text.pinyin: Zhè ge xuéqī Wáng Xiǎomíng hěn yònggōng, kǎoshì de chéngjì yě yí cì bǐ yí cì jìnbù le.
text.english: Wang Xiaoming is very hardworking this semester, and his exam scores improved with each test.

text.traditional: 這個地區因為工廠越來越多的關係，空氣一年比一年差了。
text.simplified: 这个地区因为工厂越来越多的关系，空气一年比一年差了。
text.pinyin: Zhè ge dìqū yīnwèi gōngchǎng yuè lái yuè duō de guānxi, kōngqì yì nián bǐ yì nián chà le.
text.english: Because of more and more factories in this region, the air quality has worsened year by year.

words.pinyin: yīnwèi gōngchǎng yuè lái yuè duō

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using NP 一M比一M + Vs (了) in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the correct phrase to complete the sentence.

segments.traditional: 換了工作以後，我每天吃得很多，肚子
segments.simplified: 换了工作以后，我每天吃得很多，肚子

questions.correctFeedback: 一天比一天大了 describes an incremental increase in size day after day.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 一天比一天 to describe incremental change across successive days.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This sentence structure explains that the degree of a thing or situation changes gradually. For example, 天氣一天比一天熱了。

dialogue.title: 短文 · 比價 · Comparing Prices

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 在現代消費社會中，每個人都希望能「買得開心、用得放心」。
lines.simplified: 在现代消费社会中，每个人都希望能「买得开心、用得放心」。
lines.english: In modern consumer society, everyone hopes to 'buy with joy and use with peace of mind.'

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 俗話說「貨比三家不吃虧」，意思是在購買貴重物品前，多比較幾家商店的價格與品質，才不會吃虧上當。
lines.simplified: 俗话说「货比三家不吃亏」，意思是在购买贵重物品前，多比较几家商店的价格与品质，才不会吃亏上当。
lines.english: As the proverb says, 'Shop around and you won't suffer a loss,' meaning before purchasing expensive items, compare prices and quality across several stores so you won't get cheated.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 以前人們為了比價，得跑好幾家實體店鋪，費時又費力。
lines.simplified: 以前人们为了比价，得跑好几家实体店铺，费时又费力。
