lines.english: In the past, to compare prices people had to run around several physical shops, which was time-consuming and laborious.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 現在網路科技發達，大家不僅能透過比價網站輕鬆查詢價格，還能參考其他消費者的評價。
lines.simplified: 现在网路科技发达，大家不仅能透过比价网站轻松查询价格，还能参考其他消费者的评价。
lines.english: Now with advanced internet technology, people not only can easily query prices via price-comparison sites, but also consult reviews from other consumers.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 消費者變得一次比一次聰明，商家也一年比一年更注重產品質量與售後服務。
lines.simplified: 消费者变得一次比一次聪明，商家也一年比一年更注重产品质量与售后服务。
lines.english: Consumers become smarter each time, and businesses focus more on product quality and customer service year after year.

dialogue.title: 對話 · 孩子滿月了 · One Month Old

lines.speaker: 瑪莉
lines.traditional: 嗨，芳草，好久沒見。這瓶葡萄酒送妳。
lines.simplified: 嗨，芳草，好久没见。这瓶葡萄酒送你。
lines.pinyin: Hāi, Fāngcǎo, hǎojiǔ méi jiàn. Zhè píng pútáojiǔ sòng nǐ.
lines.english: Mary: Hi, Fangcao, long time no see. This bottle of wine is for you.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 快進來！人來就好了，別這麼客氣。請坐，請坐。妳知道佳琳生了一對雙胞胎吧？
lines.simplified: 快进来！人来就好了，别这么客气。请坐，请坐。你知道佳琳生了一对双胞胎吧？
lines.pinyin: Kuài jìnlái! Rén lái jiù hǎo le, bié zhème kèqi. Qǐng zuò, qǐng zuò. Nǐ zhīdào Jiālín shēng le yí duì shuāngbāotāi ba?
lines.english: Fangcao: Come in quickly! Just you coming is enough, don't be so polite. Please sit down, please sit down. You know Jialin had a pair of twins, right?

lines.speaker: 瑪莉
lines.traditional: 上星期就知道了。我一聽到這個好消息，就立刻打電話恭喜她了，她說孩子又乖又可愛，可是很擔心一下子要養兩個會很辛苦。等小孩滿月那天，我們一起去看她吧。
lines.simplified: 上星期就知道了。我一听到这个好消息，就立刻打电话恭喜她了，她说孩子又乖又可爱，可是很担心一下子要养两个会很辛苦。等小孩满月那天，我们一起去看她吧。
lines.pinyin: Shàng xīngqī jiù zhīdào le. Wǒ yì tīngdào zhè ge hǎo xiāoxi, jiù lìkè dǎ diànhuà gōngxǐ tā le, tā shuō háizi yòu guāi yòu kě'ài, kěshì hěn dānxīn yíxiàzi yào yǎng liǎng ge huì hěn xīnkǔ. Děng xiǎohái mǎnyuè nà tiān, wǒmen yìqǐ qù kàn tā ba.
lines.english: Mary: I found out last week. As soon as I heard the good news, I immediately called to congratulate her. She said the babies are both well-behaved and cute, but she's worried that raising two all at once will be very tough. When the babies reach their full month, let's go visit her together.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 好啊。我也想看看那對雙胞胎，也許能抱抱他們。妳想送什麼禮物祝福他們？
lines.simplified: 好啊。我也想看看那对双胞胎，也许能抱抱他们。你想送什么礼物祝福他们？
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a. Wǒ yě xiǎng kànkan nà duì shuāngbāotāi, yěxǔ néng bàobao tāmen. Nǐ xiǎng sòng shénme lǐwù zhùfú tāmen?
lines.english: Fangcao: Sure. I also want to see that pair of twins, and maybe get to hold them. What gift do you want to give to bless them?

lines.speaker: 瑪莉
lines.traditional: 我前兩天到百貨公司選了兩件衣服。（拿出手機）妳看，就是這兩件。
lines.simplified: 我前两天到百货公司选了两件衣服。（拿出手机）你看，就是这两件。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ qián liǎng tiān dào bǎihuò gōngsī xuǎn le liǎng jiàn yīfu. (Ná chū shǒujī) Nǐ kàn, jiùshì zhè liǎng jiàn.
lines.english: Mary: Two days ago I went to the department store and picked out two pieces of clothing. (Takes out cell phone) Look, it's these two.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 好可愛的衣服啊！我呢，想來想去，還是決定送紅包，可是不知道滿月的紅包要包多少。
lines.simplified: 好可爱的衣服啊！我呢，想来想去，还是决定送红包，可是不知道满月的红包要包多少。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo kě'ài de yīfu a! Wǒ ne, xiǎng lái xiǎng qù, háishì juédìng sòng hóngbāo, kěshì bù zhīdào mǎnyuè de hóngbāo yào bāo duōshǎo.
lines.english: Fangcao: What cute clothes! As for me, after thinking back and forth, I still decided to give a red envelope, but I don't know how much to put in for a full-month red envelope.

lines.speaker: 瑪莉
lines.traditional: 送紅包這個主意不錯。包多少，要看妳們的關係怎麼樣。不過錢的數字一定得是雙數，而且不可以有「四」喔！
lines.simplified: 送红包这个主意不错。包多少，要看你们的关系怎么样。不过钱的数字一定得是双数，而且不可以有「四」喔！
lines.pinyin: Sòng hóngbāo zhè ge zhǔyì búcuò. Bāo duōshǎo, yào kàn nǐmen de guānxi zěnmeyàng. Búguò qián de shùzì yídìng děi shì shuāngshù, érqiě bù kěyǐ yǒu "sì" o!
lines.english: Mary: Giving a red envelope is a good idea. How much to give depends on your relationship. But the amount must be an even number, and definitely cannot contain "four"!

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 好，我會注意的。記得去年妳婆婆過生日，妳送給她一盒梨子。妳怕她一個人吃不了整個梨，很體貼地分了一半給她，沒想到她笑了出來。
lines.simplified: 好，我会注意的。记得去年你婆婆过生日，你送给她一盒梨子。你怕她一个人吃不了整个梨，很体贴地分了一半给她，没想到她笑了出来。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ huì zhùyì de. Jìde qùnián nǐ pópo guò shēngrì, nǐ sòng gěi tā yì hé lízi. Nǐ pà tā yí ge rén chī buliǎo zhěng ge lí, hěn tǐtiē de fēn le yíbàn gěi tā, méi xiǎngdào tā xiào le chūlai.
lines.english: Fangcao: Okay, I will pay attention to that. Remember last year for your mother-in-law's birthday, you gave her a box of pears. You were afraid she couldn't eat an entire pear by herself, so you thoughtfully shared half with her, not expecting her to burst out laughing.

lines.speaker: 瑪莉
lines.traditional: 是啊，當我知道把梨分一半，有不好的意思時，就馬上向她道歉。婆婆笑著說，她還不想跟我說再見呢！
lines.simplified: 是啊，当我知道把梨分一半，有不好的意思时，就马上向她道歉。婆婆笑着说，她还不想跟我说再见呢！
lines.pinyin: Shì a, dāng wǒ zhīdào bǎ lí fēn yíbàn, yǒu bù hǎo de yìsi shí, jiù mǎshàng xiàng tā dàoqiàn. Pópo xiào zhe shuō, tā hái bù xiǎng gēn wǒ shuō zàijiàn ne!
lines.english: Mary: Yes, when I found out that dividing a pear has an inauspicious meaning, I immediately apologized to her. Mother-in-law laughed and said she didn't want to say goodbye to me yet!

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 剛來臺灣的時候，我也常因為不清楚文化差異而說錯話、送錯禮。要是那時候能先跟臺灣朋友打聽一下，也許就可以避免這樣的情況了。
lines.simplified: 刚来台湾的时候，我也常因为不清楚文化差异而说错话、送错礼。要是那时候能先跟台湾朋友打听一下，也许就可以避免这样的情况了。
lines.pinyin: Gāng lái Táiwān de shíhou, wǒ yě cháng yīnwèi bù qīngchǔ wénhuà chāyì ér shuō cuò huà, sòng cuò lǐ. Yàoshi nà shíhou néng xiān gēn Táiwān péngyou dǎting yíxià, yěxǔ jiù kěyǐ bìmiǎn zhèyàng de qíngkuàng le.
lines.english: Fangcao: When I first arrived in Taiwan, I also often said the wrong thing or gave the wrong gift because I wasn't clear about cultural differences. If I could have asked around with Taiwanese friends first back then, maybe I could have avoided that kind of situation.

lines.speaker: 瑪莉
lines.traditional: 沒錯。還好我婆婆常教我臺灣的送禮文化，也會給我介紹臺灣的風俗，現在我終於比較了解了。
lines.simplified: 没错。还好我婆婆常教我台湾的送礼文化，也会给我介绍台湾的风俗，现在我终于比较了解了。
lines.pinyin: Méi cuò. Háihǎo wǒ pópo cháng jiāo wǒ Táiwān de sònglǐ wénhuà, yě huì gěi wǒ jièshào Táiwān de fēngsú, xiànzài wǒ zhōngyú bǐjiào liǎojiě le.
lines.english: Mary: Exactly. Fortunately, my mother-in-law often teaches me Taiwan's gift-giving culture and introduces Taiwanese customs to me, so now I finally understand it better.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 其實不僅東西方的文化差異大，連同樣是亞洲國家的越南，飲食習慣也跟臺灣不同。比如，有的臺灣菜醬油放得太多，鹹了點兒。
lines.simplified: 其实不仅东西方的文化差异大，连同样是亚洲国家的越南，饮食习惯也跟台湾不同。比如，有的台湾菜酱油放得太多，咸了点儿。
lines.pinyin: Qíshí bùjǐn dōngxīfāng de wénhuà chāyì dà, lián tóngyàng shì Yàzhōu guójiā de Yuènán, yǐnshí xíguàn yě gēn Táiwān bù tóng. Bǐrú, yǒude Táiwāncài jiàngyóu fàng de tài duō, xián le diǎnr.
lines.english: Fangcao: Actually, not only is the cultural difference between East and West large, but even for Vietnam, also an Asian country, dietary habits are different from Taiwan. For example, some Taiwanese dishes have too much soy sauce, and are a bit too salty.

lines.speaker: 瑪莉
lines.traditional: 我也這麼覺得。從上次去越南旅行回來，我就常吃越南菜。我很喜歡越南的醬料，還有不加醋，加檸檬汁的越南菜。
lines.simplified: 我也这么觉得。从上次去越南旅行回来，我就常吃越南菜。我很喜欢越南的酱料，还有不加醋，加柠檬汁的越南菜。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě zhème juéde. Cóng shàng cì qù Yuènán lǚxíng huílái, wǒ jiù cháng chī Yuènáncài. Wǒ hěn xǐhuan Yuènán de jiàngliào, hái yǒu bù jiā cù, jiā níngméngzhī de Yuènáncài.
lines.english: Mary: I feel the same way. Since returning from traveling to Vietnam last time, I often eat Vietnamese food. I really like Vietnamese sauces, and Vietnamese dishes made with lemon juice instead of vinegar.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 快六點了，等一下我請妳去附近的越南餐廳吃飯吧！
lines.simplified: 快六点了，等一下我请你去附近的越南餐厅吃饭吧！
lines.pinyin: Kuài liù diǎn le, děng yíxià wǒ qǐng nǐ qù fùjìn de Yuènán cāntīng chī fàn ba!
lines.english: Fangcao: It's almost six o'clock; in a little while let me treat you to dinner at a nearby Vietnamese restaurant!

lines.speaker: 瑪莉
lines.traditional: 這些菜樣樣都好吃，特別是紅豆點心，可惜我吃不下了。
lines.simplified: 这些菜样样都好吃，特别是红豆点心，可惜我吃不下了。
lines.pinyin: Zhèxiē cài yàngyàng dōu hǎochī, tèbié shì hóngdòu diǎnxin, kěxī wǒ chī bu xià le.
lines.english: Mary: Every single one of these dishes is delicious, especially the red bean dessert; pity I can't eat any more.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 剩下的菜妳要不要打包？
lines.simplified: 剩下的菜你要不要打包？
lines.pinyin: Shèngxià de cài nǐ yào bu yào dǎbāo?
lines.english: Fangcao: Do you want to pack up the leftover food?

lines.speaker: 瑪莉
lines.traditional: 不用了。在美國打包剩菜是很常見的，只是我沒這個習慣，從不打包。
lines.simplified: 不用了。在美国打包剩菜是很常见的，只是我没这个习惯，从不打包。
lines.pinyin: Bú yòng le. Zài Měiguó dǎbāo shèngcài shì hěn chángjiàn de, zhǐshì wǒ méi zhè ge xíguàn, cóng bù dǎbāo.
lines.english: Mary: No need. In America, packing up leftovers is very common, it's just that I don't have this habit and never pack them up.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 那就算了吧。
lines.simplified: 那就算了吧。
lines.pinyin: Nà jiù suàn le ba.
lines.english: Fangcao: Then let's just forget it.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express spontaneous exclamation or admiration about a noun using 好 + Vs + 的 + N + (啊)!
grammarPages.explanation: 「好 Vs 的 N（啊）！」是說話的人想表達強烈感嘆語氣時使用的。例如：「好有趣的表演啊！」、「好苦的咖啡！難怪你不喝。」
grammarPages.pattern: 好 + Vs + 的 + N + (啊)!

text.traditional:
瑪莉：……妳看，就是這兩件。
芳草：好可愛的衣服啊！
text.simplified:
玛莉：……你看，就是这两件。
芳草：好可爱的衣服啊！
text.pinyin:
Mǎlì: …Nǐ kàn, jiùshì zhè liǎng jiàn.
Fāngcǎo: Hǎo kě'ài de yīfu a!
text.english: Mary: …Look, these are the two. Fangcao: What cute clothes!

text.traditional:
A：好酸的檸檬汁啊！你忘了加糖嗎？
B：我以為你要喝無糖的，所以沒加。
text.simplified:
A：好酸的柠檬汁啊！你忘了加糖吗？
B：我以为你要喝无糖的，所以没加。
text.pinyin:
A: Hǎo suān de níngméngzhī a! Nǐ wàng le jiā táng ma?
B: Wǒ yǐwéi nǐ yào hē wú táng de, suǒyǐ méi jiā.
text.english: A: What sour lemon juice! Did you forget to add sugar? B: I thought you wanted it without sugar, so I did not add any.

text.traditional:
A：我早上出門時忘了帶手機，沒想到兒子親自拿到公司給我。
B：好體貼的兒子！我女兒跟你兒子年紀差不多，就沒那麼關心我。
text.simplified:
A：我早上出门时忘了带手机，没想到儿子亲自拿到公司给我。
B：好体贴的儿子！我女儿跟你儿子年纪差不多，就没那么关心我。
text.pinyin:
A: Wǒ zǎoshang chūmén shí wàng le dài shǒujī, méi xiǎngdào érzi qīnzì ná dào gōngsī gěi wǒ.
B: Hǎo tǐtiē de érzi! Wǒ nǚ'ér gēn nǐ érzi niánjì chàbuduō, jiù méi nàme guānxīn wǒ.
text.english: A: I forgot my phone when I left this morning; unexpectedly, my son brought it to my office himself. B: What a considerate son! My daughter is about his age, but she does not care about me that much.

items.question: Why do we say 好可愛的衣服啊 instead of 很可愛的衣服啊 as an exclamation?
items.answer: 好 + Vs + 的 + N + 啊 forms a standalone exclamatory noun phrase. 很 is a neutral degree modifier and cannot form this exclamation.
items.wrongTraditional: 你看，這是很可愛的衣服啊！
items.wrongSimplified: 你看，这是很可爱的衣服啊！

right.traditional: 你看，這是好可愛的衣服啊！
right.simplified: 你看，这是好可爱的衣服啊！
right.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, zhè shì hǎo kě'ài de yīfu a!
right.english: Look, what cute clothes this is!

items.question: Can we omit 的 in 好Vs的N(啊)?
items.answer: No, 的 is required to connect the stative verb to the noun in this exclamatory pattern.
items.wrongTraditional: 好酸檸檬汁啊！
items.wrongSimplified: 好酸柠檬汁啊！

right.traditional: 好酸的檸檬汁啊！
right.simplified: 好酸的柠檬汁啊！
right.pinyin: Hǎo suān de níngméngzhī a!
right.english: What sour lemon juice!

questions.correctFeedback: 好 + Vs + 的 + N + 啊 expresses an exclamation admiring the clothing.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 好 + Vs + 的 + N + 啊 to make an exclamatory phrase.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 好 Vs 的 N（啊）! is used when the speaker wants to express a strong feeling. For example, 好有趣的表演啊！Or 好苦的咖啡！難怪你不喝。

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express deliberating repeatedly or taking repeated actions before still reaching a conclusion using V來V去，還是……
grammarPages.explanation: 「V 來 V 去，還是……」表示說話的人不斷重複某一個動作，花了時間，最後還是沒什麼改變。「還是」的後面表示說話人的看法、感想或決定。例如：我逛來逛去，還是覺得夜市的東西最便宜。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + V來V去，還是 + Predicate

text.traditional: 我呢，想來想去，還是決定送紅包……
text.simplified: 我呢，想来想去，还是决定送红包……
text.pinyin: Wǒ ne, xiǎng lái xiǎng qù, háishì juédìng sòng hóngbāo…
text.english: As for me, after thinking it over, I still decided to give a red envelope…

text.traditional: 這幾個月我不斷地找工作，或許是我的眼光太高，找來找去，還是找不到合適的。
text.simplified: 这几个月我不断地找工作，或许是我的眼光太高，找来找去，还是找不到合适的。
text.pinyin: Zhè jǐ ge yuè wǒ búduàn de zhǎo gōngzuò, huòxǔ shì wǒ de yǎnguāng tài gāo, zhǎo lái zhǎo qù, háishì zhǎo bu dào héshì de.
text.english: I have been looking for work these past few months; perhaps my standards are too high. After all that searching, I still cannot find anything suitable.

text.traditional: 我看來看去，還是覺得這個社區的環境最好，不僅綠樹多、空氣新鮮，交通也方便。
text.simplified: 我看来看去，还是觉得这个社区的环境最好，不仅绿树多、空气新鲜，交通也方便。
text.pinyin: Wǒ kàn lái kàn qù, háishì juéde zhè ge shèqū de huánjìng zuì hǎo, bùjǐn lǜ shù duō, kōngqì xīnxiān, jiāotōng yě fāngbiàn.
text.english: After looking around, I still think this community has the best environment: lots of green trees, fresh air, and convenient transportation.

items.question: Why do we say 想來想去，還是…… instead of just 想想，還是……?
items.answer: V來V去 emphasizes repeated, prolonged deliberation before concluding, whereas 想想 is just a brief thought.
items.wrongTraditional: 我想想，還是決定送紅包。
items.wrongSimplified: 我想想，还是决定送红包。

right.traditional: 我想來想去，還是決定送紅包。
right.simplified: 我想来想去，还是决定送红包。
right.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng lái xiǎng qù, háishì juédìng sòng hóngbāo.
right.english: After thinking back and forth, I still decided to give a red envelope.

items.question: What function does 還是 have after V來V去?
items.answer: 還是 indicates that despite the repeated actions or spent time, the speaker returns to an original or steadfast choice.
items.wrongTraditional: 我看來看去，所以買這件衣服。
items.wrongSimplified: 我看来看去，所以买这件衣服。

right.traditional: 我看來看去，還是買這件衣服。
right.simplified: 我看来看去，还是买这件衣服。
right.pinyin: Wǒ kàn lái kàn qù, háishì mǎi zhè jiàn yīfu.
right.english: After looking back and forth, I still bought this piece of clothing.

questions.correctFeedback: 選來選去，還是 expresses choosing back and forth before still opting for Vietnamese cuisine.
questions.repairFeedback: Use V來V去，還是…… to express deliberation leading back to a choice.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: "V 來 V 去，還是……" means that the speaker repeatedly carries out a certain action. After having spent/wasted time, nothing has changed. The statement after 還是 shows the speaker's views, feelings or decisions. For example, 我逛來逛去，還是覺得夜市的東西最便宜。

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express reaching a hoped-for, expected, or anticipated result after a long process with 終於.
grammarPages.explanation: 「終於」是副詞。表示經過一個很長的過程，最後好不容易達到希望、期待或預期的結果。「終於」的前面是主語，後面可以接動詞或不及物狀態動詞（Vs）。句尾加「了」表示狀態的變化。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 終於 + Verb / Vs + (了)

text.traditional: ……現在我終於比較了解了。
text.simplified: ……现在我终于比较了解了。
text.pinyin: …Xiànzài wǒ zhōngyú bǐjiào liǎojiě le.
text.english: …Now I finally understand better.

text.traditional: 我家附近上個星期終於有一家設備新、空間大的健身房了。
text.simplified: 我家附近上个星期终于有一家设备新、空间大的健身房了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiā fùjìn shàng ge xīngqī zhōngyú yǒu yì jiā shèbèi xīn, kōngjiān dà de jiànshēnfáng le.
text.english: Last week, a gym with new equipment and a large space finally opened near my home.

text.traditional: 媽媽到了機場才發現護照不見了，找來找去，終於在她的口袋裡找到了，真糊塗啊！
text.simplified: 妈妈到了机场才发现护照不见了，找来找去，终于在她的口袋里找到了，真糊涂啊！
text.pinyin: Māma dào le jīchǎng cái fāxiàn hùzhào bú jiàn le, zhǎo lái zhǎo qù, zhōngyú zài tā de kǒudài lǐ zhǎodào le, zhēn hútu a!
text.english: Mom only noticed her passport was missing when she reached the airport. After searching everywhere, she finally found it in her pocket. How forgetful!

items.question: When do you use 終於 instead of 最後?
items.answer: 終於 carries strong emotional relief after an arduous effort or long wait. 最後 is simply the chronological final event.
items.wrongTraditional: 準備了一整年，最後考上大學了！
items.wrongSimplified: 准备了一整年，最后考上大学了！

right.traditional: 準備了一整年，終於考上大學了！
right.simplified: 准备了一整年，终于考上大学了！
right.pinyin: Zhǔnbèi le yì zhěng nián, zhōngyú kǎoshàng dàxué le!
right.english: After preparing for a whole year, I finally got into college!

items.question: Where is 終於 placed in a sentence?
items.answer: 終於 is an adverb placed after the subject and before the verb phrase.
items.wrongTraditional: 終於我買到了門票。
items.wrongSimplified: 终于我买到了门票。

right.traditional: 我終於買到了門票。
right.simplified: 我终于买到了门票。
right.pinyin: Wǒ zhōngyú mǎidào le ménpiào.
right.english: I finally bought the tickets.

questions.correctFeedback: 終於 indicates that after months of effort, he finally succeeded.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 終於 to mark an achievement after prolonged effort.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 終於 is an adverb. It means that after a long process, it is finally possible to achieve the hope, expectation or desired result. Put the subject in front of 終於, followed by a verb or intransitive state verb (Vs). 了 is put at the end to indicate a change in state.

dialogue.title: 短文 · 坐月子 · Confinement After Childbirth

lines.speaker: 佳琳
lines.traditional: 親愛的以晴：收到妳的卡片，知道妳要結婚的消息，真叫我高興。看了你們兩人的相片，穿上洋裝的妳好漂亮，妳先生又高大又英俊，真是幸福的一對。
lines.simplified: 亲爱的以晴：收到你的卡片，知道你要结婚的消息，真叫我高兴。看了你们两人的相片，穿上洋装的你好漂亮，你先生又高大又英俊，真是幸福的一对。
lines.pinyin: Qīn'ài de Yǐqíng: Shōudào nǐ de kǎpiàn, zhīdào nǐ yào jiéhūn de xiāoxi, zhēn jiào wǒ gāoxìng. Kàn le nǐmen liǎng rén de xiàngpiàn, chuān shàng yángzhuāng de nǐ hǎo piàoliang, nǐ xiānsheng yòu gāodà yòu yīngjùn, zhēn shì xìngfú de yí duì.
lines.english: Dear Yiqing: Receiving your card and knowing the news of your upcoming marriage made me truly happy. Looking at the photo of the two of you, you look so beautiful in a dress, and your husband is so tall and handsome; you are truly a blessed couple.

lines.speaker: 佳琳
lines.traditional: 記得我在美國留學時，我們常一塊兒吃喝玩樂，也常一同閱讀、討論，思考未來的方向。開心時，會笑個不停；傷心時，會哭個不停。戀愛了五年的男友離開我時，妳陪著我哭，三大盒面紙都被我們抽光了。對我來說，那些珍貴的回憶是一輩子都忘不了的。
lines.simplified: 记得我在美国留学时，我们常一块儿吃喝玩乐，也常一同阅读、讨论，思考未来的方向。开心时，会笑个不停；伤心时，会哭个不停。恋爱了五年的男友离开我时，你陪着我哭，三大盒面纸都被我们抽光了。对我来说，那些珍贵的回忆是一辈子都忘不了的。
lines.pinyin: Jìde wǒ zài Měiguó liúxué shí, wǒmen cháng yíkuàir chī hē wán lè, yě cháng yìtóng yuèdú, tǎolùn, sīkǎo wèilái de fāngxiàng. Kāixīn shí, huì xiào ge bùtíng; shāngxīn shí, huì kū ge bùtíng. Liàn'ài le wǔ nián de nányǒu líkāi wǒ shí, nǐ péi zhe wǒ kū, sān dà hé miànzhǐ dōu bèi wǒmen chōu guāng le. Duì wǒ lái shuō, nàxiē zhēnguì de huíyì shì yíbèizi dōu wàng buliǎo de.
lines.english: I remember when I was studying abroad in the US, we often ate, drank, and had fun together, and also read, discussed, and pondered the future together. When happy, we laughed non-stop; when sad, we cried non-stop. When my boyfriend of five years left me, you cried with me, and we went through three large boxes of tissues. To me, those precious memories can never be forgotten in a lifetime.

lines.speaker: 佳琳
lines.traditional: 我非常想去美國參加妳的婚禮，可是這段時間我還在坐月子。「坐月子」是華人的傳統習慣，照我婆婆的說法，女人生了孩子以後得休息一個月，不多不少，就是三十天；還應該注意營養，不但不能洗冷水澡，而且不能洗頭，這樣才能早點兒恢復健康。我外婆也說，這個時候身體最要緊，孩子滿月以前，我們母子都不能出門。所以我每天除了吃飯、睡覺以外，就是抱著小孩餵他喝奶；婆婆每天不是煮魚湯、雞湯給我喝，就是幫我買菜、做家事。我非常感謝她、尊敬她，也一定會孝順她的。
lines.simplified: 我非常想去美国参加你的婚礼，可是这段时间我还在坐月子。「坐月子」是华人的传统习惯，照我婆婆的说法，女人生了孩子以后得休息一个月，不多不少，就是三十天；还应该注意营养，不但不能洗冷水澡，而且不能洗头，这样才能早点儿恢复健康。我外婆也说，这个时候身体最要紧，孩子满月以前，我们母子都不能出门。所以我每天除了吃饭、睡觉以外，就是抱着小孩喂他喝奶；婆婆每天不是煮鱼汤、鸡汤给我喝，就是帮我买菜、做家事。我非常感谢她、尊敬她，也一定会孝顺她的。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ fēicháng xiǎng qù Měiguó cānjiā nǐ de hūnlǐ, kěshì zhè duàn shíjiān wǒ hái zài zuòyuèzi. "Zuòyuèzi" shì Huárén de chuántǒng xíguàn, zhào wǒ pópo de shuōfǎ, nǚrén shēng le háizi yǐhòu děi xiūxi yí ge yuè, bù duō bù shǎo, jiùshì sānshí tiān; hái yīnggāi zhùyì yíngyǎng, búdàn bù néng xǐ lěngshuǐzǎo, érqiě bù néng xǐ tóu, zhèyàng cái néng zǎodiǎnr huīfù jiànkāng. Wǒ wàipó yě shuō, zhè ge shíhou shēntǐ zuì yàojǐn, háizi mǎnyuè yǐqián, wǒmen mǔzǐ dōu bù néng chūmén. Suǒyǐ wǒ měitiān chúle chīfàn, shuìjiào yǐwài, jiùshì bào zhe xiǎohái wèi tā hē nǎi; pópo měitiān búshì zhǔ yútāng, jītāng gěi wǒ hē, jiùshì bāng wǒ mǎi cài, zuò jiāshì. Wǒ fēicháng gǎnxiè tā, zūnjìng tā, yě yídìng huì xiàoshùn tā de.
lines.english: I would love to go to America to attend your wedding, but during this time I'm still doing postpartum confinement. "Sitting the month" is a traditional Chinese custom; according to my mother-in-law, after a woman gives birth she must rest for a month, no more and no less, exactly thirty days; she also needs to pay attention to nutrition, and not only cannot take cold showers, but also cannot wash her hair, so that she can recover her health sooner. My maternal grandmother also said that at this time one's health is the most critical; before the child reaches a full month, mother and baby cannot go outdoors. Therefore, every day besides eating and sleeping, I'm just holding the baby and nursing him; every day my mother-in-law either makes fish soup or chicken soup for me to drink, or helps me buy groceries and do housework. I am so grateful to her, respect her, and will definitely be filial to her.

lines.speaker: 佳琳
lines.traditional:
在臺灣，孩子滿月那天，我們會送油飯和紅蛋給親人、朋友，感謝大家對孩子的祝福。可惜妳在美國，沒辦法請妳吃。等我們見面的時候，再好好地一起吃個飯、聊一聊。祝
平安健康、事事如意、早生貴子
好友 佳琳
9.28
lines.simplified:
在台湾，孩子满月那天，我们会送油饭和红蛋给亲人、朋友，感谢大家对孩子的祝福。可惜你在美国，没办法请你吃。等我们见面的时候，再好好地一起吃个饭、聊一聊。祝
平安健康、事事如意、早生贵子
好友 佳琳
9.28
lines.pinyin:
Zài Táiwān, háizi mǎnyuè nà tiān, wǒmen huì sòng yóufàn hàn hóngdàn gěi qīnrén, péngyou, gǎnxiè dàjiā duì háizi de zhùfú. Kěxī nǐ zài Měiguó, méi bànfǎ qǐng nǐ chī. Děng wǒmen jiànmiàn de shíhou, zài hǎohāode yìqǐ chī ge fàn, liáo yì liáo. Zhù
Píng'ān jiànkāng, shìshì rúyì, zǎoshēng guìzǐ
Hǎoyǒu Jiālín
9.28
lines.english:
In Taiwan, on the baby's one-month day, we send glutinous oil rice and red eggs to relatives and friends to thank everyone for their blessings to the baby. Unfortunately you are in America, so there is no way to treat you. When we meet, let's have a nice meal together and have a good chat. Wishing you:
Peace and health, everything according to your wishes, and early birth of precious children,
Your good friend Jialin,
Sept 28

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe an action that goes on continuously without stopping or ending using V + 個不停 / 個沒完.
grammarPages.explanation: 「V 個不停」強調同樣的動作在短時間內不斷地重複，例如：這幾天雨下個不停。而「V 個沒完」強調做某動作時，不想或是沒辦法停止，例如：昨天剛考完試，今天又考了，每天考試考個沒完。「V 個沒完」一般用在說話的人對這樣的情況覺得不好或感到不耐煩。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + Verb + 個不停 / 個沒完

text.traditional: 開心時，會笑個不停；傷心時，會哭個不停。
text.simplified: 开心时，会笑个不停；伤心时，会哭个不停。
text.pinyin: Kāixīn shí, huì xiào ge bù tíng; shāngxīn shí, huì kū ge bù tíng.
text.english: When happy, they laugh nonstop; when sad, they cry nonstop.

text.traditional: 最近工作很多，我們每天開會開個不停，電話也接個不停，累死了。
text.simplified: 最近工作很多，我们每天开会开个不停，电话也接个不停，累死了。
text.pinyin: Zuìjìn gōngzuò hěn duō, wǒmen měi tiān kāihuì kāi ge bù tíng, diànhuà yě jiē ge bù tíng, lèi sǐ le.
text.english: There has been a lot of work lately; every day we have endless meetings and phone calls. We are exhausted.

text.traditional: 我的雙胞胎兒子整天吵個沒完、哭個沒完，真不知道怎麼辦才好。
text.simplified: 我的双胞胎儿子整天吵个没完、哭个没完，真不知道怎么办才好。
text.pinyin: Wǒ de shuāngbāotāi érzi zhěngtiān chǎo ge méi wán, kū ge méi wán, zhēn bù zhīdào zěnme bàn cái hǎo.
text.english: My twin sons fuss and cry all day without end. I really do not know what to do.

items.question: How is V個不停 different from 一直V?
items.answer: 一直V simply marks duration or persistence, whereas V個不停 conveys vivid, ceaseless action with an exasperated or emotional tone.
items.wrongTraditional: 他上課的時候，總是一直說話了。
items.wrongSimplified: 他上课的时候，总是一直说话了。

right.traditional: 他上課的時候，總是說個不停。
right.simplified: 他上课的时候，总是说个不停。
right.pinyin: Tā shàngkè de shíhou, zǒngshì shuō ge bùtíng.
right.english: During class, he is always talking non-stop.

items.question: When a verb has an object (like 開會), where does 個不停 go?
items.answer: The verb is repeated: 開會開個不停 or 接電話接個不停.
items.wrongTraditional: 我們每天開會個不停。
items.wrongSimplified: 我们每天开会个不停。

right.traditional: 我們每天開會開個不停。
right.simplified: 我们每天开会开个不停。
right.pinyin: Wǒmen měitiān kāihuì kāi ge bùtíng.
right.english: We hold meetings non-stop every day.

questions.correctFeedback: 問個不停 shows his habit of asking ceaseless questions until he understands.
questions.repairFeedback: Use V + 個不停 to convey non-stop activity.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: V 個不停 emphasizes that the same action is repeated continuously in a short period of time. For example, 這幾天雨下個不停。V 個沒完 emphasizes that a certain action takes place without stopping. For example, 昨天剛考完試，今天又考了，每天考試考個沒完。V 個沒完 is usually used when the person speaking feels bad about or impatient with such a situation.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe a moderate, suitable, or just-right condition using paired opposite stative verbs in 不Vs1不Vs2.
grammarPages.explanation: 「不 Vs₁ 不 Vs₂」說明介於「Vs₁」和「Vs₂」兩者之間的程度，表示說話的人覺得適中、適宜、舒服的，數量或程度正好。例如：不大不小、不多不少、不高不矮、不新不舊等。兩個 Vs 都必須是單音詞，而且意思相反，如：大小、多少、高矮、新舊、遠近、快慢、好壞、冷熱等。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 不Vs1不Vs2

text.traditional: 女人生了孩子以後得休息一個月，不多不少，就是三十天。
text.simplified: 女人生了孩子以后得休息一个月，不多不少，就是三十天。
text.pinyin: Nǚrén shēng le háizi yǐhòu děi xiūxi yí ge yuè, bù duō bù shǎo, jiùshì sānshí tiān.
text.english: After giving birth, women must rest for one month: exactly thirty days.

text.traditional: 這種不冷不熱的天氣舒服極了，不但適合野餐、露營，還很適合爬山。
text.simplified: 这种不冷不热的天气舒服极了，不但适合野餐、露营，还很适合爬山。
text.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng bù lěng bú rè de tiānqì shūfu jí le, búdàn shìhé yěcān, lùyíng, hái hěn shìhé páshān.
text.english: This weather is neither cold nor hot and is extremely comfortable. It suits picnics, camping, and hiking.

text.traditional: 林老師說話的速度不快不慢，例子的說明也很清楚，學生很容易就明白了。
text.simplified: 林老师说话的速度不快不慢，例子的说明也很清楚，学生很容易就明白了。
text.pinyin: Lín lǎoshī shuōhuà de sùdù bú kuài bú màn, lìzi de shuōmíng yě hěn qīngchǔ, xuésheng hěn róngyì jiù míngbai le.
text.english: Teacher Lin speaks neither fast nor slowly and explains examples clearly, so students understand easily.

items.question: Why are the paired antonyms fixed in order (e.g. 不大不小, not 不小不大)?
items.answer: Conventional pairing always places the primary/positive dimension first: 大小, 多少, 高矮, 新舊, 遠近, 快慢, 好壞, 冷熱.
items.wrongTraditional: 這件衣服不小不大，穿起來剛好。
items.wrongSimplified: 这件衣服不小不大，穿起来刚好。

right.traditional: 這件衣服不大不小，穿起來剛好。
right.simplified: 这件衣服不大不小，穿起来刚好。
right.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu bú dà bù xiǎo, chuān qǐlai gānghǎo.
right.english: This piece of clothing is neither big nor small; it fits just right.

items.question: Can two unrelated stative verbs be used in this pattern?
items.answer: No, the two Vs must be direct monosyllabic antonyms signifying two opposing ends of a single continuum.
items.wrongTraditional: 這個西瓜不甜不貴，很好吃。
items.wrongSimplified: 这个西瓜不甜不贵，很好吃。

right.traditional: 這個西瓜不大不小，很好拿。
right.simplified: 这个西瓜不大不小，很好拿。
right.pinyin: Zhè ge xīguā bú dà bù xiǎo, hěn hǎo ná.
right.english: This watermelon is neither big nor small, very easy to carry.

questions.correctFeedback: 不高不矮 describes a moderate height.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 不高不矮 for human height.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: "不 Vs₁ 不 Vs₂" illustrates the degree between "Vs₁" and "Vs₂", indicating that the person speaking feels the situation is moderate, appropriate, and suitable, and the number or degree is just right. Both Vs must be monosyllabic with opposite meanings. The order is 大小, 多少, 高矮, 新舊, 遠近, 快慢, 好壞, 冷熱, etc.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Emphasize an exclusive situation where, aside from one thing, only one other possibility or activity exists with 除了……(以外)，就是……
grammarPages.explanation: 這個語法強調如果「除了」後面的人事物排除，就只有「就是」後面的人事物。「以外」可以省略。例如：「我來臺灣除了學中文以外，就是工作」、「他週末除了爬山，就是在家打掃」。
grammarPages.pattern: 除了 + NP1 / VP1 + (以外)，就是 + NP2 / VP2

text.traditional: ……我每天除了吃飯、睡覺以外，就是抱著小孩餵他喝奶……
text.simplified: ……我每天除了吃饭、睡觉以外，就是抱着小孩喂他喝奶……
text.pinyin: …Wǒ měi tiān chúle chīfàn, shuìjiào yǐwài, jiùshì bào zhe xiǎohái wèi tā hē nǎi…
text.english: …Every day, apart from eating and sleeping, I just hold the baby and feed him milk…

text.traditional: 小李在咖啡館打工，每天除了煮咖啡以外，就是擦桌子、倒垃圾，他覺得很輕鬆。
text.simplified: 小李在咖啡馆打工，每天除了煮咖啡以外，就是擦桌子、倒垃圾，他觉得很轻松。
text.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ zài kāfēiguǎn dǎgōng, měi tiān chúle zhǔ kāfēi yǐwài, jiùshì cā zhuōzi, dào lèsè, tā juéde hěn qīngsōng.
text.english: Xiao Li works at a cafe. Every day, apart from making coffee, he just wipes tables and takes out the garbage; he finds it easy.

text.traditional: 我家冰箱裡的東西不多，除了啤酒，就是一些水餃和雞蛋。
text.simplified: 我家冰箱里的东西不多，除了啤酒，就是一些水饺和鸡蛋。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiā bīngxiāng lǐ de dōngxi bù duō, chúle píjiǔ, jiùshì yìxiē shuǐjiǎo hé jīdàn.
text.english: There is not much in my fridge: apart from beer, just some dumplings and eggs.

items.question: How does 除了……就是…… differ from 除了……也/還……?
items.answer: 除了……就是…… is exclusive: excluding X, only Y exists. 除了……還/也…… is additive: in addition to X, Y also applies.
items.wrongTraditional: 我週末除了睡覺以外，也工作。
items.wrongSimplified: 我周末除了睡觉以外，也工作。

right.traditional: 我週末除了睡覺以外，就是工作。
right.simplified: 我周末除了睡觉以外，就是工作。
right.pinyin: Wǒ zhōumò chúle shuìjiào yǐwài, jiùshì gōngzuò.
right.english: On weekends, besides sleeping, I just work (nothing else).

items.question: Can 以外 be omitted in 除了……就是……?
items.answer: Yes, 以外 can be omitted without changing the meaning.
items.wrongTraditional: 除了中文，我就是只學英文。
items.wrongSimplified: 除了中文，我就是只学英文。

right.traditional: 除了中文，我就是學英文。
right.simplified: 除了中文，我就是学英文。
right.pinyin: Chúle Zhōngwén, wǒ jiùshì xué Yīngwén.
right.english: Besides Chinese, I just study English.

segments.traditional: 他下班回家後，除了吃飯，
segments.simplified: 他下班回家后，除了吃饭，

questions.correctFeedback: 除了……就是…… indicates that watching TV is the sole remaining activity.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 除了……就是…… to express an exclusive remaining action.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This grammer emphasizes that if the person or thing after 除了 is excluded, there is only the person or thing after 就是. The phrase 以外 can be omitted. For example, 我來臺灣除了學習中文以外，就是工作。Or 他週末除了爬山，就是在家打掃。

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express an alternative compound where either one condition or the other must happen using 不是……，就是……
grammarPages.explanation: 「不是……，就是……」為選擇複句，表示「不是」後面的人事物和「就是」後面的人事物，兩個當中一定有一個發生或成立，沒有其他的情況或選擇。例如：教室裡的書包不是小美的，就是小麗的。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 不是 + Choice 1，就是 + Choice 2

text.traditional: 婆婆每天不是煮魚湯、雞湯給我喝，就是幫我買菜、做家事……
text.simplified: 婆婆每天不是煮鱼汤、鸡汤给我喝，就是帮我买菜、做家事……
text.pinyin: Pópo měi tiān bú shì zhǔ yútāng, jītāng gěi wǒ hē, jiùshì bāng wǒ mǎi cài, zuò jiāshì…
text.english: Every day my mother-in-law either makes fish or chicken soup for me, or helps me shop for food and do housework…

text.traditional: 小華很會利用放假的時間，不是去健身，就是參加各種社團活動。
text.simplified: 小华很会利用放假的时间，不是去健身，就是参加各种社团活动。
text.pinyin: Xiǎo Huá hěn huì lìyòng fàngjià de shíjiān, bú shì qù jiànshēn, jiùshì cānjiā gè zhǒng shètuán huódòng.
text.english: Xiao Hua makes good use of his time off, either working out or joining various club activities.

words.meaning: every kind of; all kinds of; various

text.traditional: 每年華語中心的春節活動，不是唱歌，就是跳舞，今年我們來設計一些不同的活動吧！
text.simplified: 每年华语中心的春节活动，不是唱歌，就是跳舞，今年我们来设计一些不同的活动吧！
text.pinyin: Měi nián Huáyǔ Zhōngxīn de Chūnjié huódòng, bú shì chànggē, jiùshì tiàowǔ, jīnnián wǒmen lái shèjì yìxiē bù tóng de huódòng ba!
text.english: The Chinese center’s Lunar New Year activities are always either singing or dancing. Let us design some different activities this year!

items.question: How does 不是……就是…… differ from 除了……就是……?
items.answer: 不是……就是…… presents two alternative possibilities (either A or B). 除了……就是…… states that after removing A, only B exists.
items.wrongTraditional: 桌上的水果不是蘋果以外，就是香蕉。
items.wrongSimplified: 桌上的水果不是苹果以外，就是香蕉。

right.traditional: 桌上的水果不是蘋果，就是香蕉。
right.simplified: 桌上的水果不是苹果，就是香蕉。
right.pinyin: Zhuō shàng de shuǐguǒ búshì píngguǒ, jiùshì xiāngjiāo.
right.english: The fruit on the table is either apples or bananas.

items.question: Can 不是……就是…… be used when both options happen simultaneously?
items.answer: No, 不是……就是…… is strictly disjunctive (one or the other). For both, use 不但……而且…… or 又……又…….
items.wrongTraditional: 他又聰明，不是又努力。
items.wrongSimplified: 他又聪明，不是又努力。

right.traditional: 他不是看書，就是寫字。
right.simplified: 他不是看书，就是写字。
right.pinyin: Tā búshì kànshū, jiùshì xiězì.
right.english: He is either reading books or writing characters.

segments.hint: either older brother or younger brother

questions.correctFeedback: 不是……就是…… indicates that one of the two brothers must have eaten it.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 不是……就是…… for two mutually exclusive alternative possibilities.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 不是……，就是…… is a compound sentence which means either the person and the thing after 不是 or the person and the thing after 就是 must happen or be established, there are no other conditions or choices. For example, 教室裡的書包不是小美的，就是小麗的。

dialogue.title: 對話 · 地震和颱風 · Earthquakes and Typhoons

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 昨晚的颱風真可怕。
lines.simplified: 昨晚的台风真可怕。
lines.pinyin: Zuówǎn de táifēng zhēn kěpà.
lines.english: Fangcao: Last night's typhoon was truly terrifying.

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 是啊！這次的強烈颱風不但風大雨大，而且來的速度突然變快，讓人來不及準備。
lines.simplified: 是啊！这次的强烈台风不但风大雨大，而且来的速度突然变快，让人来不及准备。
lines.pinyin: Shì a! Zhè cì de qiángliè táifēng búdàn fēng dà yǔ dà, érqiě lái de sùdù tūrán biàn kuài, ràng rén láibùjí zhǔnbèi.
lines.english: Jiahao: Yeah! This strong typhoon not only brought heavy winds and rain, but also sped up so suddenly that people didn't have time to prepare.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 前天的新聞只說這個颱風離臺灣不遠，要大家注意，沒想到來得這麼快。你家沒事吧？
lines.simplified: 前天的新闻只说这个台风离台湾不远，要大家注意，没想到来得这么快。你家没事吧？
lines.pinyin: Qiántiān de xīnwén zhǐ shuō zhè ge táifēng lí Táiwān bù yuǎn, yào dàjiā zhùyì, méi xiǎngdào lái de zhème kuài. Nǐ jiā méi shì ba?
lines.english: Fangcao: The news the day before yesterday only said this typhoon wasn't far from Taiwan and warned everyone to pay attention; who knew it would come so fast. Is your home okay?

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 屋子裡還好，可是社區周圍有很多樹木被吹倒了，馬路兩旁的路燈也被吹壞了，而且我住的這棟樓整晚都停電。妳家呢？
lines.simplified: 屋子里还好，可是社区周围有很多树木被吹倒了，马路两旁的路灯也被吹坏了，而且我住的这栋楼整晚都停电。你家呢？
lines.pinyin: Wūzi lǐ háihǎo, kěshì shèqū zhōuwéi yǒu hěn duō shùmù bèi chuīdǎo le, mǎlù liǎngpáng de lùdēng yě bèi chuīhuài le, érqiě wǒ zhù de zhè dòng lóu zhěngwǎn dōu tíngdiàn. Nǐ jiā ne?
lines.english: Jiahao: Inside the house is fine, but around the neighborhood lots of trees were blown down, streetlamps along the road were smashed, and the building I live in had a blackout all night. How about yours?

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 我家還好。因為外面淹水，家裡螞蟻多了一點。鄰居的運氣就沒這麼好，他們家被破壞得很嚴重，連屋頂都飛了。
lines.simplified: 我家还好。因为外面淹水，家里蚂蚁多了一点。邻居的运气就没这么好，他们家被破坏得很严重，连屋顶都飞了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ jiā háihǎo. Yīnwèi wàimiàn yānshuǐ, jiā lǐ mǎyǐ duō le yìdiǎn. Línjū de yùnqì jiù méi zhème hǎo, tāmen jiā bèi pòhuài de hěn yánzhòng, lián wūdǐng dōu fēi le.
lines.english: Fangcao: My home is okay. Because of flooding outside, there are a few more ants inside. The neighbors weren't as lucky; their house was severely damaged, and even their roof flew off.

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 真是太糟糕了！那很難整理吧？
lines.simplified: 真是太糟糕了！那很难整理吧？
lines.pinyin: Zhēn shì tài zāogāo le! Nà hěn nán zhěnglǐ ba?
lines.english: Jiahao: That's terrible! It must be very hard to clean up?

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 是啊。收音機的廣播說，東部有一些地區發生水災，很多房子塌了，住在那裡的人還得離開家，住到安全的地方去。
lines.simplified: 是啊。收音机的广播说，东部有一些地区发生水灾，很多房子塌了，住在那里的人还得离开家，住到安全的地方去。
lines.pinyin: Shì a. Shōuyīnjī de guǎngbō shuō, dōngbù yǒu yìxiē dìqū fāshēng shuǐzāi, hěn duō fángzi tā le, zhù zài nàlǐ de rén hái děi líkāi jiā, zhù dào ānquán de dìfang qù.
lines.english: Fangcao: Yes. The radio broadcast said flooding occurred in some eastern regions; many houses collapsed, and people living there had to leave home to stay in safe places.

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 我昨天晚上沒辦法看電視，手機也沒電，所以不知道最新的消息。沒想到東部的情況這麼嚴重。
lines.simplified: 我昨天晚上没办法看电视，手机也没电，所以不知道最新的消息。没想到东部的情况这么严重。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān wǎnshang méi bànfǎ kàn diànshì, shǒujī yě méi diàn, suǒyǐ bù zhīdào zuìxīn de xiāoxi. Méi xiǎngdào dōngbù de qíngkuàng zhème yánzhòng.
lines.english: Jiahao: Last night I couldn't watch TV and my phone was out of power, so I didn't know the latest news. I didn't realize the eastern situation was so severe.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 聽說還有一個颱風要來，跟臺灣的距離只有一千公里。我看你最好準備個收音機，這樣停電時也能聽到颱風的最新消息。還有，要注意門窗有沒有問題，萬一被颱風吹壞，造成意外就麻煩了。
lines.simplified: 听说还有一个台风要来，跟台湾的距离只有一千公里。我看你最好准备个收音机，这样停电时也能听到台风的最新消息。还有，要注意门窗有没有问题，万一被台风吹坏，造成意外就麻烦了。
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō hái yǒu yí ge táifēng yào lái, gēn Táiwān de jùlí zhǐyǒu yìqiān gōnglǐ. Wǒ kàn nǐ zuìhǎo zhǔnbèi ge shōuyīnjī, zhèyàng tíngdiàn shí yě néng tīngdào táifēng de zuìxīn xiāoxi. Hái yǒu, yào zhùyì ménchuāng yǒu méi yǒu wèntí, wànyī bèi táifēng chuīhuài, zàochéng yìwài jiù máfan le.
lines.english: Fangcao: I heard another typhoon is coming, only 1,000 kilometers from Taiwan. I think you'd better get a radio ready, so that during a blackout you can still hear the latest typhoon updates. Also, check if there are problems with windows and doors; in case they get broken by the typhoon and cause accidents, it will be troublesome.

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 好，我知道了。提到收音機，讓我想起小時候，有一次來了個大颱風，一連下了好幾天的大雨。停電的時候，我們一家人點著蠟燭坐在收音機旁，一邊聽著廣播，一邊聽著外面的風雨聲，那種感覺到現在都忘不了。
lines.simplified: 好，我知道了。提到收音机，让我想起小时候，有一次来了个大台风，一连下了好几天的大雨。停电的时候，我们一家人点着蜡烛坐在收音机旁，一边听着广播，一边听着外面的风雨声，那种感觉到现在都忘不了。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ zhīdào le. Tídào shōuyīnjī, ràng wǒ xiǎngqǐ xiǎoshíhou, yǒu yí cì lái le ge dà táifēng, yìlián xià le hǎojǐ tiān de dàyǔ. Tíngdiàn de shíhou, wǒmen yì jiā rén diǎn zhe làzhú zuò zài shōuyīnjī páng, yìbiān tīng zhe guǎngbō, yìbiān tīng zhe wàimiàn de fēngyǔshēng, nà zhǒng gǎnjué dào xiànzài dōu wàng buliǎo.
lines.english: Jiahao: Okay, got it. Mentioning radios reminds me of my childhood: once a huge typhoon hit and it rained hard for several days in a row. During the blackout, our whole family lit candles and sat by the radio, listening to the broadcast while hearing the wind and rain outside; that feeling is unforgettable even now.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 我也記得小時候晚上一停電就點蠟燭。有一次鄰居點蠟燭時不小心，差點就引起火災，把大家嚇了一跳。
lines.simplified: 我也记得小时候晚上一停电就点蜡烛。有一次邻居点蜡烛时不小心，差点就引起火灾，把大家吓了一跳。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě jìde xiǎoshíhou wǎnshang yì tíngdiàn jiù diǎn làzhú. Yǒu yí cì línjū diǎn làzhú shí bù xiǎoxīn, chàdiǎn jiù yǐnqǐ huǒzāi, bǎ dàjiā xià le yí tiào.
lines.english: Fangcao: I also remember lighting candles whenever power went out at night in my childhood. Once a neighbor wasn't careful when lighting a candle and almost caused a fire, which gave everyone quite a scare.

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 點蠟燭真的得很小心。對了，我等一下要去超市看看。每次颱風一來，蔬菜水果的價格就提高了，而且不一定買得到。妳最好也先準備一些吃的。
lines.simplified: 点蜡烛真的得很小心。对了，我等一下要去超市看看。每次台风一来，蔬菜水果的价格就提高了，而且不一定买得到。你最好也先准备一些吃的。
lines.pinyin: Diǎn làzhú zhēnde děi hěn xiǎoxīn. Duì le, wǒ děng yíxià yào qù chāoshì kànkan. Měi cì táifēng yì lái, shūcài shuǐguǒ de jiàgé jiù tígāo le, érqiě bù yídìng mǎi de dào. Nǐ zuìhǎo yě xiān zhǔnbèi yìxiē chī de.
lines.english: Jiahao: One really must be careful with candles. By the way, I'm heading to the supermarket soon. Whenever a typhoon hits, fruit and vegetable prices jump, and you might not even be able to get them. You'd better stock up on some food too.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 我早就買好了。剛來臺灣的時候，我以為隨時去超市都買得到新鮮的蔬菜，沒想到新聞一說颱風要來，不但變貴了，還被搶光了。
lines.simplified: 我早就买好了。刚来台湾的时候，我以为随时去超市都买得到新鲜的蔬菜，没想到新闻一说台风要来，不但变贵了，还被抢光了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zǎojiù mǎi hǎo le. Gāng lái Táiwān de shíhou, wǒ yǐwéi suíshí qù chāoshì dōu mǎi de dào xīnxiān de shūcài, méi xiǎngdào xīnwén yì shuō táifēng yào lái, búdàn biàn guì le, hái bèi qiǎng guāng le.
lines.english: Fangcao: I bought mine long ago. When I first came to Taiwan, I thought one could always buy fresh vegetables at the supermarket at any time; who knew that as soon as the news said a typhoon was coming, not only did prices rise, but everything was snatched up clean.

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 所以颱風來以前，應該先把食物準備好。
lines.simplified: 所以台风来以前，应该先把食物准备好。
lines.pinyin: Suǒyǐ táifēng lái yǐqián, yīnggāi xiān bǎ shíwù zhǔnbèi hǎo.
lines.english: Jiahao: So before a typhoon arrives, one should prepare food first.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 沒錯。不過，你還是先買收音機，再去超市吧。
lines.simplified: 没错。不过，你还是先买收音机，再去超市吧。
lines.pinyin: Méi cuò. Búguò, nǐ háishì xiān mǎi shōuyīnjī, zài qù chāoshì ba.
lines.english: Fangcao: Exactly. Still, you'd better buy the radio first before heading to the supermarket.

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 也好。我們下次再聊。
lines.simplified: 也好。我们下次再聊。
lines.pinyin: Yě hǎo. Wǒmen xià cì zài liáo.
lines.english: Jiahao: Sounds good. Let's chat next time.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express hypothetical low-probability emergencies and countermeasures using 萬一.
grammarPages.explanation: 「萬一」後面是可能性很小的假設，大多是不好的事情。
grammarPages.pattern: Condition / Prep + 萬一 + Contingency，(就/才) + Remedy

text.traditional: ……要注意門窗有沒有問題，萬一被颱風吹壞，造成意外就麻煩了。
text.simplified: ……要注意门窗有没有问题，万一被台风吹坏，造成意外就麻烦了。
text.pinyin: …… yào zhùyì ménchuāng yǒu méiyǒu wèntí, wànyī bèi táifēng chuīhuài, zàochéng yìwài jiù máfan le.
text.english: …Check the doors and windows for problems; if the typhoon damages them and causes an accident, it will be troublesome.

text.traditional: 出國旅遊前最好先買個旅遊平安保險，萬一發生什麼意外，就不必擔心了。
text.simplified: 出国旅游前最好先买个旅游平安保险，万一发生什么意外，就不必担心了。
text.pinyin: Chū guó lǚyóu qián zuì hǎo xiān mǎi ge lǚyóu píng'ān bǎoxiǎn, wànyī fāshēng shénme yìwài, jiù bú bì dānxīn le.
text.english: Before going abroad, it is best to buy travel insurance, so that if an accident happens you need not worry.

text.traditional: 我家裡平時都準備了一些蠟燭、電池什麼的，萬一停電了，才不會不方便。
text.simplified: 我家里平时都准备了一些蜡烛、电池什么的，万一停电了，才不会不方便。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiā lǐ píngshí dōu zhǔnbèi le yìxiē làzhú, diànchí shénme de, wànyī tíngdiàn le, cái bú huì bù fāngbiàn.
text.english: I usually keep candles, batteries and other supplies at home, so that a power outage will not cause inconvenience.

items.question: How does 萬一 differ from 如果 / 要是?
items.answer: 如果 / 要是 are neutral conditionals for any situation. 萬一 specifies a low-probability, typically undesirable event.
items.wrongTraditional: 萬一明天是晴天，我們就去爬山。
items.wrongSimplified: 万一明天是晴天，我们就去爬山。

right.traditional: 如果明天是晴天，我們就去爬山。
right.simplified: 如果明天是晴天，我们就去爬山。
right.pinyin: Rúguǒ míngtiān shì qíngtiān, wǒmen jiù qù páshān.
right.english: If tomorrow is sunny, we will go hiking.

items.question: What conjunctions typically follow the 萬一 clause?
items.answer: 就 (for negative consequences) or 才 (for preventative actions that avert trouble).
items.wrongTraditional: 出門帶傘，萬一下雨而且淋濕。
items.wrongSimplified: 出门带伞，万一下雨而且淋湿。

right.traditional: 出門帶傘，萬一下雨才不會淋濕。
right.simplified: 出门带伞，万一下雨才不会淋湿。
right.pinyin: Chūmén dài sǎn, wànyī xiàyǔ cái bú huì línshī.
right.english: Take an umbrella when going out, so in case it rains you won't get soaked.

questions.correctFeedback: 萬一 introduces an unexpected risk to guard against.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 萬一 to express an emergency or undesirable possibility.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 萬一 is followed by a hypothesis with little possibility; mostly refers to bad things.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe an action or state occurring continuously without interruption using 一連.
grammarPages.explanation: 「一連」表示同一個動作或情況連續發生，後面接動詞或數量詞。例如：「他一連吃了五個包子」、「一連三天我都在家休息」。而否定詞「不」或「沒」只能用在數量詞後面的動詞，例如：「一連三天都沒下雨」。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 一連 + Verb / Num-M + Predicate

text.traditional: ……有一次來了個大颱風，一連下了好幾天的大雨。
text.simplified: ……有一次来了个大台风，一连下了好几天的大雨。
text.pinyin: …… yǒu yí cì lái le ge dà táifēng, yìlián xià le hǎojǐ tiān de dàyǔ.
text.english: …Once a big typhoon came, and it rained heavily for several days in a row.

text.traditional: 他一連說了好幾個我聽不懂的句子，他說的到底是哪國話啊？
text.simplified: 他一连说了好几个我听不懂的句子，他说的到底是哪国话啊？
text.pinyin: Tā yìlián shuō le hǎojǐ ge wǒ tīng bu dǒng de jùzi, tā shuō de dàodǐ shì nǎ guó huà a?
text.english: He said several sentences in a row that I could not understand; what language was he speaking?

words.meaning: connects a describing word to a thing; can stand for a known thing

text.traditional: 我最近窮死了，已經一連兩個星期都吃泡麵了。
text.simplified: 我最近穷死了，已经一连两个星期都吃泡面了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn qióng sǐ le, yǐjīng yìlián liǎng ge xīngqī dōu chī pàomiàn le.
text.english: I have been dead broke recently and have already eaten instant noodles for two weeks in a row.

text.traditional: 他最近為了工作忙個不停，已經一連三天沒睡好覺了，精神很不好。
text.simplified: 他最近为了工作忙个不停，已经一连三天没睡好觉了，精神很不好。
text.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn wèile gōngzuò máng ge bù tíng, yǐjīng yìlián sān tiān méi shuì hǎo jiào le, jīngshén hěn bù hǎo.
text.english: He has been busy nonstop with work recently and has not slept well for three days in a row, so he is in poor spirits.

items.question: How does 一連 differ from 常常?
items.answer: 一連 means consecutively without any interruption. 常常 means frequently across distinct occasions.
items.wrongTraditional: 他常常三天沒睡覺。
items.wrongSimplified: 他常常三天没睡觉。

right.traditional: 他一連三天沒睡覺。
right.simplified: 他一连三天没睡觉。
right.pinyin: Tā yìlián sān tiān méi shuìjiào.
right.english: He went without sleep for three days straight.

items.question: Where is negation placed with 一連?
items.answer: Negation (沒/不) must appear after the quantifier phrase, directly before the verb: 一連三天沒下雨.
items.wrongTraditional: 一連沒三天吃東西。
items.wrongSimplified: 一连没三天吃东西。

right.traditional: 一連三天沒吃東西。
right.simplified: 一连三天没吃东西。
right.pinyin: Yìlián sān tiān méi chī dōngxi.
right.english: Didn't eat anything for three days straight.

tiles.meaning: rained three days in a row

questions.correctFeedback: 一連 denotes an unbroken consecutive sequence of three days of rain.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 一連 to express actions continuing unbroken in a row.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 一連 means that the same action or situation occurs continuously, followed by verbs and quantifiers. For example, 他一連吃了五個包子, 一連三天我都在家休息. The negative words 不 or 沒 can only be used on the verb after the quantifier, such as 一連三天都沒下雨.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Contrast a mistaken prior assumption with an unexpected reality using 以為……，沒想到……
grammarPages.explanation: 「以為」後面是說話者原本的想法，但和後面發生的事實不同。「沒想到」的後面是發生的事實，但發生前說話的人沒想過。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 以為 + Assumption，沒想到 + Reality

text.traditional: 我以為隨時去超市都買得到新鮮的蔬菜，沒想到新聞一說颱風要來……
text.simplified: 我以为随时去超市都买得到新鲜的蔬菜，没想到新闻一说台风要来……
text.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi suíshí qù chāoshì dōu mǎi de dào xīnxiān de shūcài, méi xiǎngdào xīnwén yì shuō táifēng yào lái……
text.english: I thought I could always get fresh vegetables at the supermarket, but unexpectedly, as soon as the news said a typhoon was coming…

words.meaning: connects a describing word to a thing; can stand for a known thing

text.traditional: 我以為我不會看上那件深紅色的洋裝，沒想到看來看去，最後還是買了。
text.simplified: 我以为我不会看上那件深红色的洋装，没想到看来看去，最后还是买了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi wǒ bú huì kàn shàng nà jiàn shēn hóngsè de yángzhuāng, méi xiǎngdào kàn lái kàn qù, zuìhòu háishì mǎi le.
text.english: I thought I would not like that dark red dress, but after looking over and over, I bought it in the end.

text.traditional: 王媽媽以為這道菜孩子們一定會搶著吃，沒想到他們連嚐都不肯嚐。
text.simplified: 王妈妈以为这道菜孩子们一定会抢着吃，没想到他们连尝都不肯尝。
text.pinyin: Wáng māma yǐwéi zhè dào cài háizimen yídìng huì qiǎng zhe chī, méi xiǎngdào tāmen lián cháng dōu bù kěn cháng.
text.english: Mrs. Wang thought the children would scramble to eat this dish, but unexpectedly they would not even taste it.

words.pinyin: tāmen lián cháng dōu bù kěn cháng

items.question: How does 以為 differ from 認為 / 覺得?
items.answer: 以為 always implies that the prior belief was mistaken. 認為 and 覺得 describe opinions without implying falsity.
items.wrongTraditional: 我認為今天會下雨，沒想到是晴天。
items.wrongSimplified: 我认为今天会下雨，没想到是晴天。

right.traditional: 我以為今天會下雨，沒想到是晴天。
right.simplified: 我以为今天会下雨，没想到是晴天。
right.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi jīntiān huì xiàyǔ, méi xiǎngdào shì qíngtiān.
right.english: I thought it would rain today, not expecting it to be sunny.

items.question: Can 沒想到 be replaced with 不料 or 誰知道?
items.answer: In formal or written Chinese, 不料 or 誰知 can be used, but in everyday spoken Chinese 沒想到 is standard.
items.wrongTraditional: 我以為他會來，可是他沒來了。
items.wrongSimplified: 我以为他会来，可是他没来了。

right.traditional: 我以為他會來，沒想到他沒來。
right.simplified: 我以为他会来，没想到他没来。
right.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi tā huì lái, méi xiǎngdào tā méi lái.
right.english: I thought he would come, not expecting he wouldn't.

questions.correctFeedback: 以為 marks the mistaken assumption that contrasts with the actual situation.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 以為 to introduce an erroneous preconception.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 以為 is followed by the speaker's original idea, which is different from what happened later. 沒想到 is followed by the fact that has already happened but which the speaker had not thought about beforehand.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Propose a preferred suggestion or wise compromise after weighing different options with ……，還是……吧.
grammarPages.explanation: 說話的人比較了不同情況以後，做出結論或提出建議。「還是」後面是提出的建議。
grammarPages.pattern: Clause，(Subject) + 還是 + Suggestion + 吧

columns.meaning: ending word that makes a suggestion
connects a describing word to a thing; can stand for a known thing
ending word that makes a suggestion
ending word that makes a suggestion

text.traditional: ……，你還是先買收音機，再去超市吧。
text.simplified: ……，你还是先买收音机，再去超市吧。
text.pinyin: ……, nǐ háishì xiān mǎi shōuyīnjī, zài qù chāoshì ba.
text.english: …You had better buy a radio first, then go to the supermarket.

words.meaning: ending word that makes a suggestion

text.traditional:
A：我想安排時間去日本旅行，你想什麼時候去最好？
B：日本春夏秋冬都美，任何時候去都好，你還是以自己方便的時間去吧。
text.simplified:
A：我想安排时间去日本旅行，你想什么时候去最好？
B：日本春夏秋冬都美，任何时候去都好，你还是以自己方便的时间去吧。
text.pinyin:
A:wǒ xiǎng ānpái shíjiān qù Rìběn lǚxíng, nǐ xiǎng shénme shíhòu qù zuì hǎo?
B:Rìběn chūn xià qiū dōng dōu měi, rènhé shíhou qù dōu hǎo, nǐ háishì yǐ zìjǐ fāngbiàn de shíjiān qù ba.
text.english: A: I want to arrange a trip to Japan. When do you think is best? B: Japan is beautiful in every season, so any time is good; you had better go when it is convenient for you.

text.traditional:
兒子：中秋節快到了，我可以找朋友來我們社區烤肉嗎？
爸爸：我擔心會影響鄰居的生活，你們還是去別的地方吧。
text.simplified:
儿子：中秋节快到了，我可以找朋友来我们社区烤肉吗？
爸爸：我担心会影响邻居的生活，你们还是去别的地方吧。
text.pinyin:
Érzi:Zhōngqiūjié kuài dào le, wǒ kěyǐ zhǎo péngyǒu lái wǒmen shèqū kǎoròu ma?
Bàba:wǒ dānxīn huì yǐngxiǎng línjū de shēnghuó, nǐmen háishì qù bié de dìfang ba.
text.english: Son: The Mid-Autumn Festival is coming. May I invite friends to our community for a barbecue? Dad: I worry it will disturb the neighbors; you had better go somewhere else.

words.meaning: ending word for a yes-or-no question
ending word that makes a suggestion

items.question: How does 還是……吧 differ from 或者?
items.answer: 或者 presents open alternatives without favoring one. 還是……吧 presents the speaker's definitive recommendation.
items.wrongTraditional: 外面風雨大，你或者坐我的車。
items.wrongSimplified: 外面风雨大，你或者坐我的车。

right.traditional: 外面風雨大，你還是坐我的車吧。
right.simplified: 外面风雨大，你还是坐我的车吧。
right.pinyin: Wàimiàn fēngyǔ dà, nǐ háishì zuò wǒ de chē ba.
right.english: The storm is fierce outside; you had better ride in my car.

items.question: What tone does 吧 convey at the end of 還是……吧?
items.answer: 吧 softens the advice into a polite, consultative suggestion rather than an imperative command.
items.wrongTraditional: 你還是必須先去醫院！
items.wrongSimplified: 你还是必须先去医院！

right.traditional: 你還是先去醫院吧。
right.simplified: 你还是先去医院吧。
right.pinyin: Nǐ háishì xiān qù yīyuàn ba.
right.english: You'd better go to the hospital first.

tiles.pinyin: háishì liú zài jiā lǐ ba
huòzhě liú zài jiā lǐ ma
yěxǔ liú zài jiā lǐ le

questions.correctFeedback: 還是……吧 offers the wisest suggestion given the severe storm.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 還是……吧 to propose a preferable recommendation.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The person speaking compares the different situations, then makes conclusions or suggestions. 還是 is followed by such suggestions.

dialogue.title: 短文 · 九二一大地震 · The September 21st Earthquake
grammarFocus: 方位詞：以東/以西/以南/以北

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 臺灣、印尼、日本等海島國家，整年大小地震不斷。研究人員認為，地震的主要原因是地理位置在太平洋周圍的關係。對住在這個地帶的人來說，地震好像是很平常的事情。不過，一九九九年九月二十一日，半夜一點四十七分，臺灣發生了一場規模七點三的強烈地震。地震發生時，讓臺灣人感覺到非常害怕。大約過了三十分鐘，又發生了規模六點七的地震，結果造成了非常嚴重的災情。一直到現在，人們還是忘不了那個可怕的夜晚。
lines.simplified: 台湾、印尼、日本等海岛国家，整年大小地震不断。研究人员认为，地震的主要原因是地理位置在太平洋周围的关系。对住在这个地带的人来说，地震好像是很平常的事情。不过，一九九九年九月二十一日，半夜一点四十七分，台湾发生了一场规模七点三的强烈地震。地震发生时，让台湾人感觉到非常害怕。大约过了三十分钟，又发生了规模六点七的地震，结果造成了非常严重的灾情。一直到现在，人们还是忘不了那个可怕的夜晚。
lines.pinyin: Táiwān, Yìnní, Rìběn děng hǎidǎo guójiā, zhěng nián dàxiǎo dìzhèn búduàn. Yánjiū rényuán rènwéi, dìzhèn de zhǔyào yuányīn shì dìlǐ wèizhì zài Tàipíngyáng zhōuwéi de guānxi. Duì zhù zài zhè ge dìdài de rén lái shuō, dìzhèn hǎoxiàng shì hěn píngcháng de shìqing. Búguò, yī jiǔ jiǔ jiǔ nián jiǔ yuè èrshíyī rì, bànyè yì diǎn sìshíqī fēn, Táiwān fāshēng le yì chǎng guīmó qī diǎn sān de qiángliè dìzhèn. Dìzhèn fāshēng shí, ràng Táiwānrén gǎnjué dào fēicháng hàipà. Dàyuē guò le sānshí fēnzhōng, yòu fāshēng le guīmó liù diǎn qī de dìzhèn, jiéguǒ zàochéng le fēicháng yánzhòng de zāiqíng. Yìzhí dào xiànzài, rénmen háishì wàng buliǎo nà ge kěpà de yèwǎn.
lines.english: Island nations such as Taiwan, Indonesia, and Japan experience continuous earthquakes of all sizes throughout the year. Researchers believe the primary cause of earthquakes is their geographical location around the Pacific Ocean. To people living in this zone, earthquakes seem to be quite ordinary. However, on September 21, 1999, at 1:47 a.m., Taiwan experienced a powerful magnitude 7.3 earthquake. When the earthquake struck, it made Taiwanese people feel terrified. About thirty minutes later, another magnitude 6.7 earthquake struck, resulting in extremely severe devastation. Even now, people still cannot forget that terrifying night.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 那一夜，中部山區有許多大石頭從山上掉了下來，不但路不通，甚至還有人被困在塌下來的屋子或石頭底下。許多人親眼看見這樣的情況，但是沒辦法把人救出來，只能向警察或軍人求救。不久，救災人員和軍隊都到達了災區，不少國外的專業人員也都趕到臺灣，大家把力量集合起來，很有耐心地找出被困的人。
lines.simplified: 那一夜，中部山区有许多大石头从山上掉了下来，不但路不通，甚至还有人被困在塌下来的屋子或石头底下。许多人亲眼看见这样的情况，但是没办法把人救出来，只能向警察或军人求救。不久，救灾人员和军队都到达了灾区，不少国外的专业人员也都赶到台湾，大家把力量集合起来，很有耐心地找出被困的人。
lines.pinyin: Nà yí yè, zhōngbù shānqū yǒu xǔduō dà shítóu cóng shānshàng diào le xiàlai, búdàn lù bù tōng, shènzhì hái yǒurén bèi kùn zài tā xiàlai de wūzi huò shítóu dǐxia. Xǔduō rén qīnyǎn kànjiàn zhèyàng de qíngkuàng, dànshì méi bànfǎ bǎ rén jiù chūlai, zhǐ néng xiàng jǐngchá huò jūnrén qiújiù. Bùjiǔ, jiùzāi rényuán hàn jūnduì dōu dàodá le zāiqū, bù shǎo guówài de zhuānyè rényuán yě dōu gǎndào Táiwān, dàjiā bǎ lìliàng jíhé qǐlai, hěn yǒu nàixīn de zhǎochū bèi kùn de rén.
lines.english: That night, in the central mountainous area, many huge boulders fell from the mountains; not only were roads blocked, but some people were even trapped under collapsed houses or rocks. Many people saw this situation with their own eyes, but had no way to rescue the victims, and could only call for help from police or soldiers. Soon, disaster relief personnel and troops arrived in the disaster area, and quite a few overseas specialists also rushed to Taiwan; everyone combined their efforts and patiently searched for the trapped survivors.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 地震過後沒多久，人們發現中部以北和以南的地方也有不少災情，所以天還沒亮，許多民眾就開著卡車，把水、食物、電池等資源送到災區，親自發給需要的人。那段時間，因為大家有錢出錢、有力出力，發揮了互相幫助的精神，所以才能讓災民很快地恢復正常的生活。
lines.simplified: 地震过后没多久，人们发现中部以北和以南的地方也有不少灾情，所以天还没亮，许多民众就开着卡车，把水、食物、电池等资源送到灾区，亲自发给需要的人。那段时间，因为大家有钱出钱、有力出力，发挥了互相帮助的精神，所以才能让灾民很快地恢复正常的生活。
lines.pinyin: Dìzhèn guòhòu méi duōjiǔ, rénmen fāxiàn zhōngbù yǐ běi hàn yǐ nán de dìfang yě yǒu bù shǎo zāiqíng, suǒyǐ tiān hái méi liàng, xǔduō mínzhòng jiù kāi zhe kǎchē, bǎ shuǐ, shíwù, diànchí děng zīyuán sòng dào zāiqū, qīnzì fā gěi xūyào de rén. Nà duàn shíjiān, yīnwèi dàjiā yǒu qián chū qián, yǒu lì chū lì, fāhuī le hùxiāng bāngzhù de jīngshén, suǒyǐ cái néng ràng zāimín hěn kuài de huīfù zhèngcháng de shēnghuó.
lines.english: Not long after the earthquake, people found that areas north and south of the central region also suffered considerable damage; therefore before dawn, many citizens drove trucks to deliver water, food, batteries, and other resources to the disaster area, personally distributing them to people in need. During that period, because everyone contributed money if they had money, and effort if they had effort, embodying the spirit of mutual help, the victims were able to quickly resume normal life.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 經過九二一大地震以後，臺灣比以前更重視地震教育，希望這樣能降低災情，人們不要再因為地震而失去了寶貴的生命。
lines.simplified: 经过九二一大地震以后，台湾比以前更重视地震教育，希望这样能降低灾情，人们不要再因为地震而失去了宝贵的生命。
lines.pinyin: Jīngguò Jiǔ'èryī dà dìzhèn yǐhòu, Táiwān bǐ yǐqián gèng zhòngshì dìzhèn jiàoyù, xīwàng zhèyàng néng jiàngdī zāiqíng, rénmen bú yào zài yīnwèi dìzhèn ér shīqù le bǎoguì de shēngmìng.
lines.english: Following the 921 Earthquake, Taiwan attached greater importance to earthquake education than before, hoping to reduce disaster impact so people will never again lose precious lives because of earthquakes.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: As a Result, In the End
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Connect an event to its unexpected or ultimate outcome using the conjunction 結果.
grammarPages.explanation: 「結果」作連詞，表示事情發生後，最後的情況。「結果」後面接的句子是這件事情最後的情況。
grammarPages.pattern: Event Clause，結果 + Outcome Clause

columns.meaning: connects a describing word to a thing; can stand for a known thing

text.traditional: ……又發生了規模六點七的地震，結果造成了非常嚴重的災情……
text.simplified: ……又发生了规模六点七的地震，结果造成了非常严重的灾情……
text.pinyin: …… yòu fāshēng le guīmó liù diǎn qī de dìzhèn, jiéguǒ zàochéng le fēicháng yánzhòng de zāiqíng……
text.english: …Another magnitude 6.7 earthquake occurred, resulting in very serious disaster damage…

text.traditional: 昨天我在夜市看上了一件上衣，沒試穿就買了，結果回家後穿上才發現太小了。
text.simplified: 昨天我在夜市看上了一件上衣，没试穿就买了，结果回家后穿上才发现太小了。
text.pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zài yèshì kàn shàng le yí jiàn shàngyī, méi shìchuān jiù mǎi le, jiéguǒ huí jiā hòu chuān shàng cái fāxiàn tài xiǎo le.
text.english: Yesterday I liked a top at the night market and bought it without trying it on; when I got home and put it on, I found it was too small.

words.meaning: be in the middle of an action; at

text.traditional: 這幾個月很多人因為感冒而住院了，我和家人出門都會戴上口罩，結果妹妹還是感冒了。
text.simplified: 这几个月很多人因为感冒而住院了，我和家人出门都会戴上口罩，结果妹妹还是感冒了。
text.pinyin: Zhè jǐ ge yuè hěn duō rén yīnwèi gǎnmào ér zhùyuàn le, wǒ hé jiārén chūmén dōu huì dài shàng kǒuzhào, jiéguǒ mèimei háishì gǎnmào le.
text.english: Many people have been hospitalized with colds these past few months, so my family and I wear masks when we go out; my younger sister still caught a cold.

items.question: How does 結果 differ from 所以?
items.answer: 所以 expresses logical cause-and-effect. 結果 emphasizes the ultimate outcome, often contrary to hopes or plans.
items.wrongTraditional: 他很努力準備，所以考試沒及格。
items.wrongSimplified: 他很努力准备，所以考试没及格。

right.traditional: 他很努力準備，結果考試沒及格。
right.simplified: 他很努力准备，结果考试没及格。
right.pinyin: Tā hěn nǔlì zhǔnbèi, jiéguǒ kǎoshì méi jígé.
right.english: He prepared diligently; in the end, he failed the exam.

items.question: Can 結果 serve as both noun and conjunction?
items.answer: Yes, as a noun it means 'outcome' (考試的結果); as a conjunction it links clauses ('as a result, ...').
items.wrongTraditional: 這件事情的結果是我們結果遲到了。
items.wrongSimplified: 这件事情的结果是我们结果迟到了。

right.traditional: 路上塞車，結果我們遲到了。
right.simplified: 路上塞车，结果我们迟到了。
right.pinyin: Lùshàng sāichē, jiéguǒ wǒmen chídào le.
right.english: There was a traffic jam on the road, and as a result we were late.

segments.hint: as a result was late this morning

tiles.meaning: as a result late this morning

questions.correctFeedback: 結果 marks the final unforeseen consequence of not setting an alarm.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 結果 to introduce the ultimate outcome.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 結果 is a conjunction indicating the final situation after an event has occurred. The sentence after 結果 is the final condition of this matter.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Highlight an unexpected extreme or surprising addition using 甚至(連)……也/都……
grammarPages.explanation: 「甚至」後面是說話的人要強調的人、事或物。有時和「不但/不僅」或「連……都/也……」一起使用，例如：我姊姊不但會唱歌，也會寫歌，甚至辦過個人演唱會。
grammarPages.pattern: Clause，甚至 + (連) Extreme + (也/都) Predicate

text.traditional: ……不但路不通，甚至還有人被困在塌下來的屋子或石頭底下。
text.simplified: ……不但路不通，甚至还有人被困在塌下来的屋子或石头底下。
text.pinyin: …… búdàn lù bù tōng, shènzhì hái yǒurén bèi kùn zài tā xiàlai de wūzi huò shítou dǐxià.
text.english: …Not only were roads blocked, but people were even trapped under collapsed houses or rocks.

text.traditional: 張小姐什麼動物都不怕，就是怕蛇，甚至連蛇的圖片也怕。
text.simplified: 张小姐什么动物都不怕，就是怕蛇，甚至连蛇的图片也怕。
text.pinyin: Zhāng xiǎojiě shénme dòngwù dōu bú pà, jiùshì pà shé, shènzhì lián shé de túpiàn yě pà.
text.english: Miss Zhang is not afraid of any animal except snakes; she is even afraid of pictures of snakes.

text.traditional: 馬老闆一忙起來，不但沒空吃飯，甚至連上廁所的時間都沒有。
text.simplified: 马老板一忙起来，不但没空吃饭，甚至连上厕所的时间都没有。
text.pinyin: Mǎ lǎobǎn yì máng qǐlai, búdàn méi kòng chīfàn, shènzhì lián shàng cèsuǒ de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu.
text.english: When Boss Ma gets busy, he not only has no time to eat but does not even have time to use the toilet.

items.question: How does 甚至 differ from 而且?
items.answer: 而且 adds parallel information. 甚至 adds an extreme, surprising case that escalates the degree.
items.wrongTraditional: 他會很多外語，而且會說古希臘語。
items.wrongSimplified: 他会很多外语，而且会说古希腊语。

right.traditional: 他會很多外語，甚至會說古希臘語。
right.simplified: 他会很多外语，甚至会说古希腊语。
right.pinyin: Tā huì hěn duō wàiyǔ, shènzhì huì shuō Gǔ Xīlàyǔ.
right.english: He knows many languages, and can even speak Ancient Greek.

items.question: When 甚至 pairs with 連, where does 連 go?
items.answer: 連 directly follows 甚至: 甚至連 + noun + 也/都.
items.wrongTraditional: 連他甚至名字都記不住。
items.wrongSimplified: 连他甚至名字都记不住。

right.traditional: 他甚至連名字都記不住。
right.simplified: 他甚至连名字都记不住。
right.pinyin: Tā shènzhì lián míngzi dōu jì bu zhù.
right.english: He can't even remember names.

segments.traditional: 這對雙胞胎長得太像了，
segments.simplified: 这对双胞胎长得太像了，

tiles.pinyin: shènzhì lián fùmǔ dōu cháng rèncuò
suǒyǐ lián fùmǔ dōu cháng rèncuò
suīrán lián fùmǔ dōu cháng rèncuò

questions.correctFeedback: 甚至連……都…… emphasizes the extreme surprise that even their own parents mistake them.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 甚至連……都…… to express an extreme unexpected degree.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The sentence following 甚至 is the main emphasis, which can be the person, the thing, or the object that the speaker wants to emphasize. It is often used with 不但 or 連……都/也……. For example, 我姊姊不但會唱歌，也會寫歌，甚至辦過個人演唱會.

grammarPages.titleTraditional: 方位詞：以東/以西/以南/以北
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Specify geographic areas relative to a reference point using 以東/以西/以南/以北.
grammarPages.explanation: 「以」表示方位的界限。「以」的前面放地區或是地名，例如：「臺中以北」意思是「臺中」為界限的北方。
grammarPages.pattern: Reference Point + 以 (東/西/南/北) + (的地區)

columns.meaning: connects a describing word to a thing; can stand for a known thing
connects a describing word to a thing; can stand for a known thing

text.traditional: 地震過後沒多久，人們發現中部以北和以南的地方也有不少災情。
text.simplified: 地震过后没多久，人们发现中部以北和以南的地方也有不少灾情。
text.pinyin: Dìzhèn guò hòu méi duōjiǔ, rénmen fāxiàn zhōngbù yǐ běi hàn yǐ nán de dìfang yě yǒu bù shǎo zāiqíng.
text.english: Not long after the earthquake, people found considerable damage in places both north and south of the central region.

text.traditional: 車站以北的地區比其他地區熱鬧，如果你想逛街購物，那裡真是個好地方。
text.simplified: 车站以北的地区比其他地区热闹，如果你想逛街购物，那里真是个好地方。
text.pinyin: Chēzhàn yǐ běi de dìqū bǐ qítā dìqū rènao, rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng guàngjiē gòuwù, nàlǐ zhēnshì ge hǎo dìfang.
text.english: The area north of the station is livelier than other areas; if you want to go shopping, it is a great place.

words.meaning: connects a describing word to a thing; can stand for a known thing
to go shopping, to stroll around the streets

text.traditional: 我覺得花蓮市以南到臺東這一段路的風景最美，值得推薦給喜歡旅遊的人。
text.simplified: 我觉得花莲市以南到台东这一段路的风景最美，值得推荐给喜欢旅游的人。
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde Huālián shì yǐ nán dào Táidōng zhè yí duàn lù de fēngjǐng zuì měi, zhídé tuījiàn gěi xǐhuān lǚyóu de rén.
text.english: I think the scenery on the stretch south of Hualien City to Taitung is the most beautiful and worth recommending to people who like traveling.

words.meaning: connects a describing word to a thing; can stand for a known thing
connects a describing word to a thing; can stand for a known thing

items.question: How does 臺北以南 differ from 臺北的南方?
items.answer: 臺北以南 describes an open regional zone starting from Taipei and heading south. 臺北的南方 refers to a specific direction or location south of Taipei.
items.wrongTraditional: 火車站的西方房子比較便宜。
items.wrongSimplified: 火车站的西方房子比较便宜。

right.traditional: 火車站以西的房子比較便宜。
right.simplified: 火车站以西的房子比较便宜。
right.pinyin: Huǒchēzhàn yǐ xī de fángzi bǐjiào piányi.
right.english: Apartments west of the train station are cheaper.

items.question: Can 以 be combined with any single directional compass word?
items.answer: Yes: 以東 (east of), 以西 (west of), 以南 (south of), 以北 (north of).
items.wrongTraditional: 中部往北的地方也有災情。
items.wrongSimplified: 中部往北的地方也有灾情。

right.traditional: 中部以北的地方也有災情。
right.simplified: 中部以北的地方也有灾情。
right.pinyin: Zhōngbù yǐ běi de dìfang yě yǒu zāiqíng.
right.english: Areas north of the central region also experienced disaster damage.

questions.correctFeedback: 火車站以西 indicates the geographic region extending westward from the station.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 基點 + 以 + 方向 (東/西/南/北) to specify a regional boundary.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 以 indicates the boundary of a place. Place the name of an area or location in front of 以. For example, 臺中以北 means north of the boundary of 臺中.

dialogue.title: 暑假的打算

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 暑假快到了，你有什麼打算？最近我和幾個朋友計畫去環島旅行，想跟我們去嗎？
lines.simplified: 暑假快到了，你有什么打算？最近我和几个朋友计划去环岛旅行，想跟我们去吗？
lines.pinyin: Shǔjià kuài dào le, nǐ yǒu shénme dǎsuàn? Zuìjìn wǒ hé jǐ ge péngyou jìhuà qù huándǎo lǚxíng, xiǎng gēn wǒmen qù ma?
lines.english: Summer vacation is almost here. What are your plans? Recently a few friends and I are planning a trip around the island; want to come with us?

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 想倒是想，可是我要趁暑假多打一點兒工，多存一些錢。因為畢業後，我打算去法國留學。
lines.simplified: 想倒是想，可是我要趁暑假多打一点儿工，多存一些钱。因为毕业后，我打算去法国留学。
lines.pinyin: Xiǎng dàoshì xiǎng, kěshì wǒ yào chèn shǔjià duō dǎ yìdiǎnr gōng, duō cún yìxiē qián. Yīnwèi bìyè hòu, wǒ dǎsuàn qù Fǎguó liúxué.
lines.english: I do want to, but I need to take advantage of summer break to work a bit more and save more money. Because after graduation, I plan to study abroad in France.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 你平常下課後就去補習，暑假還要打工，有休閒活動的時間嗎？
lines.simplified: 你平常下课后就去补习，暑假还要打工，有休闲活动的时间吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ píngcháng xiàkè hòu jiù qù bǔxí, shǔjià hái yào dǎgōng, yǒu xiūxián huódòng de shíjiān ma?
lines.english: You usually go to tutoring after class, and you have to work part-time in the summer; do you have time for leisure activities?

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 我有空的時候還是會上網看看電影、玩玩遊戲什麼的。
lines.simplified: 我有空的时候还是会上网看看电影、玩玩游戏什么的。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu kòng de shíhou háishì huì shàngwǎng kànkan diànyǐng, wánwan yóuxì shénme de.
lines.english: When I'm free, I still go online to watch movies, play games, and stuff.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 你不想去戶外走走嗎？最近有人調查臺灣青少年的休閒活動，發現其中有五分之四的人最常去的休閒場所是「家裡」。最讓我驚訝的是，這五分之四裡面有一半的人，週末都在家上網或睡覺。
lines.simplified: 你不想去户外走走吗？最近有人调查台湾青少年的休闲活动，发现其中有五分之四的人最常去的休闲场所是「家里」。最让我惊讶的是，这五分之四里面有一半的人，周末都在家上网或睡觉。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bù xiǎng qù hùwài zǒuzou ma? Zuìjìn yǒurén diàochá Táiwān qīngshàonián de xiūxián huódòng, fāxiàn qízhōng yǒu wǔ fēn zhī sì de rén zuì cháng qù de xiūxián chǎngsuǒ shì 'jiālǐ'. Zuì ràng wǒ jīngyà de shì, zhè wǔ fēn zhī sì lǐmiàn yǒu yíbàn de rén, zhōumò dōu zài jiā shàngwǎng huò shuìjiào.
lines.english: Don't you want to go outdoors? Recently someone surveyed leisure activities of Taiwanese youth and found that for 4/5 of them, the most frequented leisure venue is 'home'. What surprised me most is that half of that 4/5 spend weekends online or sleeping at home.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 哈哈哈！我就是其中一個。其實，我不但喜歡戶外活動，以前還常跟哥哥去日本滑雪，做一些刺激的活動。我知道運動對身心健康很有幫助，只是最近又打工又補習，回到家就累得不想動了。
lines.simplified: 哈哈哈！我就是其中一个。其实，我不但喜欢户外活动，以前还常跟哥哥去日本滑雪，做一些刺激的活动。我知道运动对身心健康很有帮助，只是最近又打工又补习，回到家就累得不想动了。
lines.pinyin: Hāhāhā! Wǒ jiùshì qízhōng yí ge. Qíshí, wǒ búdàn xǐhuan hùwài huódòng, yǐqián hái cháng gēn gēge qù Rìběn huáxuě, zuò yìxiē cìjī de huódòng. Wǒ zhīdào yùndòng duì shēnxīn jiànkāng hěn yǒu bāngzhù, zhǐshì zuìjìn yòu dǎgōng yòu bǔxí, huí dào jiā jiù lèi de bù xiǎng dòng le.
lines.english: Hahaha! I'm one of them. Actually, not only do I like outdoor activities, I used to often go skiing in Japan with my older brother and do thrilling activities. I know exercise helps physical and mental health; it's just that lately with both part-time work and tutoring, I'm too tired to move once I get home.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 這樣你的體力會越來越差的，應該多出去流流汗才好。下個週末有一場海灘球賽，我們還少一位球員。你有興趣嘗試嗎？
lines.simplified: 这样你的体力会越来越差的，应该多出去流流汗才好。下个周末有一场海滩球赛，我们还少一位球员。你有兴趣尝试吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng nǐ de tǐlì huì yuè lái yuè chà de, yīnggāi duō chūqù liúliúhàn cái hǎo. Xià ge zhōumò yǒu yì chǎng hǎitān qiúsài, wǒmen hái shǎo yí wèi qiúyuán. Nǐ yǒu xìngqù chángshì ma?
lines.english: Your physical stamina will get worse and worse this way; it's better to get out and sweat. Next weekend there is a beach ball game, and we're short one player. Interested in trying?

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 我不去！我怕水，對大海還有心理障礙。
lines.simplified: 我不去！我怕水，对大海还有心理障碍。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ bú qù! Wǒ pà shuǐ, duì dàhǎi hái yǒu xīnlǐ zhàng'ài.
lines.english: I'm not going! I'm afraid of water and still have a psychological barrier toward the sea.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 你不想克服這個障礙嗎？
lines.simplified: 你不想克服这个障碍吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bù xiǎng kèfú zhège zhàng'ài ma?
lines.english: Don't you want to overcome this barrier?

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 當然想。上個星期我跟一位會衝浪的朋友見面，看他自由自在衝浪的樣子，好酷喔！真希望這輩子也能學會衝浪。
lines.simplified: 当然想。上个星期我跟一位会冲浪的朋友见面，看他自由自在冲浪的样子，好酷喔！真希望这辈子也能学会冲浪。
lines.pinyin: Dāngrán xiǎng. Shàng ge xīngqī wǒ gēn yí wèi huì chōnglàng de péngyou jiànmiàn, kàn tā zìyóuzìzài chōnglàng de yàngzi, hǎo kù o! Zhēn xīwàng zhè bèizi yě néng xuéhuì chōnglàng.
lines.english: Of course I do. Last week I met a friend who surfs; watching him surf freely and easily looked so cool! I really hope I can learn to surf in this lifetime.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 這樣好了，等你去了法國，我請我叔叔教你。他是個衝浪教練，我從小就跟著他學。記得有一次練習時，牙齒被衝浪板打到了，流了很多血，有一段時間不敢衝浪。還好，最後總算克服了。
lines.simplified: 这样好了，等你去了法国，我请我叔叔教你。他是个冲浪教练，我从小就跟着他学。记得有一次练习时，牙齿被冲浪板打到了，流了很多血，有一段时间不敢冲浪。还好，最后总算克服了。
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng hǎo le, děng nǐ qù le Fǎguó, wǒ qǐng wǒ shūshu jiāo nǐ. Tā shì ge chōnglàng jiàoliàn, wǒ cóng xiǎo jiù gēnzhe tā xué. Jìde yǒu yí cì liànxí shí, yáchǐ bèi chōnglàngbǎn dǎdào le, liú le hěn duō xiě, yǒu yí duàn shíjiān bù gǎn chōnglàng. Hái hǎo, zuìhòu zǒngsuàn kèfú le.
lines.english: How about this: once you go to France, I'll ask my uncle to teach you. He's a surf coach; I learned with him growing up. I remember once during practice my tooth got hit by the surfboard, bleeding a lot, and for a while I didn't dare to surf. Fortunately, I finally overcame it.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 既然你這樣說，下個週末我就跟你去參加海灘球賽吧。
lines.simplified: 既然你这样说，下个周末我就跟你去参加海滩球赛吧。
lines.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ zhèyàng shuō, xià ge zhōumò wǒ jiù gēn nǐ qù cānjiā hǎitān qiúsài ba.
lines.english: Since you put it that way, next weekend I'll go with you to join the beach ball game.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 太好了。不過，參加球賽是需要體力的，你最好主動一點兒，每天去慢跑。要是比賽贏了，我就招待你去吃大餐。
lines.simplified: 太好了。不过，参加球赛是需要体力的，你最好主动一点儿，每天去慢跑。要是比赛赢了，我就招待你去吃大餐。
lines.pinyin: Tài hǎo le. Búguò, cānjiā qiúsài shì xūyào tǐlì de, nǐ zuìhǎo zhǔdòng yìdiǎnr, měitiān qù mànpǎo. Yàoshi bǐsài yíng le, wǒ jiù zhāodài nǐ qù chī dàcān.
lines.english: Awesome. However, playing in the game takes stamina; you'd better be proactive and jog every day. If we win the game, I'll treat you to a feast.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 太棒了！我今天就開始去跑步，練練體力。
lines.simplified: 太棒了！我今天就开始去跑步，练练体力。
lines.pinyin: Tài bàng le! Wǒ jīntiān jiù kāishǐ qù pǎobù, liànlian tǐlì.
lines.english: Fantastic! Starting today I'll go running to build up my stamina.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Concede a point with 倒是/是, then turn to the contrast with 可是/但是/不過.
grammarPages.explanation: 「倒是」是副詞，前句「……倒是/是……」表示說話的人認同對方的看法、意見，語氣比較客氣。後句「可是/但是/不過……」進一步表達不同的看法。「倒是」的「倒」可以省略。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 倒是 is an adverb. The first sentence means that the speaker agrees with the other person's views and opinions, and the tone is more polite. 可是/但是/不過 then expresses different opinions. 倒 of 倒是 can be omitted.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 倒是/是 + Positive view, 可是/但是/不過 + Different view

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express a share of a whole with X分之Y, read the whole first.
grammarPages.explanation: X 代表整體，Y 代表部分，說明某事物的數量在整體中的比例。例如：「2/3」的中文是「三分之二」、「5%」的中文是「百分之五」。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: X stands for the whole, and Y stands for the part, indicating the proportion of the number of things in the whole. For example, 2/3 is 三分之二, 5% is 百分之五.
grammarPages.pattern: X分之Y: 分之 sits between the whole (X) and the part (Y)

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say something you hoped for has finally happened after a wait or effort, with 總算.
grammarPages.explanation: 「總算」當副詞，表示經過一段時間的等待或努力後，期待的事情實現了。常用在口語。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 總算 is an adverb, indicating that after a long time or after some hard work, something one has desired has finally been realized. Often used in spoken Chinese.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 總算 + Result

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Take a fact as given with 既然, then state your suggestion or conclusion with 就.
grammarPages.explanation: 「既然」當連詞，是前句的句首，接已經發生或確定的事實。「就」放在後句，接說話者對前面事實表示的主觀意見、建議或結論。例如：既然你不要這本書了，就給我吧。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 既然 as a conjunction is put at the beginning of the sentence. 既然 follows an event which has already occurred or facts that have already been confirmed. 就 is put in the latter part of the sentence and shows the speaker's subjective opinions, suggestions, or conclusions about the previous facts. For example, 既然你不要這本書了，就給我吧。
grammarPages.pattern: 既然 + Fact, (…) 就 + Conclusion

dialogue.title: 張先生的決定

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 張文華在老闆的眼中，是個認真又有能力的好員工，所以進公司不久就當上了經理。他不僅要管理各部門的員工，還得負責市場研究、規劃新產品的設計等，經常因為加班而犧牲週末的休息時間；手機裡記著每天的行程和大大小小的事情，甚至連客人的興趣都記在上面。他的生活裡好像只有工作，分分秒秒都很緊張。
lines.simplified: 张文华在老板的眼中，是个认真又有能力的好员工，所以进公司不久就当上了经理。他不仅要管理各部门的员工，还得负责市场研究、规划新产品的设计等，经常因为加班而牺牲周末的休息时间；手机里记着每天的行程和大大小小的事情，甚至连客人的兴趣都记在上面。他的生活里好像只有工作，分分秒秒都很紧张。
lines.pinyin: Zhāng Wénhuá zài lǎobǎn de yǎn zhōng, shì ge rènzhēn yòu yǒu nénglì de hǎo yuángōng, suǒyǐ jìn gōngsī bùjiǔ jiù dāngshang le jīnglǐ. Tā bùjǐn yào guǎnlǐ gè bùmén de yuángōng, hái děi fùzé shìchǎng yánjiū, guīhuà xīn chǎnpǐn de shèjì děng, jīngcháng yīnwèi jiābān ér xīshēng zhōumò de xiūxi shíjiān; shǒujī lǐ jìzhe měitiān de xíngchéng hé dàdàxiǎoxiǎo de shìqing, shènzhì lián kèrén de xìngqù dōu jì zài shàngmiàn. Tā de shēnghuó lǐ hǎoxiàng zhǐyǒu gōngzuò, fēnfēnmiǎomiǎo dōu hěn jǐnzhāng.
lines.english: Narrator: In his boss's eyes, Zhang Wenhua was a diligent and capable employee, so not long after joining the company he became manager. He not only managed employees of various departments, but also oversaw market research and product design planning, often sacrificing weekend rest for overtime; his phone recorded daily schedules and matters large and small, even guests' interests. Life seemed to consist only of work, tense every second.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 除了辦公室裡必要的工作，為了讓生意談得更順利，有時張文華下班以後，還得陪客人到酒吧去喝幾杯。雖然他覺得那裡的音樂聽起來像噪音，但是為了工作不能不去，有時候還會喝得太多。有一次他醉得很厲害，第二天上班時，一整天都覺得精神很差，一直到了第三天才慢慢恢復。
lines.simplified: 除了办公室里必要的工作，为了让生意谈得更顺利，有时张文华下班以后，还得陪客人到酒吧去喝几杯。虽然他觉得那里的音乐听起来像噪音，但是为了工作不能不去，有时候还会喝得太多。有一次他醉得很厉害，第二天上班时，一整天都觉得精神很差，一直到了第三天才慢慢恢复。
lines.pinyin: Chúle bàngōngshì lǐ bìyào de gōngzuò, wèile ràng shēngyì tán de gèng shùnlì, yǒushí Zhāng Wénhuá xiàbān yǐhòu, hái děi péi kèrén dào jiǔbā qù hē jǐ bēi. Suīrán tā juéde nàlǐ de yīnyuè tīng qǐlai xiàng zàoyīn, dànshì wèile gōngzuò bùnéng bú qù, yǒu shíhou hái huì hē de tài duō. Yǒu yí cì tā zuì de hěn lìhai, dì-èr tiān shàngbān shí, yì zhěng tiān dōu juéde jīngshén hěn chà, yìzhí dào le dì-sān tiān cái mànmàn huīfù.
lines.english: Besides essential office tasks, to make business negotiations run smoothly, Zhang Wenhua sometimes had to accompany clients to bars for drinks after work. Although he felt the music there sounded like noise, for work he could not not go, and sometimes drank too much. Once he got very drunk, felt terrible all day at work the next day, and only gradually recovered by the third day.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 有一天張文華正準備出門上班時，他看到電視上播著新聞，有位明星因為工作太累、太緊張，以吸毒來忘掉痛苦，結果被警察抓了。看到這樣的新聞，他突然明白不能因為工作，而傷害自己的身心健康，所以決定重新規劃自己的生活。
lines.simplified: 有一天张文华正准备出门上班时，他看到电视上播着新闻，有位明星因为工作太累、太紧张，以吸毒来忘掉痛苦，结果被警察抓了。看到这样的新闻，他突然明白不能因为工作，而伤害自己的身心健康，所以决定重新规划自己的生活。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu yì tiān Zhāng Wénhuá zhèng zhǔnbèi chūmén shàngbān shí, tā kàndào diànshì shàng bōzhe xīnwén, yǒu wèi míngxīng yīnwèi gōngzuò tài lèi, tài jǐnzhāng, yǐ xīdú lái wàngdiào tòngkǔ, jiéguǒ bèi jǐngchá zhuā le. Kàndào zhèyàng de xīnwén, tā tūrán míngbai bùnéng yīnwèi gōngzuò, ér shānghài zìjǐ de shēnxīn jiànkāng, suǒyǐ juédìng chóngxīn guīhuà zìjǐ de shēnghuó.
lines.english: One day as Zhang Wenhua was just preparing to leave for work, he saw news on TV: a celebrity, overwhelmed and stressed from work, took drugs to forget the pain and was arrested by police. Seeing this news, he suddenly realized one must not harm mental and physical health for work, so he decided to replan his life.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 從那天起，他試著把年輕時的興趣找回來，開始玩音響、參加樂團。一放假就帶著孩子去海邊釣魚、去山上摘水果，也開始在院子裡種起花來了。當開花的季節到了，家人就會在院子裡看看花、聊聊天。上個星期他的樂團辦了一場戶外演唱會，好多人都去看他們的表演，結束時還放了煙火，熱鬧得不得了。
lines.simplified: 从那天起，他试着把年轻时的兴趣找回来，开始玩音响、参加乐团。一放假就带着孩子去海边钓鱼、去山上摘水果，也开始在院子里种起花来了。当开花的季节到了，家人就会在院子里看看花、聊聊天。上个星期他的乐团办了一场户外演唱会，好多人都去看他们的表演，结束时还放了烟火，热闹得不得了。
lines.pinyin: Cóng nà tiān qǐ, tā shìzhe bǎ niánqīng shí de xìngqù zhǎo huílái, kāishǐ wán yīnxiǎng, cānjiā yuètuán. Yí fàngjià jiù dàizhe háizi qù hǎibiān diàoyú, qù shānshàng zhāi shuǐguǒ, yě kāishǐ zài yuànzi lǐ zhòng qǐ huā lái le. Dāng kāihuā de jìjié dào le, jiārén jiù huì zài yuànzi lǐ kànkan huā, liáoliao tiān. Shàng ge xīngqī tā de yuètuán bàn le yì chǎng hùwài yǎnchànghuì, hǎo duō rén dōu qù kàn tāmen de biǎoyǎn, jiéshù shí hái fàng le yānhuǒ, rènào de bùdéliǎo.
lines.english: From that day on, he tried to recover hobbies from his youth, taking up audio gear and joining a band. On holidays he took his children fishing by the sea and fruit-picking on the mountain, and started planting flowers in the yard. When blooming season arrived, the family would enjoy the flowers and chat in the yard. Last week his band held an outdoor concert, crowds came to watch, and fireworks went off at the finale—it was lively beyond words.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 過去張文華滿腦子都是工作，現在下班時間快到時，就趕快把必要的工作完成，馬上離開辦公室。對他來說，生活的意義不再只是工作，「休息是為了走更遠的路」，努力往前走時，也要停下來看看周圍美麗的風景。
lines.simplified: 过去张文华满脑子都是工作，现在下班时间快到时，就赶快把必要的工作完成，马上离开办公室。对他来说，生活的意义不再只是工作，「休息是为了走更远的路」，努力往前走时，也要停下来看看周围美丽的风景。
lines.pinyin: Guòqù Zhāng Wénhuá mǎnnǎozǐ dōu shì gōngzuò, xiànzài xiàbān shíjiān kuài dào shí, jiù gǎnkuài bǎ bìyào de gōngzuò wánchéng, mǎshàng líkāi bàngōngshì. Duì tā lái shuō, shēnghuó de yìyì bú zài zhǐshì gōngzuò, 'xiūxi shì wèile zǒu gèng yuǎn de lù', nǔlì wǎng qián zǒu shí, yě yào tíng xiàlai kànkan zhōuwéi měilì de fēngjǐng.
lines.english: In the past Zhang Wenhua's head was full of work; now when off-work time nears, he quickly finishes essential tasks and leaves the office immediately. To him, life's meaning is no longer just work: 'rest is for walking a longer road'; while striving forward, one must also pause to take in the beautiful scenery around.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Cannot not / Have no choice but
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say you must do something with 不能不 (duty) or 不得不 (no choice, reluctant).
grammarPages.explanation:
(一)不能不
「不能不」有應該、必須、一定要負責某件事，不做不行的意思。
(二)不得不
表示當事人的心裡不願意做某件事，因為沒辦法只好做了，有無奈的感覺，語氣比「不能不」強。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish:
(一)不能不
不能不 means that you should, must, and definitely will be responsible for something, and you cannot not to do it.
(二)不得不
不得不 shows that the person does not want to do something. However, he has no choice but to do it, and he feels helpless. The tone is stronger than 不能不.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 不能不 / 不得不 + Action

text.simplified: 我叔叔才五十岁，最近因为生病的关系，不得不早一点退休。

text.english: My uncle is only fifty; recently, because of illness, he has no choice but to retire a bit early.

text.simplified: 这个地区发生了严重的森林火灾，许多人的房子被烧掉了，不得不离开，到安全的地方去。
