text.english: A serious forest fire broke out in this area and many people's houses burned down, so they have no choice but to leave for a safe place.

items.question: Is 不能不 the same as 不得不?
items.answer: 不能不 means must; 不得不 means no choice, and it is reluctant.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say one thing was just starting when another happened by coincidence, with 正 + V.
grammarPages.explanation: 「正」當副詞，有剛好、巧合的意思。「正」後面的第一件事剛開始做或剛好準備要做時，第二件事也很巧合的發生了，例如：「我正打開門時，就看見爸爸回來了」、「我正要回家，就下起雨來了」。「正」後面常接「要、想、打算、準備」等動詞。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 正 is an adverb, followed by a verb or an auxillary verb, which means "coincidentally". The first thing after 正 has just started or has already been completed, and the second thing happens by coincidence. For example, 我正打開門時，就看見爸爸回來了。Or 我正要回家，就下起雨來了。正 is often followed by verbs such as 要, 想, 打算, 準備, etc.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 正 + Action (要/想/打算/準備), 就 + Second event

dialogue.title: 走吧！當背包客去

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 東賢，你姊姊是不是又計畫去旅行了？
lines.simplified: 东贤，你姊姊是不是又计划去旅行了？
lines.pinyin: Dōngxián, nǐ jiějie shì bú shì yòu jìhuà qù lǚxíng le?
lines.english: Dongxian, is your older sister planning another trip again?

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 沒錯。她正準備去非洲大草原。
lines.simplified: 没错。她正准备去非洲大草原。
lines.pinyin: Méicuò. Tā zhèng zhǔnbèi qù Fēizhōu dà cǎoyuán.
lines.english: That's right. She's just getting ready to go to the African savanna.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 我常看她部落格裡的背包客日記，不但內容充實、想法獨特，而且跟旅遊相關的建議也寫得很詳細，讓我打開了視野。
lines.simplified: 我常看她部落格里的背包客日记，不但内容充实、想法独特，而且跟旅游相关的建议也写得很详细，让我打开了视野。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ cháng kàn tā bùluògé lǐ de bēibāokè rìjì, búdàn nèiróng chōngshí, xiǎngfǎ dútè, érqiě gēn lǚyóu xiāngguān de jiànyì yě xiě de hěn xiángxì, ràng wǒ dǎkāi le shìyě.
lines.english: I often read the backpacker diary on her blog. Not only is the content substantial and original, but the travel tips are written in great detail, which broadened my horizons.

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 我姊姊真的很厲害，一個人上山下海到處旅行。數一數，她已經去過三十幾個國家了。因為她的關係，我也對旅行產生了興趣，上個月她來臺灣時，我們還一起騎自行車環島呢！
lines.simplified: 我姊姊真的很厉害，一个人上山下海到处旅行。数一数，她已经去过三十几个国家了。因为她的关系，我也对旅行产生了兴趣，上个月她来台湾时，我们还一起骑自行车环岛呢！
lines.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie zhēnde hěn lìhai, yì ge rén shàngshān xiàhǎi dàochù lǚxíng. Shǔ yì shǔ, tā yǐjīng qù guò sānshí jǐ ge guójiā le. Yīnwèi tā de guānxì, wǒ yě duì lǚxíng chǎnshēng le xìngqù, shàng ge yuè tā lái Táiwān shí, wǒmen hái yìqǐ qí zìxíngchē huándǎo ne!
lines.english: My sister is truly amazing, traveling everywhere by herself from mountains to seas. Counting them up, she's visited over thirty countries. Because of her, I also got interested in travel; when she came to Taiwan last month, we even cycled around the island together!

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 真好。我猜，這次的環島旅行一定讓你姊姊很難忘吧？
lines.simplified: 真好。我猜，这次的环岛旅行一定让你姊姊很难忘吧？
lines.pinyin: Zhēn hǎo. Wǒ cāi, zhè cì de huándǎo lǚxíng yídìng ràng nǐ jiějie hěn nánwàng ba?
lines.english: How wonderful. I bet this island-cycling trip was unforgettable for your sister?

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 唉，怎麼說呢？我們本來計畫旅行十天，可惜才六天就結束了。
lines.simplified: 唉，怎么说呢？我们本来计划旅行十天，可惜才六天就结束了。
lines.pinyin: Ài, zěnme shuō ne? Wǒmen běnlái jìhuà lǚxíng shí tiān, kěxī cái liù tiān jiù jiéshù le.
lines.english: Well, how should I put it? We originally planned a 10-day trip, but unfortunately it ended after just 6 days.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 怎麼回事？
lines.simplified: 怎么回事？
lines.pinyin: Zěnme huí shì?
lines.english: What happened?

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 我們的運氣很差，碰到了壞天氣。出發前，氣象預報說那幾天都是晴天。頭幾天的天氣很好，誰知道到了第六天，一到山區天空就突然變黑，也下起了大雨，我的衣服都濕了，自行車也壞了。
lines.simplified: 我们的运气很差，碰到了坏天气。出发前，气象预报说那几天都是晴天。头几天的天气很好，谁知道到了第六天，一到山区天空就突然变黑，也下起了大雨，我的衣服都湿了，自行车也坏了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen de yùnqì hěn chà, pèngdào le huài tiānqì. Chūfā qián, qìxiàng yùbào shuō nà jǐ tiān dōu shì qíngtiān. Tóu jǐ tiān de tiānqì hěn hǎo, shéi zhīdào dào le dì-liù tiān, yí dào shānqū tiānkōng jiù tūrán biàn hēi, yě xià qǐ le dàyǔ, wǒ de yīfu dōu shī le, zìxíngchē yě huài le.
lines.english: Our luck was terrible; we ran into bad weather. Before leaving, the weather forecast said those days would all be sunny. The first few days were great, but on the sixth day, as soon as we hit the mountains the sky turned black and heavy rain poured down. My clothes were soaked and my bike broke down.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 那真糟糕！不過山區的天氣本來變化就很大，有時山下還是晴天，山上已經變涼，甚至起風、下雨了。後來你們怎麼辦？
lines.simplified: 那真糟糕！不过山区的天气本来变化就很大，有时山下还是晴天，山上已经变凉，甚至起风、下雨了。后来你们怎么办？
lines.pinyin: Nà zhēn zāogāo! Búguò shānqū de tiānqì běnlái biànhuà jiù hěn dà, yǒushí shānxià háishì qíngtiān, shānshàng yǐjīng biàn liáng, shènzhì qǐfēng, xiàyǔ le. Hòulái nǐmen zěnme bàn?
lines.english: That's awful! But mountain weather changes a lot naturally; sometimes it's still sunny at the foot of the mountain while cool, windy, or rainy up top. What did you do then?

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 那時，我們的手機訊號很弱，一直連絡不到能修理的人，只好推著自行車走了很長的一段路。
lines.simplified: 那时，我们的手机讯号很弱，一直连络不到能修理的人，只好推着自行车走了很长的一段路。
lines.pinyin: Nà shí, wǒmen de shǒujī xùnhào hěn ruò, yìzhí liánluò bú dào néng xiūlǐ de rén, zhǐhǎo tuī zhe zìxíngchē zǒu le hěn cháng de yí duàn lù.
lines.english: Back then our cell reception was very weak and we couldn't reach anyone to repair it, so we had no choice but to push the bikes along a long stretch of road.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 附近沒有商店嗎？有沒有車子經過？
lines.simplified: 附近没有商店吗？有没有车子经过？
lines.pinyin: Fùjìn méiyǒu shāngdiàn ma? Yǒu méiyǒu chēzi jīngguò?
lines.english: Were there no shops nearby? Did any cars pass by?

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 那是在偏僻的山區，附近什麼都沒有。還好後來遇到一個當地人，他幫我們把車修好。沒想到那時候我姊姊突然發燒了，我們不得不縮短行程，趕快下山去醫院。
lines.simplified: 那是在偏僻的山区，附近什么都没有。还好后来遇到一个当地人，他帮我们把车修好。没想到那时候我姊姊突然发烧了，我们不得不缩短行程，赶快下山去医院。
lines.pinyin: Nà shì zài piānpì de shānqū, fùjìn shénme dōu méiyǒu. Hái hǎo hòulái yùdào yí ge dāngdì rén, tā bāng wǒmen bǎ chē xiū hǎo. Méi xiǎngdào nà shíhou wǒ jiějie tūrán fāshāo le, wǒmen bùdébù suōduǎn xíngchéng, gǎnkuài xiàshān qù yīyuàn.
lines.english: It was in a remote mountain area with nothing around. Fortunately we ran into a local who fixed our bike. Little did we expect my sister suddenly ran a fever, so we had to cut the trip short and hurry down the mountain to the hospital.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 聽起來這次的旅行不太順利。不過話說回來，就是因為不確定會碰到什麼，所以旅行才這麼迷人。
lines.simplified: 听起来这次的旅行不太顺利。不过话说回来，就是因为不确定会碰到什么，所以旅行才这么迷人。
lines.pinyin: Tīng qǐlai zhè cì de lǚxíng bú tài shùnlì. Búguò huàshuō huílái, jiùshì yīnwèi bú quèdìng huì pèngdào shénme, suǒyǐ lǚxíng cái zhème mírén.
lines.english: Sounds like this trip wasn't very smooth. But then again, it's precisely because you never know what you'll encounter that travel is so enchanting.

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 沒錯，我姊姊也是這麼說的。
lines.simplified: 没错，我姊姊也是这么说的。
lines.pinyin: Méicuò, wǒ jiějie yě shì zhème shuō de.
lines.english: Exactly; my sister said so too.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 你姊姊這次去非洲，還是一個人去嗎？有個人陪比較好吧。
lines.simplified: 你姊姊这次去非洲，还是一个人去吗？有个人陪比较好吧。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ jiějie zhè cì qù Fēizhōu, háishì yí ge rén qù ma? Yǒu ge rén péi bǐjiào hǎo ba.
lines.english: Is your sister going to Africa by herself again this time? It might be better to have someone accompany her.

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 她早就習慣一個人旅行了，想去哪裡就去哪裡，不必在意別人的想法。再說，她的旅行經驗這麼豐富，一個人去絕對沒問題的。像規劃行程、辦簽證，上網查當地的氣溫、地形等等，對她來說，都是小事。
lines.simplified: 她早就习惯一个人旅行了，想去哪里就去哪里，不必在意别人的想法。再说，她的旅行经验这么丰富，一个人去绝对没问题的。像规划行程、办签证，上网查当地的气温、地形等等，对她来说，都是小事。
lines.pinyin: Tā zǎojiù xíguàn yí ge rén lǚxíng le, xiǎng qù nǎlǐ jiù qù nǎlǐ, bú bì zàiyì biérén de xiǎngfǎ. Zàishuō, tā de lǚxíng jīngyàn zhème fēngfù, yí ge rén qù juéduì méi wèntí de. Xiàng guīhuà xíngchéng, bàn qiānzhèng, shàngwǎng chá dāngdì de qìwēn, dìxíng děngděng, duì tā lái shuō, dōu shì xiǎoshì.
lines.english: She's long used to solo travel: going wherever she wants without having to care about others' opinions. Besides, with her rich travel experience, going alone is no problem at all. Planning itineraries, applying for visas, checking weather and terrain online—to her, these are all easy.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 這麼說，不管她想去哪裡，沒有去不成的？
lines.simplified: 这么说，不管她想去哪里，没有去不成的？
lines.pinyin: Zhème shuō, bùguǎn tā xiǎng qù nǎlǐ, méiyǒu qù bu chéng de?

lines.english: No wonder her backpacker diary is always so captivating.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express a short time, small quantity, or quick result with 才……就……, and show surprise.
grammarPages.explanation:
(1)「才……（，）就……」：「才」在這裡強調時間短、不久，或是數量少、次數少、程度低，後面和「就」一起使用；「就」的後面表示接著出現的事實，但是說話的人對這樣的情況感到驚訝。例如：你不是很餓嗎？怎麼才吃一碗就飽了？這句話的意思是，說話的人覺得你應該要吃兩、三碗，只吃一碗太少了。
(2)「才……（，）就……」：「才」是「剛剛」的意思，表示「才」後面的事情剛剛發生，「就」後面的事情是緊接著發生的。例如：我才出門就下雨了。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish:
(1) 才……（，）就……: 才 here emphasizes that the time is short, or the number is small, the frequency is less often, and the level is low. 才 is used together with 就 in the second part to indicate the fact that follows, but the speaker feels surprised with this situation. For example, 你不是很餓嗎？怎麼才吃一碗飯就飽了？ The meaning of this sentence is that the speaker thinks that you should eat two or three bowls, but only one bowl is not enough!
(2) 才……（，）就……: 才 means "just now", which means that the action described after 才 just happened, and the action described after 就 happened immediately afterwards. For example, 我才出門就下雨了。
grammarPages.pattern: 才（，）就 + result

text.traditional: 我們本來計畫旅行十天，可惜才六天就結束了。
text.simplified: 我们本来计划旅行十天，可惜才六天就结束了。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen běnlái jìhuà lǚxíng shí tiān, kěxī cái liù tiān jiù jiéshù le.

text.traditional: 小馬的工作能力很強，生意越做越大，才二十幾歲就已經是三家公司的老闆了。
text.simplified: 小马的工作能力很强，生意越做越大，才二十几岁就已经是三家公司的老板了。
text.pinyin: Xiǎo Mǎ de gōngzuò nénglì hěn qiáng, shēngyi yuè zuò yuè dà, cái èrshí jǐ suì jiù yǐjīng shì sān jiā gōngsī de lǎobǎn le.
text.english: Xiao Ma works very capably and his business keeps growing; he is only in his twenties and already the boss of three companies.

text.traditional: 弟弟才剛畢業就立刻找到了一份好工作，運氣真好。
text.simplified: 弟弟才刚毕业就立刻找到了一份好工作，运气真好。
text.pinyin: Dìdi cái gāng bìyè jiù lìkè zhǎodào le yí fèn hǎo gōngzuò, yùnqi zhēn hǎo.
text.english: My younger brother had just graduated and immediately found a good job; he is really lucky.

text.traditional: 你才剛從歐洲旅行回來，就開始安排去非洲旅遊的計畫，不累嗎？
text.simplified: 你才刚从欧洲旅行回来，就开始安排去非洲旅游的计划，不累吗？
text.pinyin: Nǐ cái gāng cóng Ōuzhōu lǚxíng huílai, jiù kāishǐ ānpái qù Fēizhōu lǚyóu de jìhuà, bú lèi ma?
text.english: You have just come back from a trip to Europe and already you are planning a trip to Africa; aren't you tired?

items.question: How does 才……就 differ from 剛……就?
items.answer: 才……就 emphasizes surprising brevity, small quantity, or earliness. 剛……就 merely denotes that an event just took place temporally.
items.wrongTraditional: 他剛學了三天就說得非常好。
items.wrongSimplified: 他刚学了三天就说得非常好。

right.traditional: 他才學了三天就說得非常好。
right.simplified: 他才学了三天就说得非常好。
right.pinyin: Tā cái xué le sān tiān jiù shuō de fēicháng hǎo.
right.english: He studied for only three days and already speaks very well.

items.question: Can 就 be omitted in the 才……就 structure?
items.answer: No, 就 connects the surprising premise (marked by 才) to the resulting rapid event or state.
items.wrongTraditional: 我才出門而且下雨了。
items.wrongSimplified: 我才出门而且下雨了。

right.traditional: 我才出門就下起雨來了。
right.simplified: 我才出门就下起雨来了。
right.pinyin: Wǒ cái chūmén jiù xià qǐ yǔ lái le.
right.english: No sooner had I stepped out the door than it started raining.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Add a different opinion or return to the main point with 話說回來.
grammarPages.explanation: 跟別人對話時，說話的人雖然不反對對方的說法，但是，自己有不同的意見或更有道理的想法，這個時候就可以在「話說回來」的後面說明。也可以使用「話說回來」把談話的主題拉回來，並表達對這個話題最主要的意見。「話說回來」前面常加「不過、可是、但是」等詞。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 話說回來 is used when talking to others. Although the person speaking does not oppose the other person's ideas, he still has different opinions or more reasonable ideas. At this time, he can use 話說回來 then explain his opinion. 話說回來 can also be used to return to the topic of the conversation and express the most basic opinions on this topic. The words 不過, 可是 or 但是 are often added in front of 話說回來.
grammarPages.pattern: （不過／可是／但是）話說回來，……

text.traditional:
A：上網找資料不僅方便，還可以找到其他相關的資料。
B：是啊。不過話說回來，網路上的資料不一定都是對的。
text.simplified:
A：上网找资料不仅方便，还可以找到其他相关的资料。
B：是啊。不过话说回来，网路上的资料不一定都是对的。
text.pinyin:
A: Shàngwǎng zhǎo zīliào bùjǐn fāngbiàn, hái kěyǐ zhǎodào qítā xiāngguān de zīliào.
B: Shì a. Búguò huàshuō huílái, wǎnglù shàng de zīliào bù yídìng dōu shì duì de.
text.english:
A: Looking for information online is not only convenient, you can also find other related information.
B: Yes. But then again, not all information online is necessarily correct.

text.traditional:
A：住在捷運站附近，方便是方便，不過噪音太大，讓我沒辦法好好休息。
B：可是話說回來，你不是說方便比什麼都重要，所以才搬到那裡去住的嗎？

A：住在捷运站附近，方便是方便，不过噪音太大，让我没办法好好休息。
B：可是话说回来，你不是说方便比什么都重要，所以才搬到那里去住的吗？
text.pinyin:
A: Zhù zài jiéyùn zhàn fùjìn, fāngbiàn shì fāngbiàn, búguò zàoyīn tài dà, ràng wǒ méi bànfǎ hǎohǎo xiūxi.
B: Kěshì huàshuō huílái, nǐ bú shì shuō fāngbiàn bǐ shénme dōu zhòngyào, suǒyǐ cái bān dào nàlǐ qù zhù de ma?
text.english:

B: But then again, didn't you say convenience matters more than anything, which is why you moved there?

items.question: What function does 話說回來 perform in conversation?
items.answer: It introduces a balanced, realistic counter-point without directly attacking or invalidating the other person's earlier observation.
items.wrongTraditional: 不過總而言之，網路資料不全對。
items.wrongSimplified: 不过总而言之，网路资料不全对。

right.traditional: 不過話說回來，網路資料不全對。
right.simplified: 不过话说回来，网路资料不全对。
right.pinyin: Búguò huàshuō huílái, wǎnglù zīliào bù quán duì.
right.english: Then again, web information is not entirely accurate.

items.question: What conjunctions usually precede 話說回來?
items.answer: Adversative words such as 不過, 可是, or 但是.
items.wrongTraditional: 因為話說回來，旅行也是很危險的。
items.wrongSimplified: 因为话说回来，旅行也是很危险的。

right.traditional: 可是話說回來，旅行也是很危險的。
right.simplified: 可是话说回来，旅行也是很危险的。
right.pinyin: Kěshì huàshuō huílái, lǚxíng yě shì hěn wēixiǎn de.
right.english: Then again, traveling can also be very dangerous.

questions.correctFeedback: 不過話說回來 smoothly pivots to the other side of the coin.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: So, Based on What You Said…
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Draw a conclusion from what the other person just said with 這麼說.
grammarPages.explanation: 「這麼說」是「按照你說的情況來看」的意思。「這麼說」的後面是說話的人根據對方說的內容，表達自己的推斷。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 這麼說 means 如果按照你說的情況來看(If, according to what you have said...). After 這麼說, the speaker expresses his own inferences based on what the other party has said.
grammarPages.pattern: 這麼說，（推斷）

items.question: How does 這麼說 differ from 也就是說?
items.answer: 這麼說 draws a tentative deduction from someone else's statement. 也就是說 restates or clarifies the same meaning in other words.
items.wrongTraditional: 也就是說，明天可能會放颱風假喔！
items.wrongSimplified: 也就是说，明天可能会放台风假喔！

right.traditional: 這麼說，明天可能會放颱風假喔！
right.simplified: 这么说，明天可能会放台风假喔！
right.pinyin: Zhème shuō, míngtiān kěnéng huì fàng táifēng jià o!
right.english: In that case, tomorrow might be a typhoon day off!

items.question: What position does 這麼說 take in a sentence?
items.answer: It stands at the beginning of the responsive turn, preceding the speaker's deduction.
items.wrongTraditional: 明天可能會放颱風假，這麼說！
items.wrongSimplified: 明天可能会放台风假，这么说！

right.traditional: 這麼說，明天可能會放颱風假！
right.simplified: 这么说，明天可能会放台风假！
right.pinyin: Zhème shuō, míngtiān kěnéng huì fàng táifēng jià!
right.english: In that case, tomorrow might be a typhoon day off!

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Verb + 成 (Completed / Not Completed / Possible / Impossible)
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say whether an action was completed or whether it is possible with V 成.
grammarPages.explanation: 「成」是結果補語，有成功、完成、實現的意思。「V 成」表示動作已經完成、實現了；「沒 V 成」表示沒有完成、實現，用在已經發生的情況；「V 得成」、「V 不成」表示有或沒有完成、實現的可能性。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 成 is the result complement, with the meaning of success, completion, and realization. V 成 means that the action has been completed or realized; 沒 V 成 means that the action has not been completed or accomplished. V 得成, V 不成 means the possibility of completion or realization is uncertain.
grammarPages.pattern: V 成 / 沒 V 成 / V 得成 / V 不成

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Use 成 to show completion, failure, or possibility.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Complete the sentences with V 成, 沒 V 成, V 得成 or V 不成.

items.question: How does 沒V成 differ from V不成?
items.answer: 沒V成 refers to an action in the past that failed to materialize. V不成 indicates an ongoing or future impossibility.
items.wrongTraditional: 昨天的戶外音樂會，我們辦不成了。
items.wrongSimplified: 昨天的户外音乐会，我们办不成了。

right.traditional: 昨天的戶外音樂會，我們沒辦成。
right.simplified: 昨天的户外音乐会，我们没办成。
right.pinyin: Zuótiān de hùwài yīnyuèhuì, wǒmen méi bànchéng.
right.english: Yesterday's outdoor concert we didn't manage to hold.

items.question: What does V得成 express?
items.answer: V得成 expresses affirmative potential—that an action has the feasible capability to succeed.

dialogue.title: 馬丁的環島旅行

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 馬丁的好兄弟尚恩在臺灣學習中文，他常寄臺灣的明信片給馬丁。明信片上有的是有名的景點，像臺北101、太魯閣、孔廟；有的是臺灣文化的代表，像寺廟、歌仔戲、夜市小吃等等。
lines.simplified: 马丁的好兄弟尚恩在台湾学习中文，他常寄台湾的明信片给马丁。明信片上有的是有名的景点，像台北101、太鲁阁、孔庙；有的是台湾文化的代表，像寺庙、歌仔戏、夜市小吃等等。
lines.pinyin: Mǎdīng de hǎo xiōngdì Shàng'ēn zài Táiwān xuéxí Zhōngwén, tā cháng jì Táiwān de míngxìnpiàn gěi Mǎdīng. Míngxìnpiàn shàng yǒudeshì yǒumíng de jǐngdiǎn, xiàng Táiběi 101, Tàilǔgé, Kǒngmiào; yǒudeshì Táiwān wénhuà de dàibiǎo, xiàng sìmiào, gēzǎixì, yèshì xiǎochī děngděng.
lines.english: Narrator: Martin's close pal Shawn was studying Chinese in Taiwan and often mailed Taiwan postcards to Martin. Some depicted famous attractions like Taipei 101, Taroko Gorge, and the Confucius Temple; others represented Taiwanese culture, such as temples, Taiwanese opera, and night market snacks.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 馬丁常聽尚恩提到跟臺灣相關的事。比如，臺灣曾經是荷蘭和日本等國家的殖民地；臺灣人和中國人都說中文，可是有一些詞的用法不太一樣；就選舉文化來說，臺灣和法國很不同，不過願意服務民眾的人，都比較容易當選。
lines.simplified: 马丁常听尚恩提到跟台湾相关的事。比如，台湾曾经是荷兰和日本等国家的殖民地；台湾人和中国人都说中文，可是有一些词的用法不太一样；就选举文化来说，台湾和法国很不同，不过愿意服务民众的人，都比较容易当选。
lines.pinyin: Mǎdīng cháng tīng Shàng'ēn tídào gēn Táiwān xiāngguān de shì. Bǐrú, Táiwān céngjīng shì Hélán hé Rìběn děng guójiā de zhímíndì; Táiwānrén hé Zhōngguórén dōu shuō Zhōngwén, kěshì yǒu yìxiē cí de yòngfǎ bú tài yíyàng; jiù xuǎnjǔ wénhuà lái shuō, Táiwān hé Fǎguó hěn bù tóng, búguò yuànyì fúwù mínzhòng de rén, dōu bǐjiào róngyì dāngxuǎn.
lines.english: Martin often heard Shawn mention matters regarding Taiwan. For example, Taiwan had once been a colony of the Netherlands and Japan; both Taiwanese and mainland Chinese speak Chinese, but certain word usages differ; in terms of election culture, Taiwan and France are very different, though those willing to serve the public are more likely to get elected.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 馬丁覺得尚恩在臺灣的生活很有意思，他想，有一天一定要親自來確認一下，看看這個島是不是真的像尚恩說的那樣有意思。最近馬丁的工作不太順利，所以他決定給自己放個假，到離法國約一萬公里以外的臺灣走走。不僅要嚐嚐小吃，還計畫一個人騎自行車環島旅行。
lines.simplified: 马丁觉得尚恩在台湾的生活很有意思，他想，有一天一定要亲自来确认一下，看看这个岛是不是真的像尚恩说的那样有意思。最近马丁的工作不太顺利，所以他决定给自己放个假，到离法国约一万公里以外的台湾走走。不仅要尝尝小吃，还计划一个人骑自行车环岛旅行。
lines.pinyin: Mǎdīng juéde Shàng'ēn zài Táiwān de shēnghuó hěn yǒu yìsi, tā xiǎng, yǒu yì tiān yídìng yào qīnzì lái quèrèn yíxià, kànkan zhè ge dǎo shì bú shì zhēnde xiàng Shàng'ēn shuō de nàyàng yǒu yìsi. Zuìjìn Mǎdīng de gōngzuò bú tài shùnlì, suǒyǐ tā juédìng gěi zìjǐ fàng ge jià, dào lí Fǎguó yuē yí wàn gōnglǐ yǐwài de Táiwān zǒuzou. Bùjǐn yào chángchang xiǎochī, hái jìhuà yí ge rén qí zìxíngchē huándǎo lǚxíng.
lines.english: Martin found Shawn's life in Taiwan fascinating and felt that one day he must come personally verify if this island was really as intriguing as Shawn described. Recently Martin's work wasn't going smoothly, so he decided to take a holiday and visit Taiwan, some 10,000 kilometers away from France. He planned not only to taste local snacks, but also to cycle around the island alone.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 其實馬丁剛到臺灣時，還忘不了工作的問題，所以心情不太好。但是，當他在東部又寬又平的公路上，邊騎著自行車，邊欣賞美麗的風景時，他忽然覺得就像在天堂一樣，太美好、太值得了！還有一次，馬丁坐在椅子上，很專心地看著寺廟前的歌仔戲表演。演員演出時，剛好穿著和明信片上一樣的服裝，那種熟悉的感覺讓他很興奮，立刻拿起相機拍了起來。這段時間他也認識了一些樂觀、幽默的朋友，大家一起聊天、開玩笑，讓他開心得把工作的問題都忘了。馬丁覺得在臺灣經驗過的這些美好生活，就是這次旅行最珍貴的紀念。
lines.simplified: 其实马丁刚到台湾时，还忘不了工作的问题，所以心情不太好。但是，当他在东部又宽又平的公路上，边骑着自行车，边欣赏美丽的风景时，他忽然觉得就像在天堂一样，太美好、太值得了！还有一次，马丁坐在椅子上，很专心地看着寺庙前的歌仔戏表演。演员演出时，刚好穿着和明信片上一样的服装，那种熟悉的感觉让他很兴奋，立刻拿起相机拍了起来。这段时间他也认识了一些乐观、幽默的朋友，大家一起聊天、开玩笑，让他开心得把工作的问题都忘了。马丁觉得在台湾经验过的这些美好生活，就是这次旅行最珍贵的纪念。
lines.pinyin: Qíshí Mǎdīng gāng dào Táiwān shí, hái wàng buliǎo gōngzuò de wèntí, suǒyǐ xīnqíng bú tài hǎo. Dànshì, dāng tā zài dōngbù yòu kuān yòu píng de gōnglù shàng, biān qí zhe zìxíngchē, biān xīnshǎng měilì de fēngjǐng shí, tā hūrán juéde jiù xiàng zài tiāntáng yíyàng, tài měihǎo, tài zhídé le! Hái yǒu yí cì, Mǎdīng zuò zài yǐzi shàng, hěn zhuānxīn de kàn zhe sìmiào qián de gēzǎixì biǎoyǎn. Yǎnyuán yǎnchū shí, gānghǎo chuān zhe hé míngxìnpiàn shàng yíyàng de fúzhuāng, nà zhǒng shóuxī de gǎnjué ràng tā hěn xīngfèn, lìkè ná qǐ xiàngjī pāi le qǐlai. Zhè duàn shíjiān tā yě rènshí le yìxiē lèguān, yōumò de péngyou, dàjiā yìqǐ liáotiān, kāiwánxiào, ràng tā kāixīn de bǎ gōngzuò de wèntí dōu wàng le. Mǎdīng juéde zài Táiwān jīngyàn guò de zhèxiē měihǎo shēnghuó, jiùshì zhè cì lǚxíng zuì zhēnguì de jìniàn.
lines.english: Actually when Martin first arrived, he couldn't put work troubles out of mind and was in a low mood. But as he cycled along wide flat highways in eastern Taiwan while admiring the breathtaking scenery, he suddenly felt like he was in paradise—it was wonderful and so worthwhile! Another time, sitting on a chair, he watched a Taiwanese opera performance in front of a temple attentively. The actors were dressed in the exact costumes shown on the postcards; that familiar feeling thrilled him, and he immediately snapped photos. During this trip he also befriended optimistic, humorous companions whose chats and jokes made him forget his work stress. Martin felt these wonderful experiences were the most precious souvenirs of the trip.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 經過這趟豐富的旅行後，馬丁的心情好多了，想法也改變了。回到法國後，到底要換新工作，還是要克服困難勇敢走下去，他相信自己一定能做出最佳選擇，讓生活過得更充實、更有意義。
lines.simplified: 经过这趟丰富的旅行后，马丁的心情好多了，想法也改变了。回到法国后，到底要换新工作，还是要克服困难勇敢走下去，他相信自己一定能做出最佳选择，让生活过得更充实、更有意义。
lines.pinyin: Jīngguò zhè tàng fēngfù de lǚxíng hòu, Mǎdīng de xīnqíng hǎo duō le, xiǎngfǎ yě gǎibiàn le. Huí dào Fǎguó hòu, dàodǐ yào huàn xīn gōngzuò, háishì yào kèfú kùnnan yǒnggǎn zǒu xiàqu, tā xiāngxìn zìjǐ yídìng néng zuòchū zuìjiā xuǎnzé, ràng shēnghuó guò de gèng chōngshí, gèng yǒu yìyì.
lines.english: After this enriching journey, Martin felt much better and his outlook shifted. Upon returning to France, whether to switch jobs or face difficulties bravely, he was confident he could make the best choice to make his life more fulfilling and meaningful.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Narrow a comment to one object or scope with 就……來說.
grammarPages.explanation: 「就……來說」常用在書面，「就」有針對的意思。主要針對某個對象或某個範圍來敘述或分析。

items.question: How does 就……來說 differ from 對……來說?
items.answer: 就……來說 targets a specific objective domain or criteria ('in terms of X'). 對……來說 introduces an individual's personal subjective perspective ('to person X').
items.wrongTraditional: 對選舉文化來說，兩國很不同。
items.wrongSimplified: 对选举文化来说，两国很不同。

right.traditional: 就選舉文化來說，兩國很不同。
right.simplified: 就选举文化来说，两国很不同。
right.pinyin: Jiù xuǎnjǔ wénhuà lái shuō, liǎng guó hěn bù tóng.
right.english: In terms of election culture, the two countries are very different.

items.question: Can 來說 be replaced with 看 in this pattern?
items.answer: 來說 is standard in this written construction; do not use 看 or other verbs inside the frame.
items.wrongTraditional: 就這棟房子的環境來看說，還不錯。
items.wrongSimplified: 就这栋房子的环境来看说，还不错。

right.traditional: 就這棟房子的環境來說，還不錯。
right.simplified: 就这栋房子的环境来说，还不错。
right.pinyin: Jiù zhè dòng fángzi de huánjìng lái shuō, hái búcuò.
right.english: In terms of this house's environment, it's pretty good.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: V / Vs + 得 + Result or Degree
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe how much or how far an action or state goes with V/Vs 得.
grammarPages.explanation: 「得」的後面是補語，說明「得」前面的動作(V)，或是前面的狀態(Vs)達到什麼樣的程度。「得」後面表示結果，可以使用誇張的詞語或短句加以說明。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Words after 得 ard complements. 得 explains the level of the action (V) or the state (Vs) in front of 得 to show the result. It can be expressed using exaggeration or short sentences.
grammarPages.pattern: V/Vs + 得 + degree comment

items.question: Which 得 particle connects verbs to degree complements?
items.answer: Use 得 (structural particle for complements), not 的 (noun modifier) or 地 (adverbial marker).
items.wrongTraditional: 他開心的大笑了起來。
items.wrongSimplified: 他开心的大笑了起来。

right.traditional: 他開心得大笑了起來。
right.simplified: 他开心得大笑了起来。
right.pinyin: Tā kāixīn de dàxiào le qǐlai.
right.english: He was so happy that he started laughing out loud.

items.question: Can V/Vs得 be followed by a full explanatory clause?
items.answer: Yes, it frequently introduces an exaggerated consequence clause like 我都站不起來了 or 沒時間吃飯.
items.wrongTraditional: 他忙的連飯都沒吃完。
items.wrongSimplified: 他忙的连饭都没吃完。

right.traditional: 他忙得連飯都沒吃完。
right.simplified: 他忙得连饭都没吃完。
right.pinyin: Tā máng de lián fàn dōu méi chīwán.
right.english: He was so busy that he didn't even finish his meal.

dialogue.title: 穿著和品味
grammarFocus: S 把 NP1 + V 成 NP2

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 朋子，妳最近穿衣服的風格跟以前很不一樣，名牌衣服怎麼不穿了呢？
lines.simplified: 朋子，妳最近穿衣服的风格跟以前很不一样，名牌衣服怎么不穿了呢？
lines.pinyin: Péngzǐ, nǐ zuìjìn chuān yīfú de fēnggé gēn yǐqián hěn bù yíyàng, míngpái yīfú zěnme bù chuān le ne?
lines.english: Tomoko, your clothing style lately is very different from before. How come you don't wear brand-name clothes anymore?

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 我想改變別人對我的看法。以前，我的穿著容易讓人產生誤會，以為我是個不好相處的人。
lines.simplified: 我想改变别人对我的看法。以前，我的穿着容易让人产生误会，以为我是个不好相处的人。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng gǎibiàn biérén duì wǒ de kànfǎ. Yǐqián, wǒ de chuānzhuó róngyì ràng rén chǎnshēng wùhuì, yǐwéi wǒ shì ge bù hǎo xiāngchǔ de rén.
lines.english: I want to change what people think of me. In the past, my dressing easily gave people misunderstandings, assuming I was hard to get along with.

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 說真的，剛認識妳的時候，妳從頭到腳都是名牌，總是覺得我們有一段距離。
lines.simplified: 说真的，刚认识妳的时候，妳从头到脚都是名牌，总是觉得我们有一段距离。
lines.pinyin: Shuō zhēn de, gāng rènshì nǐ de shíhòu, nǐ cóng tóu dào jiǎo dōushì míngpái, zǒngshì juéde wǒmen yǒu yí duàn jùlí.
lines.english: Honestly, when I first met you, you wore designer labels from head to toe, and I always felt a distance between us.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 唉！不用說也知道你會這麼想。其實這跟我爸媽有關，他們對穿衣服很講究，也覺得穿名牌才有品味，所以影響了我對穿著的看法。
lines.simplified: 唉！不用说也知道你会这么想。其实这跟我爸妈有关，他们对穿衣服很讲究，也觉得穿名牌才有品味，所以影响了我对穿着的看法。
lines.pinyin: Ài! Búyòng shuō yě zhīdào nǐ huì zhème xiǎng. Qíshí zhè gēn wǒ bàmā yǒuguān, tāmen duì chuān yīfú hěn jiǎngjiù, yě juéde chuān míngpái cái yǒu pǐnwèi, suǒyǐ yǐngxiǎng le wǒ duì chuānzhuó de kànfǎ.
lines.english: Sigh! It goes without saying you'd think that. Actually this has to do with my parents; they are very particular about clothing and feel only designer clothes have taste, so that influenced my view on dressing.

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 妳爸媽的朋友，不是大老闆就是政治人物，有這樣的想法很自然啊！合適的穿著對他們很重要，名牌衣服才能表現出他們的地位。
lines.simplified: 妳爸妈的朋友，不是大老板就是政治人物，有这样的想法很自然啊！合适的穿着对他们很重要，名牌衣服才能表现出他们的地位。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bàmā de péngyǒu, búshì dà lǎobǎn jiùshì zhèngzhì rénwù, yǒu zhèyàng de xiǎngfǎ hěn zìrán a! Héshì de chuānzhuó duì tāmen hěn zhòngyào, míngpái yīfú cái néng biǎoxiàn chū tāmen de dìwèi.
lines.english: Your parents' friends are either big bosses or political figures, so having that mindset is quite natural! Appropriate attire is very important for them; designer clothing expresses their status.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 你說的沒錯，可是我還是不希望大家把我看成只愛買名牌的人。
lines.simplified: 你说的没错，可是我还是不希望大家把我看成只爱买名牌的人。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de méicuò, kěshì wǒ háishì bù xīwàng dàjiā bǎ wǒ kànchéng zhǐ ài mǎi míngpái de rén.
lines.english: What you said is true, but I still don't want everyone to look at me as someone who only cares about buying luxury brands.

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 跟以前比起來，妳現在的穿著更能表現出個人的特色。
lines.simplified: 跟以前比起来，妳现在的穿着更能表现出个人的特色。
lines.pinyin: Gēn yǐqián bǐ qǐlái, nǐ xiànzài de chuānzhuó gèng néng biǎoxiàn chū gèrén de tèsè.
lines.english: Compared to before, your dressing now expresses your personal character much better.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 以前我和朋友聊天的話題，常常是哪些服裝很流行，哪個名牌又請了大明星拍廣告什麼的，現在我只想穿得舒適，又有屬於自己的風格，是不是名牌真的無所謂。
lines.simplified: 以前我和朋友聊天的话题，常常是哪些服装很流行，哪个名牌又请了大明星拍广告什么的，现在我只想穿得舒适，又有属于自己的风格，是不是名牌真的无所谓。
lines.pinyin: Yǐqián wǒ hé péngyǒu liáotiān de huàtí, chángcháng shì nǎxiē fúzhuāng hěn liúxíng, nǎge míngpái yòu qǐng le dà míngxīng pāi guǎnggào shénmede, xiànzài wǒ zhǐ xiǎng chuān de shūshì, yòu yǒu shǔyú zìjǐ de fēnggé, shì bú shì míngpái zhēn de wúsuǒwèi.
lines.english: In the past, topics when chatting with friends were often about which clothes were trendy, or which brand hired a celebrity for an ad. Now I just want to dress comfortably and have my own style; whether it's a name brand really doesn't matter.

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 一般來說，明星的穿著都會吸引大家注意，所以服裝公司才會花大錢請明星拍廣告，這是正常的商業作法。其實多了解一些流行的現象也沒什麼不好。
lines.simplified: 一般来说，明星的穿着都会吸引大家注意，所以服装公司才会花大钱请明星拍广告，这是正常的商业作法。其实多了解一些流行的现象也没什么不好。
lines.pinyin: Yìbān láishuō, míngxīng de chuānzhuó dōu huì xīyǐn dàjiā zhùyì, suǒyǐ fúzhuāng gōngsī cái huì huā dà qián qǐng míngxīng pāi guǎnggào, zhè shì zhèngcháng de shāngyè zuòfǎ. Qíshí duō liǎojiě yìxiē liúxíng de xiànxiàng yě méi shénme bù hǎo.
lines.english: Generally speaking, celebrities' attire draws attention, so apparel companies spend big money to hire stars for commercials; that's a normal commercial practice. Actually, understanding fashion trends isn't a bad thing either.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 嗯，問題是流行的穿著不一定就有品味，再英俊、再漂亮的人也應該找到自己的風格。
lines.simplified: 嗯，问题是流行的穿着不一定就有品味，再英俊、再漂亮的人也应该找到自己的风格。
lines.pinyin: Èn, wèntí shì liúxíng de chuānzhuó bù yídìng jiù yǒu pǐnwèi, zài yīngjùn, zài piàoliang de rén yě yīnggāi zhǎodào zìjǐ de fēnggé.
lines.english: Mm, the issue is that trendy dressing doesn't necessarily have good taste. No matter how handsome or pretty someone is, they should still find their own style.

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 我同意妳的說法。想穿出自己的風格，可以多看看專櫃跟雜誌上流行的服裝，想像穿在自己身上的樣子。過些時間，就能抓到感覺了。
lines.simplified: 我同意妳的说法。想穿出自己的风格，可以多看看专柜跟杂志上流行的服装，想像穿在自己身上的样子。过些时间，就能抓到感觉了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ tóngyì nǐ de shuōfǎ. Xiǎng chuān chū zìjǐ de fēnggé, kěyǐ duō kànkan zhuānguì gēn zázhì shàng liúxíng de fúzhuāng, xiǎngxiàng chuān zài zìjǐ shēnshang de yàngzi. Guò xiē shíjiān, jiù néng zhuādào gǎnjué le.
lines.english: I agree with what you said. If you want to dress with personal style, browse department counters and fashion magazines, and imagine what looks good on you. In time, you'll catch the feeling.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 不過也不能只跟著流行，一定要有自己的想法。我有幾個朋友跟我剛好相反，他們不僅天天穿名牌，也常上街買衣服，什麼流行就買什麼，好像花多少錢都沒有限制。
lines.simplified: 不过也不能只跟着流行，一定要有自己的想法。我有几个朋友跟我刚好相反，他们不仅天天穿名牌，也常上街买衣服，什么流行就买什么，好像花多少钱都没有限制。
lines.pinyin: Búguò yě bù néng zhǐ gēnzhe liúxíng, yídìng yào yǒu zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ. Wǒ yǒu jǐ ge péngyǒu gēn wǒ gānghǎo xiāngfǎn, tāmen bùjǐn tiāntiān chuān míngpái, yě cháng shàngjiē mǎi yīfú, shénme liúxíng jiù mǎi shénme, hǎoxiàng huā duōshao qián dōu méiyǒu xiànzhì.
lines.english: Still, one shouldn't just follow trends; you must have your own perspective. I have a few friends who are the exact opposite of me: not only do they wear designer clothes every day, but they often go shopping, buying whatever is trendy, as if there is no spending limit.

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 難怪大家都說女孩子的櫃子裡永遠少一件衣服。
lines.simplified: 难怪大家都说女孩子的柜子里永远少一件衣服。
lines.pinyin: Nánguài dàjiā dōu shuō nǚhái zǐ de guìzi lǐ yǒngyuǎn shǎo yí jiàn yīfú.
lines.english: No wonder everyone says a woman's wardrobe is always missing one piece of clothing.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 我可不是喔！以前，一有新商品我就去買；現在，我了解自己真正的需要是什麼，絕對不會亂買了。
lines.simplified: 我可不是喔！以前，一有新商品我就去买；现在，我了解自己真正的需要是什么，绝对不会乱买了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ kě bú shì ō! Yǐqián, yì yǒu xīn shāngpǐn wǒ jiù qù mǎi; xiànzài, wǒ liǎojiě zìjǐ zhēnzhèng de xūyào shì shénme, juéduì bú huì luàn mǎi le.
lines.english: Not me, though! In the past, as soon as a new product came out I went to buy it; now, I understand what my real needs are, and I definitely won't buy recklessly.

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 其實穿衣服也是個學問。名牌衣服，有的人穿起來好看，有的人穿起來可能很醜呢！
lines.simplified: 其实穿衣服也是个学问。名牌衣服，有的人穿起来好看，有的人穿起来可能很丑呢！
lines.pinyin: Qíshí chuān yīfú yě shì ge xuéwèn. Míngpái yīfú, yǒu de rén chuān qǐlái hǎokàn, yǒu de rén chuān qǐlái kěnéng hěn chǒu ne!
lines.english: Actually, dressing well is a skill in itself. Brand-name clothes look great on some people, but on others they can look quite ugly!

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 沒錯。對我來說，只要穿得慣、穿得自在，把自己當衣服的主人，這樣就能對自己更有信心了。
lines.simplified: 没错。对我来说，只要穿得惯、穿得自在，把自己当衣服的主人，这样就能对自己更有信心了。
lines.pinyin: Méicuò. Duì wǒ láishuō, zhǐyào chuān de guàn, chuān de zìzài, bǎ zìjǐ dāng yīfú de zhǔrén, zhèyàng jiù néng duì zìjǐ gèng yǒu xìnxīn le.
lines.english: Exactly. To me, as long as I feel accustomed and at ease wearing them, treating myself as the master of the clothes, that's how I gain more self-confidence.

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 妳本來條件就好，加上穿著又變得這麼有品味，難怪越來越有魅力了。
lines.simplified: 妳本来条件就好，加上穿着又变得这么有品味，难怪越来越有魅力了。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ běnlái tiáojiàn jiù hǎo, jiāshàng chuānzhuó yòu biànde zhème yǒu pǐnwèi, nánguài yuèláiyuè yǒu mèilì le.
lines.english: You naturally have great qualities, and now that your attire has become so tasteful, no wonder you're growing more charming by the day.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 別開玩笑了，你的品味比我更好呢！
lines.simplified: 别开玩笑了，你的品味比我更好呢！
lines.pinyin: Bié kāi wánxiào le, nǐ de pǐnwèi bǐ wǒ gèng hǎo ne!
lines.english: Stop joking, your taste is even better than mine!

grammarPages.titleTraditional: S 把 NP1 + V 成 NP2
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Transforming or Misinterpreting with 把...V成...
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say how someone transforms one thing into another, or mistakes one thing for another.
grammarPages.explanation: 「成」有「成為」、「變成」的意思。表示某人經由某個動作，讓 NP₁ 成為或變成 NP₂。如果動詞是「看、聽、說、寫、念」，有時有「弄錯了」的意思。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 把 + NP1 + Verb + 成 + NP2

text.traditional: 我還是不希望大家把我看成只愛買名牌的人。
text.simplified: 我还是不希望大家把我看成只爱买名牌的人。
text.pinyin: Wǒ háishì bù xīwàng dàjiā bǎ wǒ kànchéng zhǐ ài mǎi míngpái de rén.
text.english: I still don't want everyone to look at me as someone who only cares about buying luxury brands.

words.pinyin: zhǐ ài mǎi míngpái de rén

text.pinyin: Nà běn yǒumíng de Yīngguó xiǎoshuō, shí nián qián jiù yǒurén bǎ tā fānchéng le èrshí zhǒng yǔyán, érqiě hái pāichéng le diànyǐng.
text.english: That famous English novel had been translated into twenty languages ten years ago, and was even made into a movie.

text.simplified: 阿姨把穿不下的旧衣服，修改成非常流行的帽子和袋子。
text.pinyin: Āyí bǎ chuānbúxià de jiù yīfú, xiūgǎichéng fēicháng liúxíng de màozi hé dàizi.

words.simplified: 非常流行的帽子和袋子
words.pinyin: fēicháng liúxíng de màozi hé dàizi

questions.prompt: Express mistaking someone for your sister:
questions.correctFeedback: 把...看成... expresses visually confusing someone for another.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 把...看成... to express mistaking one person for another.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 成 has the meaning of "becoming" and "changing to". It means that someone makes NP₁ or becomes NP₂ through a certain action. If the verb is 看, 聽, 說, 寫, 念, sometimes 成 means "to get something wrong".
grammarPages.titleSimplified: S 把 NP1 + V 成 NP2

grammarPages.titleEnglish: No Matter How Extreme with 再...也/都...
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express that no matter how extreme an attribute or condition is, a decision or truth remains unchanged.
grammarPages.explanation: 「再……，也/都……」使用在假設的情況，有「就算……，也……」的意思（這個語法在本冊第一課）。「再」後面的句子是把情況說到最高或最低、最好或最壞的程度，而「也」或「都」後面的結果、決定或是想法不會改變；有時候表示說話的人覺得應該而且值得這樣做。例如：「再有錢也不可以亂買東西」、「再貴我都要買」、「再辛苦也要忍耐」。
grammarPages.pattern: (Subject) + 再 + Stative Verb / Condition + 也/都 + Consequence

text.traditional: 再英俊、再漂亮的人也應該找到自己的風格。
text.simplified: 再英俊、再漂亮的人也应该找到自己的风格。
text.pinyin: Zài yīngjùn, zài piàoliang de rén yě yīnggāi zhǎodào zìjǐ de fēnggé.
text.english: No matter how handsome or pretty someone is, they should still find their own style.

words.pinyin: zài yīngjùn, zài piàoliang de rén
words.meaning: no matter how handsome or pretty the person

words.traditional: 也應該找到自己的風格
words.simplified: 也应该找到自己的风格
words.pinyin: yě yīnggāi zhǎodào zìjǐ de fēnggé

text.traditional: 孩子需要父母照顧，父母再忙都應該陪陪他們，了解他們的想法。
text.simplified: 孩子需要父母照顾，父母再忙都应该陪陪他们，了解他们的想法。
text.pinyin: Háizi xūyào fùmǔ zhàogù, fùmǔ zài máng dōu yīnggāi péipei tāmen, liǎojiě tāmen de xiǎngfǎ.
text.english: Children need care from parents; no matter how busy parents are, they should spend time with them and understand their thoughts.

words.traditional: 父母再忙都應該陪陪他們
words.simplified: 父母再忙都应该陪陪他们
words.pinyin: fùmǔ zài máng dōu yīnggāi péipei tāmen
words.meaning: however busy parents are, they should spend time with them,

text.traditional: 為了得到更多經驗，也為了美好的未來，再討厭的工作也得忍耐。
text.simplified: 为了得到更多经验，也为了美好的未来，再讨厌的工作也得忍耐。
text.pinyin: Wèile dédào gèng duō jīngyàn, yě wèile měihǎo de wèilái, zài tǎoyàn de gōngzuò yě děi rěnnài.
text.english: To gain more experience and for a brighter future, one must endure no matter how much one dislikes the job.

items.question: How do you say no matter how sweet a cookie is, you will still eat it?
items.answer: 這是你做的，再甜我也要吃。
items.wrongTraditional: 這是你做的，更甜我也要吃。
items.wrongSimplified: 这是你做的，更甜我也要吃。

right.pinyin: Zhè shì nǐ zuò de, zài tián wǒ yě yào chī.
right.english: You made this, so no matter how sweet it is I'll still eat it.

items.answerSimplified: 这是你做的，再甜我也要吃。

items.question: How do you say no matter how difficult Chinese characters are, one must practice?
items.answer: 漢字再難寫也得練習。
items.wrongTraditional: 漢字又難寫也得練習。
items.wrongSimplified: 汉字又难写也得练习。

right.pinyin: Hànzì zài nán xiě yě děi liànxí.
right.english: No matter how hard characters are to write, one must still practice.

questions.prompt: Express resolve to take the exam no matter how sick you feel:

segments.hint: no matter how unwell still must

questions.correctFeedback: 再……也 expresses that even at the extreme limit of feeling unwell, the obligation stands.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 再 + Adjective + 也 to express concessive extreme condition.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 再……也/都…… is used in a hypothetical situation, with a similar meaning to 就算……，也…… (this grammar is found in the first lesson of this volume). The sentence after 再 refers to the best or worst of a situation, and the result, decision or idea behind 也 or 都 will not change. Sometimes it means that the speaker thinks something should be done and is worth doing. For example, 再有錢也不可以亂買東西, 再貴我都要買, 再辛苦也要忍耐.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Accustomed to Actions with V慣 / V得慣 / V不慣
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say whether you are used to doing an action, or can/cannot get accustomed to it.
grammarPages.explanation: 「動詞＋慣」的「慣」有習慣的意思，是結果補語，表示前面動作的結果。例如：他用慣了筷子，連吃西餐也用筷子。如果「慣」的前面加上「得/不」，表示前面的動作能或不能習慣，例如：「這個房間很小，你住得慣嗎？」「我吃不慣別人做的菜，每天都自己做。」
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + Verb + (得/不) + 慣 (+ Object)

text.traditional: 對我來說，只要穿得慣、穿得自在，把自己當衣服的主人
text.simplified: 对我来说，只要穿得惯、穿得自在，把自己当衣服的主人

questions.repairFeedback: Use Verb + 不慣 to express inability to get accustomed to an action.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The 慣 of "verb + 慣" has the meaning of habit. It is the complement of the result, indicating the result of the previous action. For example, 他用慣了筷子，連吃西餐也用筷子。(He is used to eating with chopsticks, and even uses chopsticks to eat western food). If 慣 is added in front of 得/不, it means that the previous action can or cannot be gotten used to. For example, 這個房間很小，你住得慣嗎？(This room is very small, are you accustomed to living here?) 我吃不慣別人做的菜，每天都自己做。(I'm not used to food prepared by others, so I make it myself every day.)

items.title: Grammar 4–6 · Fast Fashion and Rational Choices

dialogue.title: 快時尚

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 東賢以前是模特兒，他曾經和一家服裝公司合作，為推銷新產品拍廣告。廣告播出以後，商品賣得非常好。但是，過不了多久，就有樣式更新、更吸引人的服裝出來了。這種「快時尚」的現象，對民眾的生活產生了很大的影響。
lines.simplified: 东贤以前是模特儿，他曾经和一家服装公司合作，为推销新产品拍广告。广告播出以后，商品卖得非常好。但是，过不了多久，就有样式更新、更吸引人的服装出来了。这种「快时尚」的现象，对民众的生活产生了很大的影响。
lines.pinyin: Dōngxián yǐqián shì mótèr, tā céngjīng hé yì jiā fúzhuāng gōngsī hézuò, wèi tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn pāi guǎnggào. Guǎnggào bōchū yǐhòu, shāngpǐn mài de fēicháng hǎo. Dànshì, guò bù liǎo duōjiǔ, jiù yǒu yàngshì gèng xīn, gèng xīyǐn rén de fúzhuāng chūlái le. Zhè zhǒng "kuàishíshàng" de xiànxiàng, duì mínzhòng de shēnghuó chǎnshēng le hěn dà de yǐngxiǎng.
lines.english: Dongxian was formerly a model; he once collaborated with an apparel firm to film commercials for new product promotions. After the commercial aired, products sold extremely well. However, before long, newer and more attractive styles came out. This phenomenon of fast fashion has profoundly impacted everyday life.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 所謂「快時尚」，意思是服裝公司掌握最新流行的方向，很快把服裝設計、生產出來，讓顧客能趕上流行，也能擁有平價的時尚商品。不過，流行的變化速度太快，越來越多新衣服還沒穿就被丟掉，讓人們不能不思考這樣的時尚有沒有意義。
lines.simplified: 所谓「快时尚」，意思是服装公司掌握最新流行的方向，很快把服装设计、生产出来，让顾客能赶上流行，也能拥有平价的时尚商品。不过，流行的变化速度太快，越来越多新衣服还没穿就被丢掉，让人们不能不思考这样的时尚有没有意义。
lines.pinyin: Suǒwèi "kuàishíshàng", yìsi shì fúzhuāng gōngsī zhǎngwò zuìxīn liúxíng de fāngxiàng, hěn kuài bǎ fúzhuāng shèjì, shēngchǎn chūlái, ràng gùkè néng gǎnshàng liúxíng, yě néng yǒngyǒu píngjià de shíshàng shāngpǐn. Búguò, liúxíng de biànhuà sùdù tài kuài, yuèláiyuè duō xīn yīfú hái méi chuān jiù bèi diūdiào, ràng rénmen bù néng bù sīkǎo zhèyàng de shíshàng yǒu méiyǒu yìyì.
lines.english: The so-called fast fashion means apparel companies capture the latest fashion trends and quickly design and manufacture clothes, allowing customers to catch up with trends while owning affordable fashion items. However, fashion trends change so quickly that more and more new clothes are thrown out before being worn, forcing people to reconsider if such fashion holds real meaning.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 因為工作的需求，東賢的衣櫃裡掛著各式各樣的「快時尚」服裝。平時他不覺得有什麼問題，等到搬家時，才發現衣服這麼多，處理起來真的很麻煩。有的連一次也沒穿過，可是已經不流行了，到底要留下來、送人還是丟掉，讓東賢相當頭痛。他不得不承認，「快時尚」也是有壞處的。
lines.simplified: 因为工作的需求，东贤的衣柜里挂着各式各样的「快时尚」服装。平时他不觉得有什么问题，等到搬家时，才发现衣服这么多，处理起来真的很麻烦。有的连一次也没穿过，可是已经不流行了，到底要留下来、送人还是丢掉，让东贤相当头痛。他不得不承认，「快时尚」也是有坏处的。
lines.pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò de xūqiú, Dōngxián de yīguì lǐ guàzhe gèshì gèyàng de "kuàishíshàng" fúzhuāng. Píngshí tā bù juéde yǒu shénme wèntí, děng dào bānjiā shí, cái fāxiàn yīfú zhème duō, chǔlǐ qǐlái zhēn de hěn máfan. Yǒude lián yí cì yě méi chuān guo, kěshì yǐjīng bù liúxíng le, dàodǐ yào liú xiàlái, sòng rén háishì diūdiào, ràng Dōngxián xiāngdāng tóutòng. Tā bùdébù chéngrèn, "kuàishíshàng" yě shì yǒu huàichù de.
lines.english: Due to job needs, Dongxian's closet was hung with all kinds of fast-fashion garments. Ordinarily he felt no issue, but when moving, he realized there were so many clothes and sorting them out was genuinely troublesome. Some hadn't even been worn once, yet were already out of style; whether to keep, gift, or toss them gave Dongxian a huge headache. He had to admit that fast fashion also brings harms.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 過去，東賢對穿著不太有自信，也很擔心跟不上流行，所以才不斷地追求時尚。現在，他比較冷靜了，他要當衣服的主人，不再為了趕流行亂買衣服。況且把舊衣服修改一下，也能使自己穿得很有個性、很有品味，所以在東賢心中，沒有什麼是非買不可的。畢竟「快時尚」只是一時的流行，長得再帥、再漂亮的人，也應該找出屬於自己最合適的穿著，這樣才是正確的選擇。
lines.simplified: 过去，东贤对穿着不太有自信，也很担心跟不上流行，所以才不断地追求时尚。现在，他比较冷静了，他要当衣服的主人，不再为了赶流行乱买衣服。况且把旧衣服修改一下，也能使自己穿得很有个性、很有品味，所以在东贤心中，没有什么是非买不可的。毕竟「快时尚」只是一时的流行，长得再帅、再漂亮的人，也应该找出属于自己最合适的穿着，这样才是正确的选择。
lines.pinyin: Guòqù, Dōngxián duì chuānzhuó bú tài yǒu zìxìn, yě hěn dānxīn gēnbushàng liúxíng, suǒyǐ cái búduàn de zhuīqiú shíshàng. Xiànzài, tā bǐjiào lěngjìng le, tā yào dāng yīfú de zhǔrén, bú zài wèile gǎn liúxíng luàn mǎi yīfú. Kuàngqiě bǎ jiù yīfú xiūgǎi yíxià, yě néng shǐ zìjǐ chuān de hěn gèxìng, hěn yǒu pǐnwèi, suǒyǐ zài Dōngxián xīnzhōng, méiyǒu shénme shì fēi mǎi bù kě de. Bìjìng "kuàishíshàng" zhǐ shì yìshí de liúxíng, zhǎng de zài shuài, zài piàoliang de rén, yě yīnggāi zhǎochū shǔyú zìjǐ zuì héshì de chuānzhuó, zhèyàng cái shì zhèngquè de xuǎnzé.
lines.english: In the past, Dongxian lacked confidence in dressing and constantly feared falling behind trends, which drove him to chase fashion non-stop. Now he has calmed down; he wants to be the master of clothes and no longer buys thoughtlessly to chase fads. Moreover, modifying old clothes can also allow one to dress with distinction and taste, so in his mind, nothing is an absolute must-buy. After all, fast fashion is merely a temporary fad; no matter how handsome or pretty one is, finding the attire that truly suits oneself is the right choice.

items.wrongTraditional: 那你向他非道歉不可。

questions.prompt: Tell your friend an apology is mandatory after damaging a bicycle:
questions.correctFeedback: 非 must stand before the whole prepositional phrase 向他道歉.
questions.repairFeedback: Pattern: 非 + Action Phrase + 不可.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 非 means 不, so 非……不可 means that something must be done, and there is no other choice. 非 is followed with a verb or verb phrase.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: After All / Key Reality with 畢竟
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Bring up the fundamental truth or overarching reason that explains a situation or persuades someone.
grammarPages.explanation: 「畢竟」後面的句子是經過思考分析後的結論，用來說明事情的關鍵，目的是提醒或說服對方。例如：雖然中文不太好學，不過，那畢竟是我自己的選擇。
grammarPages.pattern: Statement，(不過) + 畢竟 + Core Reality

text.traditional: 沒有什麼是非買不可的。畢竟「快時尚」只是一時的流行
text.simplified: 没有什么是非买不可的。毕竟「快时尚」只是一时的流行
text.pinyin: Méiyǒu shénme shì fēi mǎi bù kě de. Bìjìng kuài shíshàng zhǐshì yìshí de liúxíng.
text.english: There is nothing he absolutely must buy. After all, fast fashion is only a passing trend.

text.traditional:
先生：這個星期很忙，週末也得加班，沒辦法陪妳去逛街了。
太太：你最好別再加班了，畢竟人不是機器，要是忙得沒時間休息一定會生病的。
text.simplified:
先生：这个星期很忙，周末也得加班，没办法陪妳去逛街了。
太太：你最好别再加班了，毕竟人不是机器，要是忙得没时间休息一定会生病的。
text.pinyin: Xiānsheng: Zhège xīngqī hěn máng, zhōumò yě děi jiābān, méi bànfǎ péi nǐ qù guàngjiē le. Tàitai: Nǐ zuì hǎo bié zài jiābān le, bìjìng rén bú shì jīqì, yàoshi máng de méi shíjiān xiūxi yídìng huì shēngbìng de.
text.english: Husband: This week is very busy, I have to work overtime on the weekend too, so I can't go shopping with you. Wife: You'd better stop working overtime; after all, people aren't machines, and if you're too busy to rest you'll surely get sick.

I have to work overtime on the weekend too,

questions.correctFeedback: 畢竟 brings up the fundamental reality that explains human behavior.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 畢竟 to appeal to an overarching truth or reality.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The sentence after 畢竟 is the conclusion after thinking and analysis, used to explain the key point of the matter, and the purpose is to remind or convince the other party. For example, 雖然中文不太好學，不過，那畢竟是我自己的選擇。(Although Chinese is not easy to learn, it is my own choice after all.)

dialogue.title: 誰說得念大學才有未來？

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 恭喜你弟弟參加網球比賽得到了第一名。好久沒看到他了，他最近怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 恭喜你弟弟参加网球比赛得到了第一名。好久没看到他了，他最近怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Gōngxǐ nǐ dìdi cānjiā wǎngqiú bǐsài dédào le dì-yī míng. Hǎojiǔ méi kàndào tā le, tā zuìjìn zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: Congratulations on your younger brother taking first place in the tennis tournament! I haven't seen him in a while; how has he been lately?

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 他忙著準備今年的大學考試，總是睡得不太安心，半夜會突然醒過來。
lines.simplified: 他忙着准备今年的大学考试，总是睡得不太安心，半夜会突然醒过来。
lines.pinyin: Tā mángzhe zhǔnbèi jīnnián de dàxué kǎoshì, zǒngshì shuì de bú tài ānxīn, bànyè huì tūrán xǐng guòlái.
lines.english: He's busy preparing for this year's college entrance exams. He never sleeps restfully and often wakes up suddenly in the middle of the night.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 記得你說過，你弟弟學習和運動的表現都很好。我想只要心情放輕鬆就沒問題了。
lines.simplified: 记得你说过，你弟弟学习和运动的表现都很好。我想只要心情放轻松就没问题了。
lines.pinyin: Jìde nǐ shuō guo, nǐ dìdi xuéxí hé yùndòng de biǎoxiàn dōu hěn hǎo. Wǒ xiǎng zhǐyào xīnqíng fàng qīngsōng jiù méi wèntí le.
lines.english: I remember you said your brother performs well in both academics and sports. I think as long as he relaxes his mindset, he'll do fine.

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 問題是，我爸媽希望他能考上前三名的大學，不是打球得第一，要求他把全部的時間都拿來準備考試。可是我弟弟覺得打球不會影響他念書，他們還因為這件事吵了一架。
lines.simplified: 问题是，我爸妈希望他能考上前三名的大学，不是打球得第一，要求他把全部的时间都拿来准备考试。可是我弟弟觉得打球不会影响他念书，他们还因为这件事吵了一架。
lines.pinyin: Wèntí shì, wǒ bàmā xīwàng tā néng kǎoshàng qián sān míng de dàxué, búshì dǎqiú dé dì-yī, yāoqiú tā bǎ quánbù de shíjiān dōu nálái zhǔnbèi kǎoshì. Kěshì wǒ dìdi juéde dǎqiú bú huì yǐngxiǎng tā niànshū, tāmen hái yīnwèi zhè jiàn shì chǎo le yí jià.
lines.english: The problem is that my parents hope he can test into a top-three university rather than placing first in ball games; they demand he devote all his time to exam prep. But my brother believes playing ball won't hurt his studies, and they even had a big argument over this.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 哦？你弟弟的運動成績那麼好，我以為你爸媽會為他高興。
lines.simplified: 哦？你弟弟的运动成绩那么好，我以为你爸妈会为他高兴。
lines.pinyin: Ó? Nǐ dìdi de yùndòng chéngjī nàme hǎo, wǒ yǐwéi nǐ bàmā huì wèi tā gāoxìng.
lines.english: Oh? Your brother's athletic achievements are so stellar; I thought your parents would be thrilled for him.

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 他們是很高興，可是現在要考大學，情況就不同了。我曾經有一次，考試前想跟同學去露營，爸媽知道了就罵我：「快考試了，怎麼不在家念書，反而想出去玩？」不管我怎麼解釋他們都不聽，讓我難過了半天。
lines.simplified: 他们是很高兴，可是现在要考大学，情况就不同了。我曾经有一次，考试前想跟同学去露营，爸妈知道了就骂我：「快考试了，怎么不在家念书，反而想出去玩？」不管我怎么解释他们都不听，让我难过了半天。
lines.pinyin: Tāmen shì hěn gāoxìng, kěshì xiànzài yào kǎo dàxué, qíngkuàng jiù bùtóng le. Wǒ céngjīng yǒu yí cì, kǎoshì qián xiǎng gēn tóngxué qù lùyíng, bàmā zhīdào le jiù mà wǒ: "Kuài kǎoshì le, zěnme bú zài jiā niànshū, fǎn'ér xiǎng chūqù wán?" Bùguǎn wǒ zěnme jiěshì tāmen dōu bù tīng, ràng wǒ nánguò le bàntiān.
lines.english: They are happy, but now that college exams are ahead, the situation is different. Once before an exam, I wanted to go camping with classmates; when my parents found out, they scolded me: 'Exams are around the corner, why aren't you studying at home instead of wanting to go out playing?' No matter how I explained, they wouldn't listen, which made me upset for a long time.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 可是，生命中有很多事情比考試還要重要啊！再說，孩子怎麼受得了一直被逼著念書呢？
lines.simplified: 可是，生命中有很多事情比考试还要重要啊！再说，孩子怎么受得了一直被逼着念书呢？
lines.pinyin: Kěshì, shēngmìng zhōng yǒu hěn duō shìqíng bǐ kǎoshì hái yào zhòngyào a! Zàishuō, háizi zěnme shòudeliǎo yìzhí bèi bīzhe niànshū ne?
lines.english: Still, there are many things in life even more important than exams! Besides, how can any kid stand being forced to study constantly?

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 我爸媽才不這麼想。其實有一些高中老師也是這樣，雖然他們也教導學生做人做事的道理，但臺灣社會很重視升學，所以考試就變成教學的重心了。
lines.simplified: 我爸妈才不这么想。其实有一些高中老师也是这样，虽然他们也教导学生做人做事的道理，但台湾社会很重视升学，所以考试就变成教学的重心了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ bàmā cái bù zhème xiǎng. Qíshí yǒu yìxiē gāozhōng lǎoshī yě shì zhèyàng, suīrán tāmen yě jiàodǎo xuéshēng zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ, dàn Táiwān shèhuì hěn zhòngshì shēngxué, suǒyǐ kǎoshì jiù biànchéng jiàoxué de zhòngxīn le.
lines.english: My parents certainly don't think that way. Actually, some high school teachers are like that too: while they teach life principles, Taiwanese society values college advancement so much that exams become the core focus of teaching.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 難怪你爸媽也認為考試最重要，好像只要考上好大學，將來就能有成就。
lines.simplified: 难怪你爸妈也认为考试最重要，好像只要考上好大学，将来就能有成就。
lines.pinyin: Nánguài nǐ bàmā yě rènwéi kǎoshì zuì zhòngyào, hǎoxiàng zhǐyào kǎoshàng hǎo dàxué, jiānglái jiù néng yǒu chéngjiù.
lines.english: No wonder your parents think exams are paramount, as if as long as you get into a good college, you will achieve success in the future.

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 是啊，就是因為這樣，所以老師要求學生做一堆測驗題目、記一堆筆記。要是孩子考不及格或學習成果不好，家長就逼孩子去補習，就算孩子再不滿也得去。
lines.simplified: 是啊，就是因为这样，所以老师要求学生做一堆测验题目、记一堆笔记。要是孩子考不及格或学习成果不好，家长就逼孩子去补习，就算孩子再不满也得去。
lines.pinyin: Shì a, jiùshì yīnwèi zhèyàng, suǒyǐ lǎoshī yāoqiú xuéshēng zuò yì duī cèyàn tímù, jì yì duī bǐjì. Yàoshi háizi kǎo bù jígé huò xuéxí chéngguǒ bù hǎo, jiāzhǎng jiù bī háizi qù bǔxí, jiùsuàn háizi zài bùmǎn yě děi qù.
lines.english: Yeah, exactly because of that, teachers demand students do piles of test questions and take heaps of notes. If a child fails or performs poorly, parents force them into cram schools no matter how unhappy they are.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 不過，我聽語言交換的朋友說，現在不少臺灣老師的教學方式變活潑了。他們利用有趣的教材和網路工具，帶領學生吸收新知識，也讓本來沒有自信的學生，願意主動舉手請教老師了。
lines.simplified: 不过，我听语言交换的朋友说，现在不少台湾老师的教学方式变活泼了。他们利用有趣的教材和网路工具，带领学生吸收新知识，也让本来没有自信的学生，愿意主动举手请教老师了。
lines.pinyin: Búguò, wǒ tīng yǔyán jiāohuàn de péngyǒu shuō, xiànzài bù shǎo Táiwān lǎoshī de jiàoxué fāngshì biàn huópo le. Tāmen lìyòng yǒuqù de jiàocái hé wǎnglù gōngjù, dàilǐng xuéshēng xīshōu xīn zhīshì, yě ràng běnlái méiyǒu zìxìn de xuéshēng, yuànyì zhǔdòng jǔshǒu qǐngjiào lǎoshī le.
lines.english: However, I heard from language exchange friends that many Taiwanese teachers are adopting livelier methods now. They use engaging materials and online tools to lead students in absorbing knowledge, prompting even unconfident students to raise their hands and consult teachers.

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 是啊，不只教學方式變了，升學制度也改了。像有一些學生體育、美術或音樂的成績非常好，就能以特殊表現，選擇理想的大學。
lines.simplified: 是啊，不只教学方式变了，升学制度也改了。像有一些学生体育、美术或音乐的成绩非常好，就能以特殊表现，选择理想的大学。
lines.pinyin: Shì a, bù zhǐ jiàoxué fāngshì biàn le, shēngxué zhìdù yě gǎi le. Xiàng yǒu yìxiē xuéshēng tǐyù, měishù huò yīnyuè de chéngjī fēicháng hǎo, jiù néng yǐ tèshū biǎoxiàn, xuǎnzé lǐxiǎng de dàxué.
lines.english: Right, not only teaching methods have changed, but college admissions systems have evolved too. Students with exceptional sports, art, or music talents can use their special achievements to enter ideal universities.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 我覺得這樣比較合理。像歐洲就有不少水準很高的職業學校，培養學生的專業能力，將來就比較容易找到工作。
lines.simplified: 我觉得这样比较合理。像欧洲就有不少水准很高的职业学校，培养学生的专业能力，将来就比较容易找到工作。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhèyàng bǐjiào hélǐ. Xiàng Ōuzhōu jiù yǒu bù shǎo shuǐzhǔn hěn gāo de zhíyè xuéxiào, péiyǎng xuéshēng de zhuānyè nénglì, jiānglái jiù bǐjiào róngyì zhǎodào gōngzuò.
lines.english: I think that's far more reasonable. Europe has many high-standard vocational schools cultivating students' technical expertise, making it easier to find jobs.

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 我有一個高中同學沒考上大學，他父母不但沒生氣，反而讓他去義大利遊學。他邊旅行邊學外文，後來就留在當地的職業學校念服裝設計，現在已經是服裝公司的大老闆了。
lines.simplified: 我有一个高中同学没考上大学，他父母不但没生气，反而让他去义大利游学。他边旅行边学外文，后来就留在当地的职业学校念服装设计，现在已经是服装公司的大老板了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí ge gāozhōng tóngxué méi kǎoshàng dàxué, tā fùmǔ búdàn méi shēngqì, fǎn'ér ràng tā qù Yìdàlì yóuxué. Tā biān lǚxíng biān xué wàiwén, hòulái jiù liú zài dāngdì de zhíyè xuéxiào niàn fúzhuāng shèjì, xiànzài yǐjīng shì fúzhuāng gōngsī de dà lǎobǎn le.
lines.english: I had a high school classmate who didn't test into college; his parents didn't get angry at all, but sent him on a study trip to Italy instead. He studied foreign languages while traveling, later studied fashion design at a local vocational academy, and is now the boss of an apparel company.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 這樣的成就也很好啊！誰說一定要念大學才有美好的未來呢？
lines.simplified: 这样的成就也很好啊！谁说一定要念大学才有美好的未来呢？
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng de chéngjiù yě hěn hǎo a! Shéi shuō yídìng yào niàn dàxué cái yǒu měihǎo de wèilái ne?
lines.english: That kind of accomplishment is wonderful too! Who can say that one must attend university to have a bright future?

grammarPages.lessonTitle: 誰說得念大學才有未來？
grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Who Can Say That There Is No Future Unless You Are a College Graduate?
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Return to Normal State with V過來 / V得過來 / V不過來
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe recovering consciousness, returning to a normal or better state, or having the capacity to handle tasks.
grammarPages.explanation: 「動詞＋過來」的「過來」是趨向補語，例如：請你把書拿過來。另外，「過來」還有回到或恢復到原來狀態的意思，大多表示正常的或是較好的狀態。例如：醒過來、改過來、明白過來。相反的，「過去」是從正常的狀態到另一種不好的狀態，比「過來」使用得少，例如：暈過去 (fainted)、昏過去 (fainted)。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + (Adverb) + (把 + Object) + Verb + 過來

text.traditional: ……總是睡得不太安心，半夜會突然醒過來。
text.simplified: ……总是睡得不太安心，半夜会突然醒过来。
text.pinyin: ……Zǒngshì shuì de bú tài ānxīn, bànyè huì tūrán xǐng guòlai.
text.english: ……He always sleeps uneasily and suddenly wakes up in the middle of the night.

text.traditional: 被媽媽罵了好幾次以後，弟弟終於把亂丟髒衣服的壞習慣改過來了。
text.simplified: 被妈妈骂了好几次以后，弟弟终于把乱丢脏衣服的坏习惯改过来了。
text.pinyin: Bèi māma mà le hǎo jǐ cì yǐhòu, dìdi zhōngyú bǎ luàndiū zāng yīfu de huài xíguàn gǎi guòlai le.
text.english: After being scolded by Mom several times, Younger Brother finally corrected his bad habit of tossing dirty clothes around.

text.traditional: 早上上班時，發現大家都對著我笑，過了一會兒我才明白過來，原來我穿著睡褲出門。
text.simplified: 早上上班时，发现大家都对着我笑，过了一会儿我才明白过来，原来我穿着睡裤出门。
text.pinyin: Zǎoshang shàngbān shí, fāxiàn dàjiā dōu duìzhe wǒ xiào, guò le yíhuìr wǒ cái míngbai guòlai, yuánlái wǒ chuānzhe shuìkù chūmén.
text.english: On my way to work in the morning, I noticed everyone was smiling at me; after a while I finally realized I had gone out wearing my pajama trousers.

items.question: How do you express that a bad habit has been corrected to a good state?
items.answer: 弟弟終於把壞習慣改過來了。
items.wrongTraditional: 弟弟終於把壞習慣改過去了。

right.english: Younger brother finally corrected his bad habit.

items.question: How do you ask for assistance because you have too much work to handle alone?
items.answer: 資料太多，我一個人忙不過來。
items.wrongTraditional: 資料太多，我一個人忙得不來。
items.wrongSimplified: 资料太多，我一个人忙得不来。

right.traditional: 資料太多，我一個人忙不過來。
right.simplified: 资料太多，我一个人忙不过来。
right.pinyin: Zīliào tài duō, wǒ yí ge rén mángbúguòlái.
right.english: There are too many materials; I can't handle it all alone.

questions.prompt: Say that one person cannot handle so many tasks:

segments.traditional: 要準備的東西太多，我一個人

questions.correctFeedback: 忙不過來 expresses that the volume of work exceeds one's capacity to handle.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 忙不過來 to state that you cannot manage all the tasks.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The 過來 of 動詞＋過來 is a directional complement. For example, 請你把書拿過來。In addition, 過來 has the meaning of returning, or returning to the original state, and primarily indicating a normal or better state. For example, 醒過來, 改過來, 明白過來. On the contrary, 過去 is moving from a normal state to a less ideal one. It is used less frequently than 過來. For example, 暈過去, 昏過去.

grammarPages.lessonTitle: 誰說得念大學才有未來？
grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Who Can Say That There Is No Future Unless You Are a College Graduate?
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Why Not... Instead with 怎麼不...反而...
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Question why someone fails to do what is reasonable and instead does something contrary or inappropriate.
grammarPages.explanation: 「怎麼不……呢？」是「為什麼不……呢？」的意思，表示說話的人對某種情況提出疑問，句尾常跟著「呢」。「怎麼不」後面是說話的人認為應該要做的事或建議；「反而」是連詞，後面是不應該做的或代表說話者的疑問。
grammarPages.pattern: (Subject) + 怎麼不 + Expected Action，反而 + Contrary Action + (呢)？

columns.meaning: want to go out to play

text.traditional: 快考試了，怎麼不在家念書，反而想出去玩？
text.simplified: 快考试了，怎么不在家念书，反而想出去玩？
text.pinyin: Kuài kǎoshì le, zěnme bú zài jiā niànshū, fǎn'ér xiǎng chūqù wán?
text.english: Exams are almost here; why aren't you studying at home and instead want to go out to play?

words.meaning: want to go out to play

text.traditional: 你聽不懂老師上課說的，怎麼不舉手請教老師，反而玩起手機來了？
text.simplified: 你听不懂老师上课说的，怎么不举手请教老师，反而玩起手机来了？
text.pinyin: Nǐ tīng bu dǒng lǎoshī shàngkè shuō de, zěnme bù jǔshǒu qǐngjiào lǎoshī, fǎn'ér wán qǐ shǒujī lái le?
text.english: You didn't understand what the teacher said in class; why didn't you raise your hand to ask the teacher, and instead started playing on your phone?

words.meaning: what the teacher said in class

text.traditional:
爸爸：孩子每次把衣服脫了就亂丟，每次都得幫他整理。
媽媽：你怎麼不跟他說，反而老是幫他整理呢？
text.simplified:
爸爸：孩子每次把衣服脱了就乱丢，每次都得帮他整理。

text.pinyin:
Bàba: Háizi měi cì bǎ yīfu tuō le jiù luàndiū, měi cì dōu děi bāng tā zhěnglǐ.
Māma: Nǐ zěnme bù gēn tā shuō, fǎn'ér lǎoshì bāng tā zhěnglǐ ne?
text.english:
Dad: Every time the kid takes off his clothes he just tosses them around, and every time I have to help him tidy up.
Mom: Why don't you tell him instead of always helping him tidy up?

items.question: How do you ask why a student isn't asking the teacher about what they don't understand, but playing on their phone instead?
items.answer: 怎麼不請教老師，反而玩起手機來了？
items.wrongTraditional: 怎麼不請教老師，而且玩起手機來了？
items.wrongSimplified: 怎么不请教老师，而且玩起手机来了？

right.traditional: 怎麼不請教老師，反而玩起手機來了？
right.simplified: 怎么不请教老师，反而玩起手机来了？
right.pinyin: Zěnme bù qǐngjiào lǎoshī, fǎn'ér wán qǐ shǒujī lái le?
right.english: Why didn't you consult the teacher, instead of playing on your phone?

words.pinyin: fǎn'ér wán qǐ shǒujī lái le

items.question: How do you question why someone isn't studying before exams?
items.answer: 快考試了，怎麼不在家念書，反而想出去玩？
items.wrongTraditional: 快考試了，為什麼反而不念書？
items.wrongSimplified: 快考试了，为什么反而不念书？

right.traditional: 快考試了，怎麼不在家念書，反而想出去玩？
right.simplified: 快考试了，怎么不在家念书，反而想出去玩？
right.pinyin: Kuài kǎoshì le, zěnme bú zài jiā niànshū, fǎn'ér xiǎng chūqù wán?
right.english: Exams are near; why aren't you studying at home instead of wanting to go out playing?

questions.prompt: Ask someone why they are playing games during an earthquake rather than seeking shelter:
questions.correctFeedback: 怎麼不 + Expected Action，反而 + Contrary Action highlights the irrational contrast.
questions.repairFeedback: Pattern: 怎麼不 + Expected Action，反而 + Inappropriate Action.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 怎麼不……呢？ has the same meaning as 為什麼不……呢？ indicating that the speaker is questioning a certain situation. The end of the sentence is often followed by 呢. 怎麼不 is followed by what the speaker thinks should be done, but 反而 as a conjunction, is followed by what should not be done or the speaker's doubt.

grammarPages.lessonTitle: 誰說得念大學才有未來？
grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Who Can Say That There Is No Future Unless You Are a College Graduate?
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Not Only Didn't... But on the Contrary with 不但不/沒...反而...
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Contrast an absent expected reaction with a surprising, contrary outcome.
grammarPages.explanation: 「不但不」、「不但沒」後面接的是與說話的人預料相反的情況；「反而」的後面是出乎預料的情況或說話的人認為不應該發生的。有時候「不但」可以省略，例如：颱風快來了，他（不但）沒留在家裡，反而去衝浪，真是太危險了。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 不但不/沒 + Expected，反而 + Contrary

columns.meaning: go out for a big meal

text.traditional: 我有一個高中同學沒考上大學，他父母不但沒生氣，反而讓他去義大利遊學。
text.simplified: 我有一个高中同学没考上大学，他父母不但没生气，反而让他去义大利游学。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí ge gāozhōng tóngxué méi kǎoshang dàxué, tā fùmǔ búdàn méi shēngqì, fǎn'ér ràng tā qù Yìdàlì yóuxué.
text.english: A high school classmate of mine did not get into college, yet his parents not only didn't get angry; they even sent him to study in Italy.

text.traditional: 我們公司不但沒給男女員工同樣的工作機會，反而對女員工有許多不合理的要求。
text.simplified: 我们公司不但没给男女员工同样的工作机会，反而对女员工有许多不合理的要求。

text.traditional: 小金最近胖了很多，體力也變差了，可是他不但不運動，反而天天約朋友去吃大餐。

text.english: Xiao Jin has gained a lot of weight recently and his stamina has gotten worse, yet he not only refuses to exercise, but instead invites friends out for big meals every day.

questions.correctFeedback: 不但不/沒……反而…… contrasts the expected courtesy with an arrogant reversal.
questions.repairFeedback: Pattern: 不但不/沒 + Expected Action，反而 + Contrary Action.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 不但不 or 不但沒 is followed by circumstances that are contrary to what the speaker expected; 反而 is followed by an unexpected situation or one the person speaking thinks shouldn't happen. Sometimes 不但 can be omitted. For example, 颱風快來了，他（不但）沒留在家裡，反而去衝浪，真是太危險了。

grammarPages.lessonTitle: 誰說得念大學才有未來？
grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Who Can Say That There Is No Future Unless You Are a College Graduate?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Strongly refute someone's claim or counter their assertion using 才……(呢).
grammarPages.explanation: 這一課的「才」是強調「才」後面所說的話，常用在反駁的時候，句尾常跟「呢」一起使用，例如：「你說那家餐廳的菜好吃，可是我覺得你煮的才好吃呢！」、「小明說我借了他的書，我才沒借呢！」
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 才 + (不/沒) + Refuted Assertion + (呢)

text.traditional:

questions.prompt: Strongly refute the rumor that you stayed home due to drinking:
questions.correctFeedback: 才沒……呢 emphatically refutes an untrue assumption.
questions.repairFeedback: Pattern: Subject + 才 + 沒/不 + Verb + 呢.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The 才 in this lesson emphasizes what is said after 才. It is often used when refuting something, and the sentence end often uses 呢. For example, 你說那家餐廳的菜好吃，可是我覺得你煮的才好吃呢！Or 小明說我借了他的書，我才沒借呢！

items.title: Grammar 5–7 · Real Competence Over Test Scores

dialogue.title: 教育是有意義的學習

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 臺灣社會一直都很重視學生的學習表現，尤其是考試的成績。人們似乎認為，成績好就代表書讀得好，書讀得好就會有美好的未來。因此，不少家長希望孩子能上好大學，甚至念到博士。為了達成這個目的，家長從孩子念國小、國中起，就非常注意每科的分數，老是擔心孩子進不了好高中、好大學。
lines.simplified: 台湾社会一直都很重视学生的学习表现，尤其是考试的成绩。人们似乎认为，成绩好就代表书读得好，书读得好就会有美好的未来。因此，不少家长希望孩子能上好大学，甚至念到博士。为了达成这个目的，家长从孩子念国小、国中起，就非常注意每科的分数，老是担心孩子进不了好高中、好大学。
lines.pinyin: Táiwān shèhuì yìzhí dōu hěn zhòngshì xuéshēng de xuéxí biǎoxiàn, yóuqí shì kǎoshì de chéngjī. Rénmen sìhū rènwéi, chéngjī hǎo jiù dàibiǎo shū dú de hǎo, shū dú de hǎo jiù huì yǒu měihǎo de wèilái. Yīncǐ, bù shǎo jiāzhǎng xīwàng háizi néng shàng hǎo dàxué, shènzhì niàn dào bóshì. Wèile dáchéng zhè ge mùdì, jiāzhǎng cóng háizi niàn guóxiǎo, guózhōng qǐ, jiù fēicháng zhùyì měi kē de fēnshù, lǎoshì dānxīn háizi jìn bù liǎo hǎo gāozhōng, hǎo dàxué.
lines.english: Taiwanese society has always attached great importance to students' academic performance, especially test scores. People seem to believe that good grades equate to doing well in school, and doing well in school ensures a bright future. Consequently, many parents hope their children get into prestigious universities or even obtain doctorates. To achieve this goal, parents closely watch scores in every subject starting from elementary and junior high school, perpetually worrying their children won't enter top high schools or universities.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 有一些家長很誇張，不但陪孩子一起補習，還幫他們把筆記寫在本子上、把重點寫在便條上，以為孩子複習時用得著，這樣考試的成績就會更好。也有家長把孩子的學習時間排得很滿，下課後還叫他們寫很多考卷。後來，大家發現學生雖然掌握了考試的技巧，但在實際生活中碰到困難時，反而缺乏解決問題的能力。畢竟會考試，不代表擁有處理事情的能力。
lines.simplified: 有一些家长很夸张，不但陪孩子一起补习，还帮他们把笔记写在本子上、把重点写在便条上，以为孩子复习时用得着，这样考试的成绩就会更好。也有家长把孩子的学习时间排得很满，下课后还叫他们写很多考卷。后来，大家发现学生虽然掌握了考试的技巧，但在实际生活中碰到困难时，反而缺乏解决问题的能力。毕竟会考试，不代表拥有处理事情的能力。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē jiāzhǎng hěn kuāzhāng, búdàn péi háizi yìqǐ bǔxí, hái bāng tāmen bǎ bǐjì xiě zài běnzi shàng, bǎ zhòngdiǎn xiě zài biàntiáo shàng, yǐwéi háizi fùxí shí yòngdezháo, zhèyàng kǎoshì de chéngjī jiù huì gèng hǎo. Yě yǒu jiāzhǎng bǎ háizi de xuéxí shíjiān pái de hěn mǎn, xiàkè hòu hái jiào tāmen xiě hěn duō kǎojuàn. Hòulái, dàjiā fāxiàn xuéshēng suīrán zhǎngwò le kǎoshì de jǐqiào, dàn zài shíjì shēnghuó zhōng pèngdào kùnnán shí, fǎn'ér quēfá jiějué wèntí de nénglì. Bìjìng huì kǎoshì, bù dàibiǎo yǒngyǒu chǔlǐ shìqíng de nénglì.
lines.english: Some parents go to extreme lengths: not only attending cram school with their children, but copying notes into notebooks and writing key points on sticky notes, thinking kids will find them useful when reviewing, thereby scoring higher on tests. Other parents pack schedules to the brim and assign piles of test papers after class. Later on, people found that while students mastered test-taking techniques, they lacked problem-solving capabilities when encountering real-world challenges. After all, testing well does not mean having practical competence.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 其實，因為每年出生的孩子越來越少，許多學校的新生也變少了，因為這樣，被大學錄取的機會反而大大地增加了。但是國中、高中的考試沒減少，家長對教育的想法也沒有太大的改變。孩子就算考上了好大學，沒實力的人恐怕畢業後也很難找到工作，更不可能擔任公司的主管，甚至最後變成整個社會的負擔。
lines.simplified: 其实，因为每年出生的孩子越来越少，许多学校的新生也变少了，因为这样，被大学录取的机会反而大大地增加了。但是国中、高中的考试没减少，家长对教育的想法也没有太大的改变。孩子就算考上了好大学，没实力的人恐怕毕业后也很难找到工作，更不可能担任公司的主管，甚至最后变成整个社会的负担。
lines.pinyin: Qíshí, yīnwèi měi nián chūshēng de háizi yuèláiyuè shǎo, xǔduō xuéxiào de xīnshēng yě biàn shǎo le, yīnwèi zhèyàng, bèi dàxué lùqǔ de jīhuì fǎn'ér dàdà de zēngjiā le. Dànshì guózhōng, gāozhōng de kǎoshì méi jiǎnshǎo, jiāzhǎng duì jiàoyù de xiǎngfǎ yě méiyǒu tài dà de gǎibiàn. Háizi jiùsuàn kǎoshàng le hǎo dàxué, méi shílì de rén kǒngpà bìyè hòu yě hěn nán zhǎodào gōngzuò, gèng bù kěnéng dānrèn gōngsī de zhǔguǎn, shènzhì zuìhòu biànchéng zhěnggè shèhuì de fùdān.
lines.english: In fact, because fewer children are born each year, freshmen entering schools have declined, significantly increasing university admission rates instead. Yet junior and senior high exams have not decreased, and parents' educational mindset remains mostly unchanged. Even if a child tests into a good college, without genuine competence they will struggle to find employment, let alone serve as company managers, ultimately turning into burdens on society.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 這樣的例子一年比一年多。一直到最近幾年，家長和老師終於明白每個孩子都是獨特的，不是每個人都非念大學不可。再說，考試成績好的人，不一定就能幸福過日子。因此，有意義的學習是讓孩子以思考代替記答案，不僅給孩子自由的空間，發揮出自己的優點，而且還提供更好的教材和教學方式，讓孩子快樂地學習、成長。如果他們的能力可以變得更強，將來就能為社會貢獻一份力量了。
lines.simplified: 这样的例子一年比一年多。一直到最近几年，家长和老师终于明白每个孩子都是独特的，不是每个人都非念大学不可。再说，考试成绩好的人，不一定就能幸福过日子。因此，有意义的学习是让孩子以思考代替记答案，不仅给孩子自由的空间，发挥出自己的优点，而且还提供更好的教材和教学方式，让孩子快乐地学习、成长。如果他们的能力可以变得更强，将来就能为社会贡献一份力量了。
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng de lìzi yì nián bǐ yì nián duō. Yìzhí dào zuìjìn jǐ nián, jiāzhǎng hé lǎoshī zhōngyú míngbái měi ge háizi dōu shì dútè de, búshì měi ge rén dōu fēi niàn dàxué bùkě. Zàishuō, kǎoshì chéngjī hǎo de rén, bù yídìng jiù néng xìngfú guò rìzi. Yīncǐ, yǒuyìyì de xuéxí shì ràng háizi yǐ sīkǎo dàitì jì dá'àn, bùjǐn gěi háizi zìyóu de kōngjiān, fāhuī chū zìjǐ de yōudiǎn, érqiě hái tígōng gèng hǎo de jiàocái hé jiàoxué fāngshì, ràng háizi kuàilè de xuéxí, chéngzhǎng. Rúguǒ tāmen de nénglì kěyǐ biàn de gèng qiáng, jiānglái jiù néng wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn yí fèn lìliàng le.
lines.english: Such examples multiply year after year. Only in recent years have parents and educators finally realized that each child is unique and not everyone must attend university. Furthermore, individuals with high test scores do not necessarily lead happier lives. Meaningful education allows children to replace rote memorization with critical thinking, providing free space to develop talents, along with superior curricula and methods that foster joyful learning and growth. If their capabilities grow stronger, they can contribute meaningful strength to society in the future.

grammarPages.lessonTitle: 誰說得念大學才有未來？
grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Who Can Say That There Is No Future Unless You Are a College Graduate?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Highlight the most prominent or noteworthy item within a broader category using 尤其是.
grammarPages.explanation: 「尤其」是副詞，有「特別」的意思，表示和其他事物比起來更特別。一般放在後面的句子。「尤其」＋「是」有強調的意思。
grammarPages.pattern: Topic + Statement，尤其是 + Focus

text.traditional: 臺灣社會一直都很重視學生的學習表現，尤其是考試的成績。
text.simplified: 台湾社会一直都很重视学生的学习表现，尤其是考试的成绩。

text.english: Taiwanese society has always placed great importance on students' academic performance, especially their exam scores.

text.traditional: 這個學期我選了五門課，每門課都很有意思，尤其是英文會話課，不僅教授的教法活潑，說話也很幽默。

text.simplified: 每种工作都有它的困难或问题，尤其是当警察的，经常会碰到麻烦或危险的事情。

text.english: Every job has its difficulties or problems, and especially for police officers, who often run into troubles or dangers.

questions.prompt: Advise a learner to practice speaking, highlighting local conversation:

questions.repairFeedback: Use 尤其是 to highlight the most prominent specific practice.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 尤其 is an adverb similar to 特別, which means that something is more special compared to something else. Usually placed in the following sentence. 尤其+是 has the meaning of emphasis.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Result / Attainment with V得著 / V不著 / V著了 / 沒V著
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express achieving or failing to achieve an aim with verbs like 找, 猜, 用, 買, 摸.
grammarPages.explanation: 表示做某個動作，但達不到某種目的或結果。「著(zháo)」前面的動詞具有一定的目標性，動作有「接觸或達到」的意思，常用的有「拿、看、打、猜、用、找」等。「著」在此語法作為結構補語，說明前面動詞的結果。例如：鑰匙找著了/沒找著。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + Verb + 得/不 + 著 (+ Object)

text.traditional: ……把重點寫在便條上，以為孩子複習時用得著，這樣考試的成績就會更好。
text.simplified: ……把重点写在便条上，以为孩子复习时用得着，这样考试的成绩就会更好。

text.pinyin: Nàge zhuānguì lǐ fàngzhe hǎoduō piàoliang de míngpái píbāo, kěxī wǒ méi qián mǎi, kàndezháo, mōbuzháo.

words.meaning: sadly I have no money to buy

questions.correctFeedback: 用得著 indicates that an object is applicable or useful for the needed task.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 用得著 to state that something can be put to good use.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: It expresses a certain action, but one which can not achieve a certain purpose or result. The verb in front of 著(zháo) has a certain purpose, and the action it expresses has to do with “contact or reach”. Commonly used verbs are 拿, 看, 打, 猜, 用, 找, etc. 著 here is to work as a structural complement, indicating the result of the preceding verb. For example, 鑰匙找著了/沒找著.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Who Can Say That There Is No Future Unless You Are a College Graduate?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express substituting one method, entity, or action for another using 以……代替…….
grammarPages.explanation: 「以」有「用」的意思，「以……代替……」意思是用某樣東西或某個行動來替換原本的東西或行動。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 以 + Substitute + 代替 + Original

text.traditional: 因此，有意義的學習是讓孩子以思考代替記答案……

text.simplified: 如果大家都能以搭公车、骑自行车代替开车，这样空气就不会那么脏了。

items.question: How do you express replacing rote memorization of answers with critical thinking?

items.question: How do you state that the professor replaced written exams with written reports?
