questions.prompt: State that reports will replace written exams for finals:
questions.correctFeedback: 以 A 代替 B means using A (writing reports) to replace B (written test).
questions.repairFeedback: Pattern: 以 + New Method + 代替 + Old Method.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 以 is similar to 用. 以……代替 means replacing some thing or action.

dialogue.title: 健康檢查不麻煩

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 家豪，你手裡拿的是什麼？是健康檢查的簡介嗎？
lines.simplified: 家豪，你手里拿的是什么？是健康检查的简介吗？
lines.pinyin: Jiāháo, nǐ shǒuli ná de shì shénme? Shì jiànkāng jiǎnchá de jiǎnjiè ma?
lines.english: Jiahao, what are you holding in your hand? Is it a brochure for health examinations?

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 對啊，早上陪我阿姨去醫院辦理住院手續時，順便拿的，要帶回去給我爸媽看。
lines.simplified: 对啊，早上陪我阿姨去医院办理住院手续时，顺便拿的，要带回去给我爸妈看。
lines.pinyin: Duì a, zǎoshang péi wǒ āyí qù yīyuàn bànlǐ zhùyuàn shǒuxù shí, shùnbiàn ná de, yào dài huíqù gěi wǒ bàmā kàn.
lines.english: Yes. I picked it up this morning while accompanying my aunt to handle her hospital admission, to take home for my parents to see.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 你阿姨怎麼了？昨天我還在超市遇到她，看起來很健康啊！
lines.simplified: 你阿姨怎么了？昨天我还在超市遇到她，看起来很健康啊！
lines.pinyin: Nǐ āyí zěnme le? Zuótiān wǒ hái zài chāoshì yùdào tā, kàn qǐlái hěn jiànkāng a!
lines.english: What happened to your aunt? I just ran into her at the supermarket yesterday and she looked in great health!

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 說也奇怪，她一向都有良好的飲食和生活習慣，也從來沒發覺自己有什麼毛病。直到上個月做了全身健康檢查，才知道病了。
lines.simplified: 说也奇怪，她一向都有良好的饮食和生活习惯，也从来没发觉自己有什么毛病。直到上个月做了全身健康检查，才知道病了。
lines.pinyin: Shuō yě qíguài, tā yíxiàng dōu yǒu liánghǎo de yǐnshí hé shēnghuó xíguàn, yě cónglái méi fājué zìjǐ yǒu shénme máobìng. Zhídào shàng ge yuè zuò le quánshēn jiànkāng jiǎnchá, cái zhīdào bìng le.
lines.english: Strange to say, she has always maintained healthy dietary and living habits, and never sensed anything wrong. Not until she underwent a comprehensive health check last month did she realize she was ill.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 每次聽你阿姨說話，都感覺她只想著照顧家人，自己一定沒想到會變成病人吧？
lines.simplified: 每次听你阿姨说话，都感觉她只想着照顾家人，自己一定没想到会变成病人吧？
lines.pinyin: Měicì tīng nǐ āyí shuōhuà, dōu gǎnjué tā zhǐ xiǎngzhe zhàogù jiārén, zìjǐ yídìng méi xiǎngdào huì biànchéng bìngrén ba?
lines.english: Whenever I hear your aunt speak, I feel she only ever thinks of looking after her family; she certainly never imagined becoming a patient herself.

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 是啊，她是家庭主婦，生活很單純，每天管孩子、注意家人的健康，照顧家人就是她生活的重心，從沒想過自己也需要別人照顧。
lines.simplified: 是啊，她是家庭主妇，生活很单纯，每天管孩子、注意家人的健康，照顾家人就是她生活的重心，从没想过自己也需要别人照顾。
lines.pinyin: Shì a, tā shì jiātíng zhǔfù, shēnghuó hěn dānchún, měitiān guǎn háizi, zhùyì jiārén de jiànkāng, zhàogù jiārén jiù shì tā shēnghuó de zhòngxīn, cóng méi xiǎngguò zìjǐ yě xūyào biérén zhàogù.
lines.english: Exactly. As a homemaker leading a quiet life, managing kids and watching over family health is the center of her life; she never considered that she too might need looking after.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 不過還好她去做了健檢，才知道該去看醫生。
lines.simplified: 不过还好她去做了健检，才知道该去看医生。
lines.pinyin: Búguò háihǎo tā qù zuò le jiànjiǎn, cái zhīdào gāi qù kàn yīshēng.
lines.english: Still, it's fortunate she went for the checkup; only then did she know to see a doctor.

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 妳說的沒錯。我早就想帶父母去做了，只不過他們覺得做健檢除了得花時間，還很麻煩，所以很被動，我得趁這個機會，跟他們溝通一下。
lines.simplified: 你说的没错。我早就想带父母去做了，只不过他们觉得做健检除了得花时间，还很麻烦，所以很被动，我得趁这个机会，跟他们沟通一下。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de méicuò. Wǒ zǎojiù xiǎng dài fùmǔ qù zuò le, zhǐbúguò tāmen juéde zuò jiànjiǎn chúle děi huā shíjiān, hái hěn máfan, suǒyǐ hěn bèidòng, wǒ děi chèn zhè ge jīhuì, gēn tāmen gōutōng yíxià.
lines.english: You're right. I had long wanted to take my parents, except they feel exams take time and cause hassle, making them passive about it. I must seize this opportunity to talk with them.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 我先生也一樣。最近他頭痛了好幾天，我想帶他去看病，他不但不配合，反而很生氣地說：「我又沒什麼毛病，為什麼非去不可！」他死也不肯去，害我擔心得不得了。
lines.simplified: 我先生也一样。最近他头痛了好几天，我想带他去看病，他不但不配合，反而很生气地说：“我又没什么毛病，为什么非去不可！”他死也不肯去，害我担心得不得了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiānsheng yě yíyàng. Zuìjìn tā tóutòng le hǎojǐ tiān, wǒ xiǎng dài tā qù kànbìng, tā búdàn bù pèihé, fǎn'ér hěn shēngqì de shuō: 'Wǒ yòu méi shénme máobìng, wèishénme fēi qù bùkě!' Tā sǐ yě bù kěn qù, hài wǒ dānxīn de bùdéliǎo.
lines.english: My husband is just the same. He had headaches for several days recently, and when I wanted to take him to the clinic, far from cooperating, he snapped angrily: 'Nothing is wrong with me, why must I go!' He obstinately refused, causing me tremendous worry.

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 如果感覺這麼不舒服，就是身體發出警告，表示健康有問題了。我看妳陪他去醫院，妳也順便做個免費的基本健檢吧。
lines.simplified: 如果感觉这么不舒服，就是身体发出警告，表示健康有问题了。我看你陪他去医院，你也顺便做个免费的基本健检吧。
lines.pinyin: Rúguǒ gǎnjué zhème bù shūfu, jiù shì shēntǐ fāchū jǐnggào, biǎoshì jiànkāng yǒu wèntí le. Wǒ kàn nǐ péi tā qù yīyuàn, nǐ yě shùnbiàn zuò ge miǎnfèi de jīběn jiànjiǎn ba.
lines.english: If he feels that uncomfortable, that's the body sounding an alarm that health has issues. I suggest you accompany him to the hospital, and take advantage of a free basic checkup yourself.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 免費健檢的對象，好像年齡得滿四十歲。我還年輕呢！
lines.simplified: 免费健检的对象，好像年龄得满四十岁。我还年轻呢！
lines.pinyin: Miǎnfèi jiànjiǎn de duìxiàng, hǎoxiàng niánlíng děi mǎn sìshí suì. Wǒ hái niánqīng ne!
lines.english: The eligibility for free checkups seems to require turning forty. I'm still young!

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 對不起，對不起。
lines.simplified: 对不起，对不起。
lines.pinyin: Duìbùqǐ, duìbùqǐ.
lines.english: My apologies, sorry about that.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 沒什麼啦！
lines.simplified: 没什么啦！
lines.pinyin: Méi shénme la!
lines.english: No worries at all!

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 這家醫院的醫生挺有名的，應該很可靠，健檢手續也不麻煩，只要上網填個表就行了。
lines.simplified: 这家医院的医生挺有名的，应该很可靠，健检手续也不麻烦，只要上网填个表就行了。
lines.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn de yīshēng tǐng yǒumíng de, yīnggāi hěn kěkào, jiànjiǎn shǒuxù yě bù máfan, zhǐyào shàngwǎng tián ge biǎo jiù xíng le.
lines.english: The doctors at this hospital are quite renowned and should be dependable; checkup procedures aren't complicated either—just fill out an online form.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 我最大的願望就是家人都健健康康的。既然手續這麼簡單，那明天就先帶我先生去做個健檢吧。
lines.simplified: 我最大的愿望就是家人都健健康康的。既然手续这么简单，那明天就先带我先生去做个健检吧。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zuìdà de yuànwàng jiù shì jiārén dōu jiànjiànkāngkāng de. Jìrán shǒuxù zhème jiǎndān, nà míngtiān jiù xiān dài wǒ xiānsheng qù zuò ge jiànjiǎn ba.
lines.english: My greatest wish is for my family to stay completely healthy. Since the procedure is that simple, tomorrow I'll take my husband for a health check.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Not Until a Point with 直到……才……
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express that an event delayed happening until a specific moment or condition was reached.
grammarPages.explanation: 表示過去一直沒發生的事情，到了某個時間點才發生。「直到」後面接時間或情況。「才」後面接結果，表示說話的人覺得比預期的晚。
grammarPages.pattern: 直到 + Time / Event (+ 以後/時) + Subject + 才 + Result

text.traditional: ……從來沒發覺自己有什麼毛病。直到上個月做了全身健康檢查，才知道病了。
text.simplified: ……从来没发觉自己有什么毛病。直到上个月做了全身健康检查，才知道病了。
text.pinyin: … cónglái méi fājué zìjǐ yǒu shénme máobìng. zhídào shàng ge yuè zuò le quánshēn jiànkāng jiǎnchá, cái zhīdào bìng le.
text.english: …She had never noticed any health problems of her own. Not until a full checkup last month did she learn she was ill.

words.meaning: only then knew she was ill

text.traditional: 小王大學畢業後一直找不到好工作，直到三十歲才找到合適的。
text.simplified: 小王大学毕业后一直找不到好工作，直到三十岁才找到合适的。
text.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng dàxué bìyè hòu yìzhí zhǎobùdào hǎo gōngzuò, zhídào sānshí suì cái zhǎodào héshì de.
text.english: Xiao Wang struggled to find a good job after graduating, not finding a suitable one until he turned thirty.

words.meaning: kept failing to find a good job
only then found a suitable one

text.traditional: 因為早上起床起晚了，直到飛機起飛前三十分鐘，我才趕到機場。
text.simplified: 因为早上起床起晚了，直到飞机起飞前三十分钟，我才赶到机场。
text.pinyin: Yīnwèi zǎoshang qǐchuáng qǐ wǎn le, zhídào fēijī qǐfēi qián sānshí fēnzhōng, wǒ cái gǎndào jīchǎng.
text.english: Because I overslept this morning, not until thirty minutes before takeoff did I finally rush to the airport.

words.pinyin: Yīnwèi zǎoshang qǐchuáng qǐ wǎn le

words.traditional: 直到飛機起飛前三十分鐘
words.simplified: 直到飞机起飞前三十分钟
words.pinyin: zhídào fēijī qǐfēi qián sānshí fēnzhōng

words.meaning: only then I rushed to the airport

items.question: How do you say: Not until my wife phoned did I finally wake up?
items.answer: 直到我太太打電話來，我才醒過來。
items.wrongTraditional: 自從我太太打電話來，我才醒過來。
items.wrongSimplified: 自从我太太打电话来，我才醒过来。

right.traditional: 直到我太太打電話來，我才醒過來。
right.simplified: 直到我太太打电话来，我才醒过来。
right.pinyin: Zhídào wǒ tàitai dǎ diànhuà lái, wǒ cái xǐngguòlái.
right.english: Not until my wife phoned did I finally wake up.

words.pinyin: zhídào wǒ tàitai dǎ diànhuà lái

items.question: Which marks a delayed return with 才 instead of 就?
items.answer: 直到昨天，他才搭飛機回國。
items.wrongTraditional: 直到昨天，他就搭飛機回國。
items.wrongSimplified: 直到昨天，他就搭飞机回国。

right.traditional: 直到昨天，他才搭飛機回國。
right.simplified: 直到昨天，他才搭飞机回国。
right.pinyin: Zhídào zuótiān, tā cái dā fēijī huíguó.
right.english: Not until yesterday did he finally fly home.

questions.prompt: Say that you didn't realize your phone was missing until making a call:

tiles.pinyin: zhídào yào dǎ diànhuà cái fāxiàn
zìcóng yào dǎ diànhuà jiù fāxiàn
wèile yào dǎ diànhuà cái fāxiàn

questions.correctFeedback: 直到 + Event + 才 + Result expresses delayed occurrence or discovery.
questions.repairFeedback: Pattern: 直到 + Event + 才 + Discovery.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 直到……（，）才…… means that what has not occurred will not happen until after a certain point in time. 直到 is followed by time or circumstances. 才 is followed by the result, which means that the speaker felt that the result was later than expected.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Adding a Qualification with 只不過
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Introduce a minor reservation, supplement, or softening limitation with 只不過 ('it's only that...').
grammarPages.explanation: 「只不過」是「只是」的意思，用來補充說明某件事，讓聽者更了解事情的情況。「只不過」的後面接要補充說明的內容。
grammarPages.pattern: Statement, + 只不過 + Supplementary Qualification

columns.meaning: too much work at the company

text.traditional: 我早就想帶父母去做了，只不過他們覺得做健檢除了得花時間……
text.simplified: 我早就想带父母去做了，只不过他们觉得做健检除了得花时间……
text.pinyin: Wǒ zǎojiù xiǎng dài fùmǔ qù zuò le, zhǐbúguò tāmen juéde zuò jiànjiǎn chúle děi huā shíjiān…
text.english: I had long wanted to take my parents for a checkup; it is just that they feel health exams take time…

words.traditional: 我早就想帶父母去做了
words.simplified: 我早就想带父母去做了
words.pinyin: Wǒ zǎojiù xiǎng dài fùmǔ qù zuò le
words.meaning: I had long wanted to take my parents for a checkup

words.traditional: 他們覺得做健檢除了得花時間
words.simplified: 他们觉得做健检除了得花时间
words.pinyin: tāmen juéde zuò jiànjiǎn chúle děi huā shíjiān

text.traditional: 我很喜歡這輛英國車，只不過價格太高了，我得多存一點錢才買得起。
text.simplified: 我很喜欢这辆英国车，只不过价格太高了，我得多存一点钱才买得起。
text.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuan zhè liàng Yīngguó chē, zhǐbúguò jiàgé tài gāo le, wǒ děi duō cún yìdiǎn qián cái mǎideqǐ.
text.english: I love this British car; it's merely that the price tag is too steep, so I need to save more money to afford it.

words.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuan zhè liàng Yīngguó chē
words.meaning: I really like this British car

words.pinyin: wǒ děi duō cún yìdiǎn qián
words.meaning: I need to save more money

text.traditional: 他很想當背包客去非洲旅行，只不過公司的事情太多，實在走不開。
text.simplified: 他很想当背包客去非洲旅行，只不过公司的事情太多，实在走不开。
text.pinyin: Tā hěn xiǎng dāng bēibāokè qù Fēizhōu lǚxíng, zhǐbúguò gōngsī de shìqing tài duō, shízài zǒubùkāi.
text.english: He'd love to backpack through Africa; it's just that work responsibilities are so overwhelming he simply can't leave.

words.traditional: 他很想當背包客去非洲旅行
words.simplified: 他很想当背包客去非洲旅行
words.pinyin: Tā hěn xiǎng dāng bēibāokè qù Fēizhōu lǚxíng
words.meaning: he badly wants to backpack through Africa
work at the company is overwhelming

items.question: How do you reassure someone that an illness is minor and nothing to worry about?
items.answer: 沒關係，只不過是個小感冒，多休息就會好。
items.wrongTraditional: 沒關係，畢竟是個小感冒，多休息就會好。
items.wrongSimplified: 没关系，毕竟是个小感冒，多休息就会好。

right.traditional: 沒關係，只不過是個小感冒，多休息就會好。
right.simplified: 没关系，只不过是个小感冒，多休息就会好。
right.pinyin: Méiguānxi, zhǐbúguò shì ge xiǎo gǎnmào, duō xiūxí jiù huì hǎo.
right.english: No worries; it is merely a minor cold, resting more will fix it.

items.question: How do you explain preparing for an exam while mentioning lack of experience?
items.answer: 準備是準備了，只不過我缺乏經驗，有點兒擔心。
items.wrongTraditional: 準備是準備了，反而我缺乏經驗，有點兒擔心。
items.wrongSimplified: 准备是准备了，反而我缺乏经验，有点儿担心。

right.traditional: 準備是準備了，只不過我缺乏經驗，有點兒擔心。
right.simplified: 准备是准备了，只不过我缺乏经验，有点儿担心。
right.pinyin: Zhǔnbèi shì zhǔnbèi le, zhǐbúguò wǒ quēfá jīngyàn, yǒudiǎnr dānxīn.
right.english: I did prepare, it's just that I lack exam experience and feel a bit anxious.

questions.prompt: Praise Miss Zhang's fiance while noting he doesn't speak much:
questions.correctFeedback: 只不過 adds a mild limitation or qualification to a positive statement.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 只不過 to soften the praise with a minor drawback.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 只不過 has the same meaning as 只是, which is used to supplement something and let the listener know more about the situation. 只不過 is followed by the supplementary explanation.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express that someone or something caused an unfortunate, adverse result with 害.
grammarPages.explanation: 這個「害」有「讓」或「使」的意思，語氣比較強烈。「害」的後面接負面的結果。
grammarPages.pattern: Cause / Subject + 害 + Victim / Object + Negative Result

text.simplified: ……他死也不肯去，害我担心得不得了。

text.english: …He obstinately refused to go, causing me tremendous anxiety.

words.pinyin: Tā sǐ yě bù kěn qù

text.simplified: 周先生爬山时迷了路，山上很偏僻，手机的讯号很弱，害他没办法跟家人联络。

text.english: Mr. Zhou lost his way hiking; remote mountains and faint phone signal prevented him from contacting his family.

words.meaning: to be unable to contact his family

words.simplified: 要是老师每天要求学生写很多测验题目

not only does it not help learning

items.question: How do you blame a nightmare for leaving you sleepless all night?
items.answer: 昨天我做了可怕的夢，害我整夜不敢睡。
items.wrongTraditional: 昨天我做了可怕的夢，讓我整夜不敢睡。
items.wrongSimplified: 昨天我做了可怕的梦，让我整夜不敢睡。

words.meaning: caused me fear sleep all night

items.question: How do you rebuke an unmasked sick coworker for infecting you?
items.answer: 你感冒不戴口罩，害我也開始咳嗽了。

dialogue.title: 短文 · 追求健康與幸福的生活

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 家豪的伯伯林水木是一家玩具工廠的大老闆，工作三十年了。雖然這段期間遇到了不少挫折，但是他很堅強，為了給家人安定的生活、當員工的榜樣，他都努力克服、堅持到底，終於擁有了今天的成就。
lines.simplified: 家豪的伯伯林水木是一家玩具工厂的大老板，工作三十年了。虽然这段期间遇到了不少挫折，但是他很坚强，为了给家人安定的生活、当员工的榜样，他都努力克服、坚持到底，终于拥有了今天的成就。
lines.pinyin: Jiāháo de bóbo Lín Shuǐmù shì yì jiā wánjù gōngchǎng de dà lǎobǎn, gōngzuò sānshí nián le. Suīrán zhè duàn qījiān yùdào le bùshǎo cuòzhé, dànshì tā hěn jiānqiáng, wèile gěi jiārén āndìng de shēnghuó, dāng yuángōng de bǎngyàng, tā dōu nǔlì kèfú, jiānchí dàodǐ, zhōngyú yōngyǒu le jīntiān de chéngjiù.
lines.english: Jiahao's uncle Lin Shuimu is the owner of a toy factory, where he has worked for thirty years. Although encountering numerous setbacks over this period, he remained steadfast; to provide stability for his family and serve as a model for employees, he persevered through difficulties to the very end, finally achieving today's success.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 過去三十年，林伯伯不但經常到各部門了解情況，對產品標準的要求也較高。他認為自己是公司的主角，要是少了他，銷售成績一定不理想。在家豪的記憶中，伯伯每天的生活就像打仗一樣，老是忙得忘了吃飯，有時緊張得睡不著。有一次他跟部門主管開會，因為討論得太激烈，頭突然痛得不得了，連站都站不起來，助理立刻送他到醫院去。
lines.simplified: 过去三十年，林伯伯不但经常到各部门了解情况，对产品标准的要求也较高。他认为自己是公司的主角，要是少了他，销售成绩一定不理想。在家豪的记忆中，伯伯每天的生活就像打仗一样，老是忙得忘了吃饭，有时紧张得睡不着。有一次他跟部门主管开会，因为讨论得太激烈，头突然痛得不得了，连站都站不起来，助理立刻送他到医院去。
lines.pinyin: Guòqù sānshí nián, Lín bóbo búdàn jīngcháng dào gè bùmén liǎojiě qíngkuàng, duì chǎnpǐn biāozhǔn de yāoqiú yě jiào gāo. Tā rènwéi zìjǐ shì gōngsī de zhǔjiǎo, yàoshì shǎo le tā, xiāoshòu chéngjī yídìng bù lǐxiǎng. Zài Jiāháo de jìyì zhōng, bóbo měitiān de shēnghuó jiù xiàng dǎzhàng yíyàng, lǎoshì máng de wàng le chīfàn, yǒushí jǐnzhāng de shuìbùzháo. Yǒu yí cì tā gēn bùmén zhǔguǎn kāihuì, yīnwèi tǎolùn de tài jīliè, tóu tūrán tòng de bùdéliǎo, lián zhàn dōu zhàn bù qǐlái, zhùlǐ lìkè sòng tā dào yīyuàn qù.
lines.english: Over past decades, Uncle Lin not only inspected departments regularly, but maintained demanding product standards. He viewed himself as the company protagonist, believing sales would suffer without him. In Jiahao's memory, his uncle lived every day like a battle, constantly too busy to eat, and sometimes too stressed to sleep. Once in an intense executive meeting, a violent headache incapacitated him so badly he couldn't stand, prompting his assistant to rush him to the hospital.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 醫生告訴林伯伯，想要早日恢復健康，除了調整生活作息，還要培養符合健康的飲食習慣。比如每天早睡早起、按時間吃飯、運動三十分鐘，避免吃太鹹、太油的食物。他也一再警告林伯伯，別拿生命開玩笑，假如不改變過去的生活方式，恐怕連上帝也救不了了。
lines.simplified: 医生告诉林伯伯，想要早日恢复健康，除了调整生活作息，还要培养符合健康的饮食习惯。比如每天早睡早起、按时间吃饭、运动三十分钟，避免吃太咸、太油的食物。他也一再警告林伯伯，别拿生命开玩笑，假如不改变过去的生活方式，恐怕连上帝也救不了了。
lines.pinyin: Yīshēng gàosù Lín bóbo, xiǎng yào zǎorì huīfù jiànkāng, chúle tiáozhěng shēnghuó zuòxī, hái yào péiyǎng fúhé jiànkāng de yǐnshí xíguàn. Bǐrú měitiān zǎoshuì zǎoqǐ, àn shíjiān chīfàn, yùndòng sānshí fēnzhōng, bìmiǎn chī tài xián, tài yóu de shíwù. Tā yě yízài jǐnggào Lín bóbo, bié ná shēngmìng kāiwánxiào, jiǎrú bù gǎibiàn guòqù de shēnghuó fāngshì, kǒngpà lián Shàngdì yě jiù bù liǎo le.
lines.english: The doctor advised Uncle Lin that regaining health required adjusting daily schedules and cultivating balanced diet habits: sleeping early and rising early, eating meals on time, exercising thirty minutes daily, and avoiding overly salty or greasy fare. He repeatedly warned Uncle Lin against gambling with life, saying that if past lifestyles persisted, even God couldn't save him.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 最初，林伯伯不太能適應這樣的改變，要是覺得食物的味道太淡，還是會加一些醬料；為了多運動，每天走路去上班，但經常走到一半就沒體力了，只好搭計程車。最後家人不得不一起來協助他，陪他吃飯、運動，甚至走路上下班。還好經過了一段時間，林伯伯終於恢復健康，不再教家人擔心了。
lines.simplified: 最初，林伯伯不太能适应这样的改变，要是觉得食物的味道太淡，还是会加一些酱料；为了多运动，每天走路去上班，但经常走到一半就没体力了，只好搭出租车。最后家人不得不一起来协助他，陪他吃饭、运动，甚至走路上下班。还好经过了一段时间，林伯伯终于恢复健康，不再教家人担心了。
lines.pinyin: Zuìchū, Lín bóbo bú tài néng shìyìng zhèyàng de gǎibiàn, yàoshì juéde shíwù de wèidào tài dàn, háishì huì jiā yìxiē jiàngliào; wèile duō yùndòng, měitiān zǒulù qù shàngbān, dàn jīngcháng zǒu dào yíbàn jiù méi tǐlì le, zhǐhǎo dā jìchéngchē. Zuìhòu jiārén bùdébù yìqǐ lái xiézhù tā, péi tā chīfàn, yùndòng, shènzhì zǒulù shàngxiàbān. Háihǎo jīngguò le yí duàn shíjiān, Lín bóbo zhōngyú huīfù jiànkāng, búzài jiāo jiārén dānxīn le.
lines.english: Initially, Uncle Lin struggled with the shift: when food tasted bland he still added sauces; to exercise he walked to work, but frequently ran out of steam halfway and hailed a taxi. Ultimately his family rallied to assist him, sharing meals, exercising, and even walking commutes together. Fortunately, after a while Uncle Lin recovered his health, bringing peace of mind back to his family.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 就在林伯伯為了健康而努力時，他的一位老朋友因為工作太累，僅僅五十歲就不幸去世了。這個壞消息給了林伯伯很大的刺激，讓他重新思考努力工作到底是為了什麼，真正的幸福又是什麼。或許，誰都找不到正確的答案，不過健康一定是最重要的。
lines.simplified: 就在林伯伯为了健康而努力时，他的一位老朋友因为工作太累，仅仅五十岁就不幸去世了。这个坏消息给了林伯伯很大的刺激，让他重新思考努力工作到底是为了什么，真正的幸福又是什么。或许，谁都找不到正确的答案，不过健康一定是最重要的。
lines.pinyin: Jiù zài Lín bóbo wèile jiànkāng ér nǔlì shí, tā de yí wèi lǎo péngyǒu yīnwèi gōngzuò tài lèi, jǐnjǐn wǔshí suì jiù búxìng qùshì le. Zhè ge huài xiāoxī gěi le Lín bóbo hěn dà de cìjī, ràng tā chóngxīn sīkǎo nǔlì gōngzuò dàodǐ shì wèile shénme, zhēnzhèng de xìngfú yòu shì shénme. Huòxǔ, shéi dōu zhǎobùdào zhèngquè de dá'àn, búguò jiànkāng yídìng shì zuì zhòngyào de.
lines.english: Just as Uncle Lin was striving for health, an old colleague passed away at merely fifty years old from work exhaustion. This somber news dealt him a profound shock, causing him to reevaluate what relentless work is ultimately for, and what true happiness really means. Perhaps nobody has definitive answers, but good health is certainly paramount.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Formulate hypothetical conditions ('if / suppose that') in formal and written contexts with 假如.
grammarPages.explanation: 「假如」跟「如果」、「要是」一樣，用來假設某個條件或情況，常和「就」搭配使用，表示在假設條件或情況下發生的結果。「如果」可用在主語前後，可用於書面、口語；「要是」也可用在主語前後，但僅用於口語；「假如」用在主語前，多用於書面。
grammarPages.pattern: 假如 + Condition, + (Subject) + 就 / 恐怕 + Result

questions.prompt: Hypothesize a boy's genuine affection:
questions.correctFeedback: 假如 introduces the hypothetical condition ('if he truly likes you').
questions.repairFeedback: Pattern: 假如 + Condition, + Consequence.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: As with 如果 and 要是, 假如 is used to assume a certain condition or situation. The following sentence is often used in conjunction with 就 to indicate the result of a hypothetical condition or situation. 如果 can be used before and after the subject, both written and spoken. 要是 can also be used before and after the subject, but only in spoken Chinese; 假如 is used before the subject in written Chinese.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Purpose and Action with 為了……而……
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Connect a goal (為了...) with the concrete exertion carried out to achieve it (而...).
grammarPages.explanation: 「為了」之後的短語說明要達到的目標，「而」後面的短語說明為了達到目標所做的事情。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 為了 + Goal + 而 + Action

dialogue.title: 網路交友要小心

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 最近新聞提到，有個博士透過社群網站，認識了一個女網友，給了她很多錢以後，才知道被騙了。
lines.simplified: 最近新闻提到，有个博士透过社群网站，认识了一个女网友，给了她很多钱以后，才知道被骗了。
lines.pinyin: Zuìjìn xīnwén tídào, yǒu ge bóshì tòuguò shèqún wǎngzhàn, rènshì le yí ge nǚ wǎngyǒu, gěi le tā hěn duō qián yǐhòu, cái zhīdào bèi piàn le.
lines.english: The news recently reported that a PhD holder met a female netizen via social media, gave her a lot of money, and only then realized he had been swindled.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 我看過那個新聞。那個騙子假裝是大學生，故意找很老實的男生聊天，表面上對他們很好，等對方相信她以後就騙他們說，媽媽病了，需要錢看醫生。對吧？
lines.simplified: 我看过那个新闻。那个骗子假装是大学生，故意找很老实的男生聊天，表面上对他们很好，等对方相信她以后就骗他们说，妈妈病了，需要钱看医生。对吧？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ kànguò nà ge xīnwén. Nà ge piànzi jiǎzhuāng shì dàxuéshēng, gùyì zhǎo hěn lǎoshí de nánshēng liáotiān, biǎomiàn shàng duì tāmen hěn hǎo, děng duìfāng xiāngxìn tā yǐhòu jiù piàn tāmen shuō, māma bìng le, xūyào qián kàn yīshēng. Duì ba?
lines.english: I saw that news. That scammer pretended to be a college student, deliberately chatted with honest men, acted very kindly on the surface, and once they trusted her, lied that her mother was sick and needed medical money. Right?

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 嗯。看到這類新聞，害我不敢上網交友了。你呢？你有這樣的經驗嗎？
lines.simplified: 嗯。看到这类新闻，害我不敢上网交友了。你呢？你有这样的经验吗？
lines.pinyin: Èn. Kàndào zhèlèi xīnwén, hài wǒ bù gǎn shàngwǎng jiāoyǒu le. Nǐ ne? Nǐ yǒu zhèyàng de jīngyàn ma?
lines.english: Yes. Seeing news like this makes me afraid to make online friends. What about you? Have you had any experience like that?

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 以前遇過一次。剛開始我和對方只聊了幾句，後來有幾次聊電影聊得很開心，就越來越熟了，也會互相問候家人。
lines.simplified: 以前遇过一次。刚开始我和对方只聊了几句，后来有几次聊电影聊得很开心，就越来越熟了，也会互相问候家人。
lines.pinyin: Yǐqián yùguò yí cì. Gāng kāishǐ wǒ hé duìfāng zhǐ liáo le jǐ jù, hòulái yǒu jǐ cì liáo diànyǐng liáo de hěn kāixīn, jiù yuèláiyuè shú le, yě huì hùxiāng wènhòu jiārén.
lines.english: I encountered it once before. Initially we only chatted a few lines, but later after talking happily about movies several times, we grew closer and began asking after each other's families.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 那時候你想進一步認識對方嗎？比如說跟對方見個面、吃個飯什麼的。
lines.simplified: 那时候你想进一步认识对方吗？比如说跟对方见个面、吃个饭什么的。
lines.pinyin: Nà shíhou nǐ xiǎng jìnyíbù rènshì duìfāng ma? Bǐrú shuō gēn duìfāng jiàn ge miàn, chī ge fàn shénme de.
lines.english: At that time did you want to get to know her further? For example, meeting in person, sharing a meal, or something like that?

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 我沒想過跟她約會。不過大概過了一個月，她突然跟我說，家人發生嚴重的車禍，住院的費用很高，想跟我借十萬塊。
lines.simplified: 我没想过跟她约会。不过大概过了一个月，她突然跟我说，家人发生严重的车祸，住院的费用很高，想跟我借十万块。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ méi xiǎngguò gēn tā yuēhuì. Búguò dàgài guò le yí ge yuè, tā tūrán gēn wǒ shuō, jiārén fāshēng yánzhòng de chēhuò, zhùyuàn de fèiyòng hěn gāo, xiǎng gēn wǒ jiè shí wàn kuài.
lines.english: I never considered dating her. However, after about a month, she suddenly told me her family was in a severe car accident with high hospitalization costs, and wanted to borrow 100,000 NTD.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 十萬塊？這麼多！你借她了嗎？
lines.simplified: 十万块？这么多！你借她了吗？
lines.pinyin: Shí wàn kuài? Zhème duō! Nǐ jiè tā le ma?
lines.english: 100,000 NTD? That's so much! Did you lend it to her?

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 當然沒。如果是兩萬塊以下，我可能願意借，十萬塊就太多了。再說，雖然對她不陌生，可是畢竟沒見過面，萬一借了以後才發現她說的都是假的，不但錢拿不回來，心也會很痛的。
lines.simplified: 当然没。如果是两万块以下，我可能愿意借，十万块就太多了。再说，虽然对她不陌生，可是毕竟没见过面，万一借了以后才发现她说的都是假的，不但钱拿不回来，心也会很痛的。
lines.pinyin: Dāngrán méi. Rúguǒ shì liǎng wàn kuài yǐxià, wǒ kěnéng yuànyì jiè, shí wàn kuài jiù tài duō le. Zàishuō, suīrán duì tā bù mòshēng, kěshì bìjìng méi jiànguò miàn, wànyī jiè le yǐhòu cái fāxiàn tā shuō de dōu shì jiǎ de, búdàn qián ná bù huílái, xīn yě huì hěn tòng de.
lines.english: Of course not. If it were under 20,000 NTD, I might have been willing, but 100,000 is too much. Besides, though she wasn't an unfamiliar stranger, we hadn't met after all; if I lent it and discovered it was all fake, not only would the money be gone, it would hurt deeply.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 是啊。有一些人在網路上填假資料，要是我們不小心，很可能就成了被騙的對象。不過，也許那個網友真的很可憐，需要你的幫助。
lines.simplified: 是啊。有一些人在网络上填假资料，要是我们不小心，很可能就成了被骗的对象。不过，也许那个网友真的很可怜，需要你的帮助。
lines.pinyin: Shì a. Yǒu yìxiē rén zài wǎnglù shàng tián jiǎ zīliào, yàoshì wǒmen bù xiǎoxīn, hěn kěnéng jiù chéng le bèi piàn de duìxiàng. Búguò, yěxǔ nà ge wǎngyǒu zhēnde hěn kělián, xūyào nǐ de bāngzhù.
lines.english: Indeed. Some people fill out fake profiles online; if we aren't careful, we could easily become scam targets. Still, perhaps that netizen really was pitiful and needed your help.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 我本來也很同情她，還問她媽媽得住院住多久。可是她一下子說半個月，一下子說一個月，故意不說清楚。後來，我發現她不誠實，就不再跟她聯絡了。
lines.simplified: 我本来也很同情她，还问她妈妈得住院住多久。可是她一下子说半个月，一下子说一个月，故意不说清楚。后来，我发现她不诚实，就不再跟她联络了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ běnlái yě hěn tóngqíng tā, hái wèn tā māma děi zhùyuàn zhù duō jiǔ. Kěshì tā yíxiàzi shuō bàn ge yuè, yíxiàzi shuō yí ge yuè, gùyì bù shuō qīngchǔ. Hòulái, wǒ fāxiàn tā bù chéngshí, jiù búzài gēn tā liánluò le.
lines.english: I was sympathetic at first, and asked how long her mother had to be hospitalized. But she said half a month one moment and a month the next, deliberately evading clarity. Later, finding her dishonest, I stopped contacting her.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 發現她不誠實？怎麼說呢？
lines.simplified: 发现她不诚实？怎么说呢？
lines.pinyin: Fāxiàn tā bù chéngshí? Zěnme shuō ne?
lines.english: Found her dishonest? How so?

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 那時有一個網友把自己網路交友上當的經驗，寫在部落格上。我看了以後，發現騙他的人和跟我借錢的網友是同一個人，她用同樣的方法騙了不少人。
lines.simplified: 那时有一个网友把自己网络交友上当的经验，写在部落格上。我看了以后，发现骗他的人和跟我借钱的网友是同一个人，她用同样的方法骗了不少人。
lines.pinyin: Nà shí yǒu yí ge wǎngyǒu bǎ zìjǐ wǎnglù jiāoyǒu shàngdàng de jīngyàn, xiě zài bùluògé shàng. Wǒ kàn le yǐhòu, fāxiàn piàn tā de rén hé gēn wǒ jiè qián de wǎngyǒu shì tóng yí ge rén, tā yòng tóngyàng de fāngfǎ piàn le bùshǎo rén.
lines.english: At that time a netizen posted his experience being scammed through online dating on a blog. After reading it, I realized his scammer and the netizen borrowing money from me were the same person—she had defrauded many people the same way.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 這種人實在太可惡了。不過那時候你差點兒被騙了，後來還敢上網交朋友嗎？
lines.simplified: 这种人实在太可恶了。不过那时候你差点儿被骗了，后来还敢上网交朋友吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng rén shízài tài kěwù le. Búguò nà shíhou nǐ chàdiǎnr bèi piàn le, hòulái hái gǎn shàngwǎng jiāo péngyǒu ma?
lines.english: That kind of person is truly despicable. But having nearly been scammed back then, did you dare make friends online afterward?

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 雖然我也看不起這種人，但網路交友的方式還是不錯的，而且網友也不都是壞人。
lines.simplified: 虽然我也看不起这种人，但网络交友的方式还是不错的，而且网友也不都是坏人。
lines.pinyin: Suīrán wǒ yě kànbùqǐ zhè zhǒng rén, dàn wǎnglù jiāoyǒu de fāngshì háishì búcuò de, érqiě wǎngyǒu yě bù dōu shì huàirén.
lines.english: Although I also look down on such people, making friends online is still a good avenue, and netizens aren't all bad.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 聽你這麼說，讓我回想起剛來臺灣的時候，透過社群網站，找到了會說日語的臺灣網友。他幫我找房子、認識環境，真的很感謝他。
lines.simplified: 听你这么说，让我回想起刚来台湾的时候，透过社群网站，找到了会说日语的台湾网友。他帮我找房子、认识环境，真的很感谢他。
lines.pinyin: Tīng nǐ zhème shuō, ràng wǒ huíxiǎng qǐ gāng lái Táiwān de shíhou, tòuguò shèqún wǎngzhàn, zhǎodào le huì shuō Rìyǔ de Táiwān wǎngyǒu. Tā bāng wǒ zhǎo fángzi, rènshì huánjìng, zhēnde hěn gǎnxiè tā.
lines.english: Hearing you say that reminds me of when I first arrived in Taiwan: via social networks I found a Taiwanese netizen who spoke Japanese. He helped me find housing and familiarize myself with surroundings; I'm genuinely grateful to him.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 嗯！透過網路可以擴大交友的範圍，所以別因為有人被騙了，就拒絕使用這種交友方式。況且在真實生活中，騙子也不少啊！
lines.simplified: 嗯！透过网络可以扩大交友的范围，所以别因为有人被骗了，就拒绝使用这种交友方式。况且在真实生活中，骗子也不少啊！
lines.pinyin: Èn! Tòuguò wǎnglù kěyǐ kuòdà jiāoyǒu de fànwéi, suǒyǐ bié yīnwèi yǒu rén bèi piàn le, jiù jùjué shǐyòng zhè zhǒng jiāoyǒu fāngshì. Kuàngqiě zài zhēnshí shēnghuó zhōng, piànzi yě bù shǎo a!
lines.english: Yes! Through the internet we can expand our social circle, so don't reject this channel just because someone was scammed. Besides, there are plenty of swindlers in real life too!

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 你說的對。網路交友還是可靠的，也能認識不少興趣相同的朋友。像你建立的健身社團網站，裡面有很多訊息，包括健身的影片、舉行活動的日期和地點等等，都很有用、很吸引人。
lines.simplified: 你说的对。网络交友还是可靠的，也能认识不少兴趣相同的朋友。像你建立的健身社团网站，里面有很多讯息，包括健身的影片、举行活动的日期和地点等等，都很有用、很吸引人。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de duì. Wǎnglù jiāoyǒu háishì kěkào de, yě néng rènshì bùshǎo xìngqù xiāngtóng de péngyǒu. Xiàng nǐ jiànlì de jiànshēn shètuán wǎngzhàn, lǐmiàn yǒu hěn duō xùnxí, bāokuò jiànshēn de yǐngpiàn, jǔxíng huódòng de rìqí hé dìdiǎn děngděng, dōu hěn yǒuyòng, hěn xīyǐn rén.
lines.english: You're right. Making friends online can still be reliable, helping us meet friends with shared interests. For instance, the fitness club site you built contains rich content—workout videos, event dates, locations—all very useful and engaging.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 既然妳覺得很吸引人，歡迎加入，免費喔！
lines.simplified: 既然你觉得很吸引人，欢迎加入，免费喔！
lines.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ juéde hěn xīyǐn rén, huānyíng jiārù, miǎnfèi o!
lines.english: Since you find it appealing, welcome aboard—it's free!

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Be Careful When Making Online Friends
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express achieving a goal or contacting others through a medium, person, or method with 透過.
grammarPages.explanation: 表示經過某人、事物或某種行為，達到某種目的或結果。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 透過 + Medium + Action

text.traditional: ……有個博士透過社群網站，認識了一個女網友……
text.simplified: ……有个博士透过社群网站，认识了一个女网友……
text.pinyin: …Yǒu ge bóshì tòuguò shèqún wǎngzhàn, rènshì le yí ge nǚ wǎngyǒu…

text.traditional: 人們習慣透過眼睛確認實際的情況，總是認為眼睛看到的就是對的。
text.simplified: 人们习惯透过眼睛确认实际的情况，总是认为眼睛看到的就是对的。
text.pinyin: Rénmen xíguàn tòuguò yǎnjing quèrèn shíjì de qíngkuàng, zǒngshì rènwéi yǎnjing kàndào de jiùshì duì de.
text.english: People are used to confirming actual situations through their eyes, always thinking that what the eyes see is right.

text.traditional: 康教授認為透過團體活動的方式，能讓學生學習到溝通的技巧。
text.simplified: 康教授认为透过团体活动的方式，能让学生学习到沟通的技巧。
text.pinyin: Kāng jiàoshòu rènwéi tòuguò tuántǐ huódòng de fāngshì, néng ràng xuésheng xuéxí dào gōutōng de jìqiǎo.
text.english: Professor Kang believes that through group activities, students can learn communication skills.

items.wrongSimplified: 我是经过学校介绍，认识了语言交换的朋友。

items.question: How do you advise conducting a teen leisure survey through teacher assistance?

items.wrongTraditional: 你可以通過老師的幫助，請學生填問卷。

right.simplified: 你可以透过老师的帮助，请学生填问卷。
right.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ tòuguò lǎoshī de bāngzhù, qǐng xuéshēng tián wènjuàn.
right.english: You can ask students to fill out questionnaires through teachers' help.

questions.prompt: Explain how you broadened your social circle:
questions.correctFeedback: 透過 marks the medium or channel through which an objective is achieved.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 透過 + Medium to express connecting via online channels.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 透過 represents a person, thing, or behavior by which a certain result is achieved.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Be Careful When Making Online Friends
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Above / Below with 以上 / 以下
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Specify quantities, age thresholds, or price boundaries with 以上 ('and above') and 以下 ('and below').
grammarPages.explanation: 「以上」表示「超過」或「高於」某一點，同時也包含「某一點」，例如：「六十分以上及格」包括「六十分」。「以下」表示「低於」或「未達到」某一點。「以」與方位詞一起使用時，例如：以內、以外、以北、以南等，表示在某個一定的範圍。
grammarPages.pattern: Number + 以上/以下 + Result

columns.meaning: I might be willing to lend

columns.traditional: 就可以免費把商品送到家
columns.simplified: 就可以免费把商品送到家
columns.pinyin: jiù kěyǐ miǎnfèi bǎ shāngpǐn sòngdào jiā

text.traditional: 如果是兩萬塊以下，我可能願意借，十萬塊就太多了。
text.simplified: 如果是两万块以下，我可能愿意借，十万块就太多了。
text.pinyin: Rúguǒ shì liǎng wàn kuài yǐxià, wǒ kěnéng yuànyì jiè, shí wàn kuài jiù tài duō le.
text.english: If it is under 20,000, I might be willing to lend it; 100,000 would be too much.

words.meaning: I might be willing to lend

text.traditional: 教授說成績八十分以上的學生才能得到獎學金，我剛好八十分，太好了。
text.simplified: 教授说成绩八十分以上的学生才能得到奖学金，我刚好八十分，太好了。
text.pinyin: Jiàoshòu shuō chéngjī bāshí fēn yǐshàng de xuésheng cái néng dédào jiǎngxuéjīn, wǒ gānghǎo bāshí fēn, tài hǎo le.
text.english: The professor said only students with grades of 80 or above can get the scholarship; I have exactly 80, so that is great.

text.traditional: 那家網路商店為了吸引客人，只要購物一千元以上，就可以免費把商品送到家。
text.simplified: 那家网络商店为了吸引客人，只要购物一千元以上，就可以免费把商品送到家。
text.pinyin: Nà jiā wǎnglù shāngdiàn wèile xīyǐn kèrén, zhǐyào gòuwù yìqiān yuán yǐshàng, jiù kěyǐ miǎnfèi bǎ shāngpǐn sòngdào jiā.

words.traditional: 就可以免費把商品送到家
words.simplified: 就可以免费把商品送到家

items.wrongSimplified: 六岁以内的儿童，可以免费搭乘捷运。

items.answer: 我想找每個月一萬五千元以下的套房。
items.wrongTraditional: 我想找每個月一萬五千元以內的套房。
items.wrongSimplified: 我想找每个月一万五千元以内的套房。

words.pinyin: měi ge yuè yí wàn wǔ yǐxià

questions.prompt: State promotional store discount terms:
questions.correctFeedback: 以上 specifies amounts at or surpassing the boundary value.
questions.repairFeedback: Pattern: Amount + 以上 (e.g. 三千元以上).

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 以上 means 超過(exceed) or 高於(be higher than) a certain point, and also includes 某一點(a certain point). For example, 六十分以上及格(grades above 60 points are considered passing) also includes 60 points. 以下 means 低於(below) or 未達到(not to have reached) a certain point. When 以 is used together with a position word, for example, 以內, 以外, 以北 or 以南, it means something within a certain range.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Be Careful When Making Online Friends
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Think Highly of / Look Down Upon (看得起 / 看不起)
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express respect or disdain toward someone with 看得起 ('respect/esteem') and 看不起 ('look down on').
grammarPages.explanation: 「看得起、看不起」表示對人的重視程度。「看得起」表示認為對方很重要；「看不起」有輕視對方的意思。第二冊第四課的語法「V 得起/V 不起」表示一個人的經濟能力能否負擔。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 看得起/看不起 + Person

text.traditional: 雖然我也看不起這種人，但網路交友的方式還是不錯的……
text.simplified: 虽然我也看不起这种人，但网络交友的方式还是不错的……
text.pinyin: Suīrán wǒ yě kànbuqǐ zhè zhǒng rén, dàn wǎnglù jiāoyǒu de fāngshì háishì búcuò de……
text.english: Although I also look down on this kind of person, making friends online is still pretty good……

words.traditional: 但網路交友的方式還是不錯的
words.simplified: 但网络交友的方式还是不错的

words.traditional: 因為我們每個人都是一樣的
words.simplified: 因为我们每个人都是一样的
words.pinyin: yīnwèi wǒmen měi ge rén dōu shì yíyàng de

words.traditional: 不能以地位、成就的高低來決定對人的態度
words.simplified: 不能以地位、成就的高低来决定对人的态度
words.pinyin: bù néng yǐ dìwèi chéngjiù de gāodī lái juédìng duì rén de tàidu
words.meaning: cannot decide one's attitude by status and achievement

text.traditional: 主管看得起你，才把管理工廠工人的工作交給你，你要把握這個機會好好地表現。
text.simplified: 主管看得起你，才把管理工厂工人的工作交给你，你要把握这个机会好好地表现。

questions.prompt: Praise people who work hard regardless of family background:
questions.correctFeedback: 看得起 means holding someone in high regard or respect.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 看得起 for respecting and esteeming someone.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 看得起, 看不起 indicates the level of respect shown to the other person. 看得起 means to consider the other party important; 看不起 means to look down on or to despise the other person. The grammar V 得起/V 不起, in the fourth lesson of Book 2, indicates whether a person can or can not afford something.

items.title: Grammar 4–6 · Online Socializing Pros and Cons

dialogue.title: 短文 · 網路交友的優缺點

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 自從無線網路出現的那天起，現代人的生活似乎就離不開網路了。網路科技的進步，不但改變了從前的生活方式，甚至連人與人之間的關係，也產生了極大的變化。住在不同地區的人，可以透過網路互相交流，這一點是我們祖父母那個年代的人很難想像的。
lines.simplified: 自从无线网络出现的那天起，现代人的生活似乎就离不开网络了。网络科技的进步，不但改变了从前的生活方式，甚至连人与人之间的关系，也产生了极大的变化。住在不同地区的人，可以透过网络互相交流，这一点是我们祖父母那个年代的人很难想像的。
lines.pinyin: Zìcóng wúxiàn wǎnglù chūxiàn de nà tiān qǐ, xiàndài rén de shēnghuó sìhū jiù líbùkāi wǎnglù le. Wǎnglù kējì de jìnbù, búdàn gǎibiàn le cóngqián de shēnghuó fāngshì, shènzhì lián rén yǔ rén zhījiān de guānxì, yě chǎnshēng le jídà de biànhuà. Zhù zài bùtóng dìqū de rén, kěyǐ tòuguò wǎnglù hùxiāng jiāoliú, zhè yì diǎn shì wǒmen zǔfùmǔ nà ge niándài de rén hěn nán xiǎngxiàng de.
lines.english: Ever since wireless internet emerged, modern life seems inseparable from the web. Technological advances not only altered former lifestyles, but profoundly transformed relationships between people. Individuals residing in diverse regions can connect online—something hard to fathom for our grandparents' generation.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 在網路出現以前，想要做報告，得去圖書館借一堆書；想要認識新朋友，就非和本人面對面接觸不可。但現代社會，只要有網路，就沒有時間和空間的限制，人人都可以隨時隨地傳訊息、查資料、認識世界各地的人。不但擴大了視野、增加了知識，甚至能和網友建立珍貴的友誼。但也因為這樣，越來越多人以網路傳訊息代替當面對話。時間久了，有些人反而失去了在真實生活中與人接觸的能力，這真是不可忽視的缺點。
lines.simplified: 在网络出现以前，想要做报告，得去图书馆借一堆书；想要认识新朋友，就非和本人面对面接触不可。但现代社会，只要有网络，就没有时间和空间的限制，人人都可以随时随地传讯息、查资料、认识世界各地的人。不但扩大了视野、增加了知识，甚至能和网友建立珍贵的友谊。但也因为这样，越来越多人以网络传讯息代替当面对话。时间久了，有些人反而失去了在真实生活中与人接触的能力，这真是不可忽视的缺点。
lines.pinyin: Zài wǎnglù chūxiàn yǐqián, xiǎng yào zuò bàogào, děi qù túshūguǎn jiè yì duī shū; xiǎng yào rènshì xīn péngyǒu, jiù fēi hé běnrén miànduìmiàn jiēchù bùkě. Dàn xiàndài shèhuì, zhǐyào yǒu wǎnglù, jiù méiyǒu shíjiān hé kōngjiān de xiànzhì, rénrén dōu kěyǐ suíshí suídì chuán xùnxí, chá zīliào, rènshì shìjiè gèdì de rén. Búdàn kuòdà le shìyě, zēngjiā le zhīshì, shènzhì néng hé wǎngyǒu jiànlì zhēnguì de yǒuyì. Dàn yě yīnwèi zhèyàng, yuèláiyuè duō rén yǐ wǎnglù chuán xùnxí dàitì dāngmiàn duìhuà. Shíjiān jiǔ le, yǒuxiē rén fǎn'ér shīqù le zài zhēnshí shēnghuó zhōng yǔ rén jiēchù de nénglì, zhè zhēn shì bù kě hūshì de quēdiǎn.
lines.english: Before the internet, preparing reports meant borrowing piles of library books; meeting new people required face-to-face encounters. Today, with connectivity free from temporal and geographic boundaries, anyone can message, look up info, and meet people worldwide anytime, expanding horizons, building knowledge, and forging valuable friendships. Yet precisely because of this, more people substitute texting for in-person conversations. Over time, some lose real-world interpersonal competence—a significant drawback.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 再說，網路雖然為現代人帶來了不少好處，但也有壞處。比如有些人在網路上說的話不一定是真的。某人已經五十歲了，在網路上卻說自己才二十歲，甚至拿別人的照片當作自己的大頭照。更嚴重的是，有些騙子利用別人的同情心騙錢，那些騙子不僅可惡，還對不起社會。
lines.simplified: 再说，网络虽然为现代人带来了不少好处，但也有坏处。比如有些人在网络上说的话不一定是真的。某人已经五十岁了，在网络上却说自己才二十岁，甚至拿别人的照片当作自己的大头照。更严重的是，有些骗子利用别人的同情心骗钱，那些骗子不仅可恶，还对不起社会。
lines.pinyin: Zàishuō, wǎnglù suīrán wèi xiàndài rén dàilái le bùshǎo hǎochù, dàn yě yǒu huàichù. Bǐrú yǒuxiē rén zài wǎnglù shàng shuō de huà bù yídìng shì zhēn de. Mǒu rén yǐjīng wǔshí suì le, zài wǎnglù shàng què shuō zìjǐ cái èrshí suì, shènzhì ná biérén de zhàopiàn dāngzuò zìjǐ de dàtóuzhào. Gèng yánzhòng de shì, yǒuxiē piànzi lìyòng biérén de tóngqíngxīn piàn qián, nàxiē piànzi bùjǐn kěwù, hái duìbùqǐ shèhuì.
lines.english: Furthermore, while the internet delivers immense convenience, it also brings harms. Online claims may not be truthful: someone already fifty may claim to be twenty, even stealing others' photos for their avatar. More gravely, fraudsters exploit empathy to extort money—scammers who are not only loathsome but fail society.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 網路只是提供一種更便利的交友方式給大家，至於要不要以網路交友，或是能不能找到合適的對象，就得看個人的智慧了。畢竟真實生活中的朋友，無論如何都比虛擬世界的網友重要，沒有人可以取代。
lines.simplified: 网络只是提供一种更便利的交友方式给大家，至于要不要以网络交友，或是能不能找到合适的对象，就得看个人的智慧了。毕竟真实生活中的朋友，无论如何都比虚拟世界的网友重要，没有人可以取代。
lines.pinyin: Wǎnglù zhǐshì tígōng yì zhǒng gèng biànlì de jiāoyǒu fāngshì gěi dàjiā, zhìyú yào bú yào yǐ wǎnglù jiāoyǒu, huòshì néng bù néng zhǎodào héshì de duìxiàng, jiù děi kàn gèrén de zhìhuì le. Bìjìng zhēnshí shēnghuó zhōng de péngyǒu, wúlùn rúhé dōu bǐ xūnǐ shìjiè de wǎngyǒu zhòngyào, méiyǒu rén kěyǐ qǔdài.
lines.english: The internet merely offers a more convenient social conduit; as for whether to seek online friendships or successfully find suitable matches, that depends on personal discernment. After all, real-life companions remain incomparably more vital than virtual contacts and cannot be replaced.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 卻 is an adverb, indicating things contrary to fact or expectation. It is often placed after the subject of the sentence or in front of the verb to indicate a transition. For example, 他跟我約好在學校見面，等了半天，他卻沒來。

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Be Careful When Making Online Friends
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Live Up to / Let Down with 對得起 / 對不起
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express living up to expectations (對得起) or feeling guilty for letting someone down (對不起).
grammarPages.explanation: 「對得起」表示沒做不好或不應該的事，沒讓對方失望、生氣、丟臉。「對不起」的意思跟「對得起」相反。「對得起/對不起」後面可接事情的對象，例如：對得起老闆、對得起自己、對不起朋友、對不起社會。

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 對得起 means not doing something that should not be done; not letting the other party down, be angry, or embarrassed. On the contrary, 對不起 means being embarrassed or sorry for disappointing the other person. 對得起/對不起 can be followed by the object. For example, 對得起老闆, 對得起自己, 對不起朋友, 對不起社會.

lines.speaker: 林家豪
lines.traditional: 您好，王經理，我是林家豪。這是我的工作經驗相關資料，請您參考。
lines.simplified: 您好，王经理，我是林家豪。这是我的工作经验相关资料，请您参考。
lines.pinyin: Nínhǎo, Wáng jīnglǐ, wǒ shì Lín Jiāháo. Zhè shì wǒ de gōngzuò jīngyàn xiāngguān zīliào, qǐng nín cānkǎo.
lines.english: Hello, Manager Wang, I am Lin Jiahao. This is the information related to my work experience for your reference.

lines.speaker: 王經理
lines.traditional: 這次我們要找的是銷售人員，你在這方面有經驗嗎？
lines.simplified: 这次我们要找的是销售人员，你在这方面有经验吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhè cì wǒmen yào zhǎo de shì xiāoshòu rényuán, nǐ zài zhè fāngmiàn yǒu jīngyàn ma?
lines.english: We are looking for sales personnel this time. Do you have experience in this field?

lines.speaker: 林家豪
lines.traditional: 念大學時，我在電腦公司打過工。向客人介紹商品功能、使用方法、和其他牌子的差異，最重要的是想辦法把商品賣出去。
lines.simplified: 念大学时，我在电脑公司打过工。向客人介绍商品功能、使用方法、和其他牌子的差异，最重要的是想办法把商品卖出去。
lines.pinyin: Niàn dàxué shí, wǒ zài diànnǎo gōngsī dǎguo gōng. Xiàng kèrén jièshào shāngpǐn gōngnéng, shǐyòng fāngfǎ, hé qítā páizi de chāyì, zuì zhòngyào de shì xiǎng bànfǎ bǎ shāngpǐn mài chūqù.
lines.english: In university, I worked part-time at a computer company, introducing product features, instructions, and differences from other brands to customers. The most important thing was finding ways to sell products.

lines.speaker: 王經理
lines.traditional: 不過推銷時，多多少少都會碰到喜歡隨便批評，甚至對你亂發脾氣的客人，你會怎麼處理呢？
lines.simplified: 不过推销时，多多少少都会碰到喜欢随便批评，甚至对你乱发脾气的客人，你会怎么处理呢？
lines.pinyin: Búguò tuīxiāo shí, duōduōshǎoshǎo dōu huì pèngdào xǐhuan suíbiàn pīpíng, shènzhì duì nǐ luàn fā píqì de kèrén, nǐ huì zěnme chǔlǐ ne?
lines.english: However, when selling, you will more or less encounter customers who criticize casually or even lose their tempers at you. How would you handle that?

lines.speaker: 林家豪
lines.traditional: 我會先了解問題是什麼，然後耐心地跟他說明，想辦法讓他理解。我想只要態度親切、謙虛，客人就會接受的。萬一他還是不滿意，我就說笑話逗他開心，或是送他小禮物什麼的。
lines.simplified: 我会先了解问题是什么，然后耐心地跟他说明，想办法让他理解。我想只要态度亲切、谦虚，客人就会接受的。万一他还是不满意，我就说笑话逗他开心，或是送他小礼物什么的。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ huì xiān liǎojiě wèntí shì shénme, ránhòu nàixīn de gēn tā shuōmíng, xiǎng bànfǎ ràng tā lǐjiě. Wǒ xiǎng zhǐyào tàidù qīnqiè, qiānxū, kèrén jiù huì jiēshòu de. Wànyī tā háishì bù mǎnyì, wǒ jiù shuō xiàohuà dòu tā kāixīn, huòshì sòng tā xiǎo lǐwù shénme de.
lines.english: I would first find out what the problem is, then patiently explain and help them understand. As long as one is warm and humble, customers will accept it. If they are still dissatisfied, I tease them with jokes to cheer them up, or give a small gift.

lines.speaker: 王經理
lines.traditional: 你的推銷觀念很正確。透過良好的溝通，往往能解決不必要的麻煩。在職場上，你碰過什麼大問題嗎？
lines.simplified: 你的推销观念很正确。透过良好的沟通，往往能解决不必要的麻烦。在职场上，你碰过什么大问题吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ de tuīxiāo guānniàn hěn zhèngquè. Tòuguò liánghǎo de gōutōng, wǎngwǎng néng jiějué bú bìyào de máfan. Zài zhíchǎng shàng, nǐ pèngguo shénme dà wèntí ma?
lines.english: Your sales philosophy is sound. Through good communication, unnecessary troubles can often be resolved. In the workplace, have you encountered any major problems?

lines.speaker: 林家豪
lines.traditional: 沒有。不過有一次，公司舉辦電腦遊戲比賽，經理叫我們早上七點先去布置會場，因為鬧鐘壞了，我睡到八點才醒來。等我趕到時，小組的同事早就把任務完成了。雖然大家沒怪我，但我卻不能原諒自己，從那次之後，我就非常注意時間，絕對不再遲到了。
lines.simplified: 没有。不过有一次，公司举办电脑游戏比赛，经理叫我们早上七点先去布置会场，因为闹钟坏了，我睡到八点才醒来。等我赶到时，小组的同事早就把任务完成了。虽然大家没怪我，但我却不能原谅自己，从那次之后，我就非常注意时间，绝对不再迟到了。
lines.pinyin: Méiyǒu. Búguò yǒu yí cì, gōngsī jǔbàn diànnǎo yóuxì bǐsài, jīnglǐ jiào wǒmen zǎoshang qī diǎn xiān qù bùzhì huìchǎng, yīnwèi nàozhōng huài le, wǒ shuì dào bā diǎn cái xǐnglái. Děng wǒ gǎndào shí, xiǎozǔ de tóngshì zǎojiù bǎ rènwù wánchéng le. Suīrán dàjiā méi guài wǒ, dàn wǒ què bù néng yuánliàng zìjǐ, cóng nà cì zhīhòu, wǒ jiù fēicháng zhùyì shíjiān, juéduì bú zài chídào le.
lines.english: No. But once, the company held a computer gaming contest, and the manager asked us to set up at seven in the morning. My alarm broke and I slept until eight. By the time I arrived, my teammates had already finished. Though no one blamed me, I couldn't forgive myself, and since then I've been extremely punctual and never late.

lines.speaker: 王經理
lines.traditional: 其實，不論在哪裡工作，準時是最基本的要求。對了，假如主管忙不過來，你願意配合加班嗎？
lines.simplified: 其实，不论在哪里工作，准时是最基本的要求。对了，假如主管忙不过来，你愿意配合加班吗？
lines.pinyin: Qíshí, búlùn zài nǎlǐ gōngzuò, zhǔnshí shì zuì jīběn de yāoqiú. Duì le, jiǎrú zhǔguǎn mángbuguòlái, nǐ yuànyì pèihé jiābān ma?
lines.english: In fact, no matter where one works, punctuality is the most fundamental requirement. By the way, if the supervisor is too busy to manage, are you willing to cooperate with overtime?

lines.speaker: 林家豪
lines.traditional: 沒問題。平日或假日，我都能配合。
lines.simplified: 没问题。平日或假日，我都能配合。
lines.pinyin: Méi wèntí. Píngrì huò jiàrì, wǒ dōu néng pèihé.
lines.english: No problem. Weekdays or holidays, I can accommodate.

lines.speaker: 王經理
lines.traditional: 除了準時，請你再說說自己其他的優點。
lines.simplified: 除了准时，请你再说说自己其他的优点。
lines.pinyin: Chúle zhǔnshí, qǐng nǐ zài shuōshuō zìjǐ qítā de yōudiǎn.
lines.english: Besides punctuality, please tell me about your other strengths.

lines.speaker: 林家豪
lines.traditional: 我個性開朗、說話幽默、做事細心、溝通能力強，是個容易相處的人。
lines.simplified: 我个性开朗、说话幽默、做事细心、沟通能力强，是个容易相处的人。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ gèxìng kāilǎng, shuōhuà yōumò, zuòshì xìxīn, gōutōng nénglì qiáng, shì ge róngyì xiāngchǔ de rén.
lines.english: I have an outgoing personality, a humorous way of speaking, pay attention to detail, communicate strongly, and am easy to get along with.

lines.speaker: 王經理
lines.traditional: 聽起來你挺優秀的。對這份工作你還有什麼要了解的？
lines.simplified: 听起来你挺优秀的。对这份工作你还有什么要了解的？
lines.pinyin: Tīng qǐlái nǐ tǐng yōuxiù de. Duì zhè fèn gōngzuò nǐ hái yǒu shénme yào liǎojiě de?
lines.english: You sound quite outstanding. Is there anything else you would like to know about this job?

lines.speaker: 林家豪
lines.traditional: 請問薪水怎麼算？有哪些福利？
lines.simplified: 请问薪水怎么算？有哪些福利？
lines.pinyin: Qǐngwèn xīnshuǐ zěnme suàn? Yǒu nǎxiē fúlì?
lines.english: May I ask how salary is calculated? What benefits are provided?

lines.speaker: 王經理
lines.traditional: 有關這方面的問題，會有相關人員來跟你詳細說明。
lines.simplified: 有关这方面的问题，会有相关人员来跟你详细说明。
lines.pinyin: Yǒuguān zhè fāngmiàn de wèntí, huì yǒu xiāngguān rényuán lái gēn nǐ xiángxì shuōmíng.
lines.english: Regarding questions in this area, relevant personnel will come explain them to you in detail.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 這就 right before a verb to express that you are carrying out an action right at this very moment.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 這就 + Verb / VP

columns.meaning: go to the door to welcome him

text.traditional: 請坐一下，我這就通知經理。
text.simplified: 请坐一下，我这就通知经理。
text.pinyin: qǐng zuò yíxià， wǒ zhè jiù tōngzhī jīnglǐ。
text.english: Please have a seat; I will notify the manager right away.

text.traditional: A：服務生，我點的是熱紅茶，不是冰咖啡。B：對不起，我這就幫您換。
text.simplified: A：服务生，我点的是热红茶，不是冰咖啡。B：对不起，我这就帮您换。
text.pinyin: A: fúwùshēng， wǒ diǎn de shì rè hóngchá， bú shì bīng kāfēi。 B: duìbuqǐ， wǒ zhè jiù bāng nín huàn。
text.english: A: Waiter, I ordered hot black tea, not iced coffee. B: Sorry, I will change it for you right away.

text.traditional: A：經理，孔老闆快到公司了。B：好，我這就到門口去歡迎他。
text.simplified: A：经理，孔老板快到公司了。B：好，我这就到门口去欢迎他。
text.pinyin: A: jīnglǐ， Kǒng lǎobǎn kuài dào gōngsī le。 B: hǎo， wǒ zhè jiù dào ménkǒu qù huānyíng tā。
text.english: A: Manager, Mr. Kong is almost at the company. B: Okay, I will go to the entrance right away to welcome him.

items.question: When should you use 這就 instead of a generic time adverb like 馬上?
items.answer: 這就 specifically indicates an immediate response or action undertaken on the spot by the speaker, right at this very second.
items.wrongTraditional: 我明天這就通知經理。
items.wrongSimplified: 我明天这就通知经理。

right.traditional: 請坐一下，我這就通知經理。
right.simplified: 请坐一下，我这就通知经理。
right.pinyin: Qǐng zuò yíxià, wǒ zhè jiù tōngzhī jīnglǐ.
right.english: Please sit down, I will notify the manager right away.

items.question: Can 這就 be replaced by a simple 就 in immediate responsive declarations?
items.answer: 雖然「就」也能表示馬上，但「這就」強化了「現在這一刻立即採取行動」的現場口語語氣。
items.wrongTraditional: 孔老闆到了，我快快就去門口。
items.wrongSimplified: 孔老板到了，我快快就去门口。

right.traditional: 好，我這就到門口去歡迎他。
right.simplified: 好，我这就到门口去欢迎他。
right.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ zhè jiù dào ménkǒu qù huānyíng tā.
right.english: Okay, I will head right to the entrance to welcome him.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：

segments.text: A: 請問關老師在嗎？我的孩子想當面向他說聲謝謝。 B: 他在，我
去叫他。

questions.correctFeedback: 太棒了！「這就＋動詞」表示說話者現在馬上採取行動。
questions.repairFeedback: 請確認語境：對方在現場詢問，回答者表示「現在立刻去叫他」，應使用「這就」。

grammarPages.explanation: 「這」是「現在」的意思，「就」表示馬上，「這就」的後面接動詞或動詞短語，用來表示現在馬上做某事。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 這 means 現在, 就 means immediately. 這就 is followed by a verb or verb phrase to indicate that something is being done right now.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Specifying Scope or Domain: 在……方面
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Frame a specific domain or angle of discussion using 在……方面.
grammarPages.pattern: 在 + Domain / Activity + 方面, + Predicate

text.traditional: 這次我們要找的是銷售人員，你在這方面有經驗嗎？
text.simplified: 这次我们要找的是销售人员，你在这方面有经验吗？
text.pinyin: zhè cì wǒmen yào zhǎo de shì xiāoshòu rényuán， nǐ zài zhè fāngmiàn yǒu jīngyàn ma？
text.english: We are looking for salespeople this time. Do you have experience in this area?

text.traditional: 在穿著方面，白小姐很有品味，身上穿的或手上戴的也都有個人的風格。
text.simplified: 在穿着方面，白小姐很有品味，身上穿的或手上戴的也都有个人的风格。
text.pinyin: zài chuānzhuó fāngmiàn， Bái xiǎojiě hěn yǒu pǐnwèi， shēnshang chuān de huò shǒushang dài de yě dōu yǒu gèrén de fēnggé。
text.english: In terms of clothing, Miss Bai has good taste; what she wears and what she puts on her hands also all have a personal style.

words.meaning: what is worn on the hands

text.traditional: 小藍從小在網球方面就表現得非常好，長大之後一定能代表國家參加比賽。
text.simplified: 小蓝从小在网球方面就表现得非常好，长大之后一定能代表国家参加比赛。
text.pinyin: Xiǎo Lán cóngxiǎo zài wǎngqiú fāngmiàn jiù biǎoxiàn de fēicháng hǎo， zhǎngdà zhīhòu yídìng néng dàibiǎo guójiā cānjiā bǐsài。
text.english: Xiao Lan has performed very well in tennis since childhood, and after growing up he will surely be able to represent the country in competitions.

items.question: How is 在……方面 different from 對……來說?
items.answer: 「在……方面」界定討論的領域、專業或範圍；「對……來說」則界定評估的角度或主體視角。
items.wrongTraditional: 對穿著方面，白小姐很有品味。
items.wrongSimplified: 对穿着方面，白小姐很有品味。

right.traditional: 在穿著方面，白小姐很有品味。
right.simplified: 在穿着方面，白小姐很有品味。
right.pinyin: Zài chuānzhuó fāngmiàn, Bái xiǎojiě hěn yǒu pǐnwèi.
right.english: In terms of attire, Miss Bai has great taste.

items.question: Can 方面 be omitted when defining a domain?
items.answer: 「在」與「方面」搭配成框架標記範疇，若缺少「方面」，句子往往失去界定領域的完整結構。
items.wrongTraditional: 你在這有經驗嗎？
items.wrongSimplified: 你在这有经验吗？

right.traditional: 你在這方面有經驗嗎？
right.simplified: 你在这方面有经验吗？
right.pinyin: Nǐ zài zhè fāngmiàn yǒu jīngyàn ma?
right.english: Do you have experience in this field?

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：

segments.text: 我從來沒辦過戶外演唱會，在辦活動
，老李的經驗很豐富，我恐怕幫不了你。

questions.correctFeedback: 正確！「在＋範圍＋方面」用來說明在某個領域或情形下的狀況。
questions.repairFeedback: 請注意框架搭配：「在辦活動……」接「方面」，用以界定特定範疇。

grammarPages.explanation: 用來說明在某個範圍或某個情況下的情形。「在」和「方面」中間是該範圍或情況，後面的句子表示產生什麼樣的情形或進一步的說明。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: It is used to describe a certain situation. The range or scope of the situation is placed between 在 and 方面, and the following sentence indicates the situation or further explanation.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: General Tendencies and Regularities: 往往
grammarPages.learnerPromise: State recurring general patterns and empirical regularities using 往往.
grammarPages.pattern: Condition, + Subject + 往往 + Regularity

columns.pinyin: néng jiějué bú bìyào de máfan

columns.meaning: whether to go to cram school

columns.pinyin: bú shì háizi nénggòu juédìng de
columns.meaning: not for the child to decide

text.traditional: 透過良好的溝通，往往能解決不必要的麻煩。
text.simplified: 透过良好的沟通，往往能解决不必要的麻烦。
text.pinyin: tòuguò liánghǎo de gōutōng， wǎngwǎng néng jiějué bú bìyào de máfan。
text.english: Through good communication, unnecessary trouble can often be resolved.

text.traditional: 許多家長都會逼孩子念書，要不要去補習往往不是孩子能夠決定的。
text.simplified: 许多家长都会逼孩子念书，要不要去补习往往不是孩子能够决定的。
text.pinyin: xǔduō jiāzhǎng dōu huì bī háizi niànshū， yào bu yào qù bǔxí wǎngwǎng bú shì háizi nénggòu juédìng de。
text.english: Many parents force their children to study; whether to go to cram school is often not for the child to decide.

words.meaning: whether to go to cram school

text.traditional: 一般來說，夢想與真實生活往往有一段距離，不可能每次都夢想成真。
text.simplified: 一般来说，梦想与真实生活往往有一段距离，不可能每次都梦想成真。
text.pinyin: yìbān láishuō， mèngxiǎng yǔ zhēnshí shēnghuó wǎngwǎng yǒu yí duàn jùlí， bù kěnéng měi cì dōu mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn。
text.english: Generally speaking, dreams and real life are often a distance apart; it is impossible for every dream to come true.

items.question: How does 往往 differ from 常常?
items.answer: 「往往」表示在一定條件下經常出現的規律或客觀事實，不能用於個人主觀意願或未發生的事，且不能被否定（不能說「不往往」）；「常常」純粹表示頻率高，可用於個人習慣與意願。
items.wrongTraditional: 我希望下個月往往去慢跑。
items.wrongSimplified: 我希望下个月往往去慢跑。

right.traditional: 只要天氣好，他往往起床後就去慢跑。
right.simplified: 只要天气好，他往往起床后就去慢跑。
right.pinyin: Zhǐyào tiānqì hǎo, tā wǎngwǎng qǐchuáng hòu jiù qù mànpǎo.
right.english: As long as the weather is fine, he tends to go jogging after getting up.

items.question: Can 往往 appear with negative markers like 不 before it?
items.answer: 不行。「往往」前面不能加否定詞，否定詞必須放在「往往」之後（例如：往往不是、往往沒有）。
items.wrongTraditional: 他不往往週末去打球。
items.wrongSimplified: 他不往往周末去打球。

right.traditional: 要不要補習往往不是孩子能決定的。
right.simplified: 要不要补习往往不是孩子能决定的。
right.pinyin: Yào bú yào bǔxí wǎngwǎng bú shì háizi néng juédìng de.
right.english: Whether to attend cram school is often not something children can decide.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：

segments.text: 照我過去的習慣，為了讓資料正確，我
會請其他人再檢查一次。

questions.correctFeedback: 沒錯！「往往」表示在特定條件或規律下經常出現的常態情況。
questions.repairFeedback: 請注意句意：根據過去的習慣和規律，常態性地請人檢查，應用「往往」。

grammarPages.explanation:
「往往」和「常常」都表示某種情況多次出現，但「往往」的用法限制較多：
(1) 表示在一定的條件下，從過去到現在經常發生的經驗或情況，不能用在未發生的事情，而且有一定的規律。例如：過去十年，每到週末，只要天氣好，歐先生往往起床後就去慢跑。
(2)「往往」用於一般的看法或事實，不能用在個人主觀的意願，例如：家庭教育非常重要，因為孩子做人做事的態度往往是被父母影響的。
(3)「往往」不能單用「往」一個字，而且前面不能加否定詞。例如不能說：*湯先生不往往週末去打球。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish:
Both 往往 and 常常 often mean that a certain situation occurs multiple times, but the usage of 往往 is more restrictive:
(1) 往往 and 常常 mean that under certain conditions, the experience or situation has frequently occurred from the past to the present, and cannot be used for things that have not happened. 往往 and 常常 always follow a certain pattern. For example, 過去十年，每到週末，只要天氣好，歐先生往往起床後就去慢跑。
(2) 往往 is used for general opinions or facts, and cannot be used for personal subjective wishes. For example, 家庭教育非常重要，因為孩子做人做事的態度往往是被父母影響的。
(3) 往往 cannot be used with one character 往 alone, and no negative word can be added before it. For example, it is not correct to say: *湯先生不往往週末去打球。

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Introduce the topic or matter under discussion at the sentence opening with 有關.
grammarPages.pattern: 有關 + Topic, + Predicate / Explanation

columns.traditional: 會有相關人員來跟你詳細說明
columns.simplified: 会有相关人员来跟你详细说明
columns.pinyin: huì yǒu xiāngguān rényuán lái gēn nǐ xiángxì shuōmíng
columns.meaning: relevant staff will explain to you in detail
