columns.meaning: you had better consult a lawyer

text.traditional: 有關這方面的問題，會有相關人員來跟你詳細說明。
text.simplified: 有关这方面的问题，会有相关人员来跟你详细说明。
text.pinyin: yǒuguān zhè fāngmiàn de wèntí， huì yǒu xiāngguān rényuán lái gēn nǐ xiángxì shuōmíng。
text.english: Regarding this issue, relevant staff will come and explain it to you in detail.

text.traditional: 有關那個明星吸毒的新聞，還要經過詳細地調查，才能確定是真是假。
text.simplified: 有关那个明星吸毒的新闻，还要经过详细地调查，才能确定是真是假。
text.pinyin: yǒuguān nàge míngxīng xīdú de xīnwén， hái yào jīngguò xiángxì de diàochá， cái néng quèdìng shì zhēn shì jiǎ。
text.english: Regarding that celebrity drug-use news, it still needs a detailed investigation before its truth can be confirmed.

text.traditional: 有關法律方面的問題，你最好請教專業律師，不要隨便相信網路上的說法。
text.simplified: 有关法律方面的问题，你最好请教专业律师，不要随便相信网络上的说法。
text.pinyin: yǒuguān fǎlǜ fāngmiàn de wèntí， nǐ zuìhǎo qǐngjiào zhuānyè lǜshī， búyào suíbiàn xiāngxìn wǎnglù shàng de shuōfǎ。
text.english: For legal questions, you had better consult a professional lawyer rather than casually believing claims online.

items.question: How is 有關 used compared with 對於?
items.answer: 「有關」置於句首引出討論的題材或對象，指「涉及……」；「對於」則引出對象以表達對該對象的態度或看法。
items.wrongTraditional: 在於這方面的問題，會有專人說明。
items.wrongSimplified: 在于这方面的问题，会有专人说明。

right.traditional: 有關這方面的問題，會有相關人員說明。
right.simplified: 有关这方面的问题，会有相关人员说明。
right.pinyin: Yǒuguān zhè fāngmiàn de wèntí, huì yǒu xiāngguān rényuán shuōmíng.
right.english: Regarding questions in this area, relevant personnel will explain.

items.question: Can 有關 directly modify a noun or introduce a prepositional topic?
items.answer: 「有關」常置於句首作介詞引導話題（有關……），亦可作為修飾語（跟……有關的資料）。
items.wrongTraditional: 朝向這方面的問題，請看網站。
items.wrongSimplified: 朝向这方面的问题，请看网站。

right.traditional: 有關這類的活動，你看旅遊中心網站就知道了。
right.simplified: 有关这类的活动，你看旅游中心网站就知道了。
right.pinyin: Yǒuguān zhè lèi de huódòng, nǐ kàn lǚyóu zhōngxīn wǎngzhàn jiù zhīdào le.
right.english: Regarding this type of activity, check the travel center website and you will know.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：

segments.text: 我剛到臺灣，不知道有什麼適合外國人的活動。
這類的活動，你看旅遊中心的網站就知道了。

questions.correctFeedback: 答對了！「有關」常放在句首，用來引出特定事物或情況進行進一步說明。
questions.repairFeedback: 請注意語意：句首引出「這類活動」的話題，接續提供說明建議，應使用「有關」。

grammarPages.explanation: 「有關」常放在句首，連接事物或情況，後面的句子表示進一步地說明或建議。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 有關 is often placed at the beginning of a sentence to connect things or situations, and the following sentence indicates further explanation or suggestion.

dialogue.title: 短文 · 我的面試經驗

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 一般來說，現代人找工作得經過面試。面試時表現得好，被錄取的機會就比較大。今天，我就來跟各位說說我最近面試的經驗和感想。
lines.simplified: 一般来说，现代人找工作得经过面试。面试时表现得好，被录取的机会就比较大。今天，我就来跟各位说说我最近面试的经验和感想。
lines.pinyin: Yìbān lái shuō, xiàndài rén zhǎo gōngzuò děi jīngguò miànshì. Miànshì shí biǎoxiàn de hǎo, bèi lùqǔ de jīhuì jiù bǐjiào dà. Jīntiān, wǒ jiù lái gēn gèwèi shuōshuo wǒ zuìjìn miànshì de jīngyàn hé gǎnxiǎng.
lines.english: Generally speaking, modern people must go through interviews to find jobs. Performing well in an interview brings greater chances of being hired. Today, let me share my recent interview experience and thoughts with everyone.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 上個月，我在網站上，看到某家企業有銷售人員的需求，就立刻把個人資料寄過去。資料中除了說明我過去的工作經驗，也包含我對工作的看法和態度。兩個星期之後，我收到了面試通知。儘管我不是第一次參加面試，但還是擔心表現不佳，所以面試當天很早就醒來，出門前還一再確認穿著是不是整齊、資料是不是都放進了背包。我想，這樣又緊張又興奮的心情，往往是面試時經常有的表現。
lines.simplified: 上个月，我在网站上，看到某家企业有销售人员的需求，就立刻把个人资料寄过去。资料中除了说明我过去的工作经验，也包含我对工作的看法和态度。两个星期之后，我收到了面试通知。尽管我不是第一次参加面试，但还是担心表现不佳，所以面试当天很早就醒来，出门前还一再确认穿着是不是整齐、资料是不是都放进了背包。我想，这样又紧张又兴奋的心情，往往是面试时经常有的表现。
lines.pinyin: Shàng gè yuè, wǒ zài wǎngzhàn shàng, kàndào mǒu jiā qǐyè yǒu xiāoshòu rényuán de xūqiú, jiù lìkè bǎ gèrén zīliào jì guòqù. Zīliào zhōng chúle shuōmíng wǒ guòqù de gōngzuò jīngyàn, yě bāohán wǒ duì gōngzuò de kànfǎ hé tàidù. Liǎng gè xīngqī zhīhòu, wǒ shōudào le miànshì tōngzhī. Jǐnguǎn wǒ bú shì dì-yī cì cānjiā miànshì, dàn háishì dānxīn biǎoxiàn bù jiā, suǒyǐ miànshì dāngtiān hěn zǎo jiù xǐnglái, chūmén qián hái yízài quèrèn chuānzhuó shì bú shì zhěngqí, zīliào shì bú shì dōu fàng jìn le bèibāo. Wǒ xiǎng, zhèyàng yòu jǐnzhāng yòu xīngfèn de xīnqíng, wǎngwǎng shì miànshì shí jīngcháng yǒu de biǎoxiàn.
lines.english: Last month, I saw on a website that an enterprise needed sales personnel and sent my personal information immediately. Beyond outlining my past work experience, the materials covered my views and attitudes toward work. Two weeks later, I received an interview notification. Even though it wasn't my first interview, I still worried about performing poorly, so I woke up very early on the day, repeatedly verifying that my attire was neat and my materials were all packed. Such nervous yet excited feelings are often common during interviews.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 一開始，經理請我說明對銷售工作的想法。我回答他，銷售人員是最常接觸顧客的，所以對客人要有禮貌，態度也要主動，絕對不能像木頭一樣沒反應；萬一他們亂發脾氣，就該忍耐、冷靜。畢竟，只顧自己的感覺，把跟顧客的關係搞壞，讓大家都不高興，又有什麼好處呢？
lines.simplified: 一开始，经理请我说明对销售工作的想法。我回答他，销售人员是最常接触顾客的，所以对客人要有礼貌，态度也要主动，绝对不能像木头一样没反应；万一他们乱发脾气，就该忍耐、冷静。毕竟，只顾自己的感觉，把跟顾客的关系搞坏，让大家都不高兴，又有什么好处呢？
lines.pinyin: Yì kāishǐ, jīnglǐ qǐng wǒ shuōmíng duì xiāoshòu gōngzuò de xiǎngfǎ. Wǒ huídá tā, xiāoshòu rényuán shì zuì cháng jiēchù gùkè de, suǒyǐ duì kèrén yào yǒu lǐmào, tàidù yě yào zhǔdòng, juéduì bù néng xiàng mùtou yíyàng méi fǎnyìng; wànyī tāmen luàn fā píqì, jiù gāi rěnnài, lěngjìng. Bìjìng, zhǐ gù zìjǐ de gǎnjué, bǎ gēn gùkè de guānxì gǎo huài, ràng dàjiā dōu bù gāoxìng, yòu yǒu shénme hǎochù ne?
lines.english: To begin, the manager asked for my thoughts on sales work. I replied that sales staff have the closest contact with customers, so one must be polite, take the initiative, and never act unresponsive like a piece of wood. If customers lose their temper, one should be patient and calm. After all, considering only one's own feelings and ruining relations with customers brings no benefit.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 後來，經理又問我對團體合作的看法。我之前的工作，就是以小組的方式來推銷產品，所以能理解合作是必要的。況且，主管要領導整個部門，為全公司創造好成績，要是小組人員不配合，恐怕就不能順利實行銷售計畫，也會出現混亂的情況。因此，為了公司，我認為不論主管有什麼要求，只要是合理的，員工都應該配合。
lines.simplified: 后来，经理又问我对团体合作的看法。我之前的工作，就是以小组的方式来推销产品，所以能理解合作是必要的。况且，主管要领导整个部门，为全公司创造好成绩，要是小组人员不配合，恐怕就不能顺利实行销售计划，也会出现混乱的情况。因此，为了公司，我认为不论主管有什么要求，只要是合理的，员工都应该配合。
lines.pinyin: Hòulái, jīnglǐ yòu wèn wǒ duì tuántǐ hézuò de kànfǎ. Wǒ zhīqián de gōngzuò, jiù shì yǐ xiǎozǔ de fāngshì lái tuīxiāo chǎnpǐn, suǒyǐ néng lǐjiě hézuò shì bìyào de. Kuàngqiě, zhǔguǎn yào lǐngdǎo zhěnggè bùmén, wèi quán gōngsī chuàngzào hǎo chéngjì, yàoshi xiǎozǔ rényuán bù pèihé, kǒngpà jiù bù néng shùnlì shíxíng xiāoshòu jìhuà, yě huì chūxiàn hùnluàn de qíngkuàng. Yīncǐ, wèile gōngsī, wǒ rènwéi búlùn zhǔguǎn yǒu shénme yāoqiú, zhǐyào shì hélǐ de, yuángōng dōu yīnggāi pèihé.
lines.english: Later, the manager asked about my views on teamwork. My previous work promoted products in teams, so I understand cooperation is essential. Moreover, supervisors lead entire departments to create results; without staff cooperation, plans cannot proceed smoothly and chaos results. Therefore, no matter what reasonable requests the supervisor makes, employees should cooperate.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 最後，經理問我要是被錄取了，能為公司付出什麼。我說，在推銷產品方面，我的經驗很豐富，商品銷售可說是我一輩子的事業，所以一定會盡最大的力量認真工作、完成任務。
lines.simplified: 最后，经理问我要是被录取了，能为公司付出什么。我说，在推销产品方面，我的经验很丰富，商品销售可说是我一辈子的事业，所以一定会尽最大的力量认真工作、完成任务。
lines.pinyin: Zuìhòu, jīnglǐ wèn wǒ yàoshi bèi lùqǔ le, néng wèi gōngsī fùchū shénme. Wǒ shuō, zài tuīxiāo chǎnpǐn fāngmiàn, wǒ de jīngyàn hěn fēngfù, shāngpǐn xiāoshòu kě shuō shì wǒ yíbèizi de shìyè, suǒyǐ yídìng huì jìn zuìdà de lìliàng rènzhēn gōngzuò, wánchéng rènwù.
lines.english: Finally, the manager asked what I could contribute to the company if hired. I stated that my experience in sales is extensive, that sales can be said to be my lifelong career, and that I would dedicate my utmost efforts to working conscientiously and accomplishing missions.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 上星期我收到了通過面試的通知，下個月就要上班了。盼望了好久，我終於美夢成真了。很多人說，想找到理想的工作，多多少少需要一點兒運氣。其實，個性、能力，加上不斷地努力才是最重要的。
lines.simplified: 上星期我收到了通过面试的通知，下个月就要上班了。盼望了好久，我终于美梦成真了。很多人说，想找到理想的工作，多多少少需要一点儿运气。其实，个性、能力，加上不断地努力才是最重要的。
lines.pinyin: Shàng xīngqī wǒ shōudào le tōngguò miànshì de tōngzhī, xià gè yuè jiù yào shàngbān le. Pànwàng le hǎojiǔ, wǒ zhōngyú měimèng chéngzhēn le. Hěn duō rén shuō, xiǎng zhǎodào lǐxiǎng de gōngzuò, duōduōshǎoshǎo xūyào yìdiǎnr yùnqì. Qíshí, gèxìng, nénglì, jiāshàng búduàn de nǔlì cái shì zuì zhòngyào de.
lines.english: Last week I received notification of passing the interview, and I start next month. After longing for so long, my dream has finally come true. Many say finding an ideal job takes a bit of luck, but personality, ability, and persistent effort are truly what matter most.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 以上就是我找工作的經驗和感想，如果有任何問題，歡迎跟我聯絡，謝謝！
lines.simplified: 以上就是我找工作的经验和感想，如果有任何问题，欢迎跟我联络，谢谢！
lines.pinyin: Yǐshàng jiù shì wǒ zhǎo gōngzuò de jīngyàn hé gǎnxiǎng, rúguǒ yǒu rènhé wèntí, huānyíng gēn wǒ liánluò, xièxie!
lines.english: The above is my experience and reflection on job seeking. If you have questions, please feel free to contact me. Thank you!

grammarPages.learnerPromise: State a factual concessive condition with 儘管 to contrast against an unexpected outcome.
grammarPages.pattern: 儘管 + Fact, + (但是 / 可是 / 還是 / 卻) + Contrary Result

columns.traditional: 我不是第一次參加面試
columns.simplified: 我不是第一次参加面试
columns.pinyin: wǒ bú shì dì yī cì cānjiā miànshì
columns.meaning: this is not my first interview

columns.pinyin: dàn háishi dānxīn biǎoxiàn bù jiā
columns.meaning: but still worry about doing poorly

columns.traditional: 他平時測驗的成績都不理想
columns.simplified: 他平时测验的成绩都不理想
columns.pinyin: tā píngshí cèyàn de chéngjì dōu bù lǐxiǎng
columns.meaning: his test scores are usually poor

columns.traditional: 卻不影響他對中文的興趣
columns.simplified: 却不影响他对中文的兴趣
columns.pinyin: què bù yǐngxiǎng tā duì Zhōngwén de xìngqù
columns.meaning: yet it does not affect his interest in Chinese

columns.traditional: 還是留在教室裡改作業
columns.simplified: 还是留在教室里改作业
columns.pinyin: háishi liú zài jiàoshì lǐ gǎi zuòyè
columns.meaning: still stays in the classroom grading homework

text.traditional: 儘管我不是第一次參加面試，但還是擔心表現不佳……
text.simplified: 尽管我不是第一次参加面试，但还是担心表现不佳……
text.pinyin: jǐnguǎn wǒ bú shì dì yī cì cānjiā miànshì， dàn háishi dānxīn biǎoxiàn bù jiā……
text.english: Although this is not my first time taking an interview, I still worry that my performance will not be good…

text.traditional: 儘管他平時測驗的成績都不理想，卻不影響他對中文的興趣。
text.simplified: 尽管他平时测验的成绩都不理想，却不影响他对中文的兴趣。
text.pinyin: jǐnguǎn tā píngshí cèyàn de chéngjì dōu bù lǐxiǎng， què bù yǐngxiǎng tā duì Zhōngwén de xìngqù。
text.english: Although his test scores are usually poor, they do not affect his interest in Chinese.

text.traditional: 儘管已經下課了，張老師還是留在教室裡改作業，直到晚餐時間才離開。
text.simplified: 尽管已经下课了，张老师还是留在教室里改作业，直到晚餐时间才离开。
text.pinyin: jǐnguǎn yǐjīng xiàkè le， Zhāng lǎoshī háishi liú zài jiàoshì lǐ gǎi zuòyè， zhídào wǎncān shíjiān cái líkāi。
text.english: Although class is already over, Teacher Zhang still stays in the classroom grading homework, and does not leave until dinner time.

items.question: How is 儘管 different from 即使?
items.answer: 「儘管」引導的是已經發生的既成事實；「即使」引導的是假設性的退讓條件（即便如此……）。
items.wrongTraditional: 即使已經下課了，張老師昨天留在教室改作業。
items.wrongSimplified: 即使已经下课了，张老师昨天留在教室改作业。

right.traditional: 儘管已經下課了，張老師還是留在教室改作業。
right.simplified: 尽管已经下课了，张老师还是留在教室改作业。
right.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn yǐjīng xiàkè le, Zhāng lǎoshī háishì liú zài jiàoshì gǎi zuòyè.
right.english: Even though class had dismissed, Teacher Zhang still stayed in the classroom grading.

items.question: Can 儘管 pair with 但 / 還是 / 卻 in the following clause?
items.answer: 是的，「儘管」後面常搭配「但是、可是、還是、卻」以凸顯出乎意料的轉折結果。
items.wrongTraditional: 儘管平時成績不好，所以他很開心。
items.wrongSimplified: 尽管平时成绩不好，所以他很开心。

right.traditional: 儘管成績不理想，卻不影響他的興趣。
right.simplified: 尽管成绩不理想，却不影响他的兴趣。
right.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn chéngjī bù lǐxiǎng, què bù yǐngxiǎng tā de xìngqù.
right.english: Even though grades were not ideal, it did not affect his interest.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：

segments.text: 我進公司兩年了，好像沒看過老闆生氣。是啊，
產品出現了嚴重的問題，他也沒怪任何人，脾氣真好。

questions.correctFeedback: 太棒了！「儘管」主要用來描述既成事實的讓步，後接相反的結果。
questions.repairFeedback: 請注意語意關係：前半句說明「產品出現嚴重問題」之事實，後半句為轉折結果，應使用「儘管」。

grammarPages.explanation: 「儘管」是連詞，用在第一個句子的句首，主要用來描述事實或某件事的結論，與「雖然」的意思相近；後面的分句常用「可是、但是、還是、卻」，表示與前句的結果相反。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 儘管 is a conjunction, similar to 雖然, and is used in the first half of the sentence. 儘管 is mainly used to describe the facts, or the conclusion of one thing. The second half of the sentence is often used with 但是, 可是, 卻 or 還是, indicating that the result of the first half is the opposite of what was hoped for or expected.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express that regardless of conditions, variables, or alternatives, the outcome remains invariant using 不論……都…….
grammarPages.pattern: 不論 + Variable Condition, + Subject + 都 + Invariant Result

columns.traditional: 你有升學或工作方面的問題
columns.simplified: 你有升学或工作方面的问题
columns.pinyin: nǐ yǒu shēngxué huò gōngzuò fāngmiàn de wèntí
columns.meaning: whether you have study or work questions

text.traditional: 我認為不論主管有什麼要求，只要是合理的，員工都應該配合。
text.simplified: 我认为不论主管有什么要求，只要是合理的，员工都应该配合。
text.pinyin: wǒ rènwéi bùlùn zhǔguǎn yǒu shénme yāoqiú， zhǐyào shì hélǐ de， yuángōng dōu yīnggāi pèihé。
text.english: I think that no matter what demands the supervisor makes, as long as they are reasonable, employees should cooperate.

text.traditional: 包老闆很堅持自己的想法，不論你說什麼，他都不會改變。
text.simplified: 包老板很坚持自己的想法，不论你说什么，他都不会改变。
text.pinyin: Bāo lǎobǎn hěn jiānchí zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ， bùlùn nǐ shuō shénme， tā dōu bú huì gǎibiàn。
text.english: Boss Bao insists on his own ideas; no matter what you say, he will not change.

text.traditional: 不論你有升學或工作方面的問題，都可以請教紀伯伯，他一定能給你寶貴的意見。
text.simplified: 不论你有升学或工作方面的问题，都可以请教纪伯伯，他一定能给你宝贵的意见。
text.pinyin: bùlùn nǐ yǒu shēngxué huò gōngzuò fāngmiàn de wèntí， dōu kěyǐ qǐngjiào Jì bóbo， tā yídìng néng gěi nǐ bǎoguì de yìjiàn。
text.english: No matter whether you have questions about further study or work, you can consult Uncle Ji, who will surely give you valuable advice.

text.traditional: 我為了這次的比賽準備了很久，不論教練去不去，我都要參加。
text.simplified: 我为了这次的比赛准备了很久，不论教练去不去，我都要参加。
text.pinyin: wǒ wèile zhè cì de bǐsài zhǔnbèi le hěn jiǔ， bùlùn jiàoliàn qù bu qù， wǒ dōu yào cānjiā。
text.english: I have been preparing for this competition for a long time; whether or not the coach goes, I will take part.

items.question: What types of conditions follow 不論?
items.answer: 「不論」後面通常接疑問代詞（什麼、哪裡）、反義詞對舉（遠近、好壞）或正反問句（去不去），表示各種變數下結論都不變。
items.wrongTraditional: 不論教練去，我都要參加。
items.wrongSimplified: 不论教练去，我都要参加。

right.traditional: 不論教練去不去，我都要參加。
right.simplified: 不论教练去不去，我都要参加。
right.pinyin: Búlùn jiàoliàn qù bú qù, wǒ dōu yào cānjiā.
right.english: No matter whether the coach goes or not, I will participate.

items.question: How is 不論……都 different from 既然……就?
items.answer: 「不論……都」表示排除任何變數限制，結果始終恆定；「既然……就」表示在既成前題下順理成章採取對應動作。
items.wrongTraditional: 既然主管有什麼要求，員工都要配合。
items.wrongSimplified: 既然主管有什么要求，员工都要配合。

right.traditional: 不論主管有什麼要求，員工都應該配合。
right.simplified: 不论主管有什么要求，员工都应该配合。
right.pinyin: Búlùn zhǔguǎn yǒu shénme yāoqiú, yuángōng dōu yīnggāi pèihé.
right.english: No matter what the supervisor requires, employees should cooperate.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：

segments.text: 這是我的購物習慣，
買什麼，我都要親自檢查才安心。

questions.correctFeedback: 答得很好！「不論……都……」搭配疑問詞「什麼」，表示任何情況下結果都不變。
questions.repairFeedback: 請注意條件多樣性：後接「買什麼」，後句搭配「都」，表示無條件的通則，應使用「不論」。

grammarPages.explanation: 用來表示雖然情況不同，但是最後的結果不因情況而受影響。「不論」的後面可搭配疑問詞、反義複合詞（例如：高低、大小、上下、左右、胖瘦、生死、長短、快慢等等）或 A not A 句，表示各種情況；「都」後面則是一定會出現的結果或事實。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 不論……都…… is used to indicate that although the situation is different, the final result is not affected by the situation. 不論 is followed by question words, antisense compound words (such as 大小, 高矮, 胖瘦, 遠近, etc.) or, "A not A sentences", indicating various situations. 都 is followed by the result or fact that will definitely occur.

items.title: Grammar 1–3 · Cloud Technology Is Really Convenient

dialogue.title: 雲端科技真方便

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 明哲，你不要一直看手機啦。
lines.simplified: 明哲，你不要一直看手机啦。
lines.pinyin: Míngzhé, nǐ bú yào yìzhí kàn shǒujī la.
lines.english: Mingzhe, don't keep staring at your phone all the time.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 我在查借書記錄，看看雲端圖書館的電子書還能借多久。
lines.simplified: 我在查借书记录，看看云端图书馆的电子书还能借多久。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zài chá jiè shū jìlù, kànkan yúnduān túshūguǎn de diànzǐshū hái néng jiè duō jiǔ.
lines.english: I'm checking my borrowing record to see how much longer I can keep the cloud library e-book.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 我從來沒用過雲端圖書館系統，你可以教我嗎？
lines.simplified: 我从来没用过云端图书馆系统，你可以教我吗？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ cónglái méi yòngguo yúnduān túshūguǎn xìtǒng, nǐ kěyǐ jiāo wǒ ma?
lines.english: I have never used the cloud library system before. Could you teach me?

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 妳只要上雲端圖書館的網站填資料，建立帳號、密碼，就能用了。
lines.simplified: 你只要上云端图书馆的网站填资料，建立账号、密码，就能用了。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zhǐyào shàng yúnduān túshūguǎn de wǎngzhàn tián zīliào, jiànlì zhànghào, mìmǎ, jiù néng yòng le.
lines.english: You just need to fill in information on the cloud library website and create an account and password, then you can use it.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 聽起來不難嘛！什麼時候借都可以嗎？
lines.simplified: 听起来不难嘛！什么时候借都可以吗？
lines.pinyin: Tīng qǐlái bù nán ma! Shénme shíhou jiè dōu kěyǐ ma?
lines.english: Sounds easy! Can you borrow anytime?

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 是啊，而且還書時間一到，系統就會自動還書。不像以前，想借書只能親自跑一趟圖書館，要是多借了幾本，還得抱著一堆書回家。
lines.simplified: 是啊，而且还书时间一到，系统就会自动还书。不像以前，想借书只能亲自跑一趟图书馆，要是多借了几本，还得抱着一堆书回家。
lines.pinyin: Shì a, érqiě huán shū shíjiān yí dào, xìtǒng jiù huì zìdòng huán shū. Bù xiàng yǐqián, xiǎng jiè shū zhǐ néng qīnzì pǎo yí tàng túshūguǎn, yàoshi duō jiè le jǐ běn, hái děi bàozhe yì duī shū huí jiā.
lines.english: Yes, and as soon as the due date arrives, the system returns it automatically. Unlike before, when borrowing required a trip to the library, and borrowing several books meant lugging a stack home.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 現在的讀者實在太幸福了。
lines.simplified: 现在的读者实在太幸福了。
lines.pinyin: Xiàndài de dúzhě shízài tài xìngfú le.
lines.english: Modern readers are truly fortunate.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 就是啊，只要帶著手機或平板，就能隨時隨地閱讀了。
lines.simplified: 就是啊，只要带着手机或平板，就能随时随地阅读了。
lines.pinyin: Jiù shì a, zhǐyào dàizhe shǒujī huò píngbǎn, jiù néng suíshí suídì yuèdú le.
lines.english: Exactly; as long as you carry a phone or tablet, you can read anytime, anywhere.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 這樣我的書包就能變得很空，放得下外套、雨傘什麼的。
lines.simplified: 这样我的书包就能变得很空，放得下外套、雨伞什么的。
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng wǒ de shūbāo jiù néng biàn de hěn kōng, fàng de xià wàitào, yǔsǎn shénme de.
lines.english: That way my schoolbag can become very spacious, leaving room for a coat, umbrella, and so on.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 是啊。現在我什麼文件都存在雲端，要是忘了帶隨身碟也不必擔心。
lines.simplified: 是啊。现在我什么文件都存在云端，要是忘了带随身碟也不必担心。
lines.pinyin: Shì a. Xiànzài wǒ shénme wénjiàn dōu cún zài yúnduān, yàoshi wàng le dài suíshēndié yě bú bì dānxīn.
lines.english: Indeed. Now I store all documents in the cloud; even if I forget my flash drive, there is no need to worry.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 有一次小組發表報告前五分鐘，我發現忘了帶隨身碟，也沒把預備好的資料寄到同學的電子信箱。我那時候想，這下子沒辦法報告了，還好同學說雲端上也有一份，問題就馬上解決了。
lines.simplified: 有一次小组发表报告前五分钟，我发现忘了带随身碟，也没把预备好的资料寄到同学的电子信箱。我那时候想，这下子没办法报告了，还好同学说云端上也有一份，问题就马上解决了。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu yí cì xiǎozǔ fābiǎo bàogào qián wǔ fēnzhōng, wǒ fāxiàn wàng le dài suíshēndié, yě méi bǎ yùbèi hǎo de zīliào jì dào tóngxué de diànzǐ xìnxīang. Wǒ nà shíhou xiǎng, zhèxiàzi méi bànfǎ bàogào le, hái hǎo tóngxué shuō yúnduān shàng yě yǒu yí fèn, wèntí jiù mǎshàng jiějué le.
lines.english: Once, five minutes before our group presentation, I found I had forgotten my flash drive and hadn't emailed the prepared files to classmates. I thought, 'Now we can't present!' Luckily a classmate said there was a copy on the cloud, and the problem was resolved immediately.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 現在的網路科技水平提高了不少，企業能透過高速網路把資料上傳到雲端處理，不同地區的人也能在網路上一起開會，既省時間又方便，更別說提供個人下載資料、傳訊息等基本服務了。
lines.simplified: 现在的网络科技水平提高了不少，企业能透过高速网络把资料上传到云端处理，不同地区的人也能在网络上一起开会，既省时间又方便，更别说提供个人下载资料、传讯息等基本服务了。
lines.pinyin: Xiànzài de wǎnglù kējì shuǐpíng tígāo le bù shǎo, qǐyè néng tòuguò gāosù wǎnglù bǎ zīliào shàngchuán dào yúnduān chǔlǐ, bùtóng dìqū de rén yě néng zài wǎnglù shàng yìqǐ kāihuì, jì shěng shíjiān yòu fāngbiàn, gèng bié shuō tígōng gèrén xiàzài zīliào, chuán xùnxí děng jīběn fúwù le.
lines.english: Internet technology standards have improved considerably. Enterprises can upload data to the cloud via high-speed internet for processing, and people in different regions can meet online—saving time and being convenient, not to mention basic personal services like downloads and messaging.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 除了這些優點，雲端還能把會議資料自動存起來，也能把變更的時間和內容記錄下來，讓不能參加會議的人隨時掌握最新情況。
lines.simplified: 除了这些优点，云端还能把会议资料自动存起来，也能把变更的时间和内容记录下来，让不能参加会议的人随时掌握最新情况。
lines.pinyin: Chúle zhèxiē yōudiǎn, yúnduān hái néng bǎ huìyì zīliào zìdòng cún qǐlái, yě néng bǎ biàngēng de shíjiān hé nèiróng jìlù xiàlái, ràng bù néng cānjiā huìyì de rén suíshí zhǎowò zuìxīn qíngkuàng.
lines.english: Besides these merits, the cloud automatically archives meeting materials and logs change times and details, enabling absent members to keep abreast of updates anytime.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 其實也有不少老師利用這樣的科技，把教材放上雲端，讓學生預習、複習，提高學習的效果。
lines.simplified: 其实也有不少老师利用这样的科技，把教材放上云端，让学生预习、复习，提高学习的效果。
lines.pinyin: Qíshí yě yǒu bù shǎo lǎoshī lìyòng zhèyàng de kējì, bǎ jiàocái fàng shàng yúnduān, ràng xuéshēng yùxí, fùxí, tígāo xuéxí de xiàoguǒ.
lines.english: Actually, quite a few teachers use this technology, putting course materials on the cloud for students to preview and review, boosting learning efficacy.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 不過，我覺得要利用雲端科技來改變傳統的教學方式，恐怕說起來容易，做起來不簡單吧。
lines.simplified: 不过，我觉得要利用云端科技来改变传统的教学方式，恐怕说起来容易，做起来不简单吧。
lines.pinyin: Búguò, wǒ juéde yào lìyòng yúnduān kējì lái gǎibiàn chuántǒng de jiàoxué fāngshì, kǒngpà shuōqǐlái róngyì, zuòqǐlái bù jiǎndān ba.
lines.english: However, using cloud technology to transform conventional teaching methods is probably easier said than done.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 明天系主任邀請馬博士來演講，題目跟雲端科技有關，妳要一起去嗎？
lines.simplified: 明天系主任邀请马博士来演讲，题目跟云端科技有关，你要一起去吗？
lines.pinyin: Míngtiān xì zhǔrèn yāoqǐng Mǎ bóshì lái yǎnjiǎng, tímù gēn yúnduān kējì yǒuguān, nǐ yào yìqǐ qù ma?
lines.english: Tomorrow the department chair invited Dr. Ma to give a lecture on cloud tech. Do you want to go together?

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 說實話，我本來對雲端科技沒什麼興趣，今天聽你說了這麼多，似乎該研究一下了。
lines.simplified: 说实话，我本来对云端科技没什么兴趣，今天听你说了这么多，似乎该研究一下了。
lines.pinyin: Shuō shíhuà, wǒ běnlái duì yúnduān kējì méi shénme xìngqù, jīntiān tīng nǐ shuō le zhème duō, sìhū gāi yánjiū yíxià le.
lines.english: Honestly, I initially had little interest in cloud tech, but hearing you share so much today, it seems I should look into it.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 那我明天騎摩托車去接妳。
lines.simplified: 那我明天骑摩托车去接你。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒ míngtiān qí mótuōchē qù jiē nǐ.
lines.english: Then I'll pick you up on my scooter tomorrow.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 太好了！麻煩你了！
lines.simplified: 太好了！麻烦你了！
lines.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Máfan nǐ le!
lines.english: Wonderful! Thanks so much!

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express an immediate realization, reaction, or consequence of a sudden situation using 這下子 ('now / as a result').
grammarPages.explanation: 在對話中說到某件事情或情況，說話的人表達自己的看法，也可以是自己面對突然發生的情況，當下做出的反應。
grammarPages.pattern: Situation + 這下子 + Result

text.traditional: 我那時候想，這下子沒辦法報告了，還好同學說雲端上也有一份……
text.simplified: 我那时候想，这下子没办法报告了，还好同学说云端上也有一份……
text.pinyin: wǒ nà shíhou xiǎng， zhè xiàzi méi bànfǎ bàogào le， hái hǎo tóngxué shuō yúnduān shàng yě yǒu yí fèn……
text.english: At that time I thought, now I can't report it; luckily a classmate said there is a copy on the cloud too…

text.traditional:
A：唉，我們工廠早上突然停電了，到現在還沒恢復，什麼都做不了。
B：真的？這下子你們的貨趕得出來嗎？
text.simplified:
A：唉，我们工厂早上突然停电了，到现在还没恢复，什么都做不了。
B：真的？这下子你们的货赶得出来吗？
text.pinyin:
A： āi， wǒmen gōngchǎng zǎoshang tūrán tíngdiàn le， dào xiànzài hái méi huīfù， shénme dōu zuò bu liǎo。 
B：zhēn de？ zhè xiàzi nǐmen de huò gǎn de chūlai ma？
text.english: A: Uh, our factory suddenly lost power early this morning and still hasn't recovered, so we can't get anything done. B: Really? Will you be able to get your goods out in time now?

text.traditional:
A：沒想到小顧計畫要去旅遊的國家，昨天發生了嚴重的大地震。
B：是啊。這下子他得改變計畫了。
text.simplified:
A：没想到小顾计画要去旅游的国家，昨天发生了严重的大地震。
B：是啊。这下子他得改变计画了。
text.pinyin:
A： méi xiǎngdào Xiǎo Gù jìhuà yào qù lǚyóu de guójiā， zuótiān fāshēng le yánzhòng de dà dìzhèn。 
B：shì a。 zhè xiàzi tā děi gǎibiàn jìhuà le。
text.english: A: I didn't expect that the country Xiao Gu planned to visit had a severe major earthquake yesterday. B: Yes. Now he has to change his plans.

items.question: When should you use 這下子 instead of simple 現在?
items.answer: 「這下子」強調事情發生後的即刻後果或對突發情境的強烈感嘆反應；「現在」僅客觀表示當前時間。
items.wrongTraditional: 早上工廠停電了，現在你們的貨趕得出來嗎？
items.wrongSimplified: 早上工厂停电了，现在你们的货赶得出来吗？

right.traditional: 工廠突然停電，這下子貨趕得出來嗎？
right.simplified: 工厂突然停电，这下子货赶得出来吗？
right.pinyin: Gōngchǎng tūrán tíngdiàn, zhèxiàzi huò gǎn de chūlái ma?
right.english: The factory suddenly lost power; now can the goods be rushed out in time?

words.pinyin: zhèxiàzi huò gǎn de chūlái ma

items.question: Can 這下子 be used for anticipated pleasant or unpleasant emergent turns?
items.answer: 兩者皆可，但在口語中常帶有「這下可麻煩了」或面對意外轉折的強烈情緒色彩。
items.wrongTraditional: 天氣很好，這下子我明天去學校。
items.wrongSimplified: 天气很好，这下子我明天去学校。

right.traditional: 突然下大雨沒帶傘，這下子走不成了。
right.simplified: 突然下大雨没带伞，这下子走不成了。
right.pinyin: Tūrán xià dàyǔ méi dài sǎn, zhèxiàzi zǒu bù chéng le.
right.english: Sudden heavy rain and no umbrella—now we can't leave.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：

segments.text: 下課了突然下起大雨，大家都沒帶傘，
我們只能在學校等雨停了。

questions.correctFeedback: 太棒了！「這下子」用於面對突發情況時當下做出的即時反應與感慨。
questions.repairFeedback: 請注意突發事件的因果關係：面對突發大雨沒有雨傘的處境，應使用「這下子」。

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: When talking about a certain event or situation in a conversation, the person speaking expresses his or her own views, or their immediate reaction to a sudden change in the situation.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Coordinate two simultaneous positive or negative qualities/actions using 既……又…….
grammarPages.explanation: 表示同一個主語具有兩種狀態或情況。「既」跟「又」後面常接形容詞、動詞或動詞短語，形容詞前面不可以加副詞，動詞前面可加能願動詞「會、要、能、願意」等。所連接的兩個狀態或情況，必須同樣是正面的或負面的。而「又」後面狀態或情況的程度，比「既」來得更高一些。「既……又……」比「又……又……」書面。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 既 + Quality 1 + 又 + Quality 2

text.traditional: ……不同地區的人也能在網路上一起開會，既省時間又方便……
text.simplified: ……不同地区的人也能在网络上一起开会，既省时间又方便……
text.pinyin: …… bùtóng dìqū de rén yě néng zài wǎnglù shàng yìqǐ kāihuì， jì shěng shíjiān yòu fāngbiàn……
text.english: ...people in different regions can also hold meetings together online, which both saves time and is convenient...

text.traditional: 陳教授既是我的好老師，又是我的老朋友，我很重視我們的友誼。
text.simplified: 陈教授既是我的好老师，又是我的老朋友，我很重视我们的友谊。
text.pinyin: Chén jiàoshòu jì shì wǒ de hǎo lǎoshī， yòu shì wǒ de lǎo péngyou， wǒ hěn zhòngshì wǒmen de yǒuyì。
text.english: Professor Chen is both my good teacher and my old friend, and I value our friendship very much.

text.traditional: 阮小姐對穿著很講究，她對衣服的要求是既要品質好，又要設計佳。
text.simplified: 阮小姐对穿着很讲究，她对衣服的要求是既要品质好，又要设计佳。
text.pinyin: Ruǎn xiǎojiě duì chuānzhuó hěn jiǎngjiu， tā duì yīfu de yāoqiú shì jì yào pǐnzhì hǎo， yòu yào shèjì jiā。
text.english: Miss Ruan is very particular about clothing; her requirements for clothes are that they be both high quality and well designed.

items.question: Can 既 and 又 pair opposite polarities (one positive, one negative)?
items.answer: 不行。「既……又……」連接的兩個性質必須同為正面（褒義）或同為負面（貶義）。
items.wrongTraditional: 這件衣服既漂亮又很難看。
items.wrongSimplified: 这件衣服既漂亮又很难看。

right.traditional: 這件衣服既好看又便宜。
right.simplified: 这件衣服既好看又便宜。
right.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu jì hǎokàn yòu piányi.
right.english: This piece of clothing is both nice-looking and affordable.

items.question: Can degree adverbs like 很 precede adjectives after 既 / 又?
items.answer: 通常不加副詞「很」，直接接單純形容詞（如「既省時間又方便」，不說「既很省時間又很方便」）。
items.wrongTraditional: 網上開會既很省時又很方便。
items.wrongSimplified: 网上开会既很省时又很方便。

right.traditional: 網上開會既省時又方便。
right.simplified: 网上开会既省时又方便。
right.pinyin: Wǎngshàng kāihuì jì shěngshí yòu fāngbiàn.
right.english: Online meetings are both time-saving and convenient.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：

segments.text: 不同地區的人在網路上開會，
省時間又方便。

questions.correctFeedback: 答對了！「既……又……」表示同時具備兩種同向性質或特點。
questions.repairFeedback: 請注意句式搭配：後句有「又方便」，前半句應搭配「既省時間」。

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 既……又…… indicates that the same subject has two states or situations. 既 and 又 are often followed by adjectives, verbs, or verb phrases. Adverbs are not used in front of adjectives, though volitive auxiliary verbs such as 會, 要, 能, 願意, etc. can be added before verbs. The adjectives, verbs or verb phrases following 既 and 又 must both be positive or negative. The level of the state or the situation after 又 is higher than 既. Finally, 既……又……is used more in written language than 又……又…….

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Dismiss obvious, self-evident follow-ups using 更別說 ('not to mention / let alone').
grammarPages.explanation: 「更別說」的意思是「不必說」、「不需要說」，因為「更別說」後面所表達的情況是非常清楚的，不需要再多說。
grammarPages.pattern: Basic Case + 更別說 + Advanced Case + 了

text.traditional: ……既省時間又方便，更別說提供個人下載資料、傳訊息等基本服務了。
text.simplified: ……既省时间又方便，更别说提供个人下载资料、传讯息等基本服务了。
text.pinyin: …… jì shěng shíjiān yòu fāngbiàn， gèng biéshuō tígōng gèrén xiàzài zīliào、 chuán xùnxī děng jīběn fúwù le。
text.english: ...it both saves time and is convenient, let alone providing personal downloads of data, sending messages and other basic services.

text.traditional: 我奶奶連怎麼上傳資料都不會，更別說建立自己的網站了。
text.simplified: 我奶奶连怎么上传资料都不会，更别说建立自己的网站了。
text.pinyin: wǒ nǎinai lián zěnme shàngchuán zīliào dōu bú huì， gèng biéshuō jiànlì zìjǐ de wǎngzhàn le。
text.english: My grandma can't even figure out how to upload data, let alone build her own website.

text.traditional: 溫先生一見到陌生人，就害羞得說不出話來，更別說要他演講了。
text.simplified: 温先生一见到陌生人，就害羞得说不出话来，更别说要他演讲了。
text.pinyin: Wēn xiānsheng yí jiàndào mòshēngrén， jiù hàixiu de shuō bu chū huà lái， gèng biéshuō yào tā yǎnjiǎng le。
text.english: When Mr. Wen sees a stranger, he gets so shy he cannot say a word, let alone give a speech.

items.question: How is 更別說 structured with lesser vs. greater extremes?
items.answer: 前句先提出較容易或基本的情境（常搭配『連……都……』），「更別說」後則接難度更高或更極端、顯而易見的事情。
items.wrongTraditional: 他建立網站都不會，更別說上傳資料了。
items.wrongSimplified: 他建立网站都不会，更别说上传资料了。

right.traditional: 他連上傳資料都不會，更別說建網站了。
right.simplified: 他连上传资料都不会，更别说建网站了。
right.pinyin: Tā lián shàngchuán zīliào dōu bú huì, gèng bié shuō jiàn wǎngzhàn le.
right.english: He doesn't even know how to upload files, let alone build a site.

items.question: Can 更別說 be replaced by 只要 or 除非?
items.answer: 不行。「更別說」表示遞進排除（不必說也知道），不可與假設連詞混淆。
items.wrongTraditional: 連房租都付不起，除非出國旅遊了。
items.wrongSimplified: 连房租都付不起，除非出国旅游了。

right.traditional: 連房租都付不起，更別說出國旅遊了。
right.simplified: 连房租都付不起，更别说出国旅游了。
right.pinyin: Lián fángzū dōu fù bù qǐ, gèng bié shuō chūguó lǚyóu le.
right.english: Can't even afford rent, let alone travel abroad.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：

segments.text: 小古已經三個月沒工作了，連房租都付不起，
出國旅遊了。

questions.correctFeedback: 答得很棒！「更別說」引出顯而易見更不可能成立的極端情況。
questions.repairFeedback: 請注意邏輯遞進：前半句指出連基本房租都付不起，後續更奢華的出國旅遊自然更不可能，應使用「更別說」。

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 更別說 means the same as 不必說 or 不需要說. Because the situation after 更別說 is very clear, there is no need to say more.

items.title: Grammar 4–5 · Towards The New Cloud Era

dialogue.title: 短文 · 走向雲端的新時代

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 想當年還沒有雲端科技時，人們不論想閱讀某位作者出版的作品，或是需要找某類題材的文章，都得到圖書館去查資料、借書。不過，自從有了雲端之後，人們就是不出門，也可透過網路滿足相關的需求。
lines.simplified: 想当年还没有云端科技时，人们不论想阅读某位作者出版的作品，或是需要找某类题材的文章，都得到图书馆去查资料、借书。不过，自从有了云端之后，人们就是不出门，也可透过网络满足相关的需求。
lines.pinyin: Xiǎng dāngnián hái méiyǒu yúnduān kējì shí, rénmen búlùn xiǎng yuèdú mǒu wèi zuòzhě chūbǎn de zuòpǐn, huòshì xūyào zhǎo mǒu lèi tícái de wénzhāng, dōu děi dào túshūguǎn qù chá zīliào, jiè shū. Búguò, zìcóng yǒu le yúnduān zhīhòu, rénmen jiùshì bù chūmén, yě kě tòuguò wǎnglù mǎnzú xiāngguān de xūqiú.
lines.english: Back in the days before cloud technology, whether people wanted to read works published by an author or find articles on a topic, they had to go to libraries to research and borrow books. Since the advent of the cloud, however, people can satisfy relevant needs online without leaving home.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 雲端科技的主要功能，是讓人們能隨時隨地上傳或下載資料；也因為不需要使用紙、筆來記錄，還能為地球的環保盡一份力量。以往，雲端科技多用來管理資料和電子郵件；現在遇到淹水、颱風的特殊情況，不出門也能在家開會或學習，把該做的事情都做好。上班族在家中裝上了攝影機，透過手機或電腦能看到家人的活動情況，要是他們碰上了麻煩，就能立刻請鄰居或警察協助。除了個人，企業在管理公共空間或服務方面也用得著雲端。比如說，旅館透過雲端掌握房客進出的情況、調整房間內冷氣的強弱等等。以上都是雲端科技帶來的好處。
lines.simplified: 云端科技的主要功能，是让人们能随时随地上传或下载资料；也因为不需要使用纸、笔来记录，还能为地球的环保尽一份力量。以往，云端科技多用来管理资料和电子邮件；现在遇到淹水、台风的特殊情况，不出门也能在家开会或学习，把该做的事情都做好。上班族在家中装上了摄影机，透过手机或电脑能看到家人的活动情况，要是他们碰上了麻烦，就能立刻请邻居或警察协助。除了个人，企业在管理公共空间或服务方面也用得着云端。比如说，旅馆透过云端掌握房客进出的情况、调整房间内冷气的强弱等等。以上都是云端科技带来的好处。
lines.pinyin: Yúnduān kējì de zhǔyào gōngnéng, shì ràng rénmen néng suíshí suídì shàngchuán huò xiàzài zīliào; yě yīnwèi bù xūyào shǐyòng zhǐ, bǐ lái jìlù, hái néng wèi dìqiú de huánbǎo jìn yí fèn lìliàng. Yǐwǎng, yúnduān kējì duō yòng lái guǎnlǐ zīliào hé diànzǐ yóujiàn; xiànzài yùdào yānshuǐ, táifēng de tèshū qíngkuàng, bù chūmén yě néng zài jiā kāihuì huò xuéxí, bǎ gāi zuò de shìqing dōu zuò hǎo. Shàngbānzú zài jiā zhōng zhuāng shàng le shèyǐngjī, tòuguò shǒujī huò diànnǎo néng kàndào jiārén de huódòng qíngkuàng, yàoshi tāmen pèng shàng le máfan, jiù néng lìkè qǐng línjū huò jǐngchá xiézhù. Chúle gèrén, qǐyè zài guǎnlǐ gōnggòng kōngjiān huò fúwù fāngmiàn yě yòng de zháo yúnduān. Bǐrú shuō, lǚguǎn tòuguò yúnduān zhǎowò fángkè jìnchū de qíngkuàng, tiáozhěng fángjiān nèi lěngqì de qiángruò děngděng. Yǐshàng dōu shì yúnduān kējì dàilái de hǎochù.
lines.english: The primary function of cloud tech is enabling people to upload and download data anywhere, anytime; avoiding paper and pen also contributes to environmental conservation. Previously used mainly for data and email management, during flooding or typhoons it allows remote meetings and studies. Commuters can view household activity via cameras on phone or PC and seek prompt assistance if issues arise. Beyond individuals, businesses utilize the cloud for public space and service management—hotels track guest movements and adjust AC levels. All these are benefits brought by cloud technology.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 但話說回來，雖然雲端的優點不少，卻還是有現實的問題需要克服。例如某個時刻突然停電了，或是連不上網路，再重要的會議也只能暫時停下來；也可能因為雲端系統出現安全問題，上傳的資料突然沒了或被偷了。所以最好別太依靠雲端，重要資料也應多存一份。
lines.simplified: 但话说回来，虽然云端的优点不少，却还是有现实的问题需要克服。例如某个时刻突然停电了，或是连不上网络，再重要的会议也只能暂时停下来；也可能因为云端系统出现安全问题，上传的资料突然没了或被偷了。所以最好别太依靠云端，重要资料也应多存一份。
lines.pinyin: Dàn huàshuōhuílái, suīrán yúnduān de yōudiǎn bù shǎo, què háishì yǒu xiànshí de wèntí xūyào kèfú. Lìrú mǒu ge shíkè tūrán tíngdiàn le, huòshì lián bú shàng wǎnglù, zài zhòngyào de huìyì yě zhǐ néng zhànshí tíng xiàlái; yě kěnéng yīnwèi yúnduān xìtǒng chūxiàn ānquán wèntí, shàngchuán de zīliào tūrán méi le huò bèi tōu le. Suǒyǐ zuìhǎo bié tài yīkào yúnduān, zhòngyào zīliào yě yīng duō cún yí fèn.
lines.english: Then again, though the cloud offers many perks, practical challenges persist. A sudden power outage or connectivity failure halts even crucial meetings; security breaches can cause uploaded files to vanish or be compromised. Hence one should not rely solely on the cloud and keep duplicate backups of essential data.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 雲端就像一張大網，把各種資源連在一起，提供各式各樣的服務，一方面帶給人們更便利的生活，一方面也帶給企業更良好的管理方式，對全球商業、教育、文化等方面都產生了重大的影響，相信未來雲端能夠帶領我們走向美好的新時代。
lines.simplified: 云端就像一张大网，把各种资源连在一起，提供各式各样的服务，一方面带给人们更便利的生活，一方面也带给企业更良好的管理方式，对全球商业、教育、文化等方面都产生了重大的影响，相信未来云端能够带领我们走向美好的新时代。
lines.pinyin: Yúnduān jiù xiàng yì zhāng dà wǎng, bǎ gèzhǒng zīyuán lián zài yìqǐ, tígōng gèshì gèyàng de fúwù, yì fāngmiàn dài gěi rénmen gèng biànlì de shēnghuó, yì fāngmiàn yě dài gěi qǐyè gèng liánghǎo de guǎnlǐ fāngshì, duì quánqiú shāngyè, jiàoyù, wénhuà děng fāngmiàn dōu chǎnshēng le zhòngdà de yǐngxiǎng, xiāngxìn wèilái yúnduān nénggòu dàilǐng wǒmen zǒuxiàng měihǎo de xīn shídài.
lines.english: The cloud is like an immense web linking diverse resources to deliver myriad services. It brings convenience to people while equipping enterprises with refined management, exerting profound impact across global business, education, and culture, and guiding us toward a prosperous new era.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express an extreme hypothetical condition that cannot change the outcome using 就是……也…… ('even if... still...').
grammarPages.explanation: 「就是」的後面是假設的情況，就算發生這些情況，「也」後面的結果也不會因為這樣而改變。
grammarPages.pattern: 就是 + Extreme Condition, + 也 + Result

text.traditional: ……人們就是不出門，也可透過網路滿足相關的需求。
text.simplified: ……人们就是不出门，也可透过网络满足相关的需求。
text.pinyin: …… rénmen jiùshì bù chūmén， yě kě tòuguò wǎnglù mǎnzú xiāngguān de xūqiú。
text.english: ...even if people do not go out, they can still meet related needs through the internet.

text.traditional: 為了追求夢想，就是吃再多苦，我也要堅持到底。
text.simplified: 为了追求梦想，就是吃再多苦，我也要坚持到底。
text.pinyin: wèile zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng， jiùshì chī zài duō kǔ， wǒ yě yào jiānchí dàodǐ。
text.english: To pursue a dream, even if I have to endure much hardship, I will persist to the end.

text.traditional: 林老闆既然做了決定就不會改變，就是總統來跟他說也沒用。
text.simplified: 林老板既然做了决定就不会改变，就是总统来跟他说也没用。
text.pinyin: Lín lǎobǎn jìrán zuò le juédìng jiù bú huì gǎibiàn， jiùshì zǒngtǒng lái gēn tā shuō yě méi yòng。
text.english: Since Boss Lin has made up his mind, he will not change it; even if the president came and told him, it would be useless.

items.question: How is 就是……也 different from 只要……就?
items.answer: 「就是……也」表示縱使在極端假設下，結果依然不改；「只要……就」表示充分條件（只要A達成，就必然出現B）。
items.wrongTraditional: 只要吃再多苦，我也要堅持到底。
items.wrongSimplified: 只要吃再多苦，我也要坚持到底。

right.traditional: 就是吃再多苦，我也要堅持到底。
right.simplified: 就是吃再多苦，我也要坚持到底。
right.pinyin: Jiùshì chī zài duō kǔ, wǒ yě yào jiānchí dàodǐ.
right.english: Even if I suffer more hardships, I will still persist to the end.

items.question: Can 就是 be used interchangeably with 即使 in this concessive structure?
items.answer: 可以，「就是……也……」在口語中與「即使……也……」意思相通，極具口語強調色彩。
items.wrongTraditional: 除非吃很多苦，我也堅持到底。
items.wrongSimplified: 除非吃很多苦，我也坚持到底。

right.traditional: 就是下雪了，我們也不會改變行程。
right.simplified: 就是下雪了，我们也不会改变行程。
right.pinyin: Jiùshì xiàxuě le, wǒmen yě bú huì gǎibiàn xíngchéng.
right.english: Even if it snows, we still won't change our itinerary.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：

segments.text: 為了追求自己的理想，
吃再多苦，我也要堅持到底。

questions.correctFeedback: 非常好！「就是……也……」引導極端讓步條件，表示縱使如此結果也不變。
questions.repairFeedback: 請注意句意：縱使承受再多辛苦也要堅持，後句搭配「也」，應使用「就是」。

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 就是 is followed by a hypothetical situation. Even if this situation should occur, the results after 也 will not change.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: On One Hand, On the Other Hand (一方面……一方面……)
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Present two parallel aspects, reasons, or objectives of a situation using 一方面……，一方面…….
grammarPages.explanation: 使用「一方面……，一方面……」的句式說明一件事情兩個方面的原因、結果或目的等，前後兩句沒有重要程度的差別。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 一方面 + Aspect 1, + 一方面 + Aspect 2

text.traditional: ……一方面帶給人們更便利的生活，一方面也帶給企業更良好的管理方式……
text.simplified: ……一方面带给人们更便利的生活，一方面也带给企业更良好的管理方式……
text.pinyin: …… yìfāngmiàn dàigěi rénmen gèng biànlì de shēnghuó， yìfāngmiàn yě dàigěi qǐyè gèng liánghǎo de guǎnlǐ fāngshì……
text.english: ...on the one hand it brings people a more convenient life, and on the other hand it also brings enterprises better management methods...

text.traditional: 錢老闆每天從早忙到晚，一方面要照顧生意，一方面要訓練員工，連陪家人的時間都沒有。
text.simplified: 钱老板每天从早忙到晚，一方面要照顾生意，一方面要训练员工，连陪家人的时间都没有。
text.pinyin: Qián lǎobǎn měitiān cóng zǎo máng dào wǎn， yìfāngmiàn yào zhàogù shēngyi， yìfāngmiàn yào xùnliàn yuángōng， lián péi jiārén de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu。
text.english: Boss Qian is busy from morning till night: on the one hand he has to look after the business, and on the other hand he has to train staff; he even has no time left for his family.

text.traditional: 店員建議我買這部筆電，一方面打了折之後便宜得多，一方面筆電該有的功能它都有。
text.simplified: 店员建议我买这部笔电，一方面打了折之后便宜得多，一方面笔电该有的功能它都有。
text.pinyin: diànyuán jiànyì wǒ mǎi zhè bù bǐdiàn， yìfāngmiàn dǎ le zhé zhīhòu piányi de duō， yìfāngmiàn bǐdiàn gāi yǒu de gōngnéng tā dōu yǒu。
text.english: The shop clerk suggested I buy this laptop: on the one hand it is much cheaper after the discount, and on the other hand it has all the functions a laptop should have.

items.question: Is there a priority ranking between the two aspects in 一方面……一方面……?
items.answer: 沒有。「一方面……，一方面……」並列陳述兩項同等重要的原因、目的或角度，前後無先後輕重之別。
items.wrongTraditional: 最重要是一方面照顧生意，次要是一方面訓練員工。
items.wrongSimplified: 最重要是一方面照顾生意，次要是一方面训练员工。

right.traditional: 他一方面照顧生意，一方面訓練員工。
right.simplified: 他一方面照顾生意，一方面训练员工。
right.pinyin: Tā yì fāngmiàn zhàogù shēngyì, yì fāngmiàn xùnliàn yuángōng.
right.english: On one hand he minds business, and on the other he trains staff.

items.question: How is 一方面……一方面…… different from 不但……而且……?
items.answer: 「不但……而且……」表示程度遞進，後句比前句更進一層；「一方面……一方面……」則是平行列舉。
items.wrongTraditional: 雲端不但一方面帶來便利，而且帶給企業好管理。
items.wrongSimplified: 云端不但一方面带来便利，而且带给企业好管理。

right.traditional: 雲端一方面帶來便利，一方面帶給企業良好管理。
right.simplified: 云端一方面带来便利，一方面带给企业良好管理。
right.pinyin: Yúnduān yì fāngmiàn dàilái biànlì, yì fāngmiàn dài gěi qǐyè liánghǎo guǎnlǐ.
right.english: The cloud brings convenience on one hand, and gives firms sound management on the other.

questions.prompt: 選出最合適的詞語填入空格：

segments.text: 錢老闆每天忙碌，
要照顧生意，一方面要訓練員工。

questions.correctFeedback: 答得很對！「一方面……，一方面……」平行列舉兩項並行的責任或考量。
questions.repairFeedback: 請注意並列結構：後句搭配「一方面要訓練員工」，前半句應使用「一方面」。

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The use of the phrase 一方面……，一方面……can explain the cause, result or purpose of two aspects of a thing, and there is no important difference between the preceding and following sentences.

items.title: Grammar 1–3 · The Story of the Double Seventh Festival

dialogue.title: 七夕情人節的故事

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 你這個布做的錢包好漂亮，在哪裡買的？
lines.simplified: 你这个布做的钱包好漂亮，在哪里买的？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zhège bù zuò de qiánbāo hǎo piàoliang, zài nǎlǐ mǎi de?
lines.english: This cloth wallet of yours is so pretty. Where did you buy it?

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 是我女朋友親手做的七夕情人節禮物。法國也有情人節吧？
lines.simplified: 是我女朋友亲手做的七夕情人节礼物。法国也有情人节吧？
lines.pinyin: Shì wǒ nǚpéngyǒu qīnshǒu zuò de Qīxī Qíngrénjié lǐwù. Fǎguó yě yǒu Qíngrénjié ba?
lines.english: It's a Qixi Valentine's gift handmade by my girlfriend. France has Valentine's Day too, right?

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 有啊，不過不是在七夕。你們這個節日背後應該有故事吧？
lines.simplified: 有啊，不过不是在七夕。你们这个节日背后应该有故事吧？
lines.pinyin: Yǒu a, bùguò búshì zài Qīxī. Nǐmen zhège jiérì bèihòu yīnggāi yǒu gùshì ba?
lines.english: Yes, but not on Qixi. There must be a story behind your festival, right?

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 這就要從牛郎、織女說起了。從前有個叫牛郎的青年，每天都帶著老牛去田裡工作。有一天，他在河邊休息時，看見了一位非常美麗的姑娘。
lines.simplified: 这就要从牛郎、织女说起了。从前有个叫牛郎的青年，每天都带着老牛去田里工作。有一天，他在河边休息时，看见了一位非常美丽的姑娘。
lines.pinyin: Zhè jiù yào cóng Niúláng, Zhīnǚ shuōqǐ le. Cóngqián yǒu ge jiào Niúláng de qīngnián, měitiān dōu dài zhe lǎoniú qù tián lǐ gōngzuò. Yǒu yì tiān, tā zài hébiān xiūxí shí, kànjiàn le yí wèi fēicháng měilì de gūniáng.
lines.english: That has to be told starting from the Cowherd and Weaver Girl. Once there was a young man named Niulang who took his old ox to work the fields every day. One day while resting by the river, he saw an exceptionally beautiful girl.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 我猜牛郎第一眼看到她，就覺得遇到了真愛吧。
lines.simplified: 我猜牛郎第一眼看到她，就觉得遇到了真爱吧。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ cāi Niúláng dì-yī yǎn kàndào tā, jiù juéde yùdào le zhēn'ài ba.
lines.english: I bet the very first moment Niulang saw her, he felt he had found true love.

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 是啊。那個天真可愛的姑娘名叫織女，她是天上的仙女，跟著幾個姊姊來人間玩，過幾天就得回到天上。
lines.simplified: 是啊。那个天真可爱的小姑娘名叫织女，她是天上的仙女，跟着几个姐姐来人间玩，过几天就得回到天上。
lines.pinyin: Shì a. Nàge tiānzhēn kě'ài de gūniáng míng jiào Zhīnǚ, tā shì tiānshàng de xiānnǚ, gēn zhe jǐ ge jiějiě lái rénjiān wán, guò jǐ tiān jiù děi huídào tiānshàng.
lines.english: Indeed. That innocent and lovely girl was named Weaver Girl. She was a celestial fairy from heaven, visiting the mortal world with her older sisters for fun, and had to return to heaven after a few days.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 牛郎不想把她留下來嗎？
lines.simplified: 牛郎不想把她留下来吗？
lines.pinyin: Niúláng bù xiǎng bǎ tā liú xiàlái ma?
lines.english: Didn't Niulang want to keep her here?

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 當然想啊！為了把織女留在身邊，牛郎就拿走了能讓織女飛回天上的衣服。後來，因為牛郎很溫柔、很體貼，織女就慢慢愛上他了，最後他們成了夫婦，還生了兩個寶貝。
lines.simplified: 当然想啊！为了把织女留在身边，牛郎就拿走了能让织女飞回天上的衣服。后来，因为牛郎很温柔、很体贴，织女就慢慢爱上他了，最后他们成了夫妇，还生了两个宝贝。
lines.pinyin: Dāngrán xiǎng a! Wèile bǎ Zhīnǚ liú zài shēnbiān, Niúláng jiù názǒu le néng ràng Zhīnǚ fēi huí tiānshàng de yīfú. Hòulái, yīnwèi Niúláng hěn wēnróu, hěn tǐtiē, Zhīnǚ jiù mànmàn àishàng tā le, zuìhòu tāmen chéng le fūfù, hái shēng le liǎng ge bǎobèi.
lines.english: Of course he did! To keep Weaver Girl by his side, Niulang took away the clothes that allowed her to fly back to heaven. Later, because Niulang was gentle and thoughtful, Weaver Girl gradually fell in love with him, and eventually they became husband and wife and had two precious children.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 他們就這樣過著幸福快樂的日子嗎？
lines.simplified: 他们就这样过着幸福快乐的日子吗？
lines.pinyin: Tāmen jiù zhèyàng guò zhe xìngfú kuàilè de rìzi ma?
lines.english: And did they live happily ever after just like that?

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 唉，沒那麼簡單。天帝知道了以後，氣得叫王母娘娘把織女抓回天上，還把她關了起來。牛郎找來找去，總算在天上某個神祕的地方找到了織女。沒想到王母娘娘卻在他們中間變出一條銀河，讓他們只能遠遠地看著對方。
lines.simplified: 唉，没那么简单。天帝知道了以后，气得叫王母娘娘把织女抓回天上，还把她关了起来。牛郎找来找去，总算在天上某个神秘的地方找到了织女。没想到王母娘娘却在他们中间变出一条银河，让他们只能远远地看着对方。
lines.pinyin: Ài, méi nàme jiǎndān. Tiāndì zhīdào le yǐhòu, qì de jiào Wángmǔ Niángniang bǎ Zhīnǚ zhuā huí tiānshàng, hái bǎ tā guān le qǐlái. Niúláng zhǎoláizhǎoqù, zǒngsuàn zài tiānshàng mǒu ge shénmì de dìfāng zhǎodào le Zhīnǚ. Méi xiǎngdào Wángmǔ Niángniang què zài tāmen zhōngjiān biànchū yì tiáo Yínhé, ràng tāmen zhǐ néng yuǎnyuǎn de kàn zhe duìfāng.
lines.english: Alas, it wasn't so simple. When the Heavenly Emperor found out, he was furious and ordered the Queen Mother of the West to drag Weaver Girl back to heaven and lock her up. Niulang searched everywhere and finally found Weaver Girl in a mysterious place in heaven. Unexpectedly, the Queen Mother conjured up the Milky Way between them, allowing them only to gaze at each other from afar.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 織女不能跟牛郎聚在一起，也不能在人間住下去，真可憐。
lines.simplified: 织女不能跟牛郎聚在一起，也不能在人间住下去，真可怜。
lines.pinyin: Zhīnǚ bù néng gēn Niúláng jù zài yìqǐ, yě bù néng zài rénjiān zhù xiàqù, zhēn kělián.
lines.english: Weaver Girl couldn't be together with Niulang, nor could she live on in the mortal world; how pitiful.

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 還好姊姊們很同情她，好幾次請求王母娘娘幫忙。王母娘娘仔細觀察了兩人的情況，終於被他們的愛情感動了，答應讓他們在每年的農曆七月初七見面。有人說，七夕年年都會下雨，那就是織女流下的眼淚。
lines.simplified: 还好姐姐们很同情她，好几次请求王母娘娘帮忙。王母娘娘仔细观察了两人的情况，终于被他们的爱情感动了，答应让他们在每年的农历七月初七见面。有人说，七夕年年都会下雨，那就是织女流下的眼泪。
lines.pinyin: Háihǎo jiějiěmen hěn tóngqíng tā, hǎojǐ cì qǐngqiú Wángmǔ Niángniang bāngmáng. Wángmǔ Niángniang zǐxì guānchá le liǎng rén de qíngkuàng, zhōngyú bèi tāmen de àiqíng gǎndòng le, dāyìng ràng tāmen zài měinián de nónglì qīyuè chū qī jiànmiàn. Yǒu rén shuō, Qīxī niánnián dōu huì xiàyǔ, nà jiùshì Zhīnǚ liúxià de yǎnlèi.
lines.english: Fortunately her sisters sympathized with her and begged the Queen Mother repeatedly for help. The Queen Mother closely observed the couple's devotion and was finally moved by their love, granting them permission to meet every year on the seventh day of the seventh lunar month. Some say that it rains every year on Qixi, and that is Weaver Girl shedding tears.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 幸虧有姊姊們的幫助，要不然他們一生都不能團圓了。
lines.simplified: 幸亏有姐姐们的帮助，要不然他们一生都不能团圆了。
lines.pinyin: Xìngkuī yǒu jiějiěmen de bāngzhù, yàobùrán tāmen yìshēng dōu bù néng tuányuán le.
lines.english: Fortunately they had the sisters' help, otherwise they would never have reunited in their entire lives.

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 可是一年只能見一次面，這樣的結局讓我很難過。
lines.simplified: 可是一年只能见一次面，这样的结局让我很难过。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì yì nián zhǐ néng jiàn yí cì miàn, zhèyàng de jiéjú ràng wǒ hěn nánguò.
lines.english: But meeting only once a year—such an ending makes me sad.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 怎麼說呢？
lines.simplified: 怎么说呢？
lines.pinyin: Zěnme shuō ne?
lines.english: Why do you say that?

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 我女朋友畢業後就要出國念書，我擔心兩個人分開太久，關係就變淡了。
lines.simplified: 我女朋友毕业后就要出国念书，我担心两个人分开太久，关系就变淡了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ nǚpéngyǒu bìyè hòu jiù yào chūguó niànshū, wǒ dānxīn liǎng ge rén fēnkāi tài jiǔ, guānxì jiù biàn dàn le.
lines.english: My girlfriend is going abroad to study after graduation. I worry that being apart too long will cause our relationship to fade.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 別擔心，現在網路這麼方便，隨時都能聊天、傳照片，距離再遠也沒問題。
lines.simplified: 别担心，现在网络这么方便，随时都能聊天、传照片，距离再远也没问题。
lines.pinyin: Bié dānxīn, xiànzài wǎnglù zhème fāngbiàn, suíshí dōu néng liáotiān, chuán zhàopiàn, jùlí zài yuǎn yě méi wèntí.
lines.english: Don't worry. The internet is so convenient now; you can chat and send photos anytime. No matter how far the distance, it won't be a problem.

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 沒問題倒是沒問題，不過遠距離的戀愛還是很辛苦的。
lines.simplified: 没问题倒是没问题，不过远距离的恋爱还是很辛苦的。
lines.pinyin: Méi wèntí dàoshì méi wèntí, bùguò yuǎnjùlí de liàn'ài háishì hěn xīnkǔ de.
lines.english: No problem is true enough, but a long-distance relationship is still very tough.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 別想那麼多了，你還是說說跟七夕有關的習俗吧。
lines.simplified: 别想那么多了，你还是说说跟七夕有关的习俗吧。
lines.pinyin: Bié xiǎng nàme duō le, nǐ háishì shuōshuo gēn Qīxī yǒuguān de xísú ba.
lines.english: Don't overthink it; why not tell me about customs related to Qixi instead?

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 好吧。七夕那天，當月亮升起時，就會有拜織女的活動。因為織女織布的技巧很好，能織出漂亮的衣服和美麗的雲。人間的姑娘希望能像她那樣又聰明又漂亮，就會用一些親手做的東西來拜她。
lines.simplified: 好吧。七夕那天，当月亮升起时，就会有拜织女的活动。因为织女织布的技巧很好，能织出漂亮的衣服和美丽的云。人间的小姑娘希望能像她那样又聪明又漂亮，就会用一些亲手做的小东西来拜她。
lines.pinyin: Hǎoba. Qīxī nà tiān, dāng yuèliàng shēngqǐ shí, jiù huì yǒu bài Zhīnǚ de huódòng. Yīnwèi Zhīnǚ zhībù de jìqiǎo hěn hǎo, néng zhīchū piàoliang de yīfú hé měilì de yún. Rénjiān de gūniáng xīwàng néng xiàng tā nàyàng yòu cōngmíng yòu piàoliang, jiù huì yòng yìxiē qīnshǒu zuò de xiǎo dōngxī lái bài tā.
lines.english: All right. On Qixi day, when the moon rises, there are activities honoring Weaver Girl. Because Weaver Girl's weaving skill was superb, able to weave beautiful clothes and splendid clouds. Girls in the mortal world hoping to be clever and lovely like her would worship her with handmade items.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 你女朋友在七夕送你這個親手做的錢包，原來有特別的意義啊！
lines.simplified: 你女朋友在七夕送你这个亲手做的钱包，原来有特别的意义啊！
lines.pinyin: Nǐ nǚpéngyǒu zài Qīxī sòng nǐ zhège qīnshǒu zuò de qiánbāo, yuánlái yǒu tèbié de yìyì a!
lines.english: So your girlfriend giving you this handmade wallet on Qixi carries a special meaning after all!

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: The Story of the Double Seventh Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day)
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Starting to explain/narrate from a specific point
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Explain origins or multi-faceted backgrounds by starting at an appropriate context or timeline.
grammarPages.explanation: 本課對話中使用「（這）就要從……說起了」，表示說話者提到的某件事，沒辦法簡單說清楚，得從某個角度、部分或時間開始說，才能讓聽者明白。這個「說」可換成「看、做、寫、找、談、講、聊」等單音節動詞，表示開始做那件事。假如前句已提到主題，就不需用「這/那」。
grammarPages.pattern: (這) + 就要從 + Source + V + 起了

columns.meaning: the Cowherd and the Weaver Girl

text.traditional: 這就要從牛郎、織女說起了。……
text.simplified: 这就要从牛郎、织女说起了。……
text.pinyin: Zhè jiùyào cóng Niúláng, Zhīnǚ shuōqǐ le.…
text.english: It has to start from the Cowherd and the Weaver Girl…

words.meaning: the Cowherd and the Weaver Girl

text.traditional: 這個計畫一再地調整內容，想找到舊資料的話，就要從兩年前的找起了。
text.simplified: 这个计画一再地调整内容，想找到旧资料的话，就要从两年前的找起了。
text.pinyin: Zhège jìhuà yízàidì tiáozhěng nèiróng, xiǎng zhǎodào jiù zīliào de huà, jiùyào cóng liǎng nián qián de zhǎoqǐ le.
text.english: This plan has been adjusted again and again. If you want old data, you have to start looking from two years ago.

text.traditional:
A：我花了很多錢去健身房運動，怎麼過了三個月還沒變瘦？
B：這就要從你的飲食習慣說起了。要是你不改掉愛吃零食的壞習慣，怎麼瘦得下來呢？
text.simplified:
A：我花了很多钱去健身房运动，怎么过了三个月还没变瘦？
B：这就要从你的饮食习惯说起了。要是你不改掉爱吃零食的坏习惯，怎么瘦得下来呢？
text.pinyin:
A: wǒ huāle hěn duō qián qù jiànshēnfáng yùndòng, zěnme guòle sān ge yuè hái méi biànshòu?
B: zhè jiùyào cóng nǐ de yǐnshí xíguàn shuōqǐ le. yàoshi nǐ bù gǎidiào ài chī língshí de huài xíguàn, zěnme shòu de xiàlai ne?
text.english: A: I spent a lot of money going to the gym, why have I not lost weight after three months? B: That is where we start: your eating habits. If you do not give up your bad habit of loving snacks, how can you lose weight?

words.meaning: I spent a lot of money
go to the gym to exercise
how three months have already passed

words.pinyin: ài chī língshí de huài xíguàn

items.question: Which verb can replace 說 in this pattern?
items.answer: A single-syllable verb such as 看、做、寫、找、談、講、聊. A two-syllable verb such as 說明 does not fit.
items.wrongTraditional: 這就要從他說明了。
items.wrongSimplified: 这就要从他说明了。

right.traditional: 這就要從他講起了。
right.simplified: 这就要从他讲起了。
right.pinyin: Zhè jiùyào cóng tā jiǎng qǐ le.
right.english: That is where we start, with him.

items.question: Which ending does this pattern use?
items.answer: The pattern ends in 起了, as in 說起了, not 起來.
items.wrongTraditional: 這就要從他說起來。
items.wrongSimplified: 这就要从他说起来。

right.traditional: 這就要從他說起了。
right.simplified: 这就要从他说起了。
right.pinyin: Zhè jiùyào cóng tā shuōqǐ le.
right.english: That is where we start, with him.

segments.traditional: 你們這個節日背後應該有故事吧？
segments.simplified: 你们这个节日背后应该有故事吧？

segments.hint: this is where the story starts

tiles.meaning: this is where it all starts from

questions.correctFeedback: Good. 這就要從……說起了 introduces where a story background begins.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 這就要從 to start explaining from the origin of the festival.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: In the dialogue in this lesson, （這）就要從……說起了 means that something mentioned by the speaker cannot be easily stated clearly. You must start from a certain angle, part or time to make the listener understand. “Speak” can be replaced with a single-syllable verb such as “see, do, write, find, discuss, speak, chat”, which means to begin that action. If the subject is mentioned in the previous sentence, “this/that” is not necessary.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: The Story of the Double Seventh Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day)
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express continuation of an ongoing activity or the feasibility of persevering with it.
grammarPages.explanation: 「下去」放在動詞之後，當作補語，表示某個動作繼續進行，「V下去」後面不可加賓語。
grammarPages.pattern: Verb + 下去 / 得下去 / 不下去

text.traditional: 織女不能跟牛郎聚在一起，也不能在人間住下去，真可憐。
text.simplified: 织女不能跟牛郎聚在一起，也不能在人间住下去，真可怜。
text.pinyin: Zhīnǚ bù néng gēn Niúláng jù zài yìqǐ, yě bù néng zài rénjiān zhù xiàqu, zhēn kělián.
text.english: The Weaver Girl could not be together with the Cowherd, and could not keep living in the human world either. How pitiful.

text.traditional: 這部電影很無聊，演員的演戲技巧也不好，我實在看不下去了。
text.simplified: 这部电影很无聊，演员的演戏技巧也不好，我实在看不下去了。
text.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng hěn wúliáo, yǎnyuán de yǎnxì jìqiǎo yě bù hǎo, wǒ shízài kàn bu xiàqu le.
text.english: This film is so boring, and the actors acting skills are poor too. I really cannot keep watching it.

text.traditional:
A：總統給你們的任務很危險，你們能堅持下去嗎？
B：我們是軍人，為了國家，就算犧牲生命也必須完成。
text.simplified:
A：总统给你们的任务很危险，你们能坚持下去吗？
B：我们是军人，为了国家，就算牺牲生命也必须完成。
text.pinyin:
A: zǒngtǒng gěi nǐmen de rènwu hěn wéixiǎn, nǐmen néng jiānchí xiàqu ma?
B: wǒmen shì jūnrén, wèile guójiā, jiùsuàn xīshēng shēngmìng yě bìxū wánchéng.
text.english: A: The task the president gave you is very dangerous. Can you keep going? B: We are soldiers; for the country, we must complete it even if we sacrifice our lives.

words.meaning: the task the president gave you
even if we sacrifice our lives

items.question: Can an object follow 「V下去」?
items.answer: No. No object can be added after 「V下去」.
items.wrongTraditional: 你們能堅持下去這份工作嗎？
items.wrongSimplified: 你们能坚持下去这份工作吗？

right.traditional: 你們能堅持下去嗎？
right.simplified: 你们能坚持下去吗？
right.pinyin: Nǐmen néng jiānchí xiàqu ma?
right.english: Can you keep going?

items.question: What do 得 and 不 change in 看得下去 and 看不下去?
items.answer: 得 means one can keep going; 不 means one cannot keep going.
items.wrongTraditional: 這部電影很無聊，我看得下去。
items.wrongSimplified: 这部电影很无聊，我看得下去。

right.traditional: 這部電影很無聊，我實在看不下去了。
right.simplified: 这部电影很无聊，我实在看不下去了。
right.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng hěn wúliáo, wǒ shízài kàn bu xiàqu le.
right.english: This film is so boring, I really cannot keep watching it.

segments.traditional: 這部電影太無聊了，我實在
segments.simplified: 这部电影太无聊了，我实在

questions.correctFeedback: Good. 看不下去 means you can no longer keep watching.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 看不下去 when you cannot keep watching a film.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 下去 is placed after the verb and used as a complement to indicate that a certain action continues. No object can be added after “V 下去”.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: The Story of the Double Seventh Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day)
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Explain how a lucky circumstance prevented a terrible outcome from happening.
grammarPages.explanation: 「幸虧」是副詞，後面敘述某個因為很幸運而發生的事件，要是沒有這個事件，「要不然」後面不好的、擔心的情況就會出現。
grammarPages.pattern: 幸虧 + Fortunate event, + 要不然 + Negative outcome

columns.traditional: 他們一生都不能團圓了
columns.simplified: 他们一生都不能团圆了
columns.pinyin: tāmen yìshēng dōu bù néng tuányuán le
columns.meaning: could never be reunited in their lifetime
she did not go that day
the police were right by the road

columns.pinyin: tā de mìng jiù méi le

text.traditional: 幸虧有姊姊們的幫助，要不然他們一生都不能團圓了。
text.simplified: 幸亏有姐姐们的帮助，要不然他们一生都不能团圆了。
text.pinyin: Xìngkuī yǒu jiějiemen de bāngzhù, yàobùrán tāmen yìshēng dōu bù néng tuányuán le.
text.english: Luckily the older sisters helped; otherwise they could never have been reunited in their lifetime.

text.traditional: 奶奶天天去拜拜的那座寺廟前天忽然塌了，幸虧她那天沒去，要不然就糟了。
text.simplified: 奶奶天天去拜拜的那座寺庙前天忽然塌了，幸亏她那天没去，要不然就糟了。
text.pinyin: Nǎinai tiāntiān qù bàibai de nà zuò sìmiào qiántiān hūrán tā le, xìngkuī tā nà tiān méi qù, yàobùrán jiù zāo le.
text.english: The temple Grandma visited every day collapsed the day before. Luckily she did not go that day; otherwise it would have been bad.

words.traditional: 奶奶天天去拜拜的那座寺廟
words.simplified: 奶奶天天去拜拜的那座寺庙
words.pinyin: nǎinai tiāntiān qù bàibai de nà zuò sìmiào
words.meaning: the temple Grandma visited every day
she did not go that day

text.traditional: 錢先生發生嚴重車禍時，幸虧警察就在路邊，趕快把他送到了醫院，要不然他的命就沒了。
text.simplified: 钱先生发生严重车祸时，幸亏警察就在路边，赶快把他送到了医院，要不然他的命就没了。
text.pinyin: Qián xiānsheng fāshēng yánzhòng chēhuò shí, xìngkuī jǐngchá jiù zài lùbiān, gǎnkuài bǎ tā sòngdào le yīyuàn, yàobùrán tā de mìng jiù méi le.
text.english: When Mr. Qian had a serious car accident, luckily a police officer was right by the road and quickly took him to the hospital; otherwise his life would have been gone.

words.traditional: 錢先生發生嚴重車禍時
words.simplified: 钱先生发生严重车祸时
words.pinyin: Qián xiānsheng fāshēng yánzhòng chēhuò shí
words.meaning: when Mr. Qian had a serious car accident
the police were right by the road

words.pinyin: gǎnkuài bǎ tā sòngdào le yīyuàn
words.meaning: quickly took him to the hospital

words.pinyin: tā de mìng jiù méi le

items.question: Can 幸虧 introduce a bad event?
items.answer: No. 幸虧 introduces a fortunate event; the bad result comes after 要不然.
items.wrongTraditional: 幸虧他沒帶傘，要不然就淋濕了。
items.wrongSimplified: 幸亏他没带伞，要不然就淋湿了。

right.traditional: 幸虧他帶了傘，要不然就淋濕了。
right.simplified: 幸亏他带了伞，要不然就淋湿了。
right.pinyin: Xìngkuī tā dài le sǎn, yàobùrán jiù lín shī le.
right.english: Luckily he brought an umbrella; otherwise he would be soaked.

items.question: What does 要不然 introduce?
items.answer: The bad outcome that would have happened without the lucky event.
items.wrongTraditional: 幸虧他帶了傘，要不然衣服很乾淨。
items.wrongSimplified: 幸亏他带了伞，要不然衣服很干净。

right.traditional: 幸虧他帶了傘，要不然衣服就濕了。
right.simplified: 幸亏他带了伞，要不然衣服就湿了。
right.pinyin: Xìngkuī tā dài le sǎn, yàobùrán yīfu jiù shī le.
right.english: Luckily he brought an umbrella; otherwise his clothes would be wet.

words.meaning: then the clothes would be wet

segments.traditional: 我帶了傘，要不然衣服全都淋濕了。
segments.simplified: 我带了伞，要不然衣服全都淋湿了。

questions.correctFeedback: Good. 幸虧 introduces a fortunate event that prevented a bad result.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 幸虧 to express that a lucky action avoided a bad outcome.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 幸虧 is an adverb. The statement after 幸虧 describes an event that happened because of luck. If there is no such event, the bad and worrisome situation behind 要不然 will appear.

items.title: Grammar 4–5 · The Meaning of Chinese Valentine's Day

dialogue.title: 短文 · 情人節的意義
grammarFocus: 按照 / 按 / 照 NP + V

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 根據中國古代的說法，農曆七月初七是所謂的「七夕」。一提到七夕，人們就會想到牛郎和織女的愛情故事。這個故事不是真的，不過大家對愛情還是有無窮的想像，希望在現實中能夠擁有最美好的愛情。
lines.simplified: 根据中国古代的说法，农历七月初七是所谓的「七夕」。一提到七夕，人们就会想到牛郎和织女的爱情故事。这个故事不是真的，不过大家对爱情还是有无穷的想像，希望在现实中能够拥有最美好的爱情。
lines.pinyin: Gēnjù Zhōngguó gǔdài de shuōfǎ, nónglì qīyuè chū qī shì suǒwèi de "Qīxī". Yì tídào Qīxī, rénmen jiù huì xiǎngdào Niúláng hé Zhīnǚ de àiqíng gùshì. Zhège gùshì búshì zhēn de, bùguò dàjiā duì àiqíng háishì yǒu wúqióng de xiǎngxiàng, xīwàng zài xiànshí zhōng nénggòu yǒngyǒu zuì měihǎo de àiqíng.
lines.english: According to ancient Chinese accounts, the seventh day of the seventh lunar month is known as "Qixi". Whenever Qixi is mentioned, people think of the love story of Niulang and Weaver Girl. While this tale is not true, people still harbor boundless imagination for romance, hoping to possess the finest love in reality.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 按照過去的習俗，姑娘會在七夕把親手做的小東西送給朋友，向對方表達心意。後來，商人抓到了這個能創造更多利益的機會，就在七夕和西方情人節這兩個節日，推銷屬於情人節的特別禮物。不僅戀愛中的男女願意花錢買，平時只有以網路聊天、寫信等方式談戀愛的情侶，也會在這天送禮。但是某一些商業廣告強調，情人節交換禮物是愛對方的表現，也是情侶之間該有的責任。讓很多人以為不送禮、不約會是個錯誤，而犯了錯的人就得道歉。其實只要對情人是真心的，送不送禮物沒那麼重要，畢竟單純的愛情才是最珍貴的。
lines.simplified: 按照过去的习俗，姑娘会在七夕把亲手做的小东西送给朋友，向对方表达心意。后来，商人抓到了这个能创造更多利益的机会，就在七夕和西方情人节这两个节日，推销属于情人节的特别礼物。不仅恋爱中的男女愿意花钱买，平时只有以网络聊天、写信等方式谈恋爱的情侣，也会在这天送礼。但是某一些商业广告强调，情人节交换礼物是爱对方的表现，也是情侣之间该有的责任。让很多人以为不送礼、不约会是个错误，而犯了错的人就得道歉。其实只要对情人是真心的，送不送礼物没那么重要，毕竟单纯的爱情才是最珍贵的。
lines.pinyin: Ànzhào guòqù de xísú, gūniáng huì zài Qīxī bǎ qīnshǒu zuò de xiǎo dōngxī sòng gěi péngyǒu, xiàng duìfāng biǎodá xīnyì. Hòulái, shāngrén zhuādào le zhège néng chuàngzào gèng duō lìyì de jīhuì, jiù zài Qīxī hé xīfāng Qíngrénjié zhè liǎng ge jiérì, tuīxiāo shǔyú Qíngrénjié de tèbié lǐwù. Bùjǐn liàn'ài zhōng de nánnǚ yuànyì huāqián mǎi, píngshí zhǐyǒu yǐ wǎnglù liáotiān, xiěxìn děng fāngshì tán liàn'ài de qínglǚ, yě huì zài zhè tiān sònglǐ. Dànshì mǒu yìxiē shāngyè guǎnggào qiángdiào, Qíngrénjié jiāohuàn lǐwù shì ài duìfāng de biǎoxiàn, yě shì qínglǚ zhījiān gāi yǒu de zérèn. Ràng hěn duō rén yǐwéi bú sònglǐ, bú yuēhuì shì ge cuòwù, ér fàn le cuò de rén jiù děi dàoqiàn. Qíshí zhǐyào duì qíngrén shì zhēnxīn de, sòng bu sòng lǐwù méi nàme zhòngyào, bìjìng dānchún de àiqíng cái shì zuì zhēnguì de.
lines.english: According to past customs, young maidens would give handmade trinkets to friends on Qixi to express their affection. Later, merchants seized upon this opportunity to create greater profits, promoting special Valentine gifts during both Qixi and Western Valentine's Day. Not only were courting couples eager to spend money, but long-distance lovers who usually interacted only by online chatting and letters would also send gifts on this day. However, certain commercial advertisements emphasized that exchanging gifts on Valentine's Day proves one's love and is an obligation between lovers. This led many to believe that not giving gifts or going on dates is a misstep requiring an apology. In reality, as long as one is sincere toward their beloved, whether gifts are given is not so critical—after all, pure love is what is truly precious.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 不過話說回來，像牛郎與織女這樣的愛情故事，還是感動了無數人。不少文學與戲劇都採用這類的題材，畫家也常透過作品來表達浪漫的愛情。如能花點時間欣賞這方面的作品，或許就能更深入了解情人節的意義了。
lines.simplified: 不过话说回来，像牛郎与织女这样的爱情故事，还是感动了无数人。不少文学与戏剧都采用这类的题材，画家也常透过作品来表达浪漫的爱情。如能花点时间欣赏这方面的作品，或许就能更深入了解情人节的意义了。
lines.pinyin: Bùguò huàshuōhuílái, xiàng Niúláng yǔ Zhīnǚ zhèyàng de àiqíng gùshì, háishì gǎndòng le wúshù rén. Bùshǎo wénxué yǔ xìjù dōu cǎiyòng zhè lèi de tícái, huàjiā yě cháng tòuguò zuòpǐn lái biǎodá làngmàn de àiqíng. Rú néng huā diǎn shíjiān xīnshǎng zhè fāngmiàn de zuòpǐn, huòxǔ jiù néng gèng shēnrù liǎojiě Qíngrénjié de yìyì le.
lines.english: Then again, love stories like Niulang and Weaver Girl still touch countless hearts. Many literary works and dramas adopt themes of this kind, and painters frequently convey romantic love through their art. If one can take some time to appreciate works in this domain, perhaps one will gain a deeper understanding of Valentine's true meaning.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: The Meaning of Chinese Valentine's Day
grammarPages.titleEnglish: According to / Based on (basis or evidence)
grammarPages.learnerPromise: State the authoritative premise, survey data, law, or evidence underlying a claim or judgment.
grammarPages.explanation: 「根據」是介詞，意思是用某個行為、情況、資料、研究結果等當作基礎，做出判斷、行動或結論。「根據」的後面接名詞短語，常使用的名詞如：報告、調查、經驗、法律、規定、情況、了解、看法、結果、說明等等。
grammarPages.pattern: 根據 + Basis (Source / Law / Report / Survey), + Claim
